picture.alt: A sunny campus: a girl and a boy sit side by side on a wooden bench laid along wide outdoor stone steps in front of a school building, with green trees behind them. The girl (left) has short wavy brown hair and round glasses, a white shirt under a purple vest, olive-green trousers and a backpack on her back; she is talking and looking at the boy, one open hand held out toward him. The boy (right) has black hair, an open green shirt over a red striped T-shirt and black trousers; he smiles at her, one hand behind him at his waist and the other resting on his knee. A black bag stands on the bench beside him. Nobody is holding hands.

Big sister,

They hold each other's hands between them; she smiles and looks up at him as if they are talking. Behind them, other couples dance as dark shadows on a shiny floor. There are no photos or writing on the walls.

passage.traditional: 上個星期六晚上，我第一次跟一個在網路上認識的女生約會。我們先去夜市，吃了很多好吃的東西，照了很多照片。走了一個晚上，她說腳有點{1}，我們就在夜市旁邊的咖啡廳坐了{2}。我很{3}，不知道要跟她說什麼。她看我不說話，就跟我開了一個{4}，我們兩個人都笑了。那天我們玩得很開心，我希望下次還能跟她約會。
passage.simplified: 上个星期六晚上，我第一次跟一个在网路上认识的女生约会。我们先去夜市，吃了很多好吃的东西，照了很多照片。走了一个晚上，她说脚有点{1}，我们就在夜市旁边的咖啡厅坐了{2}。我很{3}，不知道要跟她说什么。她看我不说话，就跟我开了一个{4}，我们两个人都笑了。那天我们玩得很开心，我希望下次还能跟她约会。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíliù wǎnshàng, wǒ dì yī cì gēn yí ge zài wǎnglù shàng rènshì de nǚshēng yuēhuì. Wǒmen xiān qù yèshì, chī le hěn duō hǎochī de dōngxi, zhào le hěn duō zhàopiàn. Zǒu le yí ge wǎnshàng, tā shuō jiǎo yǒudiǎn téng, wǒmen jiù zài yèshì pángbiān de kāfēitīng zuò le yíxià. Wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, bù zhīdào yào gēn tā shuō shénme. Tā kàn wǒ bù shuōhuà, jiù gēn wǒ kāi le yí ge wánxiào, wǒmen liǎng ge rén dōu xiào le. Nà tiān wǒmen wán de hěn kāixīn, wǒ xīwàng xià cì hái néng gēn tā yuēhuì.
passage.english: Last Saturday evening I went on a first date with a girl I met online. We went to the night market first, ate lots of tasty food and took lots of photos. After walking all evening, she said her feet hurt a little, so we sat for a while in the café next to the night market. I was very nervous and didn't know what to say to her. When she saw I wasn't talking, she made a joke, and we both laughed. We had a great time that day, and I hope I can go on another date with her.

questions.why: 腳有點疼: after walking all evening her feet hurt a little, so they sat down.
坐了一下: V + 一下 is a short action, they sat for a little while.
我很緊張，不知道要說什麼: on a first date he is nervous and can't think what to say.
開玩笑 splits around 一個: 開了一個玩笑, she made a joke and they laughed.

passage.traditional: 這個學期，我住在學校的{1}。我的同學個性很好，常常帶我去吃台灣小吃，她說台灣小吃不但好吃，也不貴。有一天，她介紹了一個好朋友{2}我認識。上個週末天氣很好，我們三個人一起去騎腳踏車。騎{3}以後，我們在公園休息了{4}，一邊喝飲料，一邊聊天。我覺得能認識這兩個朋友，我真的很幸運。
passage.simplified: 这个学期，我住在学校的{1}。我的同学个性很好，常常带我去吃台湾小吃，她说台湾小吃不但好吃，也不贵。有一天，她介绍了一个好朋友{2}我认识。上个周末天气很好，我们三个人一起去骑脚踏车。骑{3}以后，我们在公园休息了{4}，一边喝饮料，一边聊天。我觉得能认识这两个朋友，我真的很幸运。
passage.pinyin: Zhège xuéqí, wǒ zhù zài xuéxiào de sùshè. Wǒ de tóngxué gèxìng hěn hǎo, chángcháng dài wǒ qù chī Táiwān xiǎochī, tā shuō Táiwān xiǎochī búdàn hǎochī, yě bú guì. Yǒu yì tiān, tā jièshào le yí ge hǎo péngyǒu gěi wǒ rènshì. Shàng ge zhōumò tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen sān ge rén yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē. Qí wán yǐhòu, wǒmen zài gōngyuán xiūxí le yíxià, yìbiān hē yǐnliào, yìbiān liáotiān. Wǒ juéde néng rènshì zhè liǎng ge péngyǒu, wǒ zhēn de hěn xìngyùn.
passage.english: This semester I live in the school dorm. My classmate has a great personality and often takes me to eat Taiwanese snacks; she says they're not only tasty but also cheap. One day she introduced a good friend to me. Last weekend the weather was lovely, and the three of us went bike riding together. After riding, we rested a while in the park, drinking and chatting. I feel really lucky to know these two friends.

questions.why: 住在學校的宿舍: the place she lives at school is the dorm.

休息了一下: V + 一下 is a short rest, a little while.

text.traditional: 我的妹妹是小學生，個性很害羞。上個週末，我帶她去動物園。看到小羊的時候，她很害怕，不敢摸，一直站在我後面。後來看到別的小孩都在摸，她也去摸了一下。雖然她只摸了一下，可是回家的時候，她一直說下次還要去。
text.simplified: 我的妹妹是小学生，个性很害羞。上个周末，我带她去动物园。看到小羊的时候，她很害怕，不敢摸，一直站在我后面。后来看到别的小孩都在摸，她也去摸了一下。虽然她只摸了一下，可是回家的时候，她一直说下次还要去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de mèimei shì xiǎoxuéshēng, gèxìng hěn hàixiū. Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ dài tā qù dòngwùyuán. Kàndào xiǎo yáng de shíhòu, tā hěn hàipà, bù gǎn mō, yìzhí zhàn zài wǒ hòumiàn. Hòulái kàndào biéde xiǎohái dōu zài mō, tā yě qù mō le yíxià. Suīrán tā zhǐ mō le yíxià, kěshì huí jiā de shíhòu, tā yìzhí shuō xià cì hái yào qù.
text.english: My little sister is in elementary school and is very shy. Last weekend I took her to the zoo. When she saw the lambs she was scared, didn't dare touch them, and stayed behind me the whole time. Then she saw other kids touching them, so she went and touched one too. Although she only touched it for a moment, on the way home she kept saying she wants to go again next time.

text.traditional:

謝謝妳那天告訴我的辦法！我請她跟她的朋友一起來參加舞會，她真的來了。她不但很會跳舞，也很愛開玩笑。舞會結束以後，我們還在學校裡散步。我很想趕快再跟她約會，可是不知道去哪裡好。妳可以幫我想一想嗎？

美心：
谢谢你那天告诉我的办法！我请她跟她的朋友一起来参加舞会，她真的来了。她不但很会跳舞，也很爱开玩笑。舞会结束以后，我们还在学校里散步。我很想赶快再跟她约会，可是不知道去哪里好。你可以帮我想一想吗？

text.pinyin:
Měixīn:
Xièxie nǐ nà tiān gàosu wǒ de bànfǎ! Wǒ qǐng tā gēn tā de péngyǒu yìqǐ lái cānjiā wǔhuì, tā zhēn de lái le. Tā búdàn hěn huì tiàowǔ, yě hěn ài kāiwánxiào. Wǔhuì jiéshù yǐhòu, wǒmen hái zài xuéxiào lǐ sànbù. Wǒ hěn xiǎng gǎnkuài zài gēn tā yuēhuì, kěshì bù zhīdào qù nǎlǐ hǎo. Nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ xiǎng yì xiǎng ma?

Thanks for the idea you told me the other day! I asked her to come to the dance party with her friends, and she really came. She not only dances well but also loves to joke. After the party we took a walk around campus. I really want to go on another date with her soon, but I don't know where to go. Could you help me think about it?

text.traditional:
最近天氣很冷，感冒的人很多，請大家注意：
一、出去的時候，最好戴口罩。
二、吃東西以前，最好先洗手。
三、發燒或是一直咳嗽的人，最好先去看醫生。看完醫生以後，不要自己來藥局拿藥，請打電話給我們，我們會送藥給您。
時間：每天上午九點到晚上十點
text.simplified:
最近天气很冷，感冒的人很多，请大家注意：
一、出去的时候，最好戴口罩。
二、吃东西以前，最好先洗手。
三、发烧或是一直咳嗽的人，最好先去看医生。看完医生以后，不要自己来药局拿药，请打电话给我们，我们会送药给您。
时间：每天上午九点到晚上十点
text.pinyin:
Zuìjìn tiānqì hěn lěng, gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, qǐng dàjiā zhùyì:
Yī, chūqù de shíhòu, zuìhǎo dài kǒuzhào.
Èr, chī dōngxi yǐqián, zuìhǎo xiān xǐ shǒu.
Sān, fāshāo huòshì yìzhí késòu de rén, zuìhǎo xiān qù kàn yīshēng. Kàn wán yīshēng yǐhòu, búyào zìjǐ lái yàojú ná yào, qǐng dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒmen, wǒmen huì sòng yào gěi nín.
Shíjiān: Měi tiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn
text.english:
It's been cold lately and many people have colds. Please note:
1. When you go out, you'd better wear a mask.
2. Before eating, you'd better wash your hands first.
3. If you have a fever or keep coughing, you'd better see a doctor first. After seeing the doctor, don't come to the drugstore for your medicine yourself: call us and we will bring the medicine to you.
Hours: every day, 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.

versions.alt: A printed notice taped on the glass door of a small neighbourhood pharmacy

prompt.traditional: 發燒的人看完醫生以後，應該怎麼做？

prompt.pinyin: Fāshāo de rén kàn wán yīshēng yǐhòu, yīnggāi zěnme zuò?

choices.english: Phone the drugstore.
Go to the drugstore for the medicine.
Wear a mask and go buy medicine.

choices.pinyin: Zài qù kàn yí cì yīshēng.
choices.english: See the doctor once more.

questions.why: 看完醫生以後，不要自己來藥局拿藥，請打電話給我們: after the doctor, a sick person phones the drugstore and it brings the medicine. Coming to the shop yourself is exactly what it asks people not to do, and the doctor has already been seen.

text.traditional: 我是從越南來的大學生，在台灣住了兩年了。雖然我很喜歡打籃球，可是還沒看過籃球比賽。上個星期，我的台灣同學買了兩張比賽的票，本來要跟他哥哥一起去，可是他哥哥那天剛好要上班，所以同學就送給我一張，我們一起去了。那天人很多，很熱鬧，我們看得很愉快。
text.simplified: 我是从越南来的大学生，在台湾住了两年了。虽然我很喜欢打篮球，可是还没看过篮球比赛。上个星期，我的台湾同学买了两张比赛的票，本来要跟他哥哥一起去，可是他哥哥那天刚好要上班，所以同学就送给我一张，我们一起去了。那天人很多，很热闹，我们看得很愉快。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì cóng Yuènán lái de dàxuéshēng, zài Táiwān zhù le liǎng nián le. Suīrán wǒ hěn xǐhuān dǎ lánqiú, kěshì hái méi kàn guo lánqiú bǐsài. Shàng ge xīngqí, wǒ de Táiwān tóngxué mǎi le liǎng zhāng bǐsài de piào, běnlái yào gēn tā gēge yìqǐ qù, kěshì tā gēge nà tiān gānghǎo yào shàngbān, suǒyǐ tóngxué jiù sòng gěi wǒ yì zhāng, wǒmen yìqǐ qù le. Nà tiān rén hěn duō, hěn rènao, wǒmen kàn de hěn yúkuài.

Last week my Taiwanese classmate bought two tickets to a game. He was going to go with his older brother, but his brother happened to have to work that day, so my classmate gave one ticket to me and we went together. It was crowded and lively, and we had a great time.

choices.pinyin: Tā zìjǐ shàngwǎng mǎi le piào.
choices.english: The student bought a ticket online.

choices.pinyin: Tā lánqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
choices.english: The student plays basketball well.

questions.why: 本來要跟他哥哥一起去，可是他哥哥那天剛好要上班，所以同學就送給我一張: the brother couldn't go, so the classmate gave the student his ticket. The ticket came from the classmate, not the brother, and the student didn't buy one.

text.traditional: 我哥哥大學畢業以後，在一家銀行工作。他說銀行的工作很辛苦，可是同事都很好。他每天早上八點上班，可是常常七點半就到辦公室了，因為他不喜歡遲到。下了班以後，他還去學日文，因為他希望以後能去日本工作。
text.simplified: 我哥哥大学毕业以后，在一家银行工作。他说银行的工作很辛苦，可是同事都很好。他每天早上八点上班，可是常常七点半就到办公室了，因为他不喜欢迟到。下了班以后，他还去学日文，因为他希望以后能去日本工作。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, zài yì jiā yínháng gōngzuò. Tā shuō yínháng de gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì tóngshì dōu hěn hǎo. Tā měi tiān zǎoshàng bā diǎn shàngbān, kěshì chángcháng qī diǎn bàn jiù dào bàngōngshì le, yīnwèi tā bù xǐhuān chídào. Xià le bān yǐhòu, tā hái qù xué Rìwén, yīnwèi tā xīwàng yǐhòu néng qù Rìběn gōngzuò.
text.english: After graduating from university, my older brother started working at a bank. He says bank work is hard, but his colleagues are all nice. He starts work at eight every morning, but he often gets to the office at seven thirty, because he doesn't like being late. After work he also studies Japanese, because he hopes to work in Japan one day.

prompt.traditional: 哥哥常常幾點到辦公室？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥常常几点到办公室？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge chángcháng jǐ diǎn dào bàngōngshì?
prompt.english: What time does the brother usually get to the office?

choices.english: Seven.
Seven thirty.
Eight.
Eight thirty.

questions.why: 八點上班 is when work starts, but 常常七點半就到辦公室了: 就 shows he is there early, at half past seven.

text.traditional: 我們本來打算這個週末去合歡山看雪，可是前幾天下了大雨，去合歡山的路壞了，不能開車上山，所以後來決定去日月潭。我們要先坐高鐵，再搭公車去日月潭，坐公車要一個多小時。我們打算在那裡住一個晚上，星期天下午再回台北。
text.simplified: 我们本来打算这个周末去合欢山看雪，可是前几天下了大雨，去合欢山的路坏了，不能开车上山，所以后来决定去日月潭。我们要先坐高铁，再搭公车去日月潭，坐公车要一个多小时。我们打算在那里住一个晚上，星期天下午再回台北。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái dǎsuàn zhège zhōumò qù Héhuān Shān kàn xuě, kěshì qián jǐ tiān xià le dà yǔ, qù Héhuān Shān de lù huài le, bù néng kāichē shàng shān, suǒyǐ hòulái juédìng qù Rìyuè Tán. Wǒmen yào xiān zuò gāotiě, zài dā gōngchē qù Rìyuè Tán, zuò gōngchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí. Wǒmen dǎsuàn zài nàlǐ zhù yí ge wǎnshàng, xīngqítiān xiàwǔ zài huí Táiběi.
text.english: We had planned to go to Hehuan Mountain this weekend to see the snow, but it rained heavily a few days ago and the road to Hehuan Mountain is damaged, so cars can't drive up. In the end we decided to go to Sun Moon Lake. We'll take the high-speed rail first and then a bus, which takes a bit over an hour. We plan to stay one night there and come back to Taipei on Sunday afternoon.

prompt.traditional: 他們後來為什麼決定去日月潭？
prompt.simplified: 他们后来为什么决定去日月潭？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen hòulái wèishénme juédìng qù Rìyuè Tán?
prompt.english: Why did they decide to go to Sun Moon Lake in the end?

choices.english: There's no snow on Hehuan Mountain.

choices.pinyin: Rìyuè Tán lí gāotiě zhàn hěn jìn.
choices.english: Sun Moon Lake is close to the high-speed rail station.

choices.traditional: 上合歡山的路不能走了
choices.simplified: 上合欢山的路不能走了
choices.pinyin: Shàng Héhuān Shān de lù bù néng zǒu le.
choices.english: The road up Hehuan Mountain can't be used.

choices.traditional: 他們想在日月潭住一晚
choices.simplified: 他们想在日月潭住一晚
choices.pinyin: Tāmen xiǎng zài Rìyuè Tán zhù yì wǎn.
choices.english: They want to stay a night at Sun Moon Lake.

questions.why: 去合歡山的路壞了，不能開車上山，所以後來決定去日月潭: the plan changed because the mountain road can't be used. Snow was why they first wanted to go, the bus ride from the train is over an hour (not close), and staying a night is the new plan, not its reason.

title.pinyin: Gěi zhù zài sùshè de tóngxué
title.english: To everyone living in the dorm

text.traditional:
最近常常有人把垃圾放在房間門口和樓梯上，請大家注意：
一、不要把垃圾放在房間門口。
二、每天晚上十點以前，請把垃圾拿到一樓的垃圾桶。
三、星期六早上九點，大家一起打掃樓梯。
text.simplified:
最近常常有人把垃圾放在房间门口和楼梯上，请大家注意：
一、不要把垃圾放在房间门口。
二、每天晚上十点以前，请把垃圾拿到一楼的垃圾桶。
三、星期六早上九点，大家一起打扫楼梯。
text.pinyin:
Zuìjìn chángcháng yǒu rén bǎ lèsè fàng zài fángjiān ménkǒu hé lóutī shàng, qǐng dàjiā zhùyì:
Yī, búyào bǎ lèsè fàng zài fángjiān ménkǒu.
Èr, měi tiān wǎnshàng shí diǎn yǐqián, qǐng bǎ lèsè ná dào yī lóu de lèsè tǒng.
Sān, xīngqíliù zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn, dàjiā yìqǐ dǎsǎo lóutī.
text.english:
Lately people keep leaving garbage at their room doors and on the stairs. Please note:
1. Don't leave garbage at your room door.
2. Every evening before ten, please take your garbage to the trash cans on the first floor.
3. Saturday at 9 a.m., everyone cleans the stairs together.

versions.alt: A printed notice taped on a dormitory hallway wall beside a staircase

prompt.traditional: 住在宿舍的同學，晚上應該怎麼做？

Take the garbage downstairs.
Clean the stairs together.

questions.why: 請把垃圾拿到一樓的垃圾桶 every evening before ten: the garbage goes down to the first floor. Leaving it at the door is what the notice asks people to stop, and cleaning the stairs is on Saturday morning.

focus.en: take the garbage down to the first floor

passage.traditional: 開學以後，我每天都很忙，已經兩個星期沒打掃房間了。我的房間裡{1}都是書和衣服，桌子上還有沒吃完的東西。昨天晚上，我在床上看見了兩隻{2}，真不舒服。媽媽以前常常告訴我，房間要每天打掃，住在裡面的人{3}會覺得舒服。所以今天我很早就起床，先把髒衣服都{4}了，再把地掃一掃。
passage.simplified: 开学以后，我每天都很忙，已经两个星期没打扫房间了。我的房间里{1}都是书和衣服，桌子上还有没吃完的东西。昨天晚上，我在床上看见了两只{2}，真不舒服。妈妈以前常常告诉我，房间要每天打扫，住在里面的人{3}会觉得舒服。所以今天我很早就起床，先把脏衣服都{4}了，再把地扫一扫。
passage.pinyin: Kāixué yǐhòu, wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn máng, yǐjīng liǎng ge xīngqí méi dǎsǎo fángjiān le. Wǒ de fángjiān lǐ dàochù dōu shì shū hé yīfu, zhuōzi shàng hái yǒu méi chī wán de dōngxi. Zuótiān wǎnshàng, wǒ zài chuáng shàng kànjiàn le liǎng zhī chóngzi, zhēn bù shūfu. Māma yǐqián chángcháng gàosu wǒ, fángjiān yào měi tiān dǎsǎo, zhù zài lǐmiàn de rén cái huì juéde shūfu. Suǒyǐ jīntiān wǒ hěn zǎo jiù qǐchuáng, xiān bǎ zāng yīfu dōu xǐ le, zài bǎ dì sǎo yì sǎo.
passage.english: Since school started I've been busy every day, and I haven't cleaned my room for two weeks. There are books and clothes everywhere in my room, and leftover food on the desk. Last night I saw two bugs on my bed, which was really unpleasant. Mom always used to tell me a room should be cleaned every day; only then do the people living in it feel comfortable. So today I got up early, washed all my dirty clothes first, and then swept the floor.

questions.why: 到處都是…: books and clothes are everywhere in the messy room.
兩隻蟲子: 隻 counts animals and bugs, and he saw two of them on his bed.
房間要每天打掃，住在裡面的人才會覺得舒服: 才 brings in the result that comes only when the condition is met.
把 + thing + V了: 把髒衣服都洗了, he washed all the dirty clothes before sweeping the floor.

passage.traditional: 今年暑假，我跟家人去花蓮玩了一個星期。回家的時候，一打開門，就覺得味道很{1}。原來出門以前，哥哥忘了把廚房的窗戶{2}了，桌子上的水果也都壞了，到處都是小蟲子。那天晚上，我們{3}都沒吃，大家先一起打掃了兩個小時。媽媽說，下次出門以前，一定要先把桌子上的水果吃完，家裡{4}不會有蟲子。
passage.simplified: 今年暑假，我跟家人去花莲玩了一个星期。回家的时候，一打开门，就觉得味道很{1}。原来出门以前，哥哥忘了把厨房的窗户{2}了，桌子上的水果也都坏了，到处都是小虫子。那天晚上，我们{3}都没吃，大家先一起打扫了两个小时。妈妈说，下次出门以前，一定要先把桌子上的水果吃完，家里{4}不会有虫子。
passage.pinyin: Jīnnián shǔjià, wǒ gēn jiārén qù Huālián wán le yí ge xīngqí. Huí jiā de shíhòu, yì dǎkāi mén, jiù juéde wèidào hěn chòu. Yuánlái chūmén yǐqián, gēge wàng le bǎ chúfáng de chuānghù guān le, zhuōzi shàng de shuǐguǒ yě dōu huài le, dàochù dōu shì xiǎo chóngzi. Nà tiān wǎnshàng, wǒmen shénme dōu méi chī, dàjiā xiān yìqǐ dǎsǎo le liǎng ge xiǎoshí. Māma shuō, xià cì chūmén yǐqián, yídìng yào xiān bǎ zhuōzi shàng de shuǐguǒ chī wán, jiā lǐ cái bú huì yǒu chóngzi.
passage.english: This summer vacation my family and I spent a week in Hualien. When we got home and opened the door, it smelled awful. It turned out that before we left, my older brother had forgotten to close the kitchen window; the fruit on the table had gone bad, and there were little bugs everywhere. That night none of us ate anything; we all cleaned together for two hours first. Mom says next time we have to finish the fruit on the table before we leave; only then won't there be bugs at home.

questions.why: 味道很臭: after a week away, the bad fruit made the house smell awful.
把 + thing + V了: 把窗戶關了, close the window. He forgot to, so bugs came in.
什麼都沒吃: a question word + 都 + 沒 means "nothing at all"; they cleaned before eating anything.
先把桌子上的水果吃完，家裡才不會有蟲子: only when the fruit is finished first will there be no bugs.

text.traditional: 昨天弟弟沒去上課，他說他頭很痛，想在家休息。媽媽覺得他可能感冒了，可是他沒發燒，也不咳嗽，晚飯還吃了兩碗，功課也都寫完了。晚上媽媽問了他很久，他才說，他是因為把同學的小說丟了，才不敢去學校的。
text.simplified: 昨天弟弟没去上课，他说他头很痛，想在家休息。妈妈觉得他可能感冒了，可是他没发烧，也不咳嗽，晚饭还吃了两碗，功课也都写完了。晚上妈妈问了他很久，他才说，他是因为把同学的小说丢了，才不敢去学校的。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān dìdi méi qù shàngkè, tā shuō tā tóu hěn tòng, xiǎng zài jiā xiūxí. Māma juéde tā kěnéng gǎnmào le, kěshì tā méi fāshāo, yě bù késòu, wǎnfàn hái chī le liǎng wǎn, gōngkè yě dōu xiě wán le. Wǎnshàng māma wèn le tā hěn jiǔ, tā cái shuō, tā shì yīnwèi bǎ tóngxué de xiǎoshuō diū le, cái bù gǎn qù xuéxiào de.
text.english: Yesterday my little brother didn't go to school; he said he had a bad headache and wanted to rest at home. Mom thought he might have a cold, but he had no fever, wasn't coughing, ate two bowls at dinner, and had finished all his homework. In the evening Mom asked him for a long time before he said that he had lost a classmate's novel, and that was the only reason he hadn't dared go to school.

prompt.traditional: 弟弟昨天為什麼沒去上課？
prompt.simplified: 弟弟昨天为什么没去上课？
prompt.pinyin: Dìdi zuótiān wèishénme méi qù shàngkè?
prompt.english: Why didn't the little brother go to school yesterday?

choices.pinyin: Tā de tóu tòng de bù néng qù.
choices.english: His head hurt too much to go.
He had a cold and a fever.

choices.pinyin: Tā de gōngkè hái méi xiě wán.
choices.english: He hadn't finished his homework.

choices.pinyin: Tā diū le tóngxué de xiǎoshuō.
choices.english: He had lost a classmate's novel.

questions.why: 他是因為把同學的小說丟了，才不敢去學校的: losing a classmate's novel is the real reason. The headache was only his excuse, there was no fever or cough, and his homework was all done.

text.traditional: 我很喜歡看小說，可是房間太小，書太多，沒有地方放。上個月，我把一些小說送給了對面鄰居的兒子。鄰居說，以前她每天都叫兒子念書，可是他什麼書都不想看。後來是因為看了我送的小說，他才開始喜歡看書。
text.simplified: 我很喜欢看小说，可是房间太小，书太多，没有地方放。上个月，我把一些小说送给了对面邻居的儿子。邻居说，以前她每天都叫儿子念书，可是他什么书都不想看。后来是因为看了我送的小说，他才开始喜欢看书。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xiǎoshuō, kěshì fángjiān tài xiǎo, shū tài duō, méiyǒu dìfāng fàng. Shàng ge yuè, wǒ bǎ yìxiē xiǎoshuō sòng gěi le duìmiàn línjū de érzi. Línjū shuō, yǐqián tā měi tiān dōu jiào érzi niànshū, kěshì tā shénme shū dōu bù xiǎng kàn. Hòulái shì yīnwèi kàn le wǒ sòng de xiǎoshuō, tā cái kāishǐ xǐhuān kàn shū.
text.english: I love reading novels, but my room is too small and I have too many books, so there's nowhere to put them. Last month I gave some novels to my neighbor's son across the hall. My neighbor says she used to tell her son to study every day, but he didn't want to read any book at all. It was only after reading the novels I gave him that he started to like reading.

prompt.traditional: 這個人為什麼把小說送給鄰居的兒子？
prompt.simplified: 这个人为什么把小说送给邻居的儿子？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén wèishénme bǎ xiǎoshuō sòng gěi línjū de érzi?
prompt.english: Why did the writer give novels to the neighbor's son?

choices.traditional: 他的房間沒有地方放書
choices.simplified: 他的房间没有地方放书
choices.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān méiyǒu dìfāng fàng shū.
choices.english: His room has no space for books.

choices.pinyin: Línjū de érzi hěn ài kàn shū.
choices.english: The neighbor's son loves reading.

choices.pinyin: Línjū qǐng tā sòng yìxiē shū.
choices.english: The neighbor asked him for some books.

choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bú ài kàn xiǎoshuō le.
choices.english: He no longer likes novels.

questions.why: 可是房間太小，書太多，沒有地方放: there is no space for the books, so he gave some away. He still loves novels, the neighbor never asked for books, and her son did not like reading at the time (什麼書都不想看).

text.traditional: 我們家有四個人，每個人都得做一件家事：爸爸做飯，媽媽洗衣服，我擦桌子，弟弟倒垃圾。可是洗碗這件事，我們誰都不想做。後來媽媽說，吃飯吃得最慢的人得洗碗。爸爸做的菜很好吃，以前我們都吃得很慢，可是現在大家都吃得很快。
text.simplified: 我们家有四个人，每个人都得做一件家事：爸爸做饭，妈妈洗衣服，我擦桌子，弟弟倒垃圾。可是洗碗这件事，我们谁都不想做。后来妈妈说，吃饭吃得最慢的人得洗碗。爸爸做的菜很好吃，以前我们都吃得很慢，可是现在大家都吃得很快。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā yǒu sì ge rén, měi ge rén dōu děi zuò yí jiàn jiāshì: bàba zuò fàn, māma xǐ yīfu, wǒ cā zhuōzi, dìdi dào lèsè. Kěshì xǐ wǎn zhè jiàn shì, wǒmen shéi dōu bù xiǎng zuò. Hòulái māma shuō, chī fàn chī de zuì màn de rén děi xǐ wǎn. Bàba zuò de cài hěn hǎochī, yǐqián wǒmen dōu chī de hěn màn, kěshì xiànzài dàjiā dōu chī de hěn kuài.
text.english: There are four of us at home, and each has one chore: Dad cooks, Mom does the laundry, I wipe the table, and my little brother takes out the garbage. But washing the dishes is something none of us wants to do. Then Mom said the slowest eater has to wash up. Dad's cooking is delicious and we used to eat slowly, but now everyone eats fast.

prompt.traditional: 現在他們家的人為什麼吃飯吃得很快？
prompt.simplified: 现在他们家的人为什么吃饭吃得很快？
prompt.pinyin: Xiànzài tāmen jiā de rén wèishénme chī fàn chī de hěn kuài?
prompt.english: Why does the family eat fast now?

choices.traditional: 他們都不想當洗碗的人
choices.simplified: 他们都不想当洗碗的人
choices.pinyin: Tāmen dōu bù xiǎng dāng xǐ wǎn de rén.
choices.english: None of them wants to be the one who washes up.

choices.traditional: 他們都很喜歡爸爸做的菜
choices.simplified: 他们都很喜欢爸爸做的菜
choices.pinyin: Tāmen dōu hěn xǐhuān bàba zuò de cài.
choices.english: They all love Dad's cooking.

choices.traditional: 他們吃完飯都得做家事
choices.simplified: 他们吃完饭都得做家事
choices.pinyin: Tāmen chī wán fàn dōu děi zuò jiāshì.

choices.traditional: 弟弟吃完飯得去倒垃圾
choices.simplified: 弟弟吃完饭得去倒垃圾
choices.pinyin: Dìdi chī wán fàn děi qù dào lèsè.
choices.english: The little brother has to take out the garbage after dinner.

questions.why: 洗碗這件事，我們誰都不想做, and the slowest eater has to wash up, so nobody wants to be last. They do love Dad's cooking, but that is why they used to eat slowly, and nothing says the chores come right after dinner (Dad cooks before it).

text.traditional: 我是從高雄來台北念大學的。開學第一天，我在宿舍誰也不認識，晚飯也不知道要去哪裡吃。後來，住在我對面的同學來找我，帶我去學校附近的夜市。她說那裡的東西什麼都好吃，可是我那天只喝了一碗湯。現在我們常常一起去吃晚飯。
text.simplified: 我是从高雄来台北念大学的。开学第一天，我在宿舍谁也不认识，晚饭也不知道要去哪里吃。后来，住在我对面的同学来找我，带我去学校附近的夜市。她说那里的东西什么都好吃，可是我那天只喝了一碗汤。现在我们常常一起去吃晚饭。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì cóng Gāoxióng lái Táiběi niàn dàxué de. Kāixué dì yī tiān, wǒ zài sùshè shéi yě bú rènshì, wǎnfàn yě bù zhīdào yào qù nǎlǐ chī. Hòulái, zhù zài wǒ duìmiàn de tóngxué lái zhǎo wǒ, dài wǒ qù xuéxiào fùjìn de yèshì. Tā shuō nàlǐ de dōngxi shénme dōu hǎochī, kěshì wǒ nà tiān zhǐ hē le yì wǎn tāng. Xiànzài wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
text.english: I came from Kaohsiung to Taipei for university. On the first day of school I knew nobody in the dorm and didn't even know where to go for dinner. Then the student living across from me came over and took me to the night market near school. She said everything there is tasty, but that day I only had a bowl of soup. Now we often have dinner together.

text.traditional: 我的鄰居是一位老太太，她一個人住。她的個性很溫柔，不但對我們很客氣，也常常做包子送給我們吃。上個星期她背疼，不能出門，我就幫她去附近的藥局買藥。她說，能有我們這樣的鄰居，她覺得很幸運。
text.simplified: 我的邻居是一位老太太，她一个人住。她的个性很温柔，不但对我们很客气，也常常做包子送给我们吃。上个星期她背疼，不能出门，我就帮她去附近的药局买药。她说，能有我们这样的邻居，她觉得很幸运。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de línjū shì yí wèi lǎo tàitai, tā yí ge rén zhù. Tā de gèxìng hěn wēnróu, búdàn duì wǒmen hěn kèqì, yě chángcháng zuò bāozi sòng gěi wǒmen chī. Shàng ge xīngqí tā bèi téng, bù néng chūmén, wǒ jiù bāng tā qù fùjìn de yàojú mǎi yào. Tā shuō, néng yǒu wǒmen zhèyàng de línjū, tā juéde hěn xìngyùn.
text.english: My neighbor is an old lady who lives alone. She's gentle; she is not only polite to us but also often makes steamed buns for us. Last week her back hurt and she couldn't go out, so I went to a nearby pharmacy to buy medicine for her. She says she feels lucky to have neighbors like us.

prompt.traditional: 這位老太太怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 这位老太太怎么样？

choices.english: The old lady lives with her family.

choices.english: Her back often hurts.

choices.simplified: 老太太上个星期没办法出门

questions.why: 上個星期她背疼，不能出門: last week her back kept her at home. She lives alone (一個人住), the medicine was bought for her (not by her), and it was her back that hurt, not the writer's.

text.traditional: 我家離學校很近，走路十分鐘就到了。我姐姐的公司離家很遠，她每天得先坐公車到捷運站，再坐四十分鐘的捷運，一共要一個多小時。所以姐姐每天早上六點就起床了，我七點半才起來。週末的時候，她都在家休息，哪裡都不去。
text.simplified: 我家离学校很近，走路十分钟就到了。我姐姐的公司离家很远，她每天得先坐公车到捷运站，再坐四十分钟的捷运，一共要一个多小时。所以姐姐每天早上六点就起床了，我七点半才起来。周末的时候，她都在家休息，哪里都不去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Wǒ jiějie de gōngsī lí jiā hěn yuǎn, tā měi tiān děi xiān zuò gōngchē dào jiéyùn zhàn, zài zuò sìshí fēnzhōng de jiéyùn, yígòng yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí. Suǒyǐ jiějie měi tiān zǎoshàng liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le, wǒ qī diǎn bàn cái qǐlái. Zhōumò de shíhòu, tā dōu zài jiā xiūxí, nǎlǐ dōu bú qù.
text.english: My home is very close to school: ten minutes on foot. My older sister's office is far from home. Every day she first takes a bus to the MRT station, then rides the MRT for forty minutes, over an hour in all. So she gets up at six every morning, while I don't get up until half past seven. On weekends she rests at home and goes nowhere.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?

choices.simplified: 姐姐的公司离她家只有十分钟
choices.pinyin: Jiějie de gōngsī lí tā jiā zhǐ yǒu shí fēnzhōng.
choices.english: The sister's office is only ten minutes from home.

choices.traditional: 姐姐到公司一共要四十分鐘
choices.simplified: 姐姐到公司一共要四十分钟
choices.pinyin: Jiějie dào gōngsī yígòng yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
choices.english: The sister's trip to work takes forty minutes in all.

choices.traditional: 姐姐每天比這個人早起床
choices.simplified: 姐姐每天比这个人早起床
choices.pinyin: Jiějie měi tiān bǐ zhège rén zǎo qǐchuáng.
choices.english: The sister gets up earlier than the writer every day.

choices.traditional: 姐姐週末常常跟朋友出去玩

questions.why: 姐姐每天早上六點就起床了，我七點半才起來: six is earlier than half past seven. Ten minutes is the writer's walk to school, her whole trip (bus, then forty minutes on the MRT) is over an hour, and on weekends she stays home (哪裡都不去).

picture.alt: Daytime, sunny. The view is from an apartment's open front door into a bright living room. In the doorway on the left stand two young people: a young man with black hair, an open green shirt over a red striped T-shirt, black trousers and a black backpack, his hands in his pockets; and next to him a young woman with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings, a blue jacket over an orange top, wide white trousers and a black bag on her shoulder. Both smile at an older woman who stands inside the apartment facing them: her hair is in a bun and she wears a mustard-yellow cardigan over a long dark-green dress; she smiles, holds one open hand toward them and stretches her other arm out toward the rooms, inviting them in. Her hands are empty. Behind her is the living room: a white sofa with a yellow and a blue cushion, a low wooden table in front of it with a small plant and a book on it, a lamp with a white shade, a tall green plant, a framed picture on the wall and a big window with city buildings outside. There is no television and no bookshelf. On the right, through a wide opening, is the kitchen: a tall white refrigerator, wooden cupboards, a wooden table with chairs and a lamp hanging from the ceiling. Nobody is sitting down.

lines.simplified: 第一天我们在旅馆休息，晚上去夜市吃东西。第二天太鲁阁不能去，我们就在海边的咖啡厅一边喝咖啡，一边看海。
lines.pinyin: Dì yī tiān wǒmen zài lǚguǎn xiūxí, wǎnshàng qù yèshì chī dōngxi. Dì èr tiān Tàilǔgé bù néng qù, wǒmen jiù zài hǎibiān de kāfēitīng yìbiān hē kāfēi, yìbiān kàn hǎi.
lines.english: On the first day we rested at the hotel and went to the night market for food in the evening. On the second day we couldn't go to Taroko, so we sat in a café by the sea, drinking coffee and watching the sea.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的第二天做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的第二天做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de dì èr tiān zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the woman do on the second day?

choices.english: Rested at the hotel.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Ate at the night market.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Walked around Taroko.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Watched the sea from a café.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 第二天……一邊喝咖啡，一邊看海: on the second day they sat in a café by the sea, drinking coffee and watching the sea. The hotel and the night market were the first day, and Taroko was out because of the rain.

prompt.traditional: 住這間公寓，除了房租，每個月還要付什麼？
prompt.simplified: 住这间公寓，除了房租，每个月还要付什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhù zhè jiān gōngyù, chúle fángzū, měi ge yuè hái yào fù shénme?
prompt.english: Living in this apartment, what else do you pay every month besides the rent?

choices.english: The water bill.
The electricity bill.
The deposit.

questions.why: The rent includes water and the internet but not electricity (不包括電費), so the electricity bill is paid on top of it every month. The deposit is paid once, not every month.

prompt.simplified: 房租最多一万元，也要有洗衣机，应该租哪里的房子？

prompt.english: With a rent of at most 10,000 a month and a washing machine, which place should you rent?

choices.english: Near the MRT station.
Across from the school.
Next to the park.

questions.why: Only the place near the MRT station has both: a washing machine and rent under 10,000 (8,500). The one across from the school has a washing machine but costs 12,000; the one by the park is cheap but has no washing machine.

text.traditional:
姐姐：
我已經把洗衣機裡的衣服拿出來，掛在外面了。昨天洗的衣服都乾了，妳的放在妳的床上，我的拿回我房間去了。晚上見！
妹妹
text.simplified:
姐姐：
我已经把洗衣机里的衣服拿出来，挂在外面了。昨天洗的衣服都干了，你的放在你的床上，我的拿回我房间去了。晚上见！
妹妹
text.pinyin:
Jiějie:
Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ xǐyījī lǐ de yīfu ná chūlái, guà zài wàimiàn le. Zuótiān xǐ de yīfu dōu gān le, nǐ de fàng zài nǐ de chuáng shàng, wǒ de ná huí wǒ fángjiān qù le. Wǎnshàng jiàn!
Mèimei
text.english:
Big sister,
I've taken the clothes out of the washing machine and hung them up outside. Yesterday's washing is all dry: I put yours on your bed and took mine back to my room. See you tonight!
Your little sister

prompt.traditional: 已經乾了的衣服，姐姐的在哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 已经干了的衣服，姐姐的在哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Yǐjīng gān le de yīfu, jiějie de zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Of the clothes that are already dry, where are the older sister's?

choices.english: Hanging outside.
In the younger sister's room.

choices.pinyin: Zài tā zìjǐ de chuáng shàng.
choices.english: On her own bed.

questions.why: 昨天洗的衣服都乾了，妳的放在妳的床上: of the dry washing, the older sister's is on her bed. The clothes taken out of the machine today (把……拿出來) are the ones hanging outside, and only the younger sister's dry clothes went back to her room.

focus.zh: 把衣服拿出來，掛在外面
focus.en: take the clothes out and hang them up

text.traditional:
張先生：
今天上午郵局送來一個袋子，是寄給您的，很重。本來想放在您家門口，可是怕不安全，所以我先把袋子拿回我家來了。您晚上回來以後，可以過來拿，或是打電話給我，我幫您送過去。
房東
text.simplified:
张先生：
今天上午邮局送来一个袋子，是寄给您的，很重。本来想放在您家门口，可是怕不安全，所以我先把袋子拿回我家来了。您晚上回来以后，可以过来拿，或是打电话给我，我帮您送过去。
房东
text.pinyin:
Zhāng xiānshēng:
Jīntiān shàngwǔ yóujú sòng lái yí ge dàizi, shì jì gěi nín de, hěn zhòng. Běnlái xiǎng fàng zài nín jiā ménkǒu, kěshì pà bù ānquán, suǒyǐ wǒ xiān bǎ dàizi ná huí wǒ jiā lái le. Nín wǎnshàng huílái yǐhòu, kěyǐ guòlái ná, huòshì dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ, wǒ bāng nín sòng guòqù.
Fángdōng
text.english:
Mr. Zhang,
This morning the post office delivered a bag addressed to you. It's heavy. I was going to leave it at your door, but I was afraid it wasn't safe, so for now I've taken it back to my place. When you get home tonight, you can come over for it, or call me and I'll bring it over to you.
Your landlord

prompt.traditional: 張先生的袋子現在在哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 张先生的袋子现在在哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Zhāng xiānshēng de dàizi xiànzài zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where is Mr. Zhang's bag now?

choices.english: At the post office.
At the landlord's home.
At his door.

questions.why: 我先把袋子拿回我家來了: the landlord thought of leaving the bag at Mr. Zhang's door but took it back to the landlord's own home instead. It goes to him only when he comes for it or calls.

focus.en: took the bag back to my place

versions.alt: Daytime, a sunny bedroom. A young man and a young woman stand in the middle of the room. The young man (left) has black hair, an open green shirt over a red striped T-shirt, black trousers and a black backpack; he holds an open brown wallet in one hand, touches his chin with the other as if thinking, and looks at the young woman. The young woman (right) has long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings, a blue jacket over an orange top, wide white trousers and a black bag on her shoulder; she smiles and holds her arm out toward the window and the bed. Right behind the young man stands a big wooden wardrobe with two doors and a plant on top; a picture hangs on the wall at the far left. On the right is a big window with yellow curtains, green trees and tall buildings outside; under the window stands a bed with a blue blanket and white, blue and yellow pillows, and next to it a small bedside table with a lamp and a plant. In front is a wooden desk with a dark-blue chair; on the desk are a blue book, a cup of pens, a plant and a dark-blue desk lamp. Everything looks new and tidy. There is no refrigerator, sofa or bookshelf in the room.

prompt.traditional: 男生站在一個很大的＿＿前面。
prompt.simplified: 男生站在一个很大的＿＿前面。

choices.english: refrigerator
wardrobe
bookshelf

answer.traditional: 男生站在一個很大的衣櫃前面。
answer.simplified: 男生站在一个很大的衣柜前面。
answer.pinyin: Nánshēng zhàn zài yí ge hěn dà de yīguì qiánmiàn.
answer.english: The young man is standing in front of a big wardrobe.

questions.why: Right behind him stands a big wooden wardrobe with two doors (衣櫃). There is no refrigerator or bookshelf in the room.

prompt.traditional: 他拿著錢包想：付了房租以後，錢還＿＿多少？
prompt.simplified: 他拿着钱包想：付了房租以后，钱还＿＿多少？

choices.english: to rent
to collect
to be left over

answer.traditional: 他拿著錢包想：付了房租以後，錢還剩多少？
answer.simplified: 他拿着钱包想：付了房租以后，钱还剩多少？
answer.pinyin: Tā názhe qiánbāo xiǎng: Fù le fángzū yǐhòu, qián hái shèng duōshǎo?
answer.english: Holding his wallet, he wonders: after paying the rent, how much money will be left?

questions.why: 剩 means to be left over: he is working out how much money he will have left after the rent. 租 (to rent) and 收 (to collect) don't make sense after 錢還.

prompt.traditional: 床和書桌＿＿都很新。
prompt.simplified: 床和书桌＿＿都很新。

choices.english: to look (seem)
to feel when sat on
to feel to live in

answer.traditional: 床和書桌看起來都很新。
answer.simplified: 床和书桌看起来都很新。
answer.pinyin: Chuáng hé shūzhuō kànqǐlái dōu hěn xīn.
answer.english: The bed and the desk both look new.

questions.why: 看起來 + comment says how something looks: being new is something you see, so the bed and the desk 看起來都很新. 坐起來 and 住起來 tell how sitting on or living in something feels, not whether it is new.

prompt.traditional: 女生覺得房東＿＿臥室打掃得很乾淨。
prompt.simplified: 女生觉得房东＿＿卧室打扫得很干净。

choices.english: for (in place of)
for; to
(disposal marker)

answer.traditional: 女生覺得房東把臥室打掃得很乾淨。
answer.simplified: 女生觉得房东把卧室打扫得很干净。
answer.pinyin: Nǚshēng juéde fángdōng bǎ wòshì dǎsǎo de hěn gānjìng.
answer.english: The young woman thinks the landlord has cleaned the bedroom very well.

questions.why: 把 + object + V得 + comment: the landlord cleaned the bedroom, and now it is very clean. 替 and 給 need a person after them, not a room.

prompt.traditional: 女生＿＿男生一起來看房子。
prompt.simplified: 女生＿＿男生一起来看房子。

choices.english: to rent
to accompany
to move

answer.traditional: 女生陪男生一起來看房子。
answer.simplified: 女生陪男生一起来看房子。
answer.pinyin: Nǚshēng péi nánshēng yìqǐ lái kàn fángzi.
answer.english: The young woman has come with the young man to look at the place.

questions.why: 陪 + person: she has come along with him to look at the room. You can't 租 (rent) or 搬 (move) a person here.

prompt.traditional: 窗戶下面有一張大＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 窗户下面有一张大＿＿。

choices.english: bed
sofa
desk

answer.traditional: 窗戶下面有一張大床。
answer.simplified: 窗户下面有一张大床。
answer.pinyin: Chuānghù xiàmiàn yǒu yì zhāng dà chuáng.
answer.english: There is a big bed under the window.

questions.why: Under the big window stands a bed with a blue blanket. The desk is in front, far from the window, and there is no sofa in this room.

passage.traditional: 我現在住在學校的宿舍，房間不大，可是離教室很近。我的室友很晚才睡覺，常常在{1}打電話、聽音樂，聲音很{2}。她也常常把吃剩的東西丟在地上，把房間弄得很{3}，到處都有小蟲子。我跟她說了好幾次，可是她都不聽，所以我決定下個學期搬{4}，到學校外面去租房子。
passage.simplified: 我现在住在学校的宿舍，房间不大，可是离教室很近。我的室友很晚才睡觉，常常在{1}打电话、听音乐，声音很{2}。她也常常把吃剩的东西丢在地上，把房间弄得很{3}，到处都有小虫子。我跟她说了好几次，可是她都不听，所以我决定下个学期搬{4}，到学校外面去租房子。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài zhù zài xuéxiào de sùshè, fángjiān bú dà, kěshì lí jiàoshì hěn jìn. Wǒ de shìyǒu hěn wǎn cái shuìjiào, chángcháng zài bànyè dǎ diànhuà, tīng yīnyuè, shēngyīn hěn chǎo. Tā yě chángcháng bǎ chī shèng de dōngxi diū zài dìshàng, bǎ fángjiān nòng de hěn zāng, dàochù dōu yǒu xiǎo chóngzi. Wǒ gēn tā shuō le hǎojǐ cì, kěshì tā dōu bù tīng, suǒyǐ wǒ juédìng xià ge xuéqí bān chūqù, dào xuéxiào wàimiàn qù zū fángzi.
passage.english: I live in the school dorm now. The room isn't big, but it's close to the classrooms. My roommate goes to bed very late and often makes phone calls and plays music in the middle of the night; it's very noisy. She also often drops leftover food on the floor and makes the room so dirty that there are little bugs everywhere. I've told her many times, but she never listens, so I've decided to move out next semester and rent a place off campus.

questions.why: 很晚才睡覺: she stays up late, so she phones and plays music in the middle of the night (在半夜).

focus.en: in the middle of the night

questions.why: Phone calls and music at midnight: 聲音很吵, it is very noisy.
Food dropped on the floor and bugs everywhere: she makes the room dirty (把房間弄得很髒).
She is leaving the dorm to rent a place outside: 搬出去, move out. 搬進來 would mean moving in.

passage.traditional: 我在{1}上找了很久，看了好幾個地方，最後租了一間離學校不遠的公寓。房東是一位很客氣的太太，我搬家以前，她已經{2}我裝了網路。她說這棟公寓的{3}都很好，常常一起打掃樓梯。我住在五樓，可是這棟公寓沒有電梯，所以搬家那天，我和朋友一起把書桌、書架搬{4}，累了一個下午。
passage.simplified: 我在{1}上找了很久，看了好几个地方，最后租了一间离学校不远的公寓。房东是一位很客气的太太，我搬家以前，她已经{2}我装了网路。她说这栋公寓的{3}都很好，常常一起打扫楼梯。我住在五楼，可是这栋公寓没有电梯，所以搬家那天，我和朋友一起把书桌、书架搬{4}，累了一个下午。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ zài zūwū wǎngzhàn shàng zhǎo le hěn jiǔ, kàn le hǎojǐ ge dìfāng, zuìhòu zū le yì jiān lí xuéxiào bù yuǎn de gōngyù. Fángdōng shì yí wèi hěn kèqì de tàitai, wǒ bānjiā yǐqián, tā yǐjīng tì wǒ zhuāng le wǎnglù. Tā shuō zhè dòng gōngyù de línjū dōu hěn hǎo, chángcháng yìqǐ dǎsǎo lóutī. Wǒ zhù zài wǔ lóu, kěshì zhè dòng gōngyù méiyǒu diàntī, suǒyǐ bānjiā nà tiān, wǒ hé péngyǒu yìqǐ bǎ shūzhuō, shūjià bān shàngqù, lèi le yí ge xiàwǔ.
passage.english: I searched on a rental website for a long time and saw several places, and in the end I rented an apartment not far from school. The landlord is a very kind lady; before I moved in, she had already set up the internet for me. She says the neighbors in this building are all very nice and often clean the stairs together. I live on the fifth floor, but the building has no elevator, so on moving day my friend and I carried the desk and the bookshelf up together. We were tired out by the end of the afternoon.

questions.why: You look for a place to rent on a rental website: 在租屋網站上找.
替 + person + verb: the landlord set up the internet for her before she moved in.

focus.en: set up the internet for me

questions.why: The people who live in the building (鄰居, neighbors) are nice and clean the stairs together.
Fifth floor and no elevator: they carried the desk and the bookshelf up (把……搬上去).

text.traditional: 我跟室友住在學校外面的一間公寓。室友很會做菜，常常做很多好吃的東西請我吃。可是她每次做完飯，都把廚房弄得很亂，碗筷也不洗，總是說明天再洗。上個週末，我們討論了很久，決定以後她做飯，我洗碗。現在廚房乾淨多了，我也常常有好吃的菜可以吃。
text.simplified: 我跟室友住在学校外面的一间公寓。室友很会做菜，常常做很多好吃的东西请我吃。可是她每次做完饭，都把厨房弄得很乱，碗筷也不洗，总是说明天再洗。上个周末，我们讨论了很久，决定以后她做饭，我洗碗。现在厨房干净多了，我也常常有好吃的菜可以吃。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu zhù zài xuéxiào wàimiàn de yì jiān gōngyù. Shìyǒu hěn huì zuò cài, chángcháng zuò hěn duō hǎochī de dōngxi qǐng wǒ chī. Kěshì tā měi cì zuò wán fàn, dōu bǎ chúfáng nòng de hěn luàn, wǎnkuài yě bù xǐ, zǒngshì shuō míngtiān zài xǐ. Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒmen tǎolùn le hěn jiǔ, juédìng yǐhòu tā zuòfàn, wǒ xǐ wǎn. Xiànzài chúfáng gānjìng duō le, wǒ yě chángcháng yǒu hǎochī de cài kěyǐ chī.
text.english: My roommate and I live in an apartment off campus. She's a very good cook and often makes lots of tasty food for me. But every time she finished cooking, she left the kitchen in a mess and didn't wash the dishes, always saying she'd do them tomorrow. Last weekend we talked it over for a long time and decided that from now on she cooks and I wash up. The kitchen is much cleaner now, and I often get good food to eat too.

prompt.traditional: 以前室友做完飯，廚房常常怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 以前室友做完饭，厨房常常怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Yǐqián shìyǒu zuò wán fàn, chúfáng chángcháng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: Before, what was the kitchen usually like after the roommate cooked?

choices.pinyin: Bú luàn, wǎnkuài yě dōu xǐ le.
choices.english: Tidy, and the dishes were all washed.

choices.pinyin: Hěn luàn, kěshì wǎnkuài dōu xǐ le.
choices.english: Messy, but the dishes were washed.

choices.pinyin: Bú luàn, kěshì wǎnkuài méi xǐ.
choices.english: Tidy, but the dishes weren't washed.

choices.pinyin: Hěn luàn, wǎnkuài yě méi xǐ.
choices.english: Messy, and the dishes weren't washed.

questions.why: 她每次做完飯，都把廚房弄得很亂，碗筷也不洗: before, every time she cooked, the kitchen was left in a mess and the dishes stayed dirty. Only now, after their new deal, is the kitchen much cleaner.

focus.en: left the kitchen in a mess

text.traditional: 我哥哥上個月搬家了。他的新房子很大，可是以前住在那裡的人在牆上亂畫，把牆弄得很髒，所以哥哥搬進去以前，得先把牆弄乾淨。哥哥不想自己弄，就請了兩個工人來幫忙。工人工作了兩天，把牆弄得跟新的一樣。現在哥哥很滿意，還請我們去他家吃飯。
text.simplified: 我哥哥上个月搬家了。他的新房子很大，可是以前住在那里的人在墙上乱画，把墙弄得很脏，所以哥哥搬进去以前，得先把墙弄干净。哥哥不想自己弄，就请了两个工人来帮忙。工人工作了两天，把墙弄得跟新的一样。现在哥哥很满意，还请我们去他家吃饭。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shàng ge yuè bānjiā le. Tā de xīn fángzi hěn dà, kěshì yǐqián zhù zài nàlǐ de rén zài qiáng shàng luàn huà, bǎ qiáng nòng de hěn zāng, suǒyǐ gēge bān jìnqù yǐqián, děi xiān bǎ qiáng nòng gānjìng. Gēge bù xiǎng zìjǐ nòng, jiù qǐng le liǎng ge gōngrén lái bāngmáng. Gōngrén gōngzuò le liǎng tiān, bǎ qiáng nòng de gēn xīn de yíyàng. Xiànzài gēge hěn mǎnyì, hái qǐng wǒmen qù tā jiā chīfàn.
text.english: My older brother moved last month. His new place is big, but the people who lived there before had scribbled all over the walls and made them dirty, so before moving in he had to get the walls cleaned. He didn't want to do it himself, so he hired two workers to help. They worked for two days and made the walls as good as new. Now my brother is very happy with it, and he's even invited us over for dinner.

prompt.traditional: 牆是誰弄乾淨的？
prompt.simplified: 墙是谁弄干净的？
prompt.pinyin: Qiáng shì shéi nòng gānjìng de?
prompt.english: Who got the walls clean?

choices.english: The brother himself.
The workers he hired.
The people who lived there before.
The brother and his family.

questions.why: 哥哥不想自己弄，就請了兩個工人來幫忙……工人……把牆弄得跟新的一樣: the workers he hired cleaned the walls. The people who lived there before made them dirty, and the family only comes for dinner afterwards.

focus.en: made the walls as good as new

text.traditional:
時間：這個星期六上午九點到下午五點
電梯有一點問題，這個時間有工人來看，電梯不能用。要出去或是回來的人，請走樓梯。要搬家的人，請星期六晚上或是星期天再搬。有問題請打電話給房東：0921-668-305。給大家帶來不方便，真不好意思！
text.simplified:
时间：这个星期六上午九点到下午五点
电梯有一点问题，这个时间有工人来看，电梯不能用。要出去或是回来的人，请走楼梯。要搬家的人，请星期六晚上或是星期天再搬。有问题请打电话给房东：0921-668-305。给大家带来不方便，真不好意思！
text.pinyin:
Shíjiān: Zhège xīngqíliù shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn dào xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn
Diàntī yǒuyìdiǎn wèntí, zhège shíjiān yǒu gōngrén lái kàn, diàntī bù néng yòng. Yào chūqù huòshì huílái de rén, qǐng zǒu lóutī. Yào bānjiā de rén, qǐng xīngqíliù wǎnshàng huòshì xīngqítiān zài bān. Yǒu wèntí qǐng dǎ diànhuà gěi fángdōng: 0921-668-305. Gěi dàjiā dàilái bù fāngbiàn, zhēn bùhǎoyìsi!
text.english:
Time: this Saturday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
The elevator has a problem. Workers are coming to look at it during this time, so it can't be used. If you are going out or coming back, please take the stairs. If you are moving house, please move on Saturday evening or on Sunday. If you have any questions, please call the landlord: 0921-668-305. We're very sorry for the trouble!

versions.alt: A printed notice taped on the wall right beside the closed elevator doors in an apartment lobby

prompt.traditional: 星期六上午十點，住在八樓的人要出去，應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 星期六上午十点，住在八楼的人要出去，应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Xīngqíliù shàngwǔ shí diǎn, zhù zài bā lóu de rén yào chūqù, yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: At 10 a.m. on Saturday, someone who lives on the 8th floor wants to go out. What should they do?

choices.english: Call the landlord first.
Walk down the stairs.
Go out after five instead.
Go out on Sunday instead.

questions.why: From 9 to 5 on Saturday the elevator can't be used, and 要出去或是回來的人，請走樓梯: anyone going out then walks down the stairs. Nobody is asked to wait until five or Sunday (Sunday is for people moving house), and the phone number is only for questions.

focus.en: people going out take the stairs

text.traditional:
哥哥：
我下課回來，才發現鑰匙忘了帶出來，現在沒辦法進門。我在樓下的便利商店買了一點東西，現在要去對面的咖啡廳坐一下，那裡有冷氣，很舒服。你六點下班，對吧？你回到家以後，打電話給我，我馬上就回去。
妹妹
text.simplified:
哥哥：
我下课回来，才发现钥匙忘了带出来，现在没办法进门。我在楼下的便利商店买了一点东西，现在要去对面的咖啡厅坐一下，那里有冷气，很舒服。你六点下班，对吧？你回到家以后，打电话给我，我马上就回去。
妹妹
text.pinyin:
Gēge:
Wǒ xiàkè huílái, cái fāxiàn yàoshi wàng le dài chūlái, xiànzài méi bànfǎ jìn mén. Wǒ zài lóuxià de biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi le yìdiǎn dōngxi, xiànzài yào qù duìmiàn de kāfēitīng zuò yíxià, nàlǐ yǒu lěngqì, hěn shūfu. Nǐ liù diǎn xiàbān, duì ba? Nǐ huí dào jiā yǐhòu, dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ, wǒ mǎshàng jiù huíqù.
Mèimei
text.english:
Big brother,
When I got back from class, I found I'd forgotten to take my keys with me, so I can't get in. I bought a few things at the convenience store downstairs, and now I'm going to sit in the café across the street for a while; it's air-conditioned and comfortable there. You finish work at six, right? When you get home, call me and I'll come straight back.
Your little sister

prompt.traditional: 哥哥回到家以後，妹妹會怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥回到家以后，妹妹会怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge huí dào jiā yǐhòu, mèimei huì zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What will the younger sister do after her brother gets home?

choices.english: Go shopping at the convenience store.
Phone her brother.
Go to the café to wait for her brother.
Go home from the café.

questions.why: 你回到家以後，打電話給我，我馬上就回去: once her brother is home and calls her, she goes straight back home from the café. It is he who phones her, and the shopping is already done.

text.traditional: 星期六晚上有客人要來我們家吃飯，所以早上媽媽叫大家一起做家事。爸爸把客廳的地掃了，我把碗筷洗了、擦乾了，哥哥去倒垃圾。只有弟弟什麼都沒做，一直在房間裡念書，因為他星期一要考試。媽媽說，考完以後，他得自己把房間打掃乾淨。
text.simplified: 星期六晚上有客人要来我们家吃饭，所以早上妈妈叫大家一起做家事。爸爸把客厅的地扫了，我把碗筷洗了、擦干了，哥哥去倒垃圾。只有弟弟什么都没做，一直在房间里念书，因为他星期一要考试。妈妈说，考完以后，他得自己把房间打扫干净。
text.pinyin: Xīngqíliù wǎnshàng yǒu kèrén yào lái wǒmen jiā chīfàn, suǒyǐ zǎoshàng māma jiào dàjiā yìqǐ zuò jiāshì. Bàba bǎ kètīng de dì sǎo le, wǒ bǎ wǎnkuài xǐ le, cāgān le, gēge qù dào lèsè. Zhǐ yǒu dìdi shénme dōu méi zuò, yìzhí zài fángjiān lǐ niànshū, yīnwèi tā xīngqíyī yào kǎoshì. Māma shuō, kǎo wán yǐhòu, tā děi zìjǐ bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng.
text.english: Guests were coming to our home for dinner on Saturday evening, so in the morning Mom had everyone do housework together. Dad swept the living room floor, I washed and dried the dishes, and my older brother took out the trash. Only my younger brother did nothing at all: he stayed in his room studying because he has an exam on Monday. Mom says that after his exam he has to clean his room himself.

prompt.traditional: 弟弟星期六早上做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 弟弟星期六早上做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Dìdi xīngqíliù zǎoshàng zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the younger brother do on Saturday morning?

choices.english: Prepared for an exam.
Took out the trash.
Swept the living room floor.
Cleaned his own room.

questions.why: 只有弟弟什麼都沒做，一直在房間裡念書，因為他星期一要考試: he did no housework at all and studied for Monday's exam. He cleans his room only after the exam; the floor and the trash were Dad's and the older brother's jobs.

text.traditional: 我姐姐在台北工作。她以前住在公司附近，走路十分鐘就到了，可是房租很貴。去年她搬到離台北比較遠的地方，房租比以前便宜一半，房子也比以前大。雖然現在每天得坐四十分鐘的捷運上班，可是她覺得在捷運上可以看書、聽音樂，也不錯。
text.simplified: 我姐姐在台北工作。她以前住在公司附近，走路十分钟就到了，可是房租很贵。去年她搬到离台北比较远的地方，房租比以前便宜一半，房子也比以前大。虽然现在每天得坐四十分钟的捷运上班，可是她觉得在捷运上可以看书、听音乐，也不错。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zài Táiběi gōngzuò. Tā yǐqián zhù zài gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le, kěshì fángzū hěn guì. Qùnián tā bān dào lí Táiběi bǐjiào yuǎn de dìfāng, fángzū bǐ yǐqián piányí yíbàn, fángzi yě bǐ yǐqián dà. Suīrán xiànzài měitiān děi zuò sìshí fēnzhōng de jiéyùn shàngbān, kěshì tā juéde zài jiéyùn shàng kěyǐ kàn shū, tīng yīnyuè, yě búcuò.
text.english: My older sister works in Taipei. She used to live near her office, a ten-minute walk away, but the rent was high. Last year she moved somewhere farther from Taipei; the rent is half what it was, and the place is bigger too. Although she now takes the MRT for forty minutes to work every day, she thinks it's not bad, since she can read and listen to music on the train.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of the following is true?

choices.traditional: 她現在住得離公司很近
choices.simplified: 她现在住得离公司很近
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài zhù de lí gōngsī hěn jìn.
choices.english: She now lives close to her office.

choices.pinyin: Tā yǐqián de fángzi bǐjiào xiǎo.
choices.english: Her old place was smaller.

choices.traditional: 她現在的房租比以前貴
choices.simplified: 她现在的房租比以前贵
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài de fángzū bǐ yǐqián guì.
choices.english: Her rent is higher than before.

choices.pinyin: Tā zuò jiéyùn yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: Her MRT ride takes an hour.

questions.why: 房子也比以前大: her new place is bigger, so her old one was smaller. Now she lives farther from her office, the rent is half of what it was, and the MRT ride is forty minutes.

picture.alt: A night market after dark: red paper lanterns and lit stalls behind, a crowd and city buildings in the distance. Four young friends lean over a stall counter around a big metal tray of fried stinky tofu (golden tofu cubes with brown sauce, chopped green onion and pickled cabbage), with steam rising from it. From left: a girl with short wavy brown hair and round glasses, a white shirt under a dark-purple vest and a backpack, smiles with her mouth open and holds the tray out toward the others; a boy with black hair, in an open light-green shirt over a red striped T-shirt, leans back with both hands raised, palms out, looking worried; a boy with short spiky black hair, in a dark-blue jacket over a red T-shirt, rests one hand on his chin and smiles as he leans toward the tofu; a girl with long wavy dark hair and hoop earrings, in a bright-blue denim jacket over an orange top and white trousers, smiles and looks at the tofu. Nobody is eating.

lines.traditional: 我的手機呢？我的袋子裡也沒有，是不是放在剛剛那家飲料店了？
lines.simplified: 我的手机呢？我的袋子里也没有，是不是放在刚刚那家饮料店了？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī ne? Wǒ de dàizi lǐ yě méiyǒu, shì bú shì fàng zài gānggāng nà jiā yǐnliào diàn le?
lines.english: Where's my phone? It's not in my bag either. Did I leave it at that drink shop just now?

versions.alt: Evening at a busy night market in front of a temple: the curved, decorated roof of a traditional temple rises behind the stalls against a dark-blue sky, and strings of red lanterns and bare light bulbs hang overhead. In front, at a stall counter with metal trays of diced mango, red beans and a yellow sauce, beside a crate of round yellow-orange fruit, a smiling older man with grey hair, in a white T-shirt and a green apron, hands a bowl of mango shaved ice (white ice heaped with yellow mango cubes, a spoon in it) across the counter to a young woman. She has a long brown ponytail, a light-purple T-shirt and a white cloth bag on her shoulder, and she takes the bowl with both hands, smiling. Behind them shoppers walk along the paved lane between the stalls, and on the right a young man in a grey cap and grey apron grills skewers on a smoking grill with tongs.

answer.english: This shop's mango ice is incredibly good, and lots of people come to buy it.

questions.why: After 得 only 不得了 fits: 好吃得不得了. 極了 joins the adjective directly (好吃極了, no 得), and 越來越 goes before it (越來越好吃).

prompt.traditional: 老闆把一碗＿＿拿給這個女生。
prompt.simplified: 老板把一碗＿＿拿给这个女生。

choices.english: braised pork rice
mango ice
beef noodles

answer.traditional: 老闆把一碗芒果冰拿給這個女生。
answer.simplified: 老板把一碗芒果冰拿给这个女生。
answer.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bǎ yì wǎn mángguǒ bīng ná gěi zhège nǚshēng.
answer.english: The owner hands a bowl of mango ice to the young woman.

questions.why: In the picture the owner is handing her a bowl of shaved ice heaped with mango: 芒果冰. All three come in bowls, but there is no rice or noodles on the counter.

prompt.traditional: 很多紅色的＿＿掛在路的上面。
prompt.simplified: 很多红色的＿＿挂在路的上面。

choices.english: shop sign
flower
light; lantern

answer.traditional: 很多紅色的燈掛在路的上面。
answer.simplified: 很多红色的灯挂在路的上面。
answer.pinyin: Hěn duō hóngsè de dēng guà zài lù de shàngmiàn.
answer.english: Lots of red lanterns hang above the lane.

questions.why: Strings of red lanterns hang above the lane: red 燈. No signs or flowers hang over it.

versions.alt: Evening at a busy night market in front of a temple: the curved, decorated roof of a traditional temple rises behind the stalls against a dark-blue sky, and strings of red lanterns and bare light bulbs hang overhead. In front, at a stall counter with metal trays of diced mango, red beans and a yellow sauce, beside a crate of round yellow-orange fruit, a smiling older man with grey hair, in a white T-shirt and a green apron, hands a bowl of mango shaved ice (white ice heaped with yellow mango cubes, a spoon in it) across the counter to a young woman. She has a long brown ponytail, a light-purple T-shirt and a white cloth bag on her shoulder, and she takes the bowl with both hands, smiling. Behind them shoppers walk along the paved lane between the stalls, and on the right a young man in a grey cap and grey apron grills skewers on a smoking grill with tongs.

prompt.traditional: 老闆的生意好＿＿，一直有人來買。
prompt.simplified: 老板的生意好＿＿，一直有人来买。

choices.english: a bit (briefly)
extremely (right after the adjective)
more and more

answer.traditional: 老闆的生意好極了，一直有人來買。
answer.simplified: 老板的生意好极了，一直有人来买。
answer.pinyin: Lǎobǎn de shēngyì hǎo jíle, yìzhí yǒu rén lái mǎi.
answer.english: The owner's business is excellent; people keep coming to buy.

questions.why: 極了 follows the adjective directly: 好極了. 一下 goes after a verb, not an adjective like 好, and 越來越 comes before the adjective (越來越好).

prompt.traditional: 右邊有一位先生在＿＿東西。
prompt.simplified: 右边有一位先生在＿＿东西。

choices.english: deep-fry
wash
grill

answer.traditional: 右邊有一位先生在烤東西。
answer.simplified: 右边有一位先生在烤东西。
answer.pinyin: Yòubiān yǒu yí wèi xiānshēng zài kǎo dōngxi.
answer.english: On the right a man is grilling food.

questions.why: On the right a man holds skewers on a smoking grill with tongs: he is grilling (烤). Nothing is in hot oil, and he isn't washing anything.

prompt.traditional: 這個女生帶著一個＿＿的袋子。
prompt.simplified: 这个女生带着一个＿＿的袋子。

white
red

answer.simplified: 这个女生带着一个白色的袋子。

answer.english: The young woman is carrying a white bag.

passage.traditional: 我剛來台灣的時候，不太{1}吃台灣菜，也不敢吃臭豆腐。後來，我的台灣室友常常帶我去夜市，還{2}我吃各種小吃，所以我{3}喜歡台灣小吃了，現在臭豆腐我也敢吃了。週末的時候，我們也常常一起去{4}，買了很多又好看又便宜的衣服，花的錢也不多。
passage.simplified: 我刚来台湾的时候，不太{1}吃台湾菜，也不敢吃臭豆腐。后来，我的台湾室友常常带我去夜市，还{2}我吃各种小吃，所以我{3}喜欢台湾小吃了，现在臭豆腐我也敢吃了。周末的时候，我们也常常一起去{4}，买了很多又好看又便宜的衣服，花的钱也不多。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān de shíhòu, bú tài xíguàn chī Táiwān cài, yě bù gǎn chī chòu dòufǔ. Hòulái, wǒ de Táiwān shìyǒu chángcháng dài wǒ qù yèshì, hái tuījiàn wǒ chī gè zhǒng xiǎochī, suǒyǐ wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐhuān Táiwān xiǎochī le, xiànzài chòu dòufǔ wǒ yě gǎn chī le. Zhōumò de shíhòu, wǒmen yě chángcháng yìqǐ qù guàngjiē, mǎi le hěn duō yòu hǎokàn yòu piányí de yīfu, huā de qián yě bù duō.
passage.english: When I first came to Taiwan, I wasn't really used to Taiwanese food, and I didn't dare eat stinky tofu. Later my Taiwanese roommate often took me to night markets and recommended all kinds of snacks to me, so I came to like Taiwanese snacks more and more; now I even dare to eat stinky tofu. At weekends we often went shopping together too, and bought lots of clothes that look good and are cheap without spending much.

questions.why: 不太習慣吃台灣菜: at first the food felt unfamiliar; the later sentences show how that changed.
推薦我吃各種小吃: the roommate recommended snacks for the writer to try (推薦 + person + 吃).
越來越喜歡……了: after many night-market trips the writer likes the snacks more and more; 越來越 goes before the verb.
一起去逛街: they went shopping together and came back with clothes.

passage.traditional: 上個星期六晚上，我跟室友去逛夜市。週末的夜市{1}得不得了，買一個雞排要排隊排二十分鐘。我們一邊逛，一邊吃了臭豆腐、蚵仔煎和豆花，最後兩個人都吃{2}了。要回家的時候，{3}下了很大的雨，我們在一家飲料店等了半個小時才回家。雖然回家很晚，可是我們都覺得這個晚上過得很{4}。
passage.simplified: 上个星期六晚上，我跟室友去逛夜市。周末的夜市{1}得不得了，买一个鸡排要排队排二十分钟。我们一边逛，一边吃了臭豆腐、蚵仔煎和豆花，最后两个人都吃{2}了。要回家的时候，{3}下了很大的雨，我们在一家饮料店等了半个小时才回家。虽然回家很晚，可是我们都觉得这个晚上过得很{4}。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíliù wǎnshàng, wǒ gēn shìyǒu qù guàng yèshì. Zhōumò de yèshì jǐ de bùdéliǎo, mǎi yí ge jīpái yào páiduì pái èrshí fēnzhōng. Wǒmen yìbiān guàng, yìbiān chī le chòu dòufǔ, ézǐjiān hé dòuhuā, zuìhòu liǎng ge rén dōu chībǎo le. Yào huí jiā de shíhòu, hūrán xià le hěn dà de yǔ, wǒmen zài yì jiā yǐnliào diàn děng le bàn ge xiǎoshí cái huí jiā. Suīrán huí jiā hěn wǎn, kěshì wǒmen dōu juéde zhège wǎnshàng guò de hěn yúkuài.
passage.english: Last Saturday evening my roommate and I went to the night market. Weekend night markets are incredibly crowded: buying a chicken cutlet meant queuing for twenty minutes. As we strolled we ate stinky tofu, oyster omelet and tofu pudding, and in the end we were both full. Just as we were about to go home, it suddenly started pouring, so we waited half an hour in a drink shop before heading home. We got home late, but we both felt we'd had a really enjoyable evening.

questions.why: 擠得不得了: on a weekend night the market is packed, which is why the queue takes twenty minutes.
吃飽了: after all those snacks they were both full (V + 飽).
忽然下了很大的雨: the rain came suddenly, just as they were leaving.
過得很愉快: 雖然……可是 turns it around: they got home late, but the evening was pleasant.

text.traditional: 我家在夜市賣蚵仔煎，已經賣了二十年了。以前常常有外國遊客看不懂我們的招牌，不知道我們賣什麼，所以去年我們在招牌上加了英文和日文。來買的日本客人很多，所以我每天早上都學一點日文，現在我的日文越來越好了。可是英文，我還是說得不太好。
text.simplified: 我家在夜市卖蚵仔煎，已经卖了二十年了。以前常常有外国游客看不懂我们的招牌，不知道我们卖什么，所以去年我们在招牌上加了英文和日文。来买的日本客人很多，所以我每天早上都学一点日文，现在我的日文越来越好了。可是英文，我还是说得不太好。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài yèshì mài ézǐjiān, yǐjīng mài le èrshí nián le. Yǐqián chángcháng yǒu wàiguó yóukè kàn bù dǒng wǒmen de zhāopái, bù zhīdào wǒmen mài shénme, suǒyǐ qùnián wǒmen zài zhāopái shàng jiā le Yīngwén hé Rìwén. Lái mǎi de Rìběn kèrén hěn duō, suǒyǐ wǒ měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu xué yìdiǎn Rìwén, xiànzài wǒ de Rìwén yuè lái yuè hǎo le. Kěshì Yīngwén, wǒ háishì shuō de bú tài hǎo.
text.english: My family has sold oyster omelets at the night market for twenty years. Foreign visitors often couldn't read our sign and didn't know what we sell, so last year we added English and Japanese to it. Lots of Japanese customers come, so I study a little Japanese every morning, and now my Japanese keeps getting better. My English, though, is still not very good.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of the following is true?

choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn de Rìwén bǐ yǐqián hǎo.

choices.english: The shop only opened last year.

choices.pinyin: Zhāopái shàng yìzhí dōu yǒu Yīngwén.
choices.english: The sign has always had English.

choices.english: The owner speaks English well.

text.traditional: 我來台灣快一年了。在我的國家，大家喝茶都要加很多糖，所以剛來的時候，我覺得台灣的無糖茶太苦了，買飲料都選半糖的。可是我越來越習慣台灣茶的味道，現在都選無糖的了。冰塊我還是不加，因為我不喜歡太冰的東西。
text.simplified: 我来台湾快一年了。在我的国家，大家喝茶都要加很多糖，所以刚来的时候，我觉得台湾的无糖茶太苦了，买饮料都选半糖的。可是我越来越习惯台湾茶的味道，现在都选无糖的了。冰块我还是不加，因为我不喜欢太冰的东西。
text.pinyin: Wǒ lái Táiwān kuài yì nián le. Zài wǒ de guójiā, dàjiā hē chá dōu yào jiā hěn duō táng, suǒyǐ gāng lái de shíhòu, wǒ juéde Táiwān de wú táng chá tài kǔ le, mǎi yǐnliào dōu xuǎn bàn táng de. Kěshì wǒ yuè lái yuè xíguàn Táiwān chá de wèidào, xiànzài dōu xuǎn wú táng de le. Bīngkuài wǒ háishì bù jiā, yīnwèi wǒ bù xǐhuān tài bīng de dōngxi.
text.english: I've been in Taiwan for almost a year. In my country everyone puts lots of sugar in their tea, so when I first came, I found Taiwan's sugar-free tea too bitter and always chose half sugar. But I'm getting more and more used to the taste of Taiwanese tea, and now I always choose sugar-free. I still don't add ice, though, because I don't like things that are too cold.

prompt.traditional: 這個人現在買飲料，會怎麼選？
prompt.simplified: 这个人现在买饮料，会怎么选？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén xiànzài mǎi yǐnliào, huì zěnme xuǎn?
prompt.english: How does the writer order drinks now?

choices.english: Very sweet.
Half sugar.
Sugar-free.
With extra ice.

questions.why: 我越來越習慣台灣茶的味道，現在都選無糖的了: as the writer got used to the taste, half sugar became sugar-free. Half sugar was the choice at first, lots of sugar is the habit back home, and the writer still takes no ice.

text.traditional:
妹妹：
妳說妳對寺廟文化很有興趣，這個星期六我帶妳去龍山寺參觀，好不好？參觀完了，我們再去旁邊的華西街夜市吃晚飯。我的同學也想跟我們一起吃飯，可是他對寺廟沒有興趣，所以他會在夜市跟我們見面。
哥哥
text.simplified:
妹妹：
你说你对寺庙文化很有兴趣，这个星期六我带你去龙山寺参观，好不好？参观完了，我们再去旁边的华西街夜市吃晚饭。我的同学也想跟我们一起吃饭，可是他对寺庙没有兴趣，所以他会在夜市跟我们见面。
哥哥
text.pinyin:
Mèimei:
Nǐ shuō nǐ duì sìmiào wénhuà hěn yǒu xìngqù, zhège xīngqíliù wǒ dài nǐ qù Lóngshān Sì cānguān, hǎo bù hǎo? Cānguān wán le, wǒmen zài qù pángbiān de Huáxī Jiē yèshì chī wǎnfàn. Wǒ de tóngxué yě xiǎng gēn wǒmen yìqǐ chīfàn, kěshì tā duì sìmiào méiyǒu xìngqù, suǒyǐ tā huì zài yèshì gēn wǒmen jiànmiàn.
Gēge
text.english:
Little sister,
You said you're really interested in temple culture, so how about I take you to visit Longshan Temple this Saturday? After the visit we'll have dinner at Huaxi Street Night Market next door. My classmate wants to eat with us too, but he isn't interested in temples, so he'll meet us at the night market.
Your big brother

prompt.traditional: 哥哥的同學星期六會做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥的同学星期六会做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge de tóngxué xīngqíliù huì zuò shénme?

choices.english: Visit the temple with them.

choices.pinyin: Zài Lóngshān Sì gēn tāmen jiànmiàn.
choices.english: Meet them at Longshan Temple.
Only have dinner with them.
Take the younger sister to the temple.

questions.why: 他對寺廟沒有興趣，所以他會在夜市跟我們見面: the classmate skips the temple and joins them only for dinner at the night market. Taking the sister to the temple is the brother's plan, and the classmate meets them at the night market, not the temple.

text.traditional: 我和我室友都喜歡逛夜市，可是我們去夜市想做的事很不一樣。我對夜市的小吃很有興趣，每次去都要試試沒吃過的東西。我室友對吃沒有興趣，她喜歡去買衣服，而且很會殺價，一件衣服常常可以便宜一百塊。
text.simplified: 我和我室友都喜欢逛夜市，可是我们去夜市想做的事很不一样。我对夜市的小吃很有兴趣，每次去都要试试没吃过的东西。我室友对吃没有兴趣，她喜欢去买衣服，而且很会杀价，一件衣服常常可以便宜一百块。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hé wǒ shìyǒu dōu xǐhuān guàng yèshì, kěshì wǒmen qù yèshì xiǎng zuò de shì hěn bù yíyàng. Wǒ duì yèshì de xiǎochī hěn yǒu xìngqù, měi cì qù dōu yào shìshi méi chī guo de dōngxi. Wǒ shìyǒu duì chī méiyǒu xìngqù, tā xǐhuān qù mǎi yīfu, érqiě hěn huì shājià, yí jiàn yīfu chángcháng kěyǐ piányí yì bǎi kuài.
text.english: My roommate and I both love going to night markets, but we want to do very different things there. I'm really interested in the snacks and always try something I haven't eaten before. My roommate isn't interested in food. She likes buying clothes, and she's great at haggling: she often gets a hundred dollars off a piece of clothing.

prompt.traditional: 這個人的室友怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 这个人的室友怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén de shìyǒu zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is the writer's roommate like?

choices.traditional: 對夜市的小吃很有興趣
choices.simplified: 对夜市的小吃很有兴趣
choices.pinyin: Duì yèshì de xiǎochī hěn yǒu xìngqù.
choices.english: Very interested in night-market snacks.

choices.pinyin: Měi cì dōu yào shì xīn de xiǎochī.
choices.english: Always tries new snacks.

choices.pinyin: Chángcháng mǎi yì bǎi kuài de yīfu.
choices.english: Often buys hundred-dollar clothes.
Good at bargaining with vendors.

questions.why: 她……很會殺價: the roommate is good at haggling (殺價 = 講價) and often gets a hundred dollars off. The snacks and trying new food are the writer, and the hundred dollars is the discount, not the price.

text.traditional: 我跟姐姐下個月要搬家了。新的公寓離學校很近，走路五分鐘就到了。房間不大，可是看起來很乾淨。房東人很好，除了替我們裝了網路，還送給我們兩張書桌。房租一個月一萬，不包括水費和電費，可是我們都很滿意。
text.simplified: 我跟姐姐下个月要搬家了。新的公寓离学校很近，走路五分钟就到了。房间不大，可是看起来很干净。房东人很好，除了替我们装了网路，还送给我们两张书桌。房租一个月一万，不包括水费和电费，可是我们都很满意。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jiějie xià ge yuè yào bānjiā le. Xīn de gōngyù lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Fángjiān bú dà, kěshì kànqǐlái hěn gānjìng. Fángdōng rén hěn hǎo, chúle tì wǒmen zhuāng le wǎnglù, hái sòng gěi wǒmen liǎng zhāng shūzhuō. Fángzū yí ge yuè yí wàn, bù bāokuò shuǐfèi hé diànfèi, kěshì wǒmen dōu hěn mǎnyì.
text.english: My older sister and I are moving next month. The new apartment is close to school, a five-minute walk. The rooms aren't big, but they look clean. The landlord is very nice: besides setting up the internet for us, he also gave us two desks. The rent is ten thousand a month, not including water and electricity, but we're both very happy with it.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of the following is true?

choices.pinyin: Fángzū lǐ yǒu shuǐfèi hé diànfèi.
choices.english: The rent includes water and electricity.

choices.pinyin: Fángdōng bāng tāmen zhuāng le wǎnglù.
choices.english: The landlord set up the internet for them.

choices.traditional: 書桌是房東賣給他們的
choices.simplified: 书桌是房东卖给他们的
choices.pinyin: Shūzhuō shì fángdōng mài gěi tāmen de.
choices.english: The landlord sold them the desks.

choices.pinyin: Fángjiān hěn dà, yě hěn gānjìng.
choices.english: The rooms are big and clean.

questions.why: 除了替我們裝了網路，還送給我們兩張書桌: the landlord set up the internet for them (替 = for). The desks are a gift, the rooms are small, and water and electricity are not in the rent.

focus.en: set up the internet for us

text.traditional: 上個星期六中午，我請朋友來我家吃飯。我本來想星期四晚上打掃房間，可是那天我在圖書館念書，念到十點才回家。星期五晚上我又得去餐廳幫忙，所以星期六早上我七點就起來了，先把地掃了，再把桌子擦一擦。朋友到的時候，房間已經很乾淨了。
text.simplified: 上个星期六中午，我请朋友来我家吃饭。我本来想星期四晚上打扫房间，可是那天我在图书馆念书，念到十点才回家。星期五晚上我又得去餐厅帮忙，所以星期六早上我七点就起来了，先把地扫了，再把桌子擦一擦。朋友到的时候，房间已经很干净了。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíliù zhōngwǔ, wǒ qǐng péngyǒu lái wǒ jiā chīfàn. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng xīngqísì wǎnshàng dǎsǎo fángjiān, kěshì nà tiān wǒ zài túshūguǎn niànshū, niàn dào shí diǎn cái huí jiā. Xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng wǒ yòu děi qù cāntīng bāngmáng, suǒyǐ xīngqíliù zǎoshàng wǒ qī diǎn jiù qǐlái le, xiān bǎ dì sǎo le, zài bǎ zhuōzi cā yì cā. Péngyǒu dào de shíhòu, fángjiān yǐjīng hěn gānjìng le.
text.english: Last Saturday at noon I had friends over for lunch. I'd meant to clean my room on Thursday evening, but that day I studied at the library and didn't get home until ten. On Friday evening I had to help at the restaurant, so on Saturday I got up at seven, swept the floor and then gave the table a wipe. By the time my friends arrived, the room was already clean.

prompt.traditional: 這個人是什麼時候打掃房間的？
prompt.simplified: 这个人是什么时候打扫房间的？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén shì shénme shíhòu dǎsǎo fángjiān de?
prompt.english: When did the writer clean the room?

choices.english: Thursday evening.
Friday evening.
Saturday morning.
Saturday noon.

questions.why: 星期四……十點才回家 and 星期五……又得去餐廳幫忙, so the cleaning happened 星期六早上. Thursday was only the plan, and by noon on Saturday the room was already clean.

picture.alt: A sunny day in an apartment complex: tall cream-and-orange apartment buildings and green trees behind, a blue sky with a few white clouds. Three young people walk side by side along a paved path, all smiling and talking. On the left, a young woman with shoulder-length wavy dark hair and round glasses wears a white short-sleeved shirt under a dark purple sweater vest and olive-green trousers, a beige cloth bag on her shoulder. In the middle, a young woman with long wavy black hair and gold hoop earrings wears a bright blue jacket over an orange top and cream-white wide trousers, a black bag on her shoulder. On the right, a young man with short black hair wears an open dark-blue shirt over a white T-shirt and rust-orange trousers; he looks at the two women and stretches one arm out to the side as if showing them the place. Right beside the path, in front of them, is a swimming pool; further back on the right are a tennis court with a net behind a green fence, a wooden shelter with a bench, bushes and pink flowers. Nobody is swimming, playing ball, sitting down or eating.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 週末你們在社區的草地上露營，好玩嗎？
lines.simplified: 周末你们在社区的草地上露营，好玩吗？

lines.english: You camped on the lawn in your complex at the weekend. Was it fun?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好玩極了！星期六晚上天氣很好，天上有好多星星。可是星期天早上九點多，忽然下起大雨來了。

lines.pinyin: Hǎowán jíle! Xīngqíliù wǎnshàng tiānqì hěn hǎo, tiān shàng yǒu hǎo duō xīngxīng. Kěshì xīngqítiān zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn duō, hūrán xià qǐ dà yǔ lái le.
lines.english: It was great fun! On Saturday night the weather was lovely and the sky was full of stars. But a little after nine on Sunday morning, it suddenly started pouring.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你們怎麼辦？

lines.english: Luckily we had gone home at eight; otherwise it would have been a real nuisance.

lines.english: When I got home from work today, I found I had forgotten my keys.

lines.english: Then why didn't you go to your landlord? He must have a key to your place, right?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 房東這個星期去日本玩了。還好我在鄰居家放了一把鑰匙，要不然就得在咖啡廳等我太太九點下班了。
lines.simplified: 房东这个星期去日本玩了。还好我在邻居家放了一把钥匙，要不然就得在咖啡厅等我太太九点下班了。
lines.pinyin: Fángdōng zhège xīngqí qù Rìběn wán le. Háihǎo wǒ zài línjū jiā fàng le yì bǎ yàoshi, yàobùrán jiù děi zài kāfēitīng děng wǒ tàitai jiǔ diǎn xiàbān le.
lines.english: My landlord is on holiday in Japan this week. Luckily I had left a key at my neighbour's; otherwise I would have had to wait in a café until my wife finished work at nine.

lines.pinyin: Hái méi. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng chī wán wǎnfàn jiù xiě, kěshì xiān tǎng zài shāfā shàng tīng yīnyuè, tīngzhe tīngzhe jiù shuìzháo le, qǐlái de shíhòu yǐjīng bànyè liǎng diǎn le.

lines.traditional: 妳住的社區有游泳池，也有網球場，妳下班以後常去運動嗎？
lines.simplified: 你住的社区有游泳池，也有网球场，你下班以后常去运动吗？

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 中秋節快到了，你每年中秋節都怎麼過？
lines.simplified: 中秋节快到了，你每年中秋节都怎么过？
lines.pinyin: Zhōngqiū Jié kuài dào le, nǐ měi nián Zhōngqiū Jié dōu zěnme guò?
lines.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. How do you spend it every year?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不一定。有時候回南部跟家人一起吃月餅，有時候跟朋友在社區的草地上烤肉。
lines.simplified: 不一定。有时候回南部跟家人一起吃月饼，有时候跟朋友在社区的草地上烤肉。
lines.pinyin: Bù yídìng. Yǒushíhòu huí nánbù gēn jiārén yìqǐ chī yuèbǐng, yǒushíhòu gēn péngyǒu zài shèqū de cǎodì shàng kǎo ròu.
lines.english: It depends. Sometimes I go back down south and eat mooncakes with my family; sometimes I barbecue with friends on the lawn in my complex.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那今年呢？
lines.simplified: 那今年呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà jīnnián ne?
lines.english: And this year?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 今年我父母要來台北玩，所以我打算帶他們去餐廳吃飯，晚上再一起看月亮。
lines.simplified: 今年我父母要来台北玩，所以我打算带他们去餐厅吃饭，晚上再一起看月亮。
lines.pinyin: Jīnnián wǒ fùmǔ yào lái Táiběi wán, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎsuàn dài tāmen qù cāntīng chīfàn, wǎnshàng zài yìqǐ kàn yuèliàng.
lines.english: This year my parents are coming to Taipei, so I'm planning to take them to a restaurant, and then we'll watch the moon together in the evening.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的今年中秋節打算做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的今年中秋节打算做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jīnnián Zhōngqiū Jié dǎsuàn zuò shénme?

questions.why: 有時候……，有時候…… is what he does in other years. This year his parents come to Taipei, so he will take them out to eat there (陪父母吃飯); nobody is going south this year.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我昨天放在冰箱裡的月餅呢？你看到了嗎？
lines.simplified: 我昨天放在冰箱里的月饼呢？你看到了吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān fàng zài bīngxiāng lǐ de yuèbǐng ne? Nǐ kàndào le ma?
lines.english: Where are the mooncakes I put in the fridge yesterday? Have you seen them?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對不起，昨天晚上我妹妹來，月餅被她吃了兩塊，剩下的我拿去送給樓下的鄰居了。
lines.simplified: 对不起，昨天晚上我妹妹来，月饼被她吃了两块，剩下的我拿去送给楼下的邻居了。
lines.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, zuótiān wǎnshàng wǒ mèimei lái, yuèbǐng bèi tā chī le liǎng kuài, shèngxià de wǒ ná qù sòng gěi lóuxià de línjū le.
lines.english: Sorry. My sister came over last night and ate two of them, and I took the rest down to the neighbours downstairs.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 什麼？那是我要帶去公司給同事吃的！
lines.simplified: 什么？那是我要带去公司给同事吃的！
lines.pinyin: Shénme? Nà shì wǒ yào dài qù gōngsī gěi tóngshì chī de!
lines.english: What? Those were for me to take to the office for my colleagues!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳不要著急，我下班以後就去買新的。
lines.simplified: 你不要着急，我下班以后就去买新的。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ búyào zhāojí, wǒ xiàbān yǐhòu jiù qù mǎi xīn de.
lines.english: Don't worry, I'll go and buy new ones after work.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 冰箱里的月饼后来怎么了？

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你弟弟怎麼看起來不太高興？
lines.simplified: 你弟弟怎么看起来不太高兴？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ dìdi zěnme kànqǐlái bú tài gāoxìng?
lines.english: Why does your little brother look so unhappy?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他下午在草地上踢足球，不小心把一樓鄰居的窗戶踢壞了。
lines.simplified: 他下午在草地上踢足球，不小心把一楼邻居的窗户踢坏了。
lines.pinyin: Tā xiàwǔ zài cǎodì shàng tī zúqiú, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ yī lóu línjū de chuānghù tī huài le.
lines.english: He was playing soccer on the lawn this afternoon and accidentally broke the window of the neighbour on the first floor.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 鄰居知道是他踢的嗎？
lines.simplified: 邻居知道是他踢的吗？
lines.pinyin: Línjū zhīdào shì tā tī de ma?
lines.english: Does the neighbour know it was him?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來不知道，大門的安全人員也沒看到。可是他想跑回家的時候，被樓上的一個小學生看到了。現在爸爸要他去說對不起。
lines.simplified: 本来不知道，大门的安全人员也没看到。可是他想跑回家的时候，被楼上的一个小学生看到了。现在爸爸要他去说对不起。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái bù zhīdào, dàmén de ānquán rényuán yě méi kàndào. Kěshì tā xiǎng pǎo huí jiā de shíhòu, bèi lóushàng de yí ge xiǎoxuéshēng kàndào le. Xiànzài bàba yào tā qù shuō duìbùqǐ.
lines.english: Not at first, and the security guard at the gate didn't see either. But when he tried to run home, a schoolkid from upstairs saw him. Now Dad wants him to go and apologise.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這件衣服妳穿起來很好看，怎麼不買？
lines.simplified: 这件衣服你穿起来很好看，怎么不买？
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu nǐ chuān qǐlái hěn hǎokàn, zěnme bù mǎi?
lines.english: That top looks great on you. Why aren't you buying it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 老闆說要三千塊，我跟他殺價，他只願意便宜兩百塊。這個月我的錢不多，買不起。
lines.simplified: 老板说要三千块，我跟他杀价，他只愿意便宜两百块。这个月我的钱不多，买不起。
lines.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shuō yào sānqiān kuài, wǒ gēn tā shājià, tā zhǐ yuànyì piányí liǎngbǎi kuài. Zhège yuè wǒ de qián bù duō, mǎi bù qǐ.
lines.english: The owner wants three thousand. I haggled, but he would only take two hundred off. I don't have much money this month; I can't afford it.

prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼不買這件衣服？

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你找到房子了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你找到房子了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎodào fángzi le ma?
lines.english: Have you found a place?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 找到了，房租一個月一萬。除了房租，我還得自己付水費跟網路的錢。電費房東會替我付。
lines.simplified: 找到了，房租一个月一万。除了房租，我还得自己付水费跟网路的钱。电费房东会替我付。
lines.pinyin: Zhǎodào le, fángzū yí ge yuè yíwàn. Chúle fángzū, wǒ hái děi zìjǐ fù shuǐfèi gēn wǎnglù de qián. Diànfèi fángdōng huì tì wǒ fù.
lines.english: Yes. The rent is ten thousand a month. Besides the rent, I also have to pay for water and the internet myself. The landlord will pay the electricity for me.

prompt.simplified: 男的每个月自己要付什么钱？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de měi ge yuè zìjǐ yào fù shénme qián?
prompt.english: Which costs does the man pay himself each month?

choices.english: The rent, water and the internet.

questions.why: 除了房租，我還得自己付水費跟網路的錢: besides the rent he pays for water and the internet. The landlord pays the electricity for him (替我付).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 球賽七點開始，你怎麼還不出門？
lines.simplified: 球赛七点开始，你怎么还不出门？
lines.pinyin: Qiúsài qī diǎn kāishǐ, nǐ zěnme hái bù chūmén?
lines.english: The game starts at seven. Why haven't you left yet?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 媽媽叫我先把碗筷洗完，再把垃圾拿出去倒了，才能出門。妳先去吧，我晚一點到。
lines.simplified: 妈妈叫我先把碗筷洗完，再把垃圾拿出去倒了，才能出门。你先去吧，我晚一点到。
lines.pinyin: Māma jiào wǒ xiān bǎ wǎnkuài xǐ wán, zài bǎ lèsè ná chūqù dào le, cái néng chūmén. Nǐ xiān qù ba, wǒ wǎn yìdiǎn dào.
lines.english: Mum told me to finish the dishes and then take the rubbish out; only then can I go. You go ahead. I'll be a bit late.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼了？為什麼一直摸自己的背？
lines.simplified: 你怎么了？为什么一直摸自己的背？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le? Wèishénme yìzhí mō zìjǐ de bèi?
lines.english: What's wrong? Why do you keep touching your back?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 昨天幫朋友搬家，搬了一天，今天早上起來，背就開始疼了。
lines.simplified: 昨天帮朋友搬家，搬了一天，今天早上起来，背就开始疼了。
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān bāng péngyǒu bānjiā, bān le yì tiān, jīntiān zǎoshàng qǐlái, bèi jiù kāishǐ téng le.
lines.english: Yesterday I spent the whole day helping a friend move house. When I got up this morning, my back started hurting.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你最好去看醫生，或是先去藥局買一點藥。
lines.simplified: 你最好去看医生，或是先去药局买一点药。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo qù kàn yīshēng, huòshì xiān qù yàojú mǎi yìdiǎn yào.
lines.english: You'd better see a doctor, or go to a pharmacy for some medicine first.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 雖然很疼，可是下午有考試，我不能請假。考完試我再去藥局看看。
lines.simplified: 虽然很疼，可是下午有考试，我不能请假。考完试我再去药局看看。
lines.pinyin: Suīrán hěn téng, kěshì xiàwǔ yǒu kǎoshì, wǒ bù néng qǐngjià. Kǎo wán shì wǒ zài qù yàojú kànkan.
lines.english: It hurts a lot, but I have an exam this afternoon and can't take time off. I'll drop by the pharmacy after the exam.

prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼做？

prompt.english: What does the man plan to do?

choices.english: See a doctor right away.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你最近怎麼常常去夜市？
lines.simplified: 你最近怎么常常去夜市？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zěnme chángcháng qù yèshì?
lines.english: How come you go to the night market so often lately?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我對台灣的小吃越來越有興趣了。上個星期吃了蚵仔煎，這個星期想試試臭豆腐。
lines.simplified: 我对台湾的小吃越来越有兴趣了。上个星期吃了蚵仔煎，这个星期想试试臭豆腐。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ duì Táiwān de xiǎochī yuè lái yuè yǒu xìngqù le. Shàng ge xīngqí chī le ézǐjiān, zhège xīngqí xiǎng shìshi chòu dòufǔ.
lines.english: I'm getting more and more interested in Taiwanese snacks. Last week I had an oyster omelette, and this week I want to try stinky tofu.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 臭豆腐的味道那麼重，你不怕嗎？
lines.simplified: 臭豆腐的味道那么重，你不怕吗？
lines.pinyin: Chòu dòufǔ de wèidào nàme zhòng, nǐ bú pà ma?
lines.english: Stinky tofu has such a strong smell. Doesn't it put you off?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 第一次聞的時候覺得好臭，現在覺得香極了。
lines.simplified: 第一次闻的时候觉得好臭，现在觉得香极了。
lines.pinyin: Dì yī cì wén de shíhòu juéde hǎo chòu, xiànzài juéde xiāng jíle.
lines.english: The first time I smelled it, I thought it stank, but now I think it smells wonderful.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 男的现在觉得臭豆腐怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài juéde chòu dòufǔ zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of stinky tofu now?

choices.english: He still thinks it stinks.

choices.english: It tastes wonderful.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: It smells wonderful.

choices.english: The smell is too strong.

text.traditional:
上車：社區大門
下車：捷運站一號出口
早上六點到九點：每十分鐘就有一班
九點到晚上八點：每三十分鐘有一班
晚上八點到十一點：每一個小時有一班
text.simplified:
上车：社区大门
下车：捷运站一号出口
早上六点到九点：每十分钟就有一班
九点到晚上八点：每三十分钟有一班
晚上八点到十一点：每一个小时有一班

Shàngchē: Shèqū dàmén
Xiàchē: Jiéyùn zhàn yī hào chūkǒu
Zǎoshàng liù diǎn dào jiǔ diǎn: Měi shí fēnzhōng jiù yǒu yì bān
Jiǔ diǎn dào wǎnshàng bā diǎn: Měi sānshí fēnzhōng yǒu yì bān
