text.english:
Get on: main gate of the complex
Get off: MRT station, Exit 1
6 to 9 a.m.: a bus every ten minutes
9 a.m. to 8 p.m.: a bus every thirty minutes
8 to 11 p.m.: a bus every hour

versions.alt: A timetable sign on a pole at a community minibus stop by a residential street

prompt.traditional: 早上十點在大門等車，最多要等多久？
prompt.simplified: 早上十点在大门等车，最多要等多久？
prompt.pinyin: Zǎoshàng shí diǎn zài dàmén děng chē, zuì duō yào děng duō jiǔ?
prompt.english: If you wait at the main gate at ten in the morning, what is the longest you might wait?

choices.english: Ten minutes.
Thirty minutes.
One hour.

questions.why: From nine in the morning to eight in the evening, 每三十分鐘有一班: a bus every thirty minutes, so at ten you wait half an hour at most. Every ten minutes is only until nine, and once an hour is after eight in the evening.

游泳课｜每个星期上两次，星期二、四晚上｜游泳池
网球比赛｜每三个月有一次，星期天上午｜网球场

Yóuyǒng kè | Měi ge xīngqí shàng liǎng cì, xīngqí'èr, sì wǎnshàng | Yóuyǒngchí

prompt.traditional: 哪一個活動最常有？
prompt.simplified: 哪一个活动最常有？
prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge huódòng zuì cháng yǒu?
prompt.english: Which activity happens most often?

choices.english: The picnic.
The swimming class.
The tennis match.

questions.why: 游泳課 is 每個星期上兩次, twice a week, so about eight times a month. The picnic is once a month and the tennis match only once every three months.

text.traditional:
大家好：
昨天晚上，有人在社區的網球場旁邊丟了一支黑色的手機。手機已經被一位住在B棟的小姐找到了。她本來想拿到社區辦公室，可是晚上辦公室沒有人，所以先帶回家了。如果這是你的手機，請到B棟三樓來拿。
社區辦公室
text.simplified:
大家好：
昨天晚上，有人在社区的网球场旁边丢了一支黑色的手机。手机已经被一位住在B栋的小姐找到了。她本来想拿到社区办公室，可是晚上办公室没有人，所以先带回家了。如果这是你的手机，请到B栋三楼来拿。
社区办公室
text.pinyin:
Dàjiā hǎo:
Zuótiān wǎnshàng, yǒu rén zài shèqū de wǎngqiú chǎng pángbiān diū le yì zhī hēisè de shǒujī. Shǒujī yǐjīng bèi yí wèi zhù zài B dòng de xiǎojiě zhǎodào le. Tā běnlái xiǎng ná dào shèqū bàngōngshì, kěshì wǎnshàng bàngōngshì méi yǒu rén, suǒyǐ xiān dài huí jiā le. Rúguǒ zhè shì nǐ de shǒujī, qǐng dào B dòng sān lóu lái ná.
Shèqū bàngōngshì
text.english:
Hello everyone,
Last night someone lost a black mobile phone beside the tennis court in the complex. A woman who lives in Building B has found it. She meant to bring it to the community office, but nobody was there at night, so she took it home for now. If it is your phone, please come to the third floor of Building B to collect it.
The community office

prompt.traditional: 這支手機現在在哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 这支手机现在在哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī xiànzài zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where is the phone now?

choices.english: Beside the tennis court.
At the community office.

choices.pinyin: Zài B dòng xiǎojiě de jiā.
choices.english: At the Building B woman's home.

questions.why: 被一位住在B棟的小姐找到了……先帶回家了: the woman from Building B found it and took it home, so it is at her place (請到B棟三樓來拿). The office was closed, and the tennis court is only where it was lost.

text.traditional:
哥哥：
我的腳踏車昨天在學校被偷了，所以今天早上騎你的去上課了。爸爸本來也想騎你的車去上班，後來搭公車去了。下課以後我會先去找警察，晚上再把車騎回來給你。
弟弟
text.simplified:
哥哥：
我的脚踏车昨天在学校被偷了，所以今天早上骑你的去上课了。爸爸本来也想骑你的车去上班，后来搭公车去了。下课以后我会先去找警察，晚上再把车骑回来给你。
弟弟
text.pinyin:
Gēge:
Wǒ de jiǎotàchē zuótiān zài xuéxiào bèi tōu le, suǒyǐ jīntiān zǎoshàng qí nǐ de qù shàngkè le. Bàba běnlái yě xiǎng qí nǐ de chē qù shàngbān, hòulái dā gōngchē qù le. Xiàkè yǐhòu wǒ huì xiān qù zhǎo jǐngchá, wǎnshàng zài bǎ chē qí huílái gěi nǐ.
Dìdi
text.english:
Big brother,
My bike was stolen at school yesterday, so this morning I rode yours to class. Dad wanted to ride your bike to work too, but in the end he took the bus. After class I'll go and see the police first, and tonight I'll ride your bike back to you.
Your little brother

prompt.traditional: 哥哥的腳踏車怎麼了？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥的脚踏车怎么了？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge de jiǎotàchē zěnme le?
prompt.english: What has happened to the older brother's bike?

choices.pinyin: Zuótiān zài xuéxiào bèi tōu le.
choices.english: It was stolen at school yesterday.

choices.pinyin: Bèi dìdi qí qù shàngkè le.
choices.english: The younger brother rode it to class.

choices.pinyin: Bèi bàba qí qù shàngbān le.
choices.english: Dad rode it to work.

questions.why: It was the younger brother's own bike that was stolen (我的腳踏車……被偷了). He rode his brother's bike to class (騎你的去上課了); Dad only wanted to ride it and took the bus in the end.

versions.alt: A Mid-Autumn night on a lawn in a residential area: a big, round full moon shines in a dark-blue sky above dark mountains, and apartment buildings with warm lit windows stand behind the trees. Five young people sit on a red-and-white checked picnic cloth on the grass, smiling and talking; four of them hold a round golden mooncake. From left: a young woman with round glasses, wavy dark hair, a white shirt under a purple vest and green trousers, a mooncake in one hand and the other hand reaching toward the plate; a young man with black hair in a light-green jacket over a red striped T-shirt; a young woman with long wavy black hair in a blue jacket and white trousers; a young man with wavy brown hair in a yellow sweater vest over a purple shirt; and a young man with short black hair in a dark-blue shirt over a white T-shirt, his hand reaching for a mooncake on the plate. In the middle, someone's hands hold out a white plate piled with mooncakes. In front are a basket, a silver thermos, a box of mooncakes, a plate of green grapes and oranges, and a glass of water. On the road behind them on the right, a small white bus with a row of windows drives by with its lights on; small lamps line the path. There is no sofa, no ball court, no taxi and no bicycle.

prompt.traditional: 中秋節的晚上，他們坐在＿＿上吃月餅。
prompt.simplified: 中秋节的晚上，他们坐在＿＿上吃月饼。

choices.english: sofa
lawn
ball court

answer.traditional: 中秋節的晚上，他們坐在草地上吃月餅。
answer.simplified: 中秋节的晚上，他们坐在草地上吃月饼。
answer.pinyin: Zhōngqiū Jié de wǎnshàng, tāmen zuò zài cǎodì shàng chī yuèbǐng.
answer.english: On the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, they are sitting on the lawn eating mooncakes.

questions.why: They sit on a picnic cloth spread on the grass (草地). There is no sofa, and they are not on a ball court.

prompt.traditional: 天上的月亮像一個大月餅＿＿圓。
prompt.simplified: 天上的月亮像一个大月饼＿＿圆。

choices.english: a little
the same
together

answer.traditional: 天上的月亮像一個大月餅一樣圓。
answer.simplified: 天上的月亮像一个大月饼一样圆。
answer.pinyin: Tiān shàng de yuèliàng xiàng yí ge dà yuèbǐng yíyàng yuán.
answer.english: The moon in the sky is as round as a big mooncake.

questions.why: A 像 B 一樣 + Vs says A is just as round as B: the moon is round like a big mooncake. 一點 and 一起 do not complete 像…….

prompt.traditional: 他們一邊吃月餅，一邊聊天，草地上熱鬧＿＿了。
prompt.simplified: 他们一边吃月饼，一边聊天，草地上热闹＿＿了。

choices.english: out (toward the speaker)
over (toward the speaker)
(start and go on)

answer.traditional: 他們一邊吃月餅，一邊聊天，草地上熱鬧起來了。
answer.simplified: 他们一边吃月饼，一边聊天，草地上热闹起来了。
answer.pinyin: Tāmen yìbiān chī yuèbǐng, yìbiān liáotiān, cǎodì shàng rènao qǐlái le.
answer.english: They eat mooncakes and chat, and the lawn has become lively.

questions.why: Vs + 起來 says a state begins and goes on: the lawn becomes lively. 出來 and 過來 are directions of movement and do not follow 熱鬧.

prompt.traditional: 他們後面的馬路上，有一輛白色的＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 他们后面的马路上，有一辆白色的＿＿。

choices.english: taxi
bus
bicycle

answer.traditional: 他們後面的馬路上，有一輛白色的巴士。
answer.simplified: 他们后面的马路上，有一辆白色的巴士。
answer.pinyin: Tāmen hòumiàn de mǎlù shàng, yǒu yí liàng báisè de bāshì.
answer.english: On the road behind them there is a white bus.

questions.why: The white vehicle with a row of windows on the road behind them is a bus (巴士). There is no taxi or bicycle in the picture.

prompt.traditional: 月亮又大又圓，＿＿一個大盤子一樣。
prompt.simplified: 月亮又大又圆，＿＿一个大盘子一样。

choices.english: than
to; toward
like

answer.traditional: 月亮又大又圓，像一個大盤子一樣。
answer.simplified: 月亮又大又圆，像一个大盘子一样。
answer.pinyin: Yuèliàng yòu dà yòu yuán, xiàng yí ge dà pánzi yíyàng.
answer.english: The moon is big and round, like a large plate.

questions.why: A 像 B 一樣 says A is like B: the round moon looks like a big plate. 比 asks which is more, and 對 does not go with 一樣.

prompt.traditional: 他們看著月亮，吃著月餅，聊＿＿天來了。
prompt.simplified: 他们看着月亮，吃着月饼，聊＿＿天来了。

choices.english: (start)
finished
(have done before)

answer.traditional: 他們看著月亮，吃著月餅，聊起天來了。
answer.simplified: 他们看着月亮，吃着月饼，聊起天来了。
answer.pinyin: Tāmen kànzhe yuèliàng, chīzhe yuèbǐng, liáo qǐ tiān lái le.
answer.english: Looking at the moon and eating mooncakes, they have started chatting.

questions.why: V 起 O 來 says an action starts and goes on, with the object between 起 and 來: 聊起天來, they start chatting. 聊完天來 and 聊過天來 are not sentences.

passage.traditional: 去年我們家搬到台北市郊區的一個社區。剛搬來的時候，我不太{1}，因為附近沒有捷運站，去哪裡都得先走十分鐘去搭公車。還好社區裡有一家二十四小時的超市，{2}買東西也會很麻煩。社區白天、晚上都有人{3}安全，空氣也很{4}。現在我越來越喜歡住在這裡了。
passage.simplified: 去年我们家搬到台北市郊区的一个社区。刚搬来的时候，我不太{1}，因为附近没有捷运站，去哪里都得先走十分钟去搭公车。还好社区里有一家二十四小时的超市，{2}买东西也会很麻烦。社区白天、晚上都有人{3}安全，空气也很{4}。现在我越来越喜欢住在这里了。
passage.pinyin: Qùnián wǒmen jiā bān dào Táiběi Shì jiāoqū de yí ge shèqū. Gāng bān lái de shíhòu, wǒ bú tài xíguàn, yīnwèi fùjìn méiyǒu jiéyùn zhàn, qù nǎlǐ dōu děi xiān zǒu shí fēnzhōng qù dā gōngchē. Háihǎo shèqū lǐ yǒu yì jiā èrshísì xiǎoshí de chāoshì, yàobùrán mǎi dōngxi yě huì hěn máfán. Shèqū báitiān, wǎnshàng dōu yǒu rén fùzé ānquán, kōngqì yě hěn xīnxiān. Xiànzài wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐhuān zhù zài zhèlǐ le.
passage.english: Last year my family moved to a housing complex in the suburbs of Taipei City. When we had just moved in, I wasn't really used to it, because there's no MRT station nearby: wherever we go, we first have to walk ten minutes to catch a bus. Luckily there's a 24-hour supermarket in the complex; otherwise shopping would be a nuisance too. Someone is in charge of security day and night, and the air is fresh. Now I like living here more and more.

questions.why: 我不太習慣: at first the writer was not used to the place, because there is no MRT station nearby.
還好……，要不然……: luckily there is a 24-hour supermarket; otherwise shopping would be a nuisance too.
有人負責安全: someone is in charge of the security of the complex day and night.
空氣很新鮮: the air in the suburbs is fresh.

passage.traditional: 上個星期六是{1}，社區在大門旁邊的草地上{2}了一個野餐活動。大家都帶了自己做的菜，{3}吃，一邊聊天。吃飽以後，有的人去踢足球，有的人在花園裡散步，也有的人躺在草地上曬太陽。我躺在草地上，看著天上的雲，感覺好{4}，真希望每個週末都能這樣。
passage.simplified: 上个星期六是{1}，社区在大门旁边的草地上{2}了一个野餐活动。大家都带了自己做的菜，{3}吃，一边聊天。吃饱以后，有的人去踢足球，有的人在花园里散步，也有的人躺在草地上晒太阳。我躺在草地上，看着天上的云，感觉好{4}，真希望每个周末都能这样。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíliù shì qíngtiān, shèqū zài dàmén pángbiān de cǎodì shàng bàn le yí ge yěcān huódòng. Dàjiā dōu dài le zìjǐ zuò de cài, yìbiān chī, yìbiān liáotiān. Chībǎo yǐhòu, yǒude rén qù tī zúqiú, yǒude rén zài huāyuán lǐ sànbù, yě yǒude rén tǎng zài cǎodì shàng shài tàiyáng. Wǒ tǎng zài cǎodì shàng, kànzhe tiān shàng de yún, gǎnjué hǎo qīngsōng, zhēn xīwàng měi ge zhōumò dōu néng zhèyàng.
passage.english: Last Saturday was a sunny day, and the complex held a picnic on the lawn beside the main gate. Everyone brought a dish they had made, and we ate and chatted at the same time. After we had eaten our fill, some people went to play soccer, some took a walk in the garden, and some lay on the grass in the sun. I lay on the lawn watching the clouds in the sky and felt so relaxed. I really wish every weekend could be like that.

questions.why: 上個星期六是晴天: it was a sunny day, good weather for a picnic and lying in the sun.
辦了一個野餐活動: the complex held (organised) a picnic.
The sentence already has a second 一邊 (一邊聊天), so the first half needs 一邊 too: 一邊吃，一邊聊天, two things at once.
感覺好輕鬆: lying on the grass watching the clouds, the writer feels very relaxed.

text.traditional: 我家住的社區在山上，社區裡有球場，也有游泳池。妹妹像爸爸一樣，很愛運動，下課以後有時候去打球，有時候去游泳。哥哥像媽媽一樣，喜歡安靜，常常在家看書、聽音樂。週末的時候，我們常常一起去社區的草地上野餐。
text.simplified: 我家住的社区在山上，社区里有球场，也有游泳池。妹妹像爸爸一样，很爱运动，下课以后有时候去打球，有时候去游泳。哥哥像妈妈一样，喜欢安静，常常在家看书、听音乐。周末的时候，我们常常一起去社区的草地上野餐。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhù de shèqū zài shān shàng, shèqū lǐ yǒu qiúchǎng, yě yǒu yóuyǒngchí. Mèimei xiàng bàba yíyàng, hěn ài yùndòng, xiàkè yǐhòu yǒushíhòu qù dǎqiú, yǒushíhòu qù yóuyǒng. Gēge xiàng māma yíyàng, xǐhuān ānjìng, chángcháng zài jiā kàn shū, tīng yīnyuè. Zhōumò de shíhòu, wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù shèqū de cǎodì shàng yěcān.
text.english: The housing complex my family lives in is in the hills, and it has a ball court and a swimming pool. My younger sister is just like Dad: she loves sport, and after school she sometimes plays ball and sometimes goes swimming. My older brother is just like Mum: he likes peace and quiet, and often stays home reading or listening to music. At weekends we often go for a picnic together on the lawn in the complex.

prompt.traditional: 這家人裡，誰很愛運動？
prompt.simplified: 这家人里，谁很爱运动？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè jiā rén lǐ, shéi hěn ài yùndòng?
prompt.english: In this family, who loves sport?

choices.english: The older brother and Dad.
The younger sister and Dad.
The older brother and Mum.
The younger sister and Mum.

questions.why: 妹妹像爸爸一樣，很愛運動: the younger sister loves sport, just like Dad. The older brother is like Mum and likes quiet things at home.

text.traditional: 張小姐上個月搬到郊區的一個社區。她的新家像以前住的地方一樣大，也有兩間臥室。這裡比以前住的地方安靜多了，晚上聽不到車子的聲音，可是離捷運站比較遠，她每天都得早一點出門，先搭社區的巴士到捷運站。
text.simplified: 张小姐上个月搬到郊区的一个社区。她的新家像以前住的地方一样大，也有两间卧室。这里比以前住的地方安静多了，晚上听不到车子的声音，可是离捷运站比较远，她每天都得早一点出门，先搭社区的巴士到捷运站。
text.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě shàng ge yuè bān dào jiāoqū de yí ge shèqū. Tā de xīn jiā xiàng yǐqián zhù de dìfāng yíyàng dà, yě yǒu liǎng jiān wòshì. Zhèlǐ bǐ yǐqián zhù de dìfāng ānjìng duō le, wǎnshàng tīng bú dào chēzi de shēngyīn, kěshì lí jiéyùn zhàn bǐjiào yuǎn, tā měi tiān dōu děi zǎo yìdiǎn chūmén, xiān dā shèqū de bāshì dào jiéyùn zhàn.
text.english: Last month Ms. Zhang moved to a housing complex in the suburbs. Her new home is just as big as the place she lived before, with two bedrooms as well. It is much quieter here than her old place, and at night she can't hear any traffic, but it is further from the MRT station, so every day she has to leave a little earlier and take the complex's bus to the station first.

prompt.traditional: 張小姐覺得新家怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 张小姐觉得新家怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě juéde xīn jiā zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does Ms. Zhang find about her new home?

choices.traditional: 一樣方便，可是比較安靜
choices.simplified: 一样方便，可是比较安静
choices.english: Just as convenient, but quieter.
Just as big, but more convenient.
Just as big, but quieter.
Just as quiet, but bigger.

questions.why: 像以前住的地方一樣大: just as big as her old place; 比以前住的地方安靜多了: much quieter than before. It is further from the MRT, so it is not as convenient.

text.traditional:
美心：
上次妳說也想來我們社區露營，這個星期六就有機會了！社區晚上要在大門旁邊的草地上辦露營活動。參加的人只要帶自己的衣服就可以了，吃的、喝的跟睡覺用的東西，社區都會準備。我六點在大門等妳跟可欣。
明生
text.simplified:
美心：
上次你说也想来我们社区露营，这个星期六就有机会了！社区晚上要在大门旁边的草地上办露营活动。参加的人只要带自己的衣服就可以了，吃的、喝的跟睡觉用的东西，社区都会准备。我六点在大门等你跟可欣。
明生
text.pinyin:
Měixīn:
Shàng cì nǐ shuō yě xiǎng lái wǒmen shèqū lùyíng, zhège xīngqíliù jiù yǒu jīhuì le! Shèqū wǎnshàng yào zài dàmén pángbiān de cǎodì shàng bàn lùyíng huódòng. Cānjiā de rén zhǐyào dài zìjǐ de yīfu jiù kěyǐ le, chī de, hē de gēn shuìjiào yòng de dōngxi, shèqū dōu huì zhǔnbèi. Wǒ liù diǎn zài dàmén děng nǐ gēn Kěxīn.
Míngshēng
text.english:
Meixin,
Last time you said you'd like to come camping in our complex too. This Saturday you can! In the evening the complex is holding a camping event on the lawn beside the main gate. People who come only need to bring their own clothes; the complex will provide food, drinks and things to sleep in. I'll wait for you and Kexin at the main gate at six.
Mingsheng

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of these is true?

choices.english: The event starts on Saturday morning.
Meixin has to bring clothes.

choices.pinyin: Měixīn děi dài chī de gēn hē de.
choices.english: Meixin has to bring food and drinks.

choices.pinyin: Míngshēng liù diǎn zài cǎodì shàng děng.
choices.english: Mingsheng will wait on the lawn at six.

questions.why: 只要帶自己的衣服就可以了: her own clothes are the one thing she must bring; food, drinks and things to sleep in are provided. The event is in the evening (晚上), and 明生 will wait at the main gate, not on the lawn.

text.traditional:
時間：早上六點到晚上十點（星期一休息）
只要是住在社區的人，就可以來游泳，不用付錢。
住在社區外面的朋友，一個人一次一百塊。
小孩得跟大人一起來。
請先洗澡，再進游泳池；不可以在游泳池旁邊吃東西。
text.simplified:
时间：早上六点到晚上十点（星期一休息）
只要是住在社区的人，就可以来游泳，不用付钱。
住在社区外面的朋友，一个人一次一百块。
小孩得跟大人一起来。
请先洗澡，再进游泳池；不可以在游泳池旁边吃东西。
text.pinyin:
Shíjiān: Zǎoshàng liù diǎn dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn (xīngqíyī xiūxí)
Zhǐyào shì zhù zài shèqū de rén, jiù kěyǐ lái yóuyǒng, búyòng fù qián.
Zhù zài shèqū wàimiàn de péngyǒu, yí ge rén yí cì yìbǎi kuài.
Xiǎohái děi gēn dàrén yìqǐ lái.
Qǐng xiān xǐzǎo, zài jìn yóuyǒngchí; bù kěyǐ zài yóuyǒngchí pángbiān chī dōngxi.
text.english:
Hours: 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. (closed on Mondays)
Anyone who lives in the complex can swim here free of charge.
Friends who live outside the complex: 100 dollars per person per visit.
Children must come with an adult.
Please shower before entering the pool; no eating beside the pool.

versions.alt: A sign fixed on the wall at the entrance of an outdoor community swimming pool

prompt.traditional: 一位住在社區的先生星期天帶兩個住在社區外面的朋友來游泳，一共要付多少錢？
prompt.simplified: 一位住在社区的先生星期天带两个住在社区外面的朋友来游泳，一共要付多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi zhù zài shèqū de xiānshēng xīngqítiān dài liǎng ge zhù zài shèqū wàimiàn de péngyǒu lái yóuyǒng, yígòng yào fù duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: A man who lives in the complex brings two friends who live outside it to swim on Sunday. How much do they pay in all?

choices.english: Nothing.
100 dollars.
200 dollars.
300 dollars.

questions.why: 只要是住在社區的人，就……不用付錢: he lives in the complex, so he swims free; his two friends pay 一個人一次一百塊, so 200 in all. The pool is open on Sundays; only Mondays are closed.

text.traditional: 我的室友人很好，除了常常替我買早飯，還把房間打掃得很乾淨。可是我們的生活習慣很不一樣。他每天早上五點就起床，在房間裡聽音樂，聲音很大，我常常沒辦法睡覺。雖然我很喜歡他，可是我還是決定下個學期搬出去住。
text.simplified: 我的室友人很好，除了常常替我买早饭，还把房间打扫得很干净。可是我们的生活习惯很不一样。他每天早上五点就起床，在房间里听音乐，声音很大，我常常没办法睡觉。虽然我很喜欢他，可是我还是决定下个学期搬出去住。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu rén hěn hǎo, chúle chángcháng tì wǒ mǎi zǎofàn, hái bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de hěn gānjìng. Kěshì wǒmen de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn bù yíyàng. Tā měi tiān zǎoshàng wǔ diǎn jiù qǐchuáng, zài fángjiān lǐ tīng yīnyuè, shēngyīn hěn dà, wǒ chángcháng méi bànfǎ shuìjiào. Suīrán wǒ hěn xǐhuān tā, kěshì wǒ háishì juédìng xià ge xuéqí bān chūqù zhù.
text.english: My roommate is a really nice person. Besides often buying breakfast for me, he also keeps our room very clean. But our habits are very different. He gets up at five every morning and plays music loudly in the room, so I often can't sleep. Although I like him a lot, I've still decided to move out next semester.

prompt.traditional: 他為什麼決定搬出去住？
prompt.simplified: 他为什么决定搬出去住？
prompt.pinyin: Tā wèishénme juédìng bān chūqù zhù?
prompt.english: Why has the writer decided to move out?

choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu bú tì tā mǎi zǎofàn le.
choices.english: The roommate doesn't buy him breakfast any more.
The roommate is too noisy in the mornings.

choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu bǎ fángjiān nòng de hěn zāng.
choices.english: The roommate makes the room very dirty.
The roommate is too noisy at night.

questions.why: 每天早上五點就起床，在房間裡聽音樂，聲音很大: the roommate plays loud music from five in the morning, so the writer can't sleep. It is mornings, not evenings; he keeps the room clean (把房間打掃得很乾淨) and buys breakfast (除了……，還……).

text.traditional: 我哥哥工作很忙，已經兩個星期沒打掃房間了。房東本來說今天要來看房子，後來又說下個月再來；同事本來也要來他家看球賽，後來大家決定去同事家看。昨天下午媽媽打電話說今天要來看他，他才趕快把房間打掃乾淨。媽媽來了以後說：「你的房間比上次乾淨多了！」
text.simplified: 我哥哥工作很忙，已经两个星期没打扫房间了。房东本来说今天要来看房子，后来又说下个月再来；同事本来也要来他家看球赛，后来大家决定去同事家看。昨天下午妈妈打电话说今天要来看他，他才赶快把房间打扫干净。妈妈来了以后说：「你的房间比上次干净多了！」
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge gōngzuò hěn máng, yǐjīng liǎng ge xīngqí méi dǎsǎo fángjiān le. Fángdōng běnlái shuō jīntiān yào lái kàn fángzi, hòulái yòu shuō xià ge yuè zài lái; tóngshì běnlái yě yào lái tā jiā kàn qiúsài, hòulái dàjiā juédìng qù tóngshì jiā kàn. Zuótiān xiàwǔ māma dǎ diànhuà shuō jīntiān yào lái kàn tā, tā cái gǎnkuài bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng. Māma lái le yǐhòu shuō: "Nǐ de fángjiān bǐ shàng cì gānjìng duō le!"
text.english: My older brother is very busy with work and hadn't cleaned his room for two weeks. His landlord had said he would come to look at the flat today, then said he would come next month instead; his colleagues were also going to come over to watch a game, but then everyone decided to watch it at a colleague's place. Yesterday afternoon Mum called to say she was coming to see him today, and only then did he hurry to clean his room. When Mum arrived she said, "Your room is much cleaner than last time!"

prompt.traditional: 哥哥為什麼昨天打掃房間？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥为什么昨天打扫房间？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge wèishénme zuótiān dǎsǎo fángjiān?
prompt.english: Why did the older brother clean his room yesterday?

choices.english: His landlord was coming that day.
His colleagues were coming to watch a game.
His mother was coming that day.
He thought his room was too dirty.

questions.why: 媽媽打電話說今天要來看他，他才趕快把房間打掃乾淨: his mother's visit is what made him clean. The landlord put his visit off to next month, and the colleagues watched the game at someone else's home.

lines.english: Shall we go and sing at the KTV this Saturday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 週末常常客滿，也比平日貴多了。我星期三、星期五下午都沒課，妳哪天方便，我們就哪天去。
lines.simplified: 周末常常客满，也比平日贵多了。我星期三、星期五下午都没课，你哪天方便，我们就哪天去。

lines.english: Weekends are often fully booked, and much more expensive than weekdays. I have no class on Wednesday or Friday afternoon. Whichever day suits you, we'll go then.

lines.english: Today's three thousand in all. There are five of us, so six hundred each.

lines.traditional: 那怎麼可以！我才點了兩首歌，你一個人點了二十首。
lines.simplified: 那怎么可以！我才点了两首歌，你一个人点了二十首。
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme kěyǐ! Wǒ cái diǎn le liǎng shǒu gē, nǐ yígerén diǎn le èrshí shǒu.
lines.english: That's not fair! I only picked two songs, and you picked twenty on your own.

lines.traditional: 那妳說怎麼付？
lines.simplified: 那你说怎么付？

lines.traditional: 下星期是我室友的生日，我想送她香水或是巧克力，可是不知道她比較喜歡哪一個。

lines.traditional: 她很愛吃甜的嗎？
lines.simplified: 她很爱吃甜的吗？
lines.pinyin: Tā hěn ài chī tián de ma?
lines.english: Does she love sweet things?

lines.simplified: 不太爱。可是香水她已经有好几瓶了，我怕她觉得太多了。
lines.pinyin: Bú tài ài. Kěshì xiāngshuǐ tā yǐjīng yǒu hǎojǐ píng le, wǒ pà tā juéde tài duō le.
lines.english: Not really. But she already has several bottles of perfume; I'm afraid she'll think it's too many.

lines.english: She wears perfume every day, so one more bottle will get used. Give her perfume; she'll like it.

text.traditional:
平日早上六點到中午十二點：一個人才兩百元！
平日中午十二點以後：一個人三百元
週末、假日：一個人四百五十元
吃到飽：一個人再加一百五十元

平日早上六点到中午十二点：一个人才两百元！
平日中午十二点以后：一个人三百元

吃到饱：一个人再加一百五十元
text.pinyin:
Píngrì zǎoshàng liù diǎn dào zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn: yí ge rén cái liǎngbǎi yuán!
Píngrì zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu: yí ge rén sānbǎi yuán
Zhōumò, jiàrì: yí ge rén sìbǎi wǔshí yuán
Chīdàobǎo: yí ge rén zài jiā yìbǎi wǔshí yuán
text.english:
Weekdays, 6 a.m. to 12 noon: only NT$200 per person!
Weekdays after 12 noon: NT$300 per person
Weekends and holidays: NT$450 per person
All you can eat: NT$150 more per person

versions.alt: A price poster on the wall behind the front desk of a KTV, soft coloured lights

prompt.traditional: 一個學生星期三早上十點去唱歌，還想吃到飽，一共要付多少錢？
prompt.simplified: 一个学生星期三早上十点去唱歌，还想吃到饱，一共要付多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Yí ge xuéshēng xīngqísān zǎoshàng shí diǎn qù chànggē, hái xiǎng chīdàobǎo, yígòng yào fù duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: A student goes to sing at ten on Wednesday morning and wants all-you-can-eat too. How much does it cost in all?

questions.why: Ten on a Wednesday is a weekday morning: 一個人才兩百元 (only 200), plus 150 for all-you-can-eat makes 350. 450 is the weekend price, or a weekday afternoon with food.

text.traditional:
哥哥：
你要的那本小說，學校旁邊的書店已經賣完了。我在網路上找到一本，才兩百塊，比書店便宜一百塊。要不要我幫你買？
弟弟
text.simplified:
哥哥：
你要的那本小说，学校旁边的书店已经卖完了。我在网路上找到一本，才两百块，比书店便宜一百块。要不要我帮你买？
弟弟
text.pinyin:
Gēge:
Nǐ yào de nà běn xiǎoshuō, xuéxiào pángbiān de shūdiàn yǐjīng mài wán le. Wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng zhǎo dào yì běn, cái liǎngbǎi kuài, bǐ shūdiàn piányí yìbǎi kuài. Yào bú yào wǒ bāng nǐ mǎi?
Dìdi
text.english:
Big brother,
The bookstore next to school has sold out of the novel you want. I found one online for only 200, 100 cheaper than the bookstore. Shall I buy it for you?
Your little brother

prompt.traditional: 這本小說在書店賣多少錢？
prompt.simplified: 这本小说在书店卖多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō zài shūdiàn mài duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: How much does the novel cost at the bookstore?

questions.why: Online it is 才兩百塊 (only 200), 便宜一百塊 (100 cheaper) than the bookstore, so the bookstore asks 300. 200 is the online price, and 100 is only the difference.

text.traditional:
姐姐：
明天去KTV，我不能早上跟你們一起去了。媽媽上午要去看醫生，我得陪她。等媽媽看完醫生，我就坐捷運去找你們，大概十二點到。你們先開始吧！

明天去KTV，我不能早上跟你们一起去了。妈妈上午要去看医生，我得陪她。等妈妈看完医生，我就坐捷运去找你们，大概十二点到。你们先开始吧！
妹妹
text.pinyin:
Jiějie:
Míngtiān qù KTV, wǒ bù néng zǎoshàng gēn nǐmen yìqǐ qù le. Māma shàngwǔ yào qù kàn yīshēng, wǒ děi péi tā. Děng māma kàn wán yīshēng, wǒ jiù zuò jiéyùn qù zhǎo nǐmen, dàgài shí'èr diǎn dào. Nǐmen xiān kāishǐ ba!
Mèimei
text.english:
Big sister,
Tomorrow I can't go to the KTV with you all in the morning. Mom is seeing the doctor in the morning, and I have to go with her. Once she's done at the doctor's, I'll take the MRT to meet you, getting there around twelve. Start without me!
Your little sister

prompt.traditional: 妹妹明天什麼時候去KTV？
prompt.simplified: 妹妹明天什么时候去KTV？
prompt.pinyin: Mèimei míngtiān shénme shíhòu qù KTV?
prompt.english: When will the younger sister go to the KTV tomorrow?

choices.english: In the morning, with her older sister.
After she's done helping Mom.
She only leaves at twelve noon.

questions.why: 等媽媽看完醫生，我就……去找你們: she sets off once Mom's doctor visit is over. Going in the morning was the old plan, and twelve is when she'll arrive, not when she leaves.

text.traditional:
時間：這個星期六上午九點到十二點

請大家把自己的房間打掃乾淨，不要的東西請丟到一樓的垃圾桶。
等打掃完，我們就一起在一樓吃午飯。午飯、飲料都不用錢！
text.simplified:

请大家把自己的房间打扫干净，不要的东西请丢到一楼的垃圾桶。
等打扫完，我们就一起在一楼吃午饭。午饭、饮料都不用钱！
text.pinyin:
Shíjiān: Zhège xīngqíliù shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn dào shí'èr diǎn
Dìfāng: Xuéshēng sùshè
Qǐng dàjiā bǎ zìjǐ de fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng, bú yào de dōngxi qǐng diū dào yī lóu de lèsètǒng.
Děng dǎsǎo wán, wǒmen jiù yìqǐ zài yī lóu chī wǔfàn. Wǔfàn, yǐnliào dōu búyòng qián!

Please clean your own room, and throw what you don't want into the trash cans on the first floor.
Once the cleaning is done, we'll have lunch together on the first floor. Lunch and drinks are free!

prompt.simplified: 这次宿舍打扫，哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè cì sùshè dǎsǎo, nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which is true about this dorm cleaning?

choices.english: Everyone pays for their own lunch.
It's on Saturday afternoon.

choices.pinyin: Dǎsǎo wán le jiù yǒu wǔfàn chī.
choices.english: There's lunch once the cleaning is done.

questions.why: 等打掃完，我們就一起……吃午飯: lunch comes as soon as the cleaning is done, and it's free (不用錢). The cleaning is on Saturday morning, 九點到十二點.

versions.alt: A karaoke room with orange, yellow and blue striped walls, a big glowing screen in the top right corner and a green plant behind the sofa. In front, seen from behind, a person with curly brown hair and a teal shirt holds a microphone and faces the sofa. On the orange sofa, a young woman with long wavy black hair, gold hoop earrings, an orange top and white trousers laughs with her eyes closed and claps; next to her, a young man with curly brown hair, an olive-green hoodie and dark trousers laughs and raises one fist in the air. On the dark round table in front lie a red tambourine, a bowl of French fries, a plate of fried chicken pieces with lettuce and a small dish of red sauce, and a glass of cola with ice and a straw.

prompt.traditional: 桌上除了吃的東西，還有一個好玩的＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 桌上除了吃的东西，还有一个好玩的＿＿。

choices.english: machine
musical instrument
floor

answer.traditional: 桌上除了吃的東西，還有一個好玩的樂器。
answer.simplified: 桌上除了吃的东西，还有一个好玩的乐器。
answer.pinyin: Zhuō shàng chúle chī de dōngxi, hái yǒu yí ge hǎowán de yuèqì.
answer.english: Besides the food, there's a fun musical instrument on the table.

questions.why: The red tambourine on the table is a 樂器 (musical instrument) to play while singing. A 機器 is a machine, and the 地板 (floor) is not on the table.

prompt.traditional: 沙發上穿綠色衣服的男生看起來很＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 沙发上穿绿色衣服的男生看起来很＿＿。

choices.english: excited
shy
sad

answer.traditional: 沙發上穿綠色衣服的男生看起來很興奮。
answer.simplified: 沙发上穿绿色衣服的男生看起来很兴奋。
answer.pinyin: Shāfā shàng chuān lǜsè yīfu de nánshēng kànqǐlái hěn xīngfèn.
answer.english: The young man in green on the sofa looks very excited.

questions.why: He laughs with one fist in the air, so he looks 興奮 (excited), not 害羞 (shy) or 傷心 (sad).

prompt.traditional: 這首歌＿＿沙發上的兩個人都好開心。
prompt.simplified: 这首歌＿＿沙发上的两个人都好开心。

choices.english: by (passive)
to make (someone feel)
(object marker)

answer.traditional: 這首歌讓沙發上的兩個人都好開心。
answer.simplified: 这首歌让沙发上的两个人都好开心。
answer.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē ràng shāfā shàng de liǎng ge rén dōu hǎo kāixīn.
answer.english: This song makes the two on the sofa really happy.

questions.why: A 讓 B + feeling: the song (A) makes the two on the sofa (B) happy. 被 marks the passive and 把 an object; neither links a cause to a feeling.

versions.alt: A karaoke room with orange, yellow and blue striped walls, a big glowing screen in the top right corner and a green plant behind the sofa. In front, seen from behind, a person with curly brown hair and a teal shirt holds a microphone and faces the sofa. On the orange sofa, a young woman with long wavy black hair, gold hoop earrings, an orange top and white trousers laughs with her eyes closed and claps; next to her, a young man with curly brown hair, an olive-green hoodie and dark trousers laughs and raises one fist in the air. On the dark round table in front lie a red tambourine, a bowl of French fries, a plate of fried chicken pieces with lettuce and a small dish of red sauce, and a glass of cola with ice and a straw.

prompt.traditional: 桌上有一＿＿冰的飲料。
prompt.simplified: 桌上有一＿＿冰的饮料。

choices.english: (for bunches)
(for songs)
glass, cup

answer.traditional: 桌上有一杯冰的飲料。
answer.simplified: 桌上有一杯冰的饮料。
answer.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu yì bēi bīng de yǐnliào.
answer.english: There's a glass of iced drink on the table.

questions.why: A drink in a glass is counted with 杯. 束 is for bunches of flowers and 首 for songs.

prompt.traditional: 沙發上的女生聽得很開心，一直在＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 沙发上的女生听得很开心，一直在＿＿。

choices.english: to cry
to laugh
to dance

answer.traditional: 沙發上的女生聽得很開心，一直在笑。
answer.simplified: 沙发上的女生听得很开心，一直在笑。
answer.pinyin: Shāfā shàng de nǚshēng tīng de hěn kāixīn, yìzhí zài xiào.
answer.english: The young woman on the sofa is enjoying it and keeps laughing.

questions.why: She claps and laughs with her eyes closed: 一直在笑. She isn't crying (哭), and she is sitting, not dancing (跳).

prompt.traditional: 跟朋友一起在KTV吃東西、聽歌，真＿＿人覺得輕鬆。
prompt.simplified: 跟朋友一起在KTV吃东西、听歌，真＿＿人觉得轻松。

choices.english: for, on behalf of
to make (someone feel)
by (passive)

answer.traditional: 跟朋友一起在KTV吃東西、聽歌，真讓人覺得輕鬆。
answer.simplified: 跟朋友一起在KTV吃东西、听歌，真让人觉得轻松。
answer.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ zài KTV chī dōngxi, tīng gē, zhēn ràng rén juéde qīngsōng.
answer.english: Eating and listening to songs with friends at the KTV really makes you feel relaxed.

questions.why: A 讓 B + feeling: an evening at the KTV with friends makes people (人) feel relaxed. 替 means 'on behalf of' and 被 marks the passive; neither links a cause to a feeling.

passage.traditional: 上個週末，我第一次帶爸爸媽媽去KTV。那裡的{1}很多，有新歌，也有很多老歌。我們點了好幾首，一家人一起{2}，非常熱鬧。爸爸一開始有點害羞，後來點的歌比誰都多。KTV的機器還會給唱歌的人{3}，爸爸的分數最{4}，才六十分，可是他說開心最重要。媽媽說下次還要再來。
passage.simplified: 上个周末，我第一次带爸爸妈妈去KTV。那里的{1}很多，有新歌，也有很多老歌。我们点了好几首，一家人一起{2}，非常热闹。爸爸一开始有点害羞，后来点的歌比谁都多。KTV的机器还会给唱歌的人{3}，爸爸的分数最{4}，才六十分，可是他说开心最重要。妈妈说下次还要再来。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ dì yī cì dài bàba māma qù KTV. Nàlǐ de gēqǔ hěn duō, yǒu xīn gē, yě yǒu hěn duō lǎo gē. Wǒmen diǎn le hǎojǐ shǒu, yìjiārén yìqǐ héchàng, fēicháng rènao. Bàba yì kāishǐ yǒudiǎn hàixiū, hòulái diǎn de gē bǐ shéi dōu duō. KTV de jīqì hái huì gěi chànggē de rén dǎfēnshù, bàba de fēnshù zuì dī, cái liùshí fēn, kěshì tā shuō kāixīn zuì zhòngyào. Māma shuō xià cì hái yào zài lái.
passage.english: Last weekend I took my mom and dad to KTV for the first time. There were lots of songs, new ones and lots of old ones too. We picked several, and the whole family sang together; it was really lively. Dad was a bit shy at first, but in the end he picked more songs than anyone. The KTV machine even gives the singers a score. Dad got the lowest, only sixty, but he said having fun is what matters most. Mom said she wants to come again next time.

questions.why: 那裡的歌曲很多: the KTV has lots of songs, new and old.
一家人一起合唱: the whole family sings together, which is lively.
給唱歌的人打分數: the machine gives each singer a score.
分數最低，才六十分: only sixty, the lowest score of the family.

passage.traditional: 學校後面有一家{1}的餐廳。那裡的台灣小吃，從滷肉飯到豆花，{2}的都有，客人想吃什麼就拿什麼，{3}擔心吃不飽。不過週末人很多，常常要排隊，所以我都{4}平日中午沒課的時間去，人少，也比較便宜。我最喜歡那裡的鹹酥雞跟芒果冰，每次都吃得很飽。
passage.simplified: 学校后面有一家{1}的餐厅。那里的台湾小吃，从卤肉饭到豆花，{2}的都有，客人想吃什么就拿什么，{3}担心吃不饱。不过周末人很多，常常要排队，所以我都{4}平日中午没课的时间去，人少，也比较便宜。我最喜欢那里的咸酥鸡跟芒果冰，每次都吃得很饱。
passage.pinyin: Xuéxiào hòumiàn yǒu yì jiā chīdàobǎo de cāntīng. Nàlǐ de Táiwān xiǎochī, cóng lǔròufàn dào dòuhuā, gèshìgèyàng de dōu yǒu, kèrén xiǎng chī shénme jiù ná shénme, búbì dānxīn chī bù bǎo. Búguò zhōumò rén hěn duō, chángcháng yào páiduì, suǒyǐ wǒ dōu lìyòng píngrì zhōngwǔ méi kè de shíjiān qù, rén shǎo, yě bǐjiào piányí. Wǒ zuì xǐhuān nàlǐ de xiánsūjī gēn mángguǒbīng, měi cì dōu chī de hěn bǎo.
passage.english: Behind school there is an all-you-can-eat restaurant. It has every kind of Taiwanese snack, from braised pork rice to tofu pudding, and guests take whatever they want, so there's no need to worry about going hungry. But on weekends it's crowded and you often have to queue, so I use my free weekday lunchtimes to go: fewer people, and cheaper too. I like their popcorn chicken and mango ice best, and I always leave full.

questions.why: 一家吃到飽的餐廳: an all-you-can-eat restaurant, so guests take whatever they like.
從滷肉飯到豆花，各式各樣的都有: every kind of snack is there.
不必擔心吃不飽: with everything on offer, there's no need to worry about going hungry.
利用……沒課的時間: make use of the weekday lunchtimes when there's no class.

text.traditional: 我來台灣半年了。第一次跟台灣同學去KTV的時候，我不會中文歌，只能坐在旁邊聽大家唱歌。後來，一個同學每個星期教我兩首歌，現在我已經學會十幾首了。下個月班上要辦活動，我打算表演一首中文歌，希望大家會喜歡。
text.simplified: 我来台湾半年了。第一次跟台湾同学去KTV的时候，我不会中文歌，只能坐在旁边听大家唱歌。后来，一个同学每个星期教我两首歌，现在我已经学会十几首了。下个月班上要办活动，我打算表演一首中文歌，希望大家会喜欢。
text.pinyin: Wǒ lái Táiwān bàn nián le. Dì yī cì gēn Táiwān tóngxué qù KTV de shíhòu, wǒ bú huì Zhōngwén gē, zhǐ néng zuò zài pángbiān tīng dàjiā chànggē. Hòulái, yí ge tóngxué měi ge xīngqí jiāo wǒ liǎng shǒu gē, xiànzài wǒ yǐjīng xuéhuì shí jǐ shǒu le. Xià ge yuè bān shàng yào bàn huódòng, wǒ dǎsuàn biǎoyǎn yì shǒu Zhōngwén gē, xīwàng dàjiā huì xǐhuān.
text.english: I've been in Taiwan for half a year. The first time I went to KTV with Taiwanese classmates, I didn't know any Chinese songs and could only sit at the side listening to everyone sing. Then a classmate started teaching me two songs a week, and now I've learned over ten. Next month our class is holding an event, and I plan to perform a Chinese song. I hope everyone will like it.

prompt.traditional: 這個人現在怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 这个人现在怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén xiànzài zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How is this person doing now?

choices.pinyin: Háishì zhǐ néng tīng dàjiā chànggē.
choices.english: He can still only listen to the others sing.

choices.pinyin: Xiànzài huì de Zhōngwén gē bùshǎo.
choices.english: He knows quite a few Chinese songs now.

choices.traditional: 每個星期教同學兩首歌
choices.simplified: 每个星期教同学两首歌
choices.pinyin: Měi ge xīngqí jiāo tóngxué liǎng shǒu gē.
choices.english: He teaches a classmate two songs a week.

choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè yào zài KTV biǎoyǎn.
choices.english: He'll perform at a KTV next month.

questions.why: 已經學會十幾首了: he has learned over ten songs, so he knows quite a few (不少). Only listening was his first time at the KTV, it is the classmate who teaches him, and he'll perform at a class event, not at the KTV.

text.traditional: 今天是我男朋友的生日。我本來想請他去吃牛排，可是他說想去KTV唱歌。到了KTV，我們才發現因為是假日，房間都客滿了。最後我們去便利商店買了一個小蛋糕，坐在學校旁邊的公園裡，一邊吃一邊聊天。他說，這是他最開心的一個生日。
text.simplified: 今天是我男朋友的生日。我本来想请他去吃牛排，可是他说想去KTV唱歌。到了KTV，我们才发现因为是假日，房间都客满了。最后我们去便利商店买了一个小蛋糕，坐在学校旁边的公园里，一边吃一边聊天。他说，这是他最开心的一个生日。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ nánpéngyǒu de shēngrì. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng qǐng tā qù chī niúpái, kěshì tā shuō xiǎng qù KTV chànggē. Dào le KTV, wǒmen cái fāxiàn yīnwèi shì jiàrì, fángjiān dōu kèmǎn le. Zuìhòu wǒmen qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi le yí ge xiǎo dàngāo, zuò zài xuéxiào pángbiān de gōngyuán lǐ, yìbiān chī yìbiān liáotiān. Tā shuō, zhè shì tā zuì kāixīn de yí ge shēngrì.
text.english: Today is my boyfriend's birthday. I first wanted to take him out for steak, but he said he wanted to go and sing at a KTV. When we got there, we found every room was fully booked because it was a holiday. In the end we bought a small cake at a convenience store and sat in the park next to school, eating and chatting. He said it was his happiest birthday ever.

prompt.traditional: 他們最後在哪裡慶祝生日？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后在哪里庆祝生日？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu zài nǎlǐ qìngzhù shēngrì?
prompt.english: Where did they celebrate the birthday in the end?

choices.english: At a steak restaurant.
At the KTV.
At a convenience store.
In a park.

questions.why: The steak was only her first plan (本來), the KTV was fully booked (客滿), and the convenience store is just where they bought the cake. They ate it in the park next to school.

text.traditional: 我妹妹這次考試考得不好，回家以後一直在房間裡哭。我想帶她去KTV輕鬆一下，可是她說不想出門。後來我告訴她，那家KTV可以吃到飽，她才跟我去。她在那裡吃了很多東西，也點了很多歌。回家的路上，她說吃東西、唱歌讓她心情好多了。
text.simplified: 我妹妹这次考试考得不好，回家以后一直在房间里哭。我想带她去KTV轻松一下，可是她说不想出门。后来我告诉她，那家KTV可以吃到饱，她才跟我去。她在那里吃了很多东西，也点了很多歌。回家的路上，她说吃东西、唱歌让她心情好多了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei zhè cì kǎoshì kǎo de bù hǎo, huí jiā yǐhòu yìzhí zài fángjiān lǐ kū. Wǒ xiǎng dài tā qù KTV qīngsōng yíxià, kěshì tā shuō bù xiǎng chūmén. Hòulái wǒ gàosu tā, nà jiā KTV kěyǐ chīdàobǎo, tā cái gēn wǒ qù. Tā zài nàlǐ chī le hěn duō dōngxi, yě diǎn le hěn duō gē. Huí jiā de lùshàng, tā shuō chī dōngxi, chànggē ràng tā xīnqíng hǎo duō le.
text.english: My little sister did badly in this exam and cried in her room the whole time after she got home. I wanted to take her to KTV to relax, but she said she didn't want to go out. Then I told her that KTV was all-you-can-eat, and only then did she come with me. She ate lots there and picked lots of songs. On the way home she said the food and the singing had made her feel much better.

prompt.traditional: 妹妹後來為什麼願意去KTV？
prompt.simplified: 妹妹后来为什么愿意去KTV？
prompt.pinyin: Mèimei hòulái wèishénme yuànyì qù KTV?
prompt.english: Why was the sister willing to go to the KTV in the end?

choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qù nàlǐ diǎn hěn duō gē.
choices.english: She wanted to pick lots of songs there.

choices.traditional: 她回家以後心情就好了
choices.simplified: 她回家以后心情就好了
choices.pinyin: Tā huí jiā yǐhòu xīnqíng jiù hǎo le.
choices.english: She felt better once she got home.

choices.pinyin: Tā zhè cì kǎoshì kǎo de búcuò.
choices.english: She did well in the exam this time.

choices.pinyin: Nàlǐ xiǎng chī duōshǎo dōu kěyǐ.
choices.english: She could eat as much as she liked there.

questions.why: 那家KTV可以吃到飽，她才跟我去: only the all-you-can-eat (想吃多少都可以) got her out of the house. She picked songs once she was there, felt better on the way home because of the outing, and did badly in the exam.

focus.en: all you can eat, only then she went

text.traditional:
樓下的鄰居：
你們好！我住在你們樓上。這個月你們家的卡拉OK常常開到半夜，聲音很大，讓我晚上睡不好，第二天上課也很累。我知道唱歌讓人很開心，不過，晚上十點以後，能不能請你們把聲音關小一點？謝謝！
樓上的學生
text.simplified:
楼下的邻居：
你们好！我住在你们楼上。这个月你们家的卡拉OK常常开到半夜，声音很大，让我晚上睡不好，第二天上课也很累。我知道唱歌让人很开心，不过，晚上十点以后，能不能请你们把声音关小一点？谢谢！
楼上的学生
text.pinyin:
Lóuxià de línjū:
Nǐmen hǎo! Wǒ zhù zài nǐmen lóushàng. Zhège yuè nǐmen jiā de kǎlā OK chángcháng kāi dào bànyè, shēngyīn hěn dà, ràng wǒ wǎnshàng shuì bù hǎo, dì èr tiān shàngkè yě hěn lèi. Wǒ zhīdào chànggē ràng rén hěn kāixīn, búguò, wǎnshàng shí diǎn yǐhòu, néng bù néng qǐng nǐmen bǎ shēngyīn guān xiǎo yìdiǎn? Xièxie!
Lóushàng de xuéshēng
text.english:
To my downstairs neighbors,
Hello! I live upstairs from you. This month your karaoke has often been on until midnight, and it's so loud that I can't sleep well at night and I'm tired in class the next day. I know singing makes people happy, but after ten at night, could you please turn the volume down a little? Thank you!
The student upstairs

prompt.traditional: 這個學生為什麼寫這張留言？
prompt.simplified: 这个学生为什么写这张留言？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège xuéshēng wèishénme xiě zhè zhāng liúyán?
prompt.english: Why does the student write this note?

choices.pinyin: Tā jiā de kǎlā OK tài dàshēng.
choices.english: His own karaoke is too loud.
The neighbors can't sleep at night.

choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gēn línjū yìqǐ chànggē.
choices.english: He wants to sing with the neighbors.

choices.pinyin: Lóuxià chǎo de tā shuì bù hǎo.
choices.english: The noise downstairs keeps him from sleeping well.

questions.why: 聲音很大，讓我晚上睡不好: the karaoke downstairs is so loud that he can't sleep, so he asks them to turn it down after ten. The karaoke is the neighbors', and it is he, not they, who can't sleep.

text.traditional: 我的室友很不愛打掃，房間總是又髒又亂。我叫他打掃，他總是說等一下。上個週末他要搬家，房東說要先把房間打掃乾淨，才能拿回押金。他就把髒衣服都洗了，把地掃乾淨，還把桌子擦了一次。原來他也會打掃！
text.simplified: 我的室友很不爱打扫，房间总是又脏又乱。我叫他打扫，他总是说等一下。上个周末他要搬家，房东说要先把房间打扫干净，才能拿回押金。他就把脏衣服都洗了，把地扫干净，还把桌子擦了一次。原来他也会打扫！
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu hěn bú ài dǎsǎo, fángjiān zǒngshì yòu zāng yòu luàn. Wǒ jiào tā dǎsǎo, tā zǒngshì shuō děng yíxià. Shàng ge zhōumò tā yào bānjiā, fángdōng shuō yào xiān bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng, cái néng ná huí yājīn. Tā jiù bǎ zāng yīfu dōu xǐ le, bǎ dì sǎo gānjìng, hái bǎ zhuōzi cā le yí cì. Yuánlái tā yě huì dǎsǎo!
text.english: My roommate really doesn't like cleaning, and his room is always dirty and messy. When I tell him to clean, he always says 'in a minute'. Last weekend he was moving out, and the landlord said the room had to be cleaned first before he could get his deposit back. So he washed all his dirty clothes, swept the floor clean and even wiped the table. So he can clean after all!

prompt.traditional: 上個週末，室友為什麼打掃房間？
prompt.simplified: 上个周末，室友为什么打扫房间？
prompt.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò, shìyǒu wèishénme dǎsǎo fángjiān?
prompt.english: Why did the roommate clean his room last weekend?

choices.english: He wanted his deposit back.

choices.pinyin: Tā měi ge zhōumò dōu dǎsǎo.
choices.english: He cleans every weekend.
The landlord told him to move out.

choices.pinyin: Tā juéde fángjiān tài zāng le.
choices.english: He thought his room was too dirty.

questions.why: 要先把房間打掃乾淨，才能拿回押金: only a clean room gets the deposit back (……，才……), so that is why he cleaned. The mess never bothers him, he doesn't clean every weekend, and the move was his own; the landlord only asked for a clean room.

text.traditional: 我家附近有一家很特別的書店。只要買兩本書，就送一杯咖啡。每個星期六晚上，書店都會辦活動，有時候請寫書的人來介紹新書，有時候放電影給大家看。書店裡的椅子很舒服，我常常看書看著看著，就忘了時間。
text.simplified: 我家附近有一家很特别的书店。只要买两本书，就送一杯咖啡。每个星期六晚上，书店都会办活动，有时候请写书的人来介绍新书，有时候放电影给大家看。书店里的椅子很舒服，我常常看书看着看着，就忘了时间。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā hěn tèbié de shūdiàn. Zhǐyào mǎi liǎng běn shū, jiù sòng yì bēi kāfēi. Měi ge xīngqíliù wǎnshàng, shūdiàn dōu huì bàn huódòng, yǒushíhòu qǐng xiě shū de rén lái jièshào xīn shū, yǒushíhòu fàng diànyǐng gěi dàjiā kàn. Shūdiàn lǐ de yǐzi hěn shūfu, wǒ chángcháng kàn shū kànzhe kànzhe, jiù wàng le shíjiān.
text.english: Near my home there is a very special bookstore. Buy two books and you get a free coffee. Every Saturday evening the store holds an event: sometimes a writer comes to present a new book, sometimes they show a film for everyone. The chairs in the store are so comfortable that I often lose track of time reading.

prompt.traditional: 在這家書店，怎麼樣可以拿到一杯咖啡？
prompt.simplified: 在这家书店，怎么样可以拿到一杯咖啡？
prompt.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā shūdiàn, zěnmeyàng kěyǐ ná dào yì bēi kāfēi?
prompt.english: At this bookstore, how do you get a cup of coffee?

choices.english: Buy one book.
Buy two books.
Read in the store.
Come to a film on Saturday evening.

questions.why: 只要買兩本書，就送一杯咖啡: the condition is buying two books. One book isn't enough, reading in the store doesn't count, and the Saturday films are only 有時候 (sometimes) and come with no coffee.

picture.alt: Three students sit together at a wooden table in front of large windows. Outside the windows are green mountains, a curving bay of blue sea with a sandy beach, some city buildings, trees and a blue sky with white clouds. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark-brown hair and round glasses wears a white collared shirt under a dark purple knit vest; she holds a light-purple phone in one hand, points at its screen with the other and is talking. In the middle, a boy with black hair wears an open green jacket over a red striped T-shirt; he rests his cheek on his hand and smiles. On the right, a girl with long curly dark-brown hair and gold hoop earrings wears an open blue shirt over an orange top and white trousers; she rests her chin on her hand and smiles. On the table: a stack of blue and green books, an open spiral notebook with a green pen lying on it, a postcard of a sea-and-mountain view like the one outside, a lavender water bottle and a black backpack. A white backpack hangs on the chair behind the girl with glasses. Nothing hangs on the windows, and nobody is holding the postcard.

choices.pinyin: Yǒu hǎi, yě yǒu hěn duō rén zài yóuyǒng.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說學校旁邊那家店的蛋糕很好吃，我們下了課去買吧！
lines.simplified: 听说学校旁边那家店的蛋糕很好吃，我们下了课去买吧！
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō xuéxiào pángbiān nà jiā diàn de dàngāo hěn hǎochī, wǒmen xià le kè qù mǎi ba!
lines.english: I hear the cakes at the shop next to the school are really good. Let's go and buy some after class!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下了課再去就太晚了，那家店的蛋糕每天中午以前就賣光了。
lines.simplified: 下了课再去就太晚了，那家店的蛋糕每天中午以前就卖光了。
lines.pinyin: Xià le kè zài qù jiù tài wǎn le, nà jiā diàn de dàngāo měitiān zhōngwǔ yǐqián jiù màiguāng le.
lines.english: After class will be too late. That shop's cakes are sold out before noon every day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我們明天早一點出門，先去買蛋糕，再去上課。
lines.simplified: 那我们明天早一点出门，先去买蛋糕，再去上课。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen míngtiān zǎo yìdiǎn chūmén, xiān qù mǎi dàngāo, zài qù shàngkè.
lines.english: Then let's leave a bit earlier tomorrow, buy the cake first and then go to class.

prompt.pinyin: Tāmen shénme shíhòu qù mǎi dàngāo?

prompt.traditional: 一位先生七點才能到台北車站。他要搭幾點的火車，才能最早到花蓮？

prompt.english: A man can't get to Taipei Station before seven. Which train should he take to reach Hualien as early as possible?

questions.why: He can't make the 6:10 train. The 7:30 train stops at 12 stations and only arrives at 10:40; the 8:00 train leaves later but arrives first, at 10:15.

text.traditional:
弟弟：
我明天早上就要出發去花蓮，星期天晚上才回來。你的電腦壞了，趁我不在家，你可以用我的。可是我回來以前，請你把電腦放回我的房間。
哥哥
text.simplified:
弟弟：
我明天早上就要出发去花莲，星期天晚上才回来。你的电脑坏了，趁我不在家，你可以用我的。可是我回来以前，请你把电脑放回我的房间。
哥哥
text.pinyin:
Dìdi:
Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshàng jiù yào chūfā qù Huālián, xīngqítiān wǎnshàng cái huílái. Nǐ de diànnǎo huài le, chèn wǒ bú zài jiā, nǐ kěyǐ yòng wǒ de. Kěshì wǒ huílái yǐqián, qǐng nǐ bǎ diànnǎo fàng huí wǒ de fángjiān.
Gēge
text.english:
Little brother,
I'm leaving for Hualien tomorrow morning and won't be back until Sunday evening. Your computer is broken, so while I'm away you can use mine. But please put it back in my room before I come home.
Your big brother

prompt.traditional: 弟弟什麼時候可以用哥哥的電腦？
prompt.simplified: 弟弟什么时候可以用哥哥的电脑？
prompt.pinyin: Dìdi shénme shíhòu kěyǐ yòng gēge de diànnǎo?

choices.english: Before his brother leaves.
While his brother is in Hualien.
After his brother comes back.

questions.why: 趁我不在家，你可以用我的: he may use the computer while his brother is away, and must put it back before his brother comes home on Sunday evening.

text.traditional:
老闆：
謝謝您這幾天的幫忙！房間是有點小，可是很乾淨，從窗戶還看得到山。您做的早飯也好吃極了。下次我一定會再帶朋友來住。
203號房間的客人
text.simplified:
老板：
谢谢您这几天的帮忙！房间是有点小，可是很干净，从窗户还看得到山。您做的早饭也好吃极了。下次我一定会再带朋友来住。
203号房间的客人
text.pinyin:
Lǎobǎn:
Xièxie nín zhè jǐ tiān de bāngmáng! Fángjiān shì yǒudiǎn xiǎo, kěshì hěn gānjìng, cóng chuānghù hái kàn de dào shān. Nín zuò de zǎofàn yě hǎochī jíle. Xiàcì wǒ yídìng huì zài dài péngyǒu lái zhù.
Èr líng sān hào fángjiān de kèrén
text.english:
Dear owner,
Thank you for all your help these past few days! The room is a bit small, it's true, but very clean, and you can even see the mountains from the window. The breakfast you made was delicious, too. Next time I'll definitely bring friends to stay.
The guest in Room 203

versions.alt: A sunny dorm room with a wooden loft bed and shelves behind. Two young people sit side by side at a desk, looking at an open grey laptop. The one on the left has wavy shoulder-length brown hair and wears a mustard-yellow knit vest over a plum-coloured shirt; this person smiles and points at the laptop. The one on the right, a young man with spiky black hair, wears an open blue jacket over a white T-shirt; he smiles and raises both fists in joy. On the desk: a stack of books, a black phone lying unused, a postcard of forested mountains above a sea of clouds with a wooden viewing deck, the laptop and a green water bottle. A green backpack and a blue bag sit at the two ends of the desk. Through the window on the right are mountains, trees and a blue sky with clouds; a mountain poster hangs on the wall.

prompt.pinyin: Chuān lánsè ＿＿ de nánshēng kànqǐlái fēicháng gāoxìng.
prompt.english: The young man in the blue ＿＿ looks very happy.

choices.english: coat
raincoat
jacket

answer.traditional: 穿藍色外套的男生看起來非常高興。
answer.simplified: 穿蓝色外套的男生看起来非常高兴。
answer.pinyin: Chuān lánsè wàitào de nánshēng kànqǐlái fēicháng gāoxìng.

prompt.simplified: 他们刚订到小火车的票，＿＿把订票号码记下来了。

right away
then (later)

answer.simplified: 他们刚订到小火车的票，就把订票号码记下来了。

let
for (someone)

phone

prompt.english: Not only did they get high-speed rail tickets, they ＿＿ got tickets for the Forest Train.

choices.english: then
also
only then

answer.traditional: 他們不但訂到了高鐵票，還訂到了小火車的票。
answer.simplified: 他们不但订到了高铁票，还订到了小火车的票。
answer.pinyin: Tāmen búdàn dìngdào le gāotiě piào, hái dìngdào le xiǎo huǒchē de piào.
answer.english: Not only did they get high-speed rail tickets, they also got tickets for the Forest Train.

prompt.traditional: 春假第一天的台鐵車票，他們一＿＿也沒訂到。
prompt.simplified: 春假第一天的台铁车票，他们一＿＿也没订到。

choices.english: bag (measure word)
dime
(measure word for tickets)

answer.traditional: 春假第一天的台鐵車票，他們一張也沒訂到。
answer.simplified: 春假第一天的台铁车票，他们一张也没订到。
answer.pinyin: Chūnjià dì yī tiān de Táitiě chēpiào, tāmen yì zhāng yě méi dìngdào.
answer.english: They didn't get a single Taiwan Railways ticket for the first day of spring break.

questions.why: 一 + measure word + 也沒 means not even one; tickets are counted with 張. 包 counts bags and 毛 is a dime.

passage.traditional: 上個週末我跟朋友去花蓮玩。出發以前，我發現這個月的錢都用光了，一{1}錢都沒有。還好朋友說：「別擔心，這幾天{2}我請客吧！」我們住在海邊的一家{3}，從房間就看得到大海。雖然那幾天花蓮很熱，可是山上{4}也不熱，我們玩得很開心。
passage.simplified: 上个周末我跟朋友去花莲玩。出发以前，我发现这个月的钱都用光了，一{1}钱都没有。还好朋友说：「别担心，这几天{2}我请客吧！」我们住在海边的一家{3}，从房间就看得到大海。虽然那几天花莲很热，可是山上{4}也不热，我们玩得很开心。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò wǒ gēn péngyǒu qù Huālián wán. Chūfā yǐqián, wǒ fāxiàn zhège yuè de qián dōu yòngguāng le, yì máo qián dōu méiyǒu. Háihǎo péngyǒu shuō: "Bié dānxīn, zhè jǐ tiān ràng wǒ qǐngkè ba!" Wǒmen zhù zài hǎibiān de yì jiā mínsù, cóng fángjiān jiù kàn de dào dàhǎi. Suīrán nà jǐ tiān Huālián hěn rè, kěshì shān shàng yìdiǎn yě bú rè, wǒmen wán de hěn kāixīn.
passage.english: Last weekend I went to Hualien with a friend. Before we left, I found I had used up all my money for the month and didn't have a single dime. Luckily my friend said, "Don't worry, let me pay for everything these few days!" We stayed at a B&B by the sea, and we could see the sea from our room. Although Hualien was hot those days, it wasn't hot at all up in the mountains, and we had a great time.

questions.why: 一毛錢都沒有: not even a dime (一 + 毛 + 都沒有). 包 counts bags, not money.
讓我請客吧: the friend politely offers, 'let me treat you'.
一家民宿: they stayed at a B&B (counted with 家), with a sea view from the room.
一點也不熱: not hot at all, in contrast with hot Hualien (雖然……，可是……).

passage.traditional: 我很喜歡爬山。前年春假，我{1}天氣好，自己去國家公園爬山。我早上六點就出發了，那時候山上很安靜，一{2}人都沒有。我走了三個小時，一點{3}不覺得累，因為山上的風景太美了。下山的時候，我還買了一些當地的{4}，送給家人。
passage.simplified: 我很喜欢爬山。前年春假，我{1}天气好，自己去国家公园爬山。我早上六点就出发了，那时候山上很安静，一{2}人都没有。我走了三个小时，一点{3}不觉得累，因为山上的风景太美了。下山的时候，我还买了一些当地的{4}，送给家人。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān pá shān. Qiánnián chūnjià, wǒ chèn tiānqì hǎo, zìjǐ qù guójiā gōngyuán pá shān. Wǒ zǎoshàng liù diǎn jiù chūfā le, nà shíhòu shān shàng hěn ānjìng, yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu. Wǒ zǒu le sān ge xiǎoshí, yìdiǎn yě bù juéde lèi, yīnwèi shān shàng de fēngjǐng tài měi le. Xià shān de shíhòu, wǒ hái mǎi le yìxiē dāngdì de míngchǎn, sòng gěi jiārén.
passage.english: I love climbing mountains. During spring break the year before last, I made the most of the good weather and went climbing in a national park on my own. I set off at six in the morning; the mountain was very quiet then, without a single person. I walked for three hours and didn't feel tired at all, because the scenery was so beautiful. On the way down, I also bought some local specialties for my family.

questions.why: 趁天氣好: making use of the good weather to go climbing.

focus.en: making use of the good weather

questions.why: 一個人都沒有: not a single person. People are counted with 個; 張 counts flat things.
一點也不覺得累: didn't feel tired at all.
當地的名產: local specialties, bought as presents for the family.

text.traditional: 我在台北的一家公司工作，平常很忙，很少有時間去旅行。上個月公司讓我去嘉義工作三天，我就趁著這個機會，在嘉義多留了一天，去阿里山走走。山上的空氣很新鮮，風景也很美。回台北以前，我還買了一些當地的茶，送給同事。
text.simplified: 我在台北的一家公司工作，平常很忙，很少有时间去旅行。上个月公司让我去嘉义工作三天，我就趁着这个机会，在嘉义多留了一天，去阿里山走走。山上的空气很新鲜，风景也很美。回台北以前，我还买了一些当地的茶，送给同事。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiběi de yì jiā gōngsī gōngzuò, píngcháng hěn máng, hěn shǎo yǒu shíjiān qù lǚxíng. Shàng ge yuè gōngsī ràng wǒ qù Jiāyì gōngzuò sān tiān, wǒ jiù chènzhe zhège jīhuì, zài Jiāyì duō liú le yì tiān, qù Ālǐ Shān zǒuzǒu. Shān shàng de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān, fēngjǐng yě hěn měi. Huí Táiběi yǐqián, wǒ hái mǎi le yìxiē dāngdì de chá, sòng gěi tóngshì.
text.english: I work for a company in Taipei. I am usually very busy and rarely have time to travel. Last month my company sent me to Chiayi to work for three days, so I took the chance to stay one more day in Chiayi and go for a walk on Alishan. The mountain air was fresh and the scenery was beautiful. Before going back to Taipei, I also bought some local tea for my colleagues.

prompt.traditional: 這個人上個月去嘉義，哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 这个人上个月去嘉义，哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén shàng ge yuè qù Jiāyì, nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which is true about the writer's trip to Chiayi last month?

choices.pinyin: Tā wǎn yì tiān cái huí Táiběi.
choices.english: The writer got back to Taipei a day later.

choices.pinyin: Tā zài Jiāyì gōngzuò le sì tiān.
choices.english: He worked in Chiayi for four days.

choices.pinyin: Tā zài Ālǐ Shān zhù le sān tiān.
choices.english: The writer stayed on Alishan for three days.

choices.pinyin: Tā mǎi le chá sòng gěi jiārén.
choices.english: The writer bought tea for the family.

questions.why: 趁著這個機會，在嘉義多留了一天: the trip was for work, and the writer used it to stay one extra day for Alishan, so got back to Taipei a day later. The three days were work in Chiayi, and the tea was for colleagues.

text.traditional:
爸爸、媽媽：
我已經到花蓮了！民宿的房間很漂亮，老闆也很客氣。我們本來打算明天去太魯閣爬山，可是聽說明天會下大雨，所以趁著今天天氣好，下午就先去了。明天我們就留在民宿看書、休息，後天再回台北。
女兒
text.simplified:
爸爸、妈妈：
我已经到花莲了！民宿的房间很漂亮，老板也很客气。我们本来打算明天去太鲁阁爬山，可是听说明天会下大雨，所以趁着今天天气好，下午就先去了。明天我们就留在民宿看书、休息，后天再回台北。
女儿
text.pinyin:
Bàba, māma:
Wǒ yǐjīng dào Huālián le! Mínsù de fángjiān hěn piàoliàng, lǎobǎn yě hěn kèqì. Wǒmen běnlái dǎsuàn míngtiān qù Tàilǔgé pá shān, kěshì tīngshuō míngtiān huì xià dà yǔ, suǒyǐ chènzhe jīntiān tiānqì hǎo, xiàwǔ jiù xiān qù le. Míngtiān wǒmen jiù liú zài mínsù kàn shū, xiūxí, hòutiān zài huí Táiběi.
Nǚ'ér
text.english:
Dad, Mom,
I'm in Hualien! The room at the B&B is lovely and the owner is very kind. We had planned to go climbing at Taroko tomorrow, but we heard it will pour tomorrow, so we made use of today's good weather and went this afternoon. Tomorrow we'll stay at the B&B, reading and resting, and we'll come back to Taipei the day after.
Your daughter

prompt.traditional: 看了這個留言，哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 看了这个留言，哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Kàn le zhège liúyán, nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: According to this message, which is true?

choices.pinyin: Tāmen míngtiān yào qù pá shān.
choices.english: They're going climbing tomorrow.

choices.pinyin: Tāmen jīntiān yǐjīng pá le shān.
choices.english: They already went climbing today.
They're going back to Taipei tomorrow.

choices.pinyin: Míngtiān de tiānqì huì hěn hǎo.
choices.english: The weather will be fine tomorrow.

questions.why: 本來打算明天去……，所以趁著今天天氣好，下午就先去了: because of tomorrow's rain they used today's good weather and climbed this afternoon. Tomorrow they stay at the B&B; they go home the day after.

focus.en: making use of today's good weather

text.traditional:
姐姐：
週末去花蓮的太魯閣號，一張票都沒有了，所以我訂了星期五早上八點的車，十點十五分就到花蓮。妳星期五得請假喔！訂票號碼我已經記下來了，星期三以前我會去便利商店付錢、拿票。
妹妹
text.simplified:
姐姐：
周末去花莲的太鲁阁号，一张票都没有了，所以我订了星期五早上八点的车，十点十五分就到花莲。你星期五得请假喔！订票号码我已经记下来了，星期三以前我会去便利商店付钱、拿票。
妹妹
text.pinyin:
Jiějie:
Zhōumò qù Huālián de Tàilǔgé Hào, yì zhāng piào dōu méiyǒu le, suǒyǐ wǒ dìng le xīngqíwǔ zǎoshàng bā diǎn de chē, shí diǎn shíwǔ fēn jiù dào Huālián. Nǐ xīngqíwǔ děi qǐngjià ō! Dìngpiào hàomǎ wǒ yǐjīng jìxiàlái le, xīngqísān yǐqián wǒ huì qù biànlì shāngdiàn fù qián, ná piào.
Mèimei
text.english:
Sis,
There isn't a single Taroko Express ticket to Hualien left for the weekend, so I booked the 8:00 train on Friday morning; it gets to Hualien at 10:15. You'll have to take Friday off! I've written down the booking number, and I'll pay and pick up the tickets at a convenience store before Wednesday.
Your little sister

prompt.traditional: 這次去花蓮的火車票，哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 这次去花莲的火车票，哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Zhècì qù Huālián de huǒchē piào, nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which is true about the train tickets for this trip to Hualien?

choices.english: They're for a Saturday train.
The younger sister has already paid.
The older sister noted the booking number.

choices.pinyin: Chē shì zǎoshàng bā diǎn chūfā de.
choices.english: The train leaves at eight in the morning.

questions.why: 一張票都沒有了: there was not one weekend ticket left, so she booked the 8:00 train on Friday morning. She will pay by Wednesday, and she, not her sister, noted the booking number.

text.traditional: 上個週末我去阿里山玩了兩天。出發以前，朋友說山上很冷，所以我帶了一件大衣，行李重得不得了。可是那兩天天氣都很暖和，大衣我一次也沒穿。不過山上常常下雨，我帶的雨衣穿了好幾次。
text.simplified: 上个周末我去阿里山玩了两天。出发以前，朋友说山上很冷，所以我带了一件大衣，行李重得不得了。可是那两天天气都很暖和，大衣我一次也没穿。不过山上常常下雨，我带的雨衣穿了好几次。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò wǒ qù Ālǐ Shān wán le liǎng tiān. Chūfā yǐqián, péngyǒu shuō shān shàng hěn lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ dài le yí jiàn dàyī, xínglǐ zhòng de bùdéliǎo. Kěshì nà liǎng tiān tiānqì dōu hěn nuǎnhuo, dàyī wǒ yí cì yě méi chuān. Búguò shān shàng chángcháng xiàyǔ, wǒ dài de yǔyī chuān le hǎojǐ cì.
text.english: Last weekend I spent two days on Alishan. Before I left, a friend said it was cold up there, so I took a coat, and my luggage was terribly heavy. But it was warm both days, and I didn't wear the coat even once. It rained a lot on the mountain, though, and I wore the raincoat I had brought several times.

prompt.traditional: 這個人去阿里山，哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 这个人去阿里山，哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén qù Ālǐ Shān, nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which is true about the writer's trip to Alishan?

choices.traditional: 山上那兩天冷得不得了
choices.simplified: 山上那两天冷得不得了
choices.pinyin: Shān shàng nà liǎng tiān lěng de bùdéliǎo.
choices.english: It was terribly cold on the mountain both days.

choices.pinyin: Tā méi chuān guo nà jiàn dàyī.
choices.english: The writer never wore that coat.

choices.traditional: 他在山上買了一件雨衣
choices.simplified: 他在山上买了一件雨衣
choices.pinyin: Tā zài shān shàng mǎi le yí jiàn yǔyī.
choices.english: The writer bought a raincoat on the mountain.

choices.pinyin: Tā de xínglǐ yìdiǎn yě bú zhòng.
choices.english: The writer's luggage wasn't heavy at all.

questions.why: 大衣我一次也沒穿: the coat was never worn. It was warm, not cold; the raincoat was brought from home, not bought there; the coat made the luggage very heavy.

text.traditional: 我在台北住了三年了。剛來的時候，我住在學校附近，房租一個月只要六千塊。可是這裡的房租越來越貴，現在要九千了。我的獎學金不多，快要住不起了，所以下個學期我打算搬到郊區去。那裡的房租比較便宜，坐捷運到學校也只要半個小時。
text.simplified: 我在台北住了三年了。刚来的时候，我住在学校附近，房租一个月只要六千块。可是这里的房租越来越贵，现在要九千了。我的奖学金不多，快要住不起了，所以下个学期我打算搬到郊区去。那里的房租比较便宜，坐捷运到学校也只要半个小时。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiběi zhù le sān nián le. Gāng lái de shíhòu, wǒ zhù zài xuéxiào fùjìn, fángzū yí ge yuè zhǐ yào liùqiān kuài. Kěshì zhèlǐ de fángzū yuè lái yuè guì, xiànzài yào jiǔqiān le. Wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn bù duō, kuài yào zhù bù qǐ le, suǒyǐ xià ge xuéqí wǒ dǎsuàn bān dào jiāoqū qù. Nàlǐ de fángzū bǐjiào piányí, zuò jiéyùn dào xuéxiào yě zhǐ yào bàn ge xiǎoshí.
text.english: I've lived in Taipei for three years. When I first came, I lived near the school, and the rent was only six thousand a month. But rents here keep going up; now it's nine thousand. My scholarship isn't much, and soon I won't be able to afford it, so next semester I plan to move to the suburbs. Rent there is cheaper, and it's only half an hour to school by MRT.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of the following is true?

choices.english: The writer used to live in the suburbs.

choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bān dào jiāoqū le.
choices.english: The writer has already moved to the suburbs.

choices.traditional: 他現在的房租比以前貴
choices.simplified: 他现在的房租比以前贵
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài de fángzū bǐ yǐqián guì.
choices.english: The writer's rent is higher now than before.

choices.traditional: 他坐捷運到學校要一個小時
choices.simplified: 他坐捷运到学校要一个小时
choices.pinyin: Tā zuò jiéyùn dào xuéxiào yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: The MRT ride to school takes the writer an hour.

questions.why: 房租越來越貴: the rent went from 6,000 to 9,000. The writer used to live near the school, moves to the suburbs only next semester, and from there the MRT takes half an hour.

text.traditional: 上星期是我媽媽的生日。我在台灣念書，不能回家，所以寄給她一張卡片和一些台灣的名產。媽媽收到以後，馬上打電話給我，說她很開心。我們聊了一個多小時，我覺得好像回到了家一樣。
text.simplified: 上星期是我妈妈的生日。我在台湾念书，不能回家，所以寄给她一张卡片和一些台湾的名产。妈妈收到以后，马上打电话给我，说她很开心。我们聊了一个多小时，我觉得好像回到了家一样。
text.pinyin: Shàng xīngqí shì wǒ māma de shēngrì. Wǒ zài Táiwān niànshū, bù néng huíjiā, suǒyǐ jì gěi tā yì zhāng kǎpiàn hé yìxiē Táiwān de míngchǎn. Māma shōudào yǐhòu, mǎshàng dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ, shuō tā hěn kāixīn. Wǒmen liáo le yí ge duō xiǎoshí, wǒ juéde hǎoxiàng huídào le jiā yíyàng.
text.english: Last week was my mom's birthday. I'm studying in Taiwan and couldn't go home, so I mailed her a card and some Taiwanese specialties. As soon as she got them, she called me and said she was very happy. We talked for over an hour, and it felt as if I were back home.

prompt.traditional: 媽媽生日的時候，這個人做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 妈妈生日的时候，这个人做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Māma shēngrì de shíhòu, zhège rén zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the writer do for Mom's birthday?

choices.english: The writer mailed Mom some things.
The writer went home to celebrate with Mom.
The writer called Mom.

choices.pinyin: Tā shōudào le māma de kǎpiàn.
choices.english: The writer got a card from Mom.

questions.why: 寄給她……: the writer mailed things to Mom. Mom called the writer (打電話給我), not the other way round, and the writer couldn't go home.

choices.english: excited
scared
bored

answer.traditional: 坐在電腦前面的女生，手放在臉上，看起來很無聊。
answer.simplified: 坐在电脑前面的女生，手放在脸上，看起来很无聊。
answer.pinyin: Zuò zài diànnǎo qiánmiàn de nǚshēng, shǒu fàng zài liǎn shàng, kànqǐlái hěn wúliáo.
answer.english: The girl sitting at the computer has her hand on her face and looks bored.

questions.why: With her cheek on her hand and a flat face, the girl at the laptop looks bored (無聊). The girl on the bed is the excited one, and nobody looks scared.

versions.alt: A bright bedroom with a window (green leaves outside), a bookshelf, plants, and a bed with a pink checked blanket and cushions. On the left, a girl with straight, shoulder-length dark hair and bangs sits on a chair at a desk with an open laptop and an open spiral notebook with a pen. She wears a light-purple cardigan over a pink top and a navy pleated skirt; she rests her cheek on one hand and looks sideways at her friend with a bored, unhappy face. On the right, a girl with long, wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings sits on the edge of the bed; she wears an open blue shirt over an orange top and wide white trousers, and she talks happily, both hands open as she explains something. Folded sweaters (cream, blue, black and pink) lie on the bed beside her. Shopping bags stand around the room: pink, cream and blue bags on a small table by the window, and another pink bag on the floor at the front right.

prompt.traditional: 穿藍色衣服的女生坐在＿＿上，一邊說話，一邊看著朋友。
prompt.simplified: 穿蓝色衣服的女生坐在＿＿上，一边说话，一边看着朋友。

choices.english: bed
chair
desk

answer.traditional: 穿藍色衣服的女生坐在床上，一邊說話，一邊看著朋友。
answer.simplified: 穿蓝色衣服的女生坐在床上，一边说话，一边看着朋友。
answer.pinyin: Chuān lánsè yīfu de nǚshēng zuò zài chuáng shàng, yìbiān shuōhuà, yìbiān kànzhe péngyǒu.
answer.english: The girl in blue is sitting on the bed, talking while she looks at her friend.

questions.why: The girl in blue sits on the edge of the bed. The chair is where the other girl sits, and the desk holds the laptop.

prompt.traditional: ＿＿買這些衣服，她把錢都花光了。
prompt.simplified: ＿＿买这些衣服，她把钱都花光了。

choices.english: besides
in order to
although

answer.traditional: 為了買這些衣服，她把錢都花光了。
answer.simplified: 为了买这些衣服，她把钱都花光了。
answer.pinyin: Wèile mǎi zhèxiē yīfu, tā bǎ qián dōu huā guāng le.
answer.english: She spent all her money to buy these clothes.

questions.why: 為了 + purpose comes first, then what was done for it: to buy these clothes, she spent all her money. 除了 needs 還 or 都 later, and 雖然 needs 可是 and a contrast.

prompt.traditional: 她新買的衣服，很多都是＿＿毛衣這樣冬天穿的。
prompt.simplified: 她新买的衣服，很多都是＿＿毛衣这样冬天穿的。

choices.english: than
toward
like

answer.traditional: 她新買的衣服，很多都是像毛衣這樣冬天穿的。
answer.simplified: 她新买的衣服，很多都是像毛衣这样冬天穿的。
answer.pinyin: Tā xīn mǎi de yīfu, hěn duō dōu shì xiàng máoyī zhèyàng dōngtiān chuān de.
answer.english: Many of her new clothes are winter things like sweaters.

questions.why: 像 + example + 這樣的 names a kind of thing: clothes like sweaters, the kind worn in winter. 比 and 對 can't bring in an example.

passage.traditional: 學校附近有一家咖啡廳，以前{1}不太好，客人很少。{2}吸引學生，老闆想出了一個辦法：學生買一杯咖啡，就可以在店裡念一個下午的書，還可以免費上網。這個辦法很有用，客人{3}了很多。現在平日下午，店裡的位子都滿了，{4}週末也一樣。
passage.simplified: 学校附近有一家咖啡厅，以前{1}不太好，客人很少。{2}吸引学生，老板想出了一个办法：学生买一杯咖啡，就可以在店里念一个下午的书，还可以免费上网。这个办法很有用，客人{3}了很多。现在平日下午，店里的位子都满了，{4}周末也一样。
passage.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu yì jiā kāfēitīng, yǐqián shēngyì bú tài hǎo, kèrén hěn shǎo. Wèile xīyǐn xuéshēng, lǎobǎn xiǎng chū le yí ge bànfǎ: xuéshēng mǎi yì bēi kāfēi, jiù kěyǐ zài diàn lǐ niàn yí ge xiàwǔ de shū, hái kěyǐ miǎnfèi shàngwǎng. Zhège bànfǎ hěn yǒuyòng, kèrén zēngjiā le hěn duō. Xiànzài píngrì xiàwǔ, diàn lǐ de wèizi dōu mǎn le, lián zhōumò yě yíyàng.
passage.english: There's a café near school. Business used to be poor, with few customers. To attract students, the owner came up with an idea: a student who buys one coffee can study in the café all afternoon and use the internet for free. The idea worked: customers increased a lot. Now on weekday afternoons all the seats are taken, and even at weekends it's the same.

questions.why: 生意不太好: business was poor, which is why there were few customers.
為了 + purpose, then the action: to attract students, the owner came up with an idea.
客人增加了很多: after the idea, the number of customers went up a lot.
連週末也一樣: even at weekends the seats are all taken, as on weekday afternoons.

passage.traditional: 我家附近的夜市有一位賣衣服的老闆。以前他的衣服賣得不太好，一個晚上只能賣幾件。後來他{1}，很多年輕人喜歡韓式{2}，就開始賣韓國流行的毛衣和帽子。現在他的客人{3}了不少。他說，年輕人很容易被流行的東西{4}，做生意就要懂他們的心理。
passage.simplified: 我家附近的夜市有一位卖衣服的老板。以前他的衣服卖得不太好，一个晚上只能卖几件。后来他{1}，很多年轻人喜欢韩式{2}，就开始卖韩国流行的毛衣和帽子。现在他的客人{3}了不少。他说，年轻人很容易被流行的东西{4}，做生意就要懂他们的心理。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn de yèshì yǒu yí wèi mài yīfu de lǎobǎn. Yǐqián tā de yīfu mài de bú tài hǎo, yí ge wǎnshàng zhǐ néng mài jǐ jiàn. Hòulái tā fāxiàn, hěn duō niánqīngrén xǐhuān hánshì fúzhuāng, jiù kāishǐ mài Hánguó liúxíng de máoyī hé màozi. Xiànzài tā de kèrén zēngjiā le bù shǎo. Tā shuō, niánqīngrén hěn róngyì bèi liúxíng de dōngxi xīyǐn, zuò shēngyì jiù yào dǒng tāmen de xīnlǐ.
passage.english: At the night market near my home there's a stall owner who sells clothes. His clothes used to sell poorly; he could only sell a few a night. Then he noticed that lots of young people like Korean-style clothing, so he started selling the sweaters and hats that are in fashion in Korea. Now he has quite a few more customers. He says young people are easily attracted by what's in fashion, so to do business you have to understand how they think.

questions.why: 後來他發現: he noticed what young people like, and that gave him the idea.
韓式服裝: Korean-style clothing, which is why he started selling Korean sweaters and hats.
客人增加了不少: his customers went up quite a bit. 變成 needs what they became (變成很多人 is not said like this).
被流行的東西吸引: young people are attracted by what's in fashion (被 + doer + 吸引).

text.traditional: 我的室友以前很少看電視，可是因為她男朋友的關係，她最近愛上了日劇。她男朋友是日本人，一開始常常帶她一起看，還會告訴她日劇裡的人在說什麼。現在她不但每天都看，還開始學日文了。她說，後年想去日本遊學。
text.simplified: 我的室友以前很少看电视，可是因为她男朋友的关系，她最近爱上了日剧。她男朋友是日本人，一开始常常带她一起看，还会告诉她日剧里的人在说什么。现在她不但每天都看，还开始学日文了。她说，后年想去日本游学。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu yǐqián hěn shǎo kàn diànshì, kěshì yīnwèi tā nánpéngyǒu de guānxì, tā zuìjìn àishàng le Rìjù. Tā nánpéngyǒu shì Rìběn rén, yìkāishǐ chángcháng dài tā yìqǐ kàn, hái huì gàosu tā Rìjù lǐ de rén zài shuō shénme. Xiànzài tā búdàn měi tiān dōu kàn, hái kāishǐ xué Rìwén le. Tā shuō, hòunián xiǎng qù Rìběn yóuxué.
text.english: My roommate used to watch very little TV, but because of her boyfriend she has recently fallen for Japanese dramas. Her boyfriend is Japanese; at first he often had her watch with him and told her what the people in the dramas were saying. Now she not only watches every day but has also started learning Japanese. She says she'd like to go on a study tour in Japan the year after next.

prompt.traditional: 室友為什麼開始看日劇？
prompt.simplified: 室友为什么开始看日剧？
prompt.pinyin: Shìyǒu wèishénme kāishǐ kàn Rìjù?
prompt.english: Why did the roommate start watching Japanese dramas?

choices.pinyin: Tā yǐqián jiù hěn ài kàn diànshì.
choices.english: She always loved watching TV.
Her boyfriend wants to go on a study tour in Japan.
She's learning Japanese.

choices.pinyin: Nánpéngyǒu cháng péi tā yìqǐ kàn.
choices.english: Her boyfriend often watched with her.

questions.why: 因為她男朋友的關係: her boyfriend is the cause. He is Japanese and at first watched the dramas with her. Learning Japanese came after she started watching, the study tour is her own plan, not her boyfriend's, and she used to watch little TV.

text.traditional: 學校附近有一家冰店，老闆做的芒果冰很有名。今年因為天氣的關係，芒果很少，價錢也很貴，老闆只好每碗多收二十塊。以前一碗一百塊，現在變成一百二十塊。可是客人還是很多，每天下午不到四點，芒果冰就賣光了。
text.simplified: 学校附近有一家冰店，老板做的芒果冰很有名。今年因为天气的关系，芒果很少，价钱也很贵，老板只好每碗多收二十块。以前一碗一百块，现在变成一百二十块。可是客人还是很多，每天下午不到四点，芒果冰就卖光了。
text.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu yì jiā bīng diàn, lǎobǎn zuò de mángguǒ bīng hěn yǒumíng. Jīnnián yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxì, mángguǒ hěn shǎo, jiàqián yě hěn guì, lǎobǎn zhǐhǎo měi wǎn duō shōu èrshí kuài. Yǐqián yì wǎn yìbǎi kuài, xiànzài biànchéng yìbǎi èrshí kuài. Kěshì kèrén háishì hěn duō, měi tiān xiàwǔ bú dào sì diǎn, mángguǒ bīng jiù mài guāng le.
text.english: There's an ice shop near school whose mango ice is famous. This year, because of the weather, mangoes are scarce and expensive, so the owner has had to charge 20 dollars more a bowl. A bowl used to be 100; now it's 120. But there are still lots of customers, and every afternoon the mango ice is sold out before four.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of these is true?

choices.pinyin: Tiānqì ràng kèrén biàn duō le.
choices.english: The weather has brought more customers.

choices.pinyin: Tiānqì ràng mángguǒ biàn shǎo le.
choices.english: The weather has made mangoes scarce.

choices.traditional: 今年的芒果冰比較便宜
choices.simplified: 今年的芒果冰比较便宜
choices.pinyin: Jīnnián de mángguǒ bīng bǐjiào piányí.
choices.english: Mango ice is cheaper this year.

choices.traditional: 芒果冰四點以後才賣光
choices.simplified: 芒果冰四点以后才卖光
choices.pinyin: Mángguǒ bīng sì diǎn yǐhòu cái mài guāng.
choices.english: The mango ice only sells out after four.

questions.why: 因為天氣的關係，芒果很少: the weather is why mangoes are scarce (and dear). The text never says the weather brought more customers (客人還是很多 only says there are still many), the ice now costs 20 more, and it sells out before four (不到四點).

text.traditional: 我弟弟最近上課常常打瞌睡。老師以為他生病了，媽媽以為他每天念書念得太晚，大家都很擔心。後來我才發現，他每天晚上都在房間裡看美國影集，看完已經半夜了。現在媽媽把他的電腦放在客廳，十點以後就不讓他用了。
text.simplified: 我弟弟最近上课常常打瞌睡。老师以为他生病了，妈妈以为他每天念书念得太晚，大家都很担心。后来我才发现，他每天晚上都在房间里看美国影集，看完已经半夜了。现在妈妈把他的电脑放在客厅，十点以后就不让他用了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi zuìjìn shàngkè chángcháng dǎ kēshuì. Lǎoshī yǐwéi tā shēngbìng le, māma yǐwéi tā měi tiān niànshū niàn de tài wǎn, dàjiā dōu hěn dānxīn. Hòulái wǒ cái fāxiàn, tā měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu zài fángjiān lǐ kàn Měiguó yǐngjí, kàn wán yǐjīng bànyè le. Xiànzài māma bǎ tā de diànnǎo fàng zài kètīng, shí diǎn yǐhòu jiù bú ràng tā yòng le.
text.english: My younger brother has been nodding off in class a lot lately. His teacher thought he was ill, and Mom thought he was studying too late every night; everyone was worried. Then I found out that every night he watches American TV series in his room, and by the time he finishes it's midnight. Now Mom keeps his computer in the living room and doesn't let him use it after ten.

prompt.traditional: 弟弟上課打瞌睡，是因為什麼？
prompt.simplified: 弟弟上课打瞌睡，是因为什么？
prompt.pinyin: Dìdi shàngkè dǎ kēshuì, shì yīnwèi shénme?
prompt.english: Why does the brother nod off in class?

choices.english: He's ill.

choices.pinyin: Tā niànshū niàn de tài wǎn.
choices.english: He studies too late.

choices.pinyin: Tā kàn yǐngjí kàn de tài wǎn.
choices.english: He watches TV series too late.
He's worried about exams.

questions.why: 他每天晚上都在房間裡看美國影集，看完已經半夜了: he stays up late watching series. Being ill and studying late are only what the teacher and Mom wrongly thought (以為); the worrying in the text is the family's, about him.

text.traditional: 上個月我去花蓮玩，想買一些名產送給朋友做紀念。可是那天是星期一，很多名產店都沒開，我只好在火車站的便利商店買了幾盒小蛋糕，打算把它們送給朋友。回到台北以後，我才發現，台北的便利商店也有一樣的小蛋糕，價錢還便宜十塊。
text.simplified: 上个月我去花莲玩，想买一些名产送给朋友做纪念。可是那天是星期一，很多名产店都没开，我只好在火车站的便利商店买了几盒小蛋糕，打算把它们送给朋友。回到台北以后，我才发现，台北的便利商店也有一样的小蛋糕，价钱还便宜十块。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ qù Huālián wán, xiǎng mǎi yìxiē míngchǎn sòng gěi péngyǒu zuò jìniàn. Kěshì nà tiān shì xīngqíyī, hěn duō míngchǎn diàn dōu méi kāi, wǒ zhǐhǎo zài huǒchē zhàn de biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi le jǐ hé xiǎo dàngāo, dǎsuàn bǎ tāmen sòng gěi péngyǒu. Huí dào Táiběi yǐhòu, wǒ cái fāxiàn, Táiběi de biànlì shāngdiàn yě yǒu yíyàng de xiǎo dàngāo, jiàqián hái piányí shí kuài.
text.english: Last month I went to Hualien and wanted to buy some local specialties as souvenirs for my friends. But that day was a Monday and many specialty shops were closed, so I had to buy a few boxes of little cakes at the convenience store in the train station, planning to give them to my friends. Back in Taipei, I found that the convenience stores in Taipei have the same little cakes, and ten dollars cheaper too.

prompt.traditional: 他買的小蛋糕怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 他买的小蛋糕怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Tā mǎi de xiǎo dàngāo zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What about the little cakes he bought?

choices.pinyin: Shì zài míngchǎn diàn mǎi de.
choices.english: He bought them at a specialty shop.

choices.pinyin: Zài Táiběi yě mǎi de dào.
choices.english: You can buy them in Taipei too.

choices.pinyin: Bǐ Táiběi de piányí shí kuài.
choices.english: They're ten dollars cheaper than in Taipei.

choices.pinyin: Shì Huālián cái yǒu de míngchǎn.
choices.english: They're a specialty found only in Hualien.

questions.why: 台北的便利商店也有一樣的小蛋糕: the same cakes are sold in Taipei, ten dollars cheaper there, not in Hualien. He bought them at the station's convenience store because the specialty shops were closed.

text.traditional: 我爸爸以前對夜市沒有興趣，他覺得那裡人太多、太擠，也不太乾淨。上個月，我帶他去吃了一次臭豆腐，他就越來越喜歡逛夜市了。現在他每個週末都要去，還常常帶媽媽一起去。他說，夜市的小吃又便宜又好吃，比餐廳的菜有意思多了。
text.simplified: 我爸爸以前对夜市没有兴趣，他觉得那里人太多、太挤，也不太干净。上个月，我带他去吃了一次臭豆腐，他就越来越喜欢逛夜市了。现在他每个周末都要去，还常常带妈妈一起去。他说，夜市的小吃又便宜又好吃，比餐厅的菜有意思多了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bàba yǐqián duì yèshì méiyǒu xìngqù, tā juéde nàlǐ rén tài duō, tài jǐ, yě bú tài gānjìng. Shàng ge yuè, wǒ dài tā qù chī le yí cì chòu dòufǔ, tā jiù yuè lái yuè xǐhuān guàng yèshì le. Xiànzài tā měi ge zhōumò dōu yào qù, hái chángcháng dài māma yìqǐ qù. Tā shuō, yèshì de xiǎochī yòu piányí yòu hǎochī, bǐ cāntīng de cài yǒu yìsi duō le.
text.english: My dad used to have no interest in night markets; he thought they were too crowded, too packed and not very clean. Last month I took him to eat stinky tofu once, and he has come to like going to night markets more and more. Now he wants to go every weekend and often takes Mom along. He says night-market snacks are cheap and tasty, and much more interesting than restaurant food.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of these is true?

choices.traditional: 爸爸還是對夜市沒有興趣
choices.simplified: 爸爸还是对夜市没有兴趣
choices.pinyin: Bàba háishì duì yèshì méiyǒu xìngqù.
choices.english: Dad is still not interested in night markets.

choices.traditional: 媽媽帶爸爸去吃臭豆腐
choices.simplified: 妈妈带爸爸去吃臭豆腐
choices.pinyin: Māma dài bàba qù chī chòu dòufǔ.
choices.english: Mom took Dad for stinky tofu.

choices.traditional: 爸爸現在常常去逛夜市
choices.simplified: 爸爸现在常常去逛夜市
choices.pinyin: Bàba xiànzài chángcháng qù guàng yèshì.
choices.english: Dad often goes to night markets now.

choices.traditional: 爸爸覺得餐廳的菜比較有意思
choices.simplified: 爸爸觉得餐厅的菜比较有意思
choices.pinyin: Bàba juéde cāntīng de cài bǐjiào yǒu yìsi.
choices.english: Dad finds restaurant food more interesting.

questions.why: 以前對夜市沒有興趣……越來越喜歡逛夜市了，現在他每個週末都要去: he goes often now and is no longer uninterested. It was the writer, not Mom, who took him for stinky tofu, and he finds night-market food more interesting than restaurants'.

text.traditional: 昨天我跟朋友約好晚上七點在電影院門口見面。我六點半就到了，可是等了一個小時，她都沒來。我打電話給她，她說她記錯了，以為我們約的是今天晚上。她覺得很不好意思，說今天要請我看電影，還要請我吃晚飯。
text.simplified: 昨天我跟朋友约好晚上七点在电影院门口见面。我六点半就到了，可是等了一个小时，她都没来。我打电话给她，她说她记错了，以为我们约的是今天晚上。她觉得很不好意思，说今天要请我看电影，还要请我吃晚饭。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ gēn péngyǒu yuē hǎo wǎnshàng qī diǎn zài diànyǐngyuàn ménkǒu jiànmiàn. Wǒ liù diǎn bàn jiù dào le, kěshì děng le yí ge xiǎoshí, tā dōu méi lái. Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi tā, tā shuō tā jì cuò le, yǐwéi wǒmen yuē de shì jīntiān wǎnshàng. Tā juéde hěn bùhǎoyìsi, shuō jīntiān yào qǐng wǒ kàn diànyǐng, hái yào qǐng wǒ chī wǎnfàn.
text.english: Yesterday my friend and I arranged to meet at 7 p.m. at the cinema entrance. I got there at 6:30, but I waited an hour and she never came. I phoned her, and she said she'd got it wrong: she thought we had arranged to meet this evening. She felt very bad and said that today she'll treat me to a movie and to dinner too.

picture.alt: Late at night in a dorm room: a crescent moon shows in the dark window. A girl with long wavy dark hair, gold hoop earrings and a blue jacket over an orange top sits at a desk, her cheek on one hand and a pen in the other, over a big open book; she looks up, tired. On a plate on the desk lies a sandwich nobody is eating. Behind her stands a girl with short wavy hair, round glasses, a white shirt, a purple vest and green trousers; she points at a round clock on the wall that shows ten o'clock. A desk lamp is on; a bed and a small lamp are in the back.
