lines.traditional: 有學生在車站拿地圖給大家。我看著地圖走，五分鐘就到了。有他們幫忙，我真的很感動。
lines.simplified: 有学生在车站拿地图给大家。我看着地图走，五分钟就到了。有他们帮忙，我真的很感动。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu xuéshēng zài chēzhàn ná dìtú gěi dàjiā. Wǒ kàn zhe dìtú zǒu, wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Yǒu tāmen bāngmáng, wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎndòng.
lines.english: Some students were giving out maps at the station. I followed the map and got there in five minutes. It was really thoughtful of them!

prompt.simplified: 女的后来是怎么到学校的？

choices.english: She waited at the station for the others.

questions.why: 剛走出車站就迷路了 puts getting lost first. She considered a taxi at that point, but the students’ map let her get to the school on foot.

intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.traditional: 明天口試要先交一頁報告，再用中文說三分鐘。妳覺得我剛才說得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 明天口试要先交一页报告，再用中文说三分钟。你觉得我刚才说得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān kǒushì yào xiān jiāo yí yè bàogào, zài yòng Zhōngwén shuō sān fēnzhōng. Nǐ juéde wǒ gāngcái shuō de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: For tomorrow's oral exam we hand in a one-page report first, then speak in Chinese for three minutes. How did I sound just now?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你說得太快了，慢一點說，教授才聽得懂。
lines.simplified: 你说得太快了，慢一点说，教授才听得懂。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de tài kuài le, màn yìdiǎn shuō, jiàoshòu cái tīng de dǒng.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是說慢一點，三分鐘就說不完了。
lines.simplified: 可是说慢一点，三分钟就说不完了。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì shuō màn yìdiǎn, sān fēnzhōng jiù shuō bù wán le.
lines.english: But if I speak slower, I won't finish in three minutes.

lines.traditional: 那就少說一點。你的報告也寫得太多了，一頁寫得下嗎？
lines.simplified: 那就少说一点。你的报告也写得太多了，一页写得下吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù shǎo shuō yìdiǎn. Nǐ de bàogào yě xiě de tài duō le, yí yè xiě de xià ma?
lines.english: Then say a bit less. Your report is too long too. Does it fit on one page?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 寫不下，我今天晚上得把不重要的部分拿掉。
lines.simplified: 写不下，我今天晚上得把不重要的部分拿掉。
lines.pinyin: Xiě bú xià, wǒ jīntiān wǎnshàng děi bǎ bú zhòngyào de bùfèn ná diào.
lines.english: It doesn't. Tonight I'll have to take out the parts that don't matter.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 加油！
lines.simplified: 加油！
lines.pinyin: Jiāyóu!
lines.english: Good luck!

questions.why: She asks him to slow down so the professor can follow him. Not finishing in three minutes is his worry about slowing down, and the long report is a second, separate problem.

prompt.speaker: N

questions.why: 一頁寫不下 means his report does not fit on one page, so tonight he will cut the parts that don't matter. Writing more or speaking faster goes against what she told him, and nobody mentions asking for more time.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 開學要用的課本，你今天都買到了嗎？
lines.simplified: 开学要用的课本，你今天都买到了吗？

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 買了，我修了五門課，一共要買九本書。書包不夠大，放不下，只好用手拿。
lines.simplified: 买了，我修了五门课，一共要买九本书。书包不够大，放不下，只好用手拿。
lines.pinyin: Mǎi le, wǒ xiū le wǔ mén kè, yígòng yào mǎi jiǔ běn shū. Shūbāo bú gòu dà, fàng bú xià, zhǐhǎo yòng shǒu ná.
lines.english: Yes. I'm taking five courses, so nine books in all. They don't fit in my backpack, so I have to carry them.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼不在網路上買？送到宿舍多方便。
lines.simplified: 你怎么不在网路上买？送到宿舍多方便。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme bú zài wǎnglù shàng mǎi? Sòng dào sùshè duō fāngbiàn.
lines.english: Why don't you buy them online? Having them sent to the dorm is so much easier.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 網路上買要等一個星期，明天就要上課了。
lines.simplified: 网路上买要等一个星期，明天就要上课了。
lines.pinyin: Wǎnglù shàng mǎi yào děng yí ge xīngqí, míngtiān jiù yào shàngkè le.
lines.english: Online you wait a week, and classes start tomorrow.

lines.traditional: 那我幫你拿幾本吧。快點走，再晚一點搭公車就沒位子了。
lines.simplified: 那我帮你拿几本吧。快点走，再晚一点搭公车就没位子了。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ bāng nǐ ná jǐ běn ba. Kuài diǎn zǒu, zài wǎn yìdiǎn dā gōngchē jiù méi wèizi le.
lines.english: Then let me carry a few. Let's hurry. Any later and there'll be no seats on the bus.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，謝謝。
lines.simplified: 好，谢谢。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, xièxie.
lines.english: OK, thanks.

prompt.simplified: 男的为什么用手拿书？

prompt.english: Why does the man carry the books in his hands?

questions.why: 書包不夠大，放不下: nine books do not fit in his backpack, so he carries them in his hands. The problem is size, not weight; the dorm is where online books would be sent, and it is the woman who offers to carry a few.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 他们等一下最可能做什么？

prompt.english: What will they most likely do next?

choices.english: Buy books online.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go back to the bookstore for more books.

choices.speaker: N

choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 快點走 hurries him along: they will rush to the bus before its seats are gone. He has already bought all his books, buying online would take a week while classes start tomorrow, and he carries the books because his backpack is full.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 良介你好，我是日文系辦公室的王小姐。你上個星期交的翻譯報告，教授已經看過了。
lines.simplified: 良介你好，我是日文系办公室的王小姐。你上个星期交的翻译报告，教授已经看过了。
lines.pinyin: Liángjiè nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Rìwén xì bàngōngshì de Wáng xiǎojiě. Nǐ shàng ge xīngqí jiāo de fānyì bàogào, jiàoshòu yǐjīng kàn guo le.
lines.english: Hello Ryosuke, this is Ms. Wang from the Japanese Department office. The professor has read the translation report you handed in last week.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他說你翻得很認真，可是有幾個字寫錯了。請你把錯字都換掉，星期四下午五點以前把報告拿到系辦公室來。
lines.simplified: 他说你翻得很认真，可是有几个字写错了。请你把错字都换掉，星期四下午五点以前把报告拿到系办公室来。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō nǐ fān de hěn rènzhēn, kěshì yǒu jǐ ge zì xiě cuò le. Qǐng nǐ bǎ cuòzì dōu huàn diào, xīngqísì xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn yǐqián bǎ bàogào ná dào xì bàngōngshì lái.
lines.english: He says you translated it carefully, but there are several miswritten characters. Please correct them all and bring the report to the department office before 5 p.m. on Thursday.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 教授還說，要是你將來想做翻譯的工作，可以去修他下學期的課。有問題可以打電話給我，謝謝。
lines.simplified: 教授还说，要是你将来想做翻译的工作，可以去修他下学期的课。有问题可以打电话给我，谢谢。
lines.pinyin: Jiàoshòu hái shuō, yàoshì nǐ jiānglái xiǎng zuò fānyì de gōngzuò, kěyǐ qù xiū tā xià xuéqí de kè. Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ, xièxie.
lines.english: The professor also says that if you want to work as a translator in the future, you could take his course next semester. If you have any questions, call me. Thank you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 良介應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 良介应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Liángjiè yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What should Ryosuke do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go and see the professor on Thursday.

choices.speaker: N

choices.pinyin: Bǎ cuòzì huàn diào zài ná bàogào qù xì shàng.
choices.english: Correct the wrong characters, then take the report to the department.

questions.why: He must correct the miswritten characters and bring the report to the department office (拿到系辦公室來) by 5 p.m. Thursday. Thursday is a deadline, not a meeting with the professor; his translation itself is fine, and he calls only if he has questions.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 教授為什麼建議良介修他的課？
prompt.simplified: 教授为什么建议良介修他的课？
prompt.pinyin: Jiàoshòu wèishénme jiànyì Liángjiè xiū tā de kè?
prompt.english: Why does the professor suggest Ryosuke take his course?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Néng bāng tā shǎo xiě cuòzì.
choices.english: It can help him make fewer mistakes in characters.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Néng ràng tā fān de gèng rènzhēn.
choices.english: It can make him translate more carefully.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 能讓他把這份報告寫好
choices.simplified: 能让他把这份报告写好
choices.pinyin: Néng ràng tā bǎ zhè fèn bàogào xiě hǎo.
choices.english: It can help him get this report right.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 能幫他準備以後的工作
choices.simplified: 能帮他准备以后的工作
choices.pinyin: Néng bāng tā zhǔnbèi yǐhòu de gōngzuò.
choices.english: It can prepare him for a future job.

questions.why: The professor links his course to a future job: 要是你將來想做翻譯的工作. The miswritten characters are fixed in this report by Thursday, he already translates carefully, and the course is next semester, too late for this report.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位交換學生，歡迎來到華語文中心。這學期的課從九月十五號上到十二月底，每天上午上三個小時。
lines.simplified: 各位交换学生，欢迎来到华语文中心。这学期的课从九月十五号上到十二月底，每天上午上三个小时。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi jiāohuàn xuéshēng, huānyíng lái dào Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn. Zhè xuéqí de kè cóng jiǔ yuè shíwǔ hào shàng dào shí'èr yuè dǐ, měi tiān shàngwǔ shàng sān ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Welcome to the Chinese Language Center, exchange students. This semester's classes run from September 15 to the end of December, three hours every morning.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 課堂上，老師會帶大家念生字、用文法造句，也會讓大家練習聲調，用中文表達自己的意見。
lines.simplified: 课堂上，老师会带大家念生字、用文法造句，也会让大家练习声调，用中文表达自己的意见。
lines.pinyin: Kètáng shàng, lǎoshī huì dài dàjiā niàn shēngzì, yòng wénfǎ zàojù, yě huì ràng dàjiā liànxí shēngdiào, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
lines.english: In class, the teachers will go over new words with you and have you make sentences with the grammar; they will also have you practise tones and give your own opinions in Mandarin.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 每個月，中心還會辦一次免費的文化活動，增加大家說中文的機會。想參加的同學，可以先上網看活動的介紹。平日也可以來辦公室問我們。
lines.simplified: 每个月，中心还会办一次免费的文化活动，增加大家说中文的机会。想参加的同学，可以先上网看活动的介绍。平日也可以来办公室问我们。
lines.pinyin: Měi ge yuè, zhōngxīn hái huì bàn yí cì miǎnfèi de wénhuà huódòng, zēngjiā dàjiā shuō Zhōngwén de jīhuì. Xiǎng cānjiā de tóngxué, kěyǐ xiān shàngwǎng kàn huódòng de jièshào. Píngrì yě kěyǐ lái bàngōngshì wèn wǒmen.
lines.english: Every month the center also holds a free cultural activity so you have another chance to speak Chinese. If you want to join, you can first read about it online. You can also ask us in the office on weekdays.

prompt.simplified: 这学期的课一共上多久？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè xuéqí de kè yígòng shàng duōjiǔ?
prompt.english: How long do this semester's classes last in all?

questions.why: 從九月十五號上到十二月底: from mid-September to the end of December is three and a half months. Counting from the start of September gives four; counting only to the start of December gives two and a half.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這段話是在介紹什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这段话是在介绍什么？

choices.english: The center’s fees and class times.

title.traditional: 華語中心 期末考試
title.simplified: 华语中心 期末考试

text.traditional:
筆試：一月三日（星期三）上午九點，一共五十題，從第一課考到第十課，可以帶字典
口試：一月四日（星期四），每人十分鐘，請先上網選好時間
作文：不在考試的時候寫，請在十二月二十九日以前交給老師
注意：當天不能來考試的同學，請先跟中心請假。沒請假又沒來考試，這門課會被當
華語中心 十二月十五日
text.simplified:
笔试：一月三日（星期三）上午九点，一共五十题，从第一课考到第十课，可以带字典
口试：一月四日（星期四），每人十分钟，请先上网选好时间
作文：不在考试的时候写，请在十二月二十九日以前交给老师
注意：当天不能来考试的同学，请先跟中心请假。没请假又没来考试，这门课会被当
华语中心 十二月十五日
text.pinyin:
Bǐshì: yī yuè sān rì (xīngqísān) shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn, yígòng wǔshí tí, cóng dì yī kè kǎo dào dì shí kè, kěyǐ dài zìdiǎn
Kǒushì: yī yuè sì rì (xīngqísì), měi rén shí fēnzhōng, qǐng xiān shàngwǎng xuǎn hǎo shíjiān
Zuòwén: bú zài kǎoshì de shíhòu xiě, qǐng zài shí’èr yuè èrshíjiǔ rì yǐqián jiāo gěi lǎoshī
Zhùyì: dāngtiān bù néng lái kǎoshì de tóngxué, qǐng xiān gēn zhōngxīn qǐngjià. Méi qǐngjià yòu méi lái kǎoshì, zhè mén kè huì bèi dàng
Huáyǔ zhōngxīn shí’èr yuè shíwǔ rì

text.traditional:
各位同學：
下星期二的課堂報告要介紹一本書。先說這本書讓你學到什麼知識，再用自己的話表達意見。每人報告五分鐘，再留兩分鐘跟同學交換意見。請準備一頁資料，寫下你想跟同學討論的問題，星期一中午以前寄給我。請不要把書上的話都寫下來，先想想你對書裡的做法有什麼意見。這也是練習表達能力的好機會。
王教授 三月八日
text.simplified:
各位同学：
下星期二的课堂报告要介绍一本书。先说这本书让你学到什么知识，再用自己的话表达意见。每人报告五分钟，再留两分钟跟同学交换意见。请准备一页资料，写下你想跟同学讨论的问题，星期一中午以前寄给我。请不要把书上的话都写下来，先想想你对书里的做法有什么意见。这也是练习表达能力的好机会。
王教授 三月八日
text.pinyin:
Gèwèi tóngxué:
Xià xīngqí’èr de kètáng bàogào yào jièshào yì běn shū. Xiān shuō zhè běn shū ràng nǐ xué dào shénme zhīshì, zài yòng zìjǐ de huà biǎodá yìjiàn. Měi rén bàogào wǔ fēnzhōng, zài liú liǎng fēnzhōng gēn tóngxué jiāohuàn yìjiàn. Qǐng zhǔnbèi yí yè zīliào, xiě xià nǐ xiǎng gēn tóngxué tǎolùn de wèntí, xīngqíyī zhōngwǔ yǐqián jì gěi wǒ. Qǐng bú yào bǎ shū shàng de huà dōu xiě xiàlái, xiān xiǎngxiang nǐ duì shū lǐ de zuòfǎ yǒu shénme yìjiàn. Zhè yě shì liànxí biǎodá nénglì de hǎo jīhuì.
Wáng jiàoshòu sān yuè bā rì
text.english:
Dear students,
Next Tuesday’s class presentation is about a book. First say what you learned from it, then give your opinion in your own words. Take five minutes to present and leave two minutes afterwards to exchange views with classmates. Prepare one page with the questions you want to discuss, and send it to me before noon on Monday. Instead of writing out everything in the book, think about what you make of the approaches it describes. This is a chance to practise expressing your ideas.
Professor Wang, March 8

prompt.simplified: 明生星期一有空，他要寄什么资料，什么时候寄？
prompt.pinyin: Míngshēng xīngqíyī yǒu kòng, tā yào jì shénme zīliào, shénme shíhòu jì?
prompt.english: Mingsheng is free on Monday. What should he send, and when?

choices.traditional: 星期一晚上寄討論的問題
choices.simplified: 星期一晚上寄讨论的问题
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíyī wǎnshàng jì tǎolùn de wèntí.
choices.english: Send the discussion questions Monday evening.

choices.traditional: 星期一早上寄討論的問題
choices.simplified: 星期一早上寄讨论的问题
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíyī zǎoshàng jì tǎolùn de wèntí.
choices.english: Send the discussion questions Monday morning.

choices.traditional: 星期一早上寄書上的話
choices.simplified: 星期一早上寄书上的话

questions.why: The page is for discussion questions and is due before noon on Monday. Monday evening misses the deadline, and reproducing the book misses the purpose of the page.

prompt.traditional: 美心說完從書裡學到什麼以後，還要做什麼？

choices.traditional: 說自己的意見，再念書上的話
choices.simplified: 说自己的意见，再念书上的话
choices.pinyin: Shuō zìjǐ de yìjiàn, zài niàn shū shàng de huà.
choices.english: Give her views, then read from the book.

choices.simplified: 念书上的话，再跟同学讨论

choices.english: Read from the book, then discuss it with classmates.

choices.traditional: 說自己的意見，再跟同學討論
choices.simplified: 说自己的意见，再跟同学讨论
choices.pinyin: Shuō zìjǐ de yìjiàn, zài gēn tóngxué tǎolùn.
choices.english: Give her views, then discuss them with classmates.

choices.traditional: 跟同學討論，再說自己的意見
choices.simplified: 跟同学讨论，再说自己的意见
choices.pinyin: Gēn tóngxué tǎolùn, zài shuō zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
choices.english: Discuss it with classmates, then give her views.

questions.why: She should present her views in her own words and then open the discussion. Reading from the book does not do the first job, and discussing first reverses the order.

passage.traditional: 系上請我寫一篇文章給從義大利來的交換學生看。我本來想用很多新學的漢字，可是才寫了一頁，就一直停下來查{1}。同學看了，給我一個{2}：先想想新同學最想知道什麼。我就把活動的資料放到最後，先寫怎麼借書、怎麼還書。{3}我又請一位新同學看了一下。他看完就知道怎麼去圖書館，開開心心地跟我說：「你怎麼寫得這麼{4}！我很怕迷路，謝謝你！」我聽了很{5}。
passage.simplified: 系上请我写一篇文章给从义大利来的交换学生看。我本来想用很多新学的汉字，可是才写了一页，就一直停下来查{1}。同学看了，给我一个{2}：先想想新同学最想知道什么。我就把活动的资料放到最后，先写怎么借书、怎么还书。{3}我又请一位新同学看了一下。他看完就知道怎么去图书馆，开开心心地跟我说：「你怎么写得这么{4}！我很怕迷路，谢谢你！」我听了很{5}。
passage.pinyin: Xì shàng qǐng wǒ xiě yì piān wénzhāng gěi cóng Yìdàlì lái de jiāohuàn xuéshēng kàn. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng yòng hěn duō xīn xué de Hànzì, kěshì cái xiě le yí yè, jiù yìzhí tíng xiàlái chá zìdiǎn. Tóngxué kàn le, gěi wǒ yí ge jiànyì: xiān xiǎngxiang xīn tóngxué zuì xiǎng zhīdào shénme. Wǒ jiù bǎ huódòng de zīliào fàng dào zuìhòu, xiān xiě zěnme jiè shū, zěnme huán shū. Hòulái wǒ yòu qǐng yí wèi xīn tóngxué kàn le yíxià. Tā kàn wán jiù zhīdào zěnme qù túshūguǎn, kāikāixīnxīn de gēn wǒ shuō: “Nǐ zěnme xiě de zhème qīngchǔ! Wǒ hěn pà mílù, xièxie nǐ!” Wǒ tīng le hěn gǎndòng.
passage.english: The department asked me to write an article for the Italian exchange students. I originally wanted to use a lot of newly learned characters, but I had only written one page and already kept stopping to look things up in the dictionary. A classmate read it and suggested thinking about what the new students most wanted to know. So I moved the information about cultural activities to the end and started with how to borrow and return books. Then I asked a student who had just arrived to read it. He knew how to get to the library as soon as he finished. He told me happily, “How did you make it so clear? I was afraid I’d get lost. Thank you!” I was touched.

choices.english: map
dictionary
information
date

questions.why: 可是 sets the stopping against wanting to use many newly learned characters, so the writer keeps looking characters up in a dictionary. Looking up information does not fit: the classmate’s advice shows the writer had not yet thought about what readers want to know, and the map and dates are things the article tells readers, not what slows the writer down.

choices.english: plan
opportunity
piece of news
suggestion

questions.why: 先想想 is advice on what to do, and the writer acts on it. A plan would be the writer’s own, news tells what has happened, and 給我一個機會 would mean letting the writer try something.

choices.english: next
usually
originally
previously

questions.why: The writer had already moved the information before asking a new student to try the article. 本來 would take the story back to the original plan.

choices.english: serious
beautiful
clear
interesting

questions.why: The reader gets the information they need on the first read, so 清楚 describes what surprised them. There is no comment on how the writing looks.

choices.english: worried
touched
anxious
nervous

questions.why: The new student thanks the writer happily, and that moves the writer. Being worried or anxious about getting lost is the new student’s feeling before reading, not the writer’s after hearing the thanks.

passage.traditional: 期末以前，我到華語中心幫忙辦介紹好書的活動。老師交給我一本書，請我{1}到第十頁，找出那張大門的照片。我以前上課不太{2}，連大門上的字都不會寫。後來我每天做完作業才回家，也把大門上的字寫得清清楚楚。有人看完我寫的介紹，就{3}了那本書，說下個星期會拿回來。老師知道了，笑著說：「你怎麼這麼{4}！大門上的字一個都沒寫錯！」我{5}知道，學到的知識也能幫到別人。
passage.simplified: 期末以前，我到华语中心帮忙办介绍好书的活动。老师交给我一本书，请我{1}到第十页，找出那张大门的照片。我以前上课不太{2}，连大门上的字都不会写。后来我每天做完作业才回家，也把大门上的字写得清清楚楚。有人看完我写的介绍，就{3}了那本书，说下个星期会拿回来。老师知道了，笑着说：「你怎么这么{4}！大门上的字一个都没写错！」我{5}知道，学到的知识也能帮到别人。
passage.pinyin: Qímò yǐqián, wǒ dào Huáyǔ zhōngxīn bāngmáng bàn jièshào hǎo shū de huódòng. Lǎoshī jiāo gěi wǒ yì běn shū, qǐng wǒ fān dào dì shí yè, zhǎo chū nà zhāng dàmén de zhàopiàn. Wǒ yǐqián shàngkè bú tài yònggōng, lián dàmén shàng de zì dōu bú huì xiě. Hòulái wǒ měitiān zuò wán zuòyè cái huí jiā, yě bǎ dàmén shàng de zì xiě de qīngqīngchǔchǔ. Yǒu rén kàn wán wǒ xiě de jièshào, jiù jiè le nà běn shū, shuō xià ge xīngqí huì ná huílái. Lǎoshī zhīdào le, xiào zhe shuō: “Nǐ zěnme zhème rènzhēn! Dàmén shàng de zì yí ge dōu méi xiě cuò!” Wǒ zhè cái zhīdào, xué dào de zhīshì yě néng bāng dào biérén.
passage.english: Before the end of the semester, I went to the Chinese Language Center to help prepare an event introducing good books. The teacher gave me a book and asked me to turn to page ten to find the picture of the school gate. I used to put little effort into my classes and could not even write the name on the gate. Later I began to finish my homework before going home every day and made a clear copy of the words on the gate. After reading my introduction, someone borrowed the book and said they would bring it back next week. When my teacher heard, she smiled and said, “How did you get so thorough? You did not get a single character on the gate wrong!” Only then did I see that what I learn can help other people too.

choices.english: turn
read aloud
write
learn by heart

questions.why: The next clause, 找出那張大門的照片, shows the student only has to get to page ten to find a photo, so they turn to it. 念到, 寫到 or 背到第十頁 would mean reading, writing or memorizing everything up to that page.

choices.english: quiet
punctual
hard-working
careful

questions.why: Not being able to write the characters, and then finishing homework every day, show the change is in effort: the student did not study hard before. Being quiet or on time in class would not explain not knowing the characters.

choices.english: return
borrow
buy
reserve

questions.why: The reader takes the book and will bring it back next week, which means it is borrowed. Returning, buying or reserving the book does not fit 下個星期會拿回來.

choices.english: anxious
polite
relaxed
thorough

questions.why: The teacher praises the care the student took: not one character wrong. 你怎麼這麼客氣 is a common phrase, but nobody here is being polite, and nothing shows the student anxious or relaxed.

choices.english: long since
only then
not yet
originally

questions.why: The borrowed book shows the writer something new about how learning can help others. 早就 would mean the writer already understood it before the event.

text.traditional: 一間博物館請我們系上幫忙翻譯一篇介紹當地文化的文章，讓義大利人也看得懂。以前在課堂上，教授只要我們翻譯課文。這篇文章是給來台灣旅遊的人看的，他們不一定了解當地的習慣。我們一開始常常查字典，還好教授對當地文化的知識很豐富，第一頁很快就翻完了。教授看過以後，請我們把文章念給一位義大利校友聽。他聽得懂每個字，可是他不知道為什麼有人要把紅色的紙貼在大門上。我們才發現，只把字翻對還不夠，也要說清楚當地人的習慣。後來我們加上了照片，也多寫了一點當地人過年的方式。教授說，這就是他把翻譯課搬到博物館的目的。
text.simplified: 一间博物馆请我们系上帮忙翻译一篇介绍当地文化的文章，让义大利人也看得懂。以前在课堂上，教授只要我们翻译课文。这篇文章是给来台湾旅游的人看的，他们不一定了解当地的习惯。我们一开始常常查字典，还好教授对当地文化的知识很丰富，第一页很快就翻完了。教授看过以后，请我们把文章念给一位义大利校友听。他听得懂每个字，可是他不知道为什么有人要把红色的纸贴在大门上。我们才发现，只把字翻对还不够，也要说清楚当地人的习惯。后来我们加上了照片，也多写了一点当地人过年的方式。教授说，这就是他把翻译课搬到博物馆的目的。
text.pinyin: Yì jiān bówùguǎn qǐng wǒmen xì shàng bāngmáng fānyì yì piān jièshào dāngdì wénhuà de wénzhāng, ràng Yìdàlì rén yě kàn de dǒng. Yǐqián zài kètáng shàng, jiàoshòu zhǐ yào wǒmen fānyì kèwén. Zhè piān wénzhāng shì gěi lái Táiwān lǚyóu de rén kàn de, tāmen bù yídìng liǎojiě dāngdì de xíguàn. Wǒmen yì kāishǐ chángcháng chá zìdiǎn, háihǎo jiàoshòu duì dāngdì wénhuà de zhīshì hěn fēngfù, dì yī yè hěn kuài jiù fān wán le. Jiàoshòu kàn guo yǐhòu, qǐng wǒmen bǎ wénzhāng niàn gěi yí wèi Yìdàlì xiàoyǒu tīng. Tā tīng de dǒng měi ge zì, kěshì tā bù zhīdào wèishénme yǒu rén yào bǎ hóngsè de zhǐ tiē zài dàmén shàng. Wǒmen cái fāxiàn, zhǐ bǎ zì fān duì hái bú gòu, yě yào shuō qīngchǔ dāngdì rén de xíguàn. Hòulái wǒmen jiā shàng le zhàopiàn, yě duō xiě le yìdiǎn dāngdì rén guònián de fāngshì. Jiàoshòu shuō, zhè jiù shì tā bǎ fānyì kè bān dào bówùguǎn de mùdì.
text.english: A museum asked our department to translate an article about local culture into Italian. In class, our professor had only asked us to translate texts from the course book. This time our readers were tourists visiting Taiwan, who might know little about local culture. At first we often looked things up in the dictionary. Luckily, our professor knew a lot about the local culture, so we finished the first page quickly. After reading it, the professor asked us to read the article aloud to an Italian alumnus. He understood every word but could not work out why people stick red paper on the front door. We realized that getting the words right was only part of the job. We also had to explain local customs. So we added a photo and wrote a little about how local people celebrate the New Year. The professor said that was why he had brought the translation class to the museum.

prompt.traditional: 教授為什麼讓學生到博物館上課？
prompt.simplified: 教授为什么让学生到博物馆上课？
prompt.pinyin: Jiàoshòu wèishénme ràng xuéshēng dào bówùguǎn shàngkè?
prompt.english: Why did the professor have students work at the museum?

choices.traditional: 讓學生多了解當地文化
choices.simplified: 让学生多了解当地文化
choices.pinyin: Ràng xuéshēng duō liǎojiě dāngdì wénhuà.
choices.english: Help students learn more about local culture.

choices.traditional: 讓學生學會查各種字典
choices.simplified: 让学生学会查各种字典
choices.pinyin: Ràng xuéshēng xuéhuì chá gè zhǒng zìdiǎn.
choices.english: Teach students to use different dictionaries.

choices.traditional: 讓學生跟校友交換意見
choices.simplified: 让学生跟校友交换意见
choices.pinyin: Ràng xuéshēng gēn xiàoyǒu jiāohuàn yìjiàn.
choices.english: Have students exchange views with alumni.

choices.traditional: 讓學生了解看文章的人需要什麼
choices.simplified: 让学生了解看文章的人需要什么

text.traditional: 我在華語中心教中文十年了，我發現很多學生在自己的國家就學過漢語，筆試考得很好，生字跟語法都記得很多，漢字也寫得很漂亮，可是到了外面，連買東西都不太敢說話。所以從這個學期開始，我們改變了教法：課堂上少寫一點，多說一點，期末考口試的分數也從二十分增加到五十分。剛開始，不少學生很煩惱，他們說自己的聲調不好，怕說錯了別人聽不懂。可是一個學期以後，大部分的人都敢在課堂上表達自己的意見了，有的還跟我說，現在去夜市殺價也不怕了。從筆試的分數看不出這些改變，可是學生自己知道，他們用中文跟人說話的方式不一樣了。
text.simplified: 我在华语中心教中文十年了，我发现很多学生在自己的国家就学过汉语，笔试考得很好，生字跟语法都记得很多，汉字也写得很漂亮，可是到了外面，连买东西都不太敢说话。所以从这个学期开始，我们改变了教法：课堂上少写一点，多说一点，期末考口试的分数也从二十分增加到五十分。刚开始，不少学生很烦恼，他们说自己的声调不好，怕说错了别人听不懂。可是一个学期以后，大部分的人都敢在课堂上表达自己的意见了，有的还跟我说，现在去夜市杀价也不怕了。从笔试的分数看不出这些改变，可是学生自己知道，他们用中文跟人说话的方式不一样了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn jiāo Zhōngwén shí nián le, wǒ fāxiàn hěn duō xuéshēng zài zìjǐ de guójiā jiù xué guo Hànyǔ, bǐshì kǎo de hěn hǎo, shēngzì gēn yǔfǎ dōu jì de hěn duō, Hànzì yě xiě de hěn piàoliàng, kěshì dào le wàimiàn, lián mǎi dōngxi dōu bú tài gǎn shuōhuà. Suǒyǐ cóng zhège xuéqí kāishǐ, wǒmen gǎibiàn le jiàofǎ: kètáng shàng shǎo xiě yìdiǎn, duō shuō yìdiǎn, qímòkǎo kǒushì de fēnshù yě cóng èrshí fēn zēngjiā dào wǔshí fēn. Gāng kāishǐ, bù shǎo xuéshēng hěn fánnǎo, tāmen shuō zìjǐ de shēngdiào bù hǎo, pà shuō cuò le biérén tīng bù dǒng. Kěshì yí ge xuéqí yǐhòu, dà bùfèn de rén dōu gǎn zài kètáng shàng biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn le, yǒu de hái gēn wǒ shuō, xiànzài qù yèshì shājià yě bú pà le. Cóng bǐshì de fēnshù kàn bù chū zhèxiē gǎibiàn, kěshì xuéshēng zìjǐ zhīdào, tāmen yòng Zhōngwén gēn rén shuōhuà de fāngshì bù yíyàng le.
text.english: I have taught Mandarin at the Chinese Language Center for ten years, and I have found that many students, who already learned Mandarin in their own countries, do well in written exams, remember lots of words and grammar and write beautiful characters, yet out in the street they hardly dare to speak, even when shopping. So this semester we changed our teaching: less writing in class, more speaking, and the oral part of the final exam went from twenty points to fifty. At first many students were worried; they said their tones were bad and they were afraid people would not understand their mistakes. But after one semester most of them dared to give their opinions in class, and some told me they were no longer afraid to bargain at the night market. Written exam scores do not show these changes, but students can tell that the way they speak Chinese with other people has changed.

choices.simplified: 学生会写，可是不太敢说

choices.pinyin: Xuéshēng xiě de Hànzì tài shǎo le.

choices.simplified: 学生的口试常常考不好

Their written exams and characters were good, and the text never says how they did in the oral exam before: its share of the marks was raised as part of the change.

choices.simplified: 学生的声调都没问题了
choices.pinyin: Xuéshēng de shēngdiào dōu méi wèntí le.
choices.english: Students' tones are all fine now.

text.traditional: 期末考快到了，大家都在努力念書，學校對面那家咖啡店的生意越來越好。為了吸引學生，老闆把店裡的二樓變成了念書的地方，那裡坐得下四十個人，還有免費的無線網路。平日只要買一杯咖啡，就可以在那裡坐一個下午。假日二樓只讓來吃午餐的顧客上去。老闆還想出了一個辦法：每買滿五杯咖啡，就送一個史努比娃娃。這個辦法真的很有用，連平常不喝咖啡的室友都每天去。可是上個星期，因為人太多的關係，我去了兩次都沒有位子，只好回宿舍念書。
text.simplified: 期末考快到了，大家都在努力念书，学校对面那家咖啡店的生意越来越好。为了吸引学生，老板把店里的二楼变成了念书的地方，那里坐得下四十个人，还有免费的无线网路。平日只要买一杯咖啡，就可以在那里坐一个下午。假日二楼只让来吃午餐的顾客上去。老板还想出了一个办法：每买满五杯咖啡，就送一个史努比娃娃。这个办法真的很有用，连平常不喝咖啡的室友都每天去。可是上个星期，因为人太多的关系，我去了两次都没有位子，只好回宿舍念书。
text.pinyin: Qímòkǎo kuài dào le, dàjiā dōu zài nǔlì niànshū, xuéxiào duìmiàn nà jiā kāfēi diàn de shēngyì yuè lái yuè hǎo. Wèile xīyǐn xuéshēng, lǎobǎn bǎ diàn lǐ de èr lóu biànchéng le niànshū de dìfāng, nàlǐ zuò de xià sìshí ge rén, hái yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù. Píngrì zhǐyào mǎi yì bēi kāfēi, jiù kěyǐ zài nàlǐ zuò yí ge xiàwǔ. Jiàrì èr lóu zhǐ ràng lái chī wǔcān de gùkè shàngqù. Lǎobǎn hái xiǎng chū le yí ge bànfǎ: měi mǎi mǎn wǔ bēi kāfēi, jiù sòng yí ge Shǐnǔbǐ wáwa. Zhège bànfǎ zhēn de hěn yǒuyòng, lián píngcháng bù hē kāfēi de shìyǒu dōu měi tiān qù. Kěshì shàng ge xīngqí, yīnwèi rén tài duō de guānxì, wǒ qù le liǎng cì dōu méiyǒu wèizi, zhǐhǎo huí sùshè niànshū.
text.english: Finals are coming and everyone is studying hard, so the café across from campus is doing better and better. To attract students, the owner turned the second floor into a place to study: it seats forty and has free Wi-Fi. On weekdays, buy one coffee and you can sit there all afternoon. On weekends the second floor is for lunch customers only. The owner also came up with an idea: for every five coffees you buy, you get a Snoopy doll. It really works; even my roommate, who normally doesn't drink coffee, goes every day. But last week, because there were so many people, I went twice and found no seat both times, so I had to go back to the dorm to study.

Buy five coffees on Friday.
Buy four coffees on Saturday.

questions.why: 連平常不喝咖啡的室友都每天去: even someone who does not drink coffee goes every day, which shows how well the idea pulls people in. The roommate normally does not drink coffee, the text never says the roommate studies there, and the passage gives no evidence that the Wi-Fi brought the roommate in.

choices.english: The roommate was there every day.
The writer doesn't like coffee.

choices.pinyin: Kāfēi diàn de wǎnglù bù hǎo.
choices.english: The café's Wi-Fi was bad.

questions.why: Because of the crowds (因為人太多的關係) there was no seat either time, so 只好 back to the dorm. The roommate is there too, but that is not the reason; it is the roommate who doesn't drink coffee, and the text gives no problem with the Wi-Fi.

text.traditional: 期末考以後，社區請我們在草地上辦一場免費的表演。老師跟學生一起合唱，附近的校友也來幫忙。我們本來想下午先練習合唱，晚上才表演。可是到了中午，天上的雲越來越多。還好社區的工作人員知道隔壁的教室沒有人用，要不然這次的活動只好停了。大家把樂器搬到教室，一邊休息一邊聊天，說著說著就忘了時間。有人走進來問幾點開始，我們才知道表演時間到了。我們本來在草地旁邊貼了換教室的海報，可是海報被人拿走了，不少人還在外面等。我們請校友去帶人進來，也請先到的人幫忙把位子留給老先生跟老太太。表演開始時，教室裡已經坐滿了人。
text.simplified: 期末考以后，社区请我们在草地上办一场免费的表演。老师跟学生一起合唱，附近的校友也来帮忙。我们本来想下午先练习合唱，晚上才表演。可是到了中午，天上的云越来越多。还好社区的工作人员知道隔壁的教室没有人用，要不然这次的活动只好停了。大家把乐器搬到教室，一边休息一边聊天，说着说着就忘了时间。有人走进来问几点开始，我们才知道表演时间到了。我们本来在草地旁边贴了换教室的海报，可是海报被人拿走了，不少人还在外面等。我们请校友去带人进来，也请先到的人帮忙把位子留给老先生跟老太太。表演开始时，教室里已经坐满了人。
text.pinyin: Qímòkǎo yǐhòu, shèqū qǐng wǒmen zài cǎodì shàng bàn yì chǎng miǎnfèi de biǎoyǎn. Lǎoshī gēn xuéshēng yìqǐ héchàng, fùjìn de xiàoyǒu yě lái bāngmáng. Wǒmen běnlái xiǎng xiàwǔ xiān liànxí héchàng, wǎnshàng cái biǎoyǎn. Kěshì dào le zhōngwǔ, tiān shàng de yún yuè lái yuè duō. Háihǎo shèqū de gōngzuò rényuán zhīdào gébì de jiàoshì méiyǒu rén yòng, yàobùrán zhè cì de huódòng zhǐhǎo tíng le. Dàjiā bǎ yuèqì bān dào jiàoshì, yìbiān xiūxi yìbiān liáotiān, shuō zhe shuō zhe jiù wàng le shíjiān. Yǒu rén zǒu jìnlái wèn jǐ diǎn kāishǐ, wǒmen cái zhīdào biǎoyǎn shíjiān dào le. Wǒmen běnlái zài cǎodì pángbiān tiē le huàn jiàoshì de hǎibào, kěshì hǎibào bèi rén ná zǒu le, bù shǎo rén hái zài wàimiàn děng. Wǒmen qǐng xiàoyǒu qù dài rén jìnlái, yě qǐng xiān dào de rén bāngmáng bǎ wèizi liú gěi lǎo xiānshēng gēn lǎo tàitai. Biǎoyǎn kāishǐ shí, jiàoshì lǐ yǐjīng zuò mǎn le rén.
text.english: After finals, the community invited us to give a free performance on the lawn. Teachers and students sang together, and alumni from nearby came to help. We planned to practise in the afternoon and perform in the evening. But by noon more and more clouds had gathered. Fortunately, the community staff knew the classroom next door was free. Otherwise the event would have had to be called off. Everyone carried their instruments into the classroom and sat down to rest and lost track of time while chatting. When someone came in to ask when the show started, we realized it was already time. We had put up a poster by the lawn about the move to the classroom, but someone had taken it down, so quite a few people were still waiting outside. We asked the alumni to bring them in and asked those who had arrived early to save seats for older guests. By the time the performance began, the classroom was full.

choices.traditional: 還有人要把樂器搬進來
choices.simplified: 还有人要把乐器搬进来
choices.pinyin: Hái yǒu rén yào bǎ yuèqì bān jìnlái.
choices.english: Some people still had to bring in instruments.

questions.why: The performance moved to the classroom, and someone had taken down the outside poster. The alumni went to show the waiting audience where to go.

picture.alt: A sunny school campus: three young people walk side by side past a modern building with big glass walls. Through the glass you can see a basketball hoop and rows of blue exercise machines: it is a gym. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair and round glasses wears a light-blue face mask, a white short-sleeved shirt with a purple sweater vest, and green trousers; a white cloth bag hangs from her shoulder and she holds one hand up near her chest. In the middle, a girl with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings wears a blue jacket over an orange top and white trousers, with a black bag on her shoulder; she smiles and looks at the girl in the mask next to her. On the right, a young man with black hair wears an open green shirt over a red striped T-shirt and dark trousers; a blue sports bag hangs from his shoulder, and he smiles and holds out his other hand toward the gym. Trees with yellow-green leaves and a blue sky are behind them.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那個男生在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 那个男生在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the young man doing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā cóng jiànshēnfáng lǐ zǒu chūlái.
choices.english: He is walking out of the gym.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他把運動服送給旁邊的女生。
choices.simplified: 他把运动服送给旁边的女生。
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ yùndòngfú sòng gěi pángbiān de nǚshēng.
choices.english: He is giving the girl next to him some sportswear.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他請兩個女生一起去健身。
choices.simplified: 他请两个女生一起去健身。
choices.pinyin: Tā qǐng liǎng ge nǚshēng yìqǐ qù jiànshēn.
choices.english: He is inviting the two girls to work out with him.

questions.why: He smiles and holds his hand out toward the gym as the three walk past it: he is asking the two girls along to work out. They are outside the gym, not coming out of it, and his sports bag stays on his shoulder; he is not handing anyone clothes.

picture.alt: A sunny day at a school: three young people run side by side on a red running track. Inside the track is a green grass field with a soccer goal; school buildings and trees stand in the back under a blue sky with a few clouds. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair and round glasses wears a white T-shirt and green trousers with a white stripe. In the middle, a young man with black hair wears a red striped T-shirt and black shorts. On the right, a girl with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings wears a blue jacket over an orange top and dark leggings. All three wear white running shoes, smile and run easily with their arms bent; nobody is on the grass or playing ball.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這三個人在操場上慢跑。下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 这三个人在操场上慢跑。下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè sān ge rén zài cāochǎng shàng mànpǎo. Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: These three people are jogging on the sports field. Which of these is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男生跑在兩個女生的中間。
choices.simplified: 男生跑在两个女生的中间。
choices.pinyin: Nánshēng pǎo zài liǎng ge nǚshēng de zhōngjiān.
choices.english: The young man is running between the two girls.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 三個人都穿著牛仔褲跑步。
choices.simplified: 三个人都穿着牛仔裤跑步。
choices.pinyin: Sān ge rén dōu chuān zhe niúzǎikù pǎobù.
choices.english: All three are running in jeans.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 戴眼鏡的女生跑在最後。
choices.simplified: 戴眼镜的女生跑在最后。
choices.pinyin: Dài yǎnjìng de nǚshēng pǎo zài zuìhòu.
choices.english: The girl with glasses is running at the back.

questions.why: The young man in the red striped T-shirt runs in the middle, with a girl on each side. Nobody wears jeans (he has black shorts, the girls trousers and leggings), and the three run side by side, so the girl with glasses is not behind the others.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你昨天又開夜車了？眼睛怎麼這麼紅。
lines.simplified: 你昨天又开夜车了？眼睛怎么这么红。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān yòu kāiyèchē le? Yǎnjīng zěnme zhème hóng.
lines.english: You stayed up late again last night? Your eyes are so red.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 報告明天就要交了，我來不及，只好寫到半夜三點。
lines.simplified: 报告明天就要交了，我来不及，只好写到半夜三点。
lines.pinyin: Bàogào míngtiān jiù yào jiāo le, wǒ láibùjí, zhǐhǎo xiě dào bànyè sān diǎn.
lines.english: The report is due tomorrow and I was running out of time, so I had to write until three in the morning.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你上個星期也說來不及。你到底是事情太多，還是晚上老是在玩手機？
lines.simplified: 你上个星期也说来不及。你到底是事情太多，还是晚上老是在玩手机？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge xīngqí yě shuō láibùjí. Nǐ dàodǐ shì shìqíng tài duō, háishì wǎnshàng lǎoshì zài wán shǒujī?
lines.english: You said you were out of time last week too. Is it really too much work, or are you always on your phone at night?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，是手機。我得改變一下習慣了，今天晚上十一點就睡。
lines.simplified: 好吧，是手机。我得改变一下习惯了，今天晚上十一点就睡。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, shì shǒujī. Wǒ děi gǎibiàn yíxià xíguàn le, jīntiān wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn jiù shuì.
lines.english: All right, it's the phone. I need to change my habits; tonight I'll go to bed at eleven.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼常常來不及寫報告？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么常常来不及写报告？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme chángcháng láibùjí xiě bàogào?
prompt.english: Why does the man keep running out of time for his reports?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ shíjiān huā zài shǒujī shàng
choices.english: He spends his time on his phone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yào zuò de shì tài duō le
choices.english: He has too much to do.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā měi tiān shíyī diǎn jiù shuì
choices.english: He goes to bed at eleven every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bànyè sān diǎn cái huíjiā
choices.english: He gets home at three in the morning.

questions.why: 你到底是事情太多，還是……老是在玩手機？ presses him to say which it really is, and he admits 是手機: his evenings go to his phone. Too much work is the excuse she doubts, three o'clock is when he stopped writing, not when he got home, and eleven is only tonight's plan.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼一直跑廁所？是不是拉肚子了？
lines.simplified: 你怎么一直跑厕所？是不是拉肚子了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yìzhí pǎo cèsuǒ? Shì bú shì lādùzi le?
lines.english: Why do you keep running to the bathroom? Do you have diarrhea?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，下午開始的，還有一點頭痛。
lines.simplified: 对啊，下午开始的，还有一点头痛。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, xiàwǔ kāishǐ de, hái yǒu yìdiǎn tóutòng.
lines.english: Yes, it started this afternoon, and I have a bit of a headache too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你今天到底吃了什麼？
lines.simplified: 你今天到底吃了什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān dàodǐ chī le shénme?
lines.english: What on earth did you eat today?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 早上吃漢堡，中午吃學校餐廳，同學吃了都沒事。下課太熱，在路邊買了一杯果汁。
lines.simplified: 早上吃汉堡，中午吃学校餐厅，同学吃了都没事。下课太热，在路边买了一杯果汁。
lines.pinyin: Zǎoshàng chī hànbǎo, zhōngwǔ chī xuéxiào cāntīng, tóngxué chī le dōu méi shì. Xiàkè tài rè, zài lùbiān mǎi le yì bēi guǒzhī.
lines.english: A hamburger in the morning and lunch at the school cafeteria; my classmates ate there too and they're fine. After class it was so hot that I bought a cup of juice from a street stand.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一定是那杯果汁的問題。走，我陪你去看病。
lines.simplified: 一定是那杯果汁的问题。走，我陪你去看病。
lines.pinyin: Yídìng shì nà bēi guǒzhī de wèntí. Zǒu, wǒ péi nǐ qù kànbìng.
lines.english: It must be that juice. Come on, I'll go with you to see a doctor.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得男的為什麼拉肚子？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得男的为什么拉肚子？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde nán de wèishénme lādùzi?
prompt.english: Why does the woman think the man has diarrhea?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hē le lùbiān mài de yǐnliào
choices.english: He had a drink from a street stand.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng de cài bù gānjìng
choices.english: The school cafeteria's food was not clean.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He had a hamburger for breakfast.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: It was too hot after class.

questions.why: After 到底吃了什麼？ he lists everything, and she blames the juice he bought at a street stand (一定是那杯果汁的問題). His classmates ate the same cafeteria lunch and are fine, nobody blames the hamburger, and the heat is only why he bought the juice.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 昨天第一次去健身房，今天腿痛死了，連走路都很慢。
lines.simplified: 昨天第一次去健身房，今天腿痛死了，连走路都很慢。
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān dì yī cì qù jiànshēnfáng, jīntiān tuǐ tòng sǐ le, lián zǒulù dōu hěn màn.
lines.english: Yesterday was my first time at the gym, and today my legs are killing me. I can hardly even walk.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你是不是一下子做太多了？
lines.simplified: 你是不是一下子做太多了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shì bú shì yíxiàzi zuò tài duō le?
lines.english: Did you do too much all at once?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 教練要我慢慢來，可是我想快一點把體重減下來，就多做了一個小時。
lines.simplified: 教练要我慢慢来，可是我想快一点把体重减下来，就多做了一个小时。
lines.pinyin: Jiàoliàn yào wǒ mànmàn lái, kěshì wǒ xiǎng kuài yìdiǎn bǎ tǐzhòng jiǎn xiàlái, jiù duō zuò le yí ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: The coach told me to take it slowly, but I wanted to get my weight down faster, so I did an extra hour.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你也太誇張了！下次照教練說的做就好。
lines.simplified: 你也太夸张了！下次照教练说的做就好。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yě tài kuāzhāng le! Xià cì zhào jiàoliàn shuō de zuò jiù hǎo.
lines.english: That's way over the top! Next time just do what the coach says.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼腿這麼痛？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么腿这么痛？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme tuǐ zhème tòng?
prompt.english: Why do the man's legs hurt so much?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zuò de bǐ jiàoliàn shuō de duō
choices.english: He did more than the coach said.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiàoliàn yào tā zuò hěn jiǔ
choices.english: The coach made him work out for a long time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zuótiān zǒu le hěn duō lù
choices.english: He walked a lot yesterday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jīntiān yòu qù jiànshēn le
choices.english: He went to the gym again today.

questions.why: 腿痛死了 means his legs hurt terribly, and he gives the reason himself: the coach said to take it slowly, but he added an extra hour to lose weight faster. The coach wanted less, not more; walking is what is hard today, and he went yesterday, not again today.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 爸爸，醫生怎麼說？
lines.simplified: 爸爸，医生怎么说？
lines.pinyin: Bàba, yīshēng zěnme shuō?
lines.english: Dad, what did the doctor say?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 醫生說我的情況改善很多，藥可以少吃了。
lines.simplified: 医生说我的情况改善很多，药可以少吃了。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ de qíngkuàng gǎishàn hěn duō, yào kěyǐ shǎo chī le.
lines.english: The doctor said my condition has improved a lot, and I can take less medicine now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 太好了！是因為你每天晚上去慢跑吧？
lines.simplified: 太好了！是因为你每天晚上去慢跑吧？
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Shì yīnwèi nǐ měi tiān wǎnshàng qù mànpǎo ba?
lines.english: Great! It's because you go jogging every evening, right?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 慢跑只是一部分。最重要的是你媽媽做的菜，都少油少鹽，剛開始覺得難吃死了，現在習慣了。我也不喝可樂了，只喝開水。
lines.simplified: 慢跑只是一部分。最重要的是你妈妈做的菜，都少油少盐，刚开始觉得难吃死了，现在习惯了。我也不喝可乐了，只喝开水。
lines.pinyin: Mànpǎo zhǐ shì yí bùfèn. Zuì zhòngyào de shì nǐ māma zuò de cài, dōu shǎo yóu shǎo yán, gāng kāishǐ juéde nánchī sǐ le, xiànzài xíguàn le. Wǒ yě bù hē kělè le, zhǐ hē kāishuǐ.
lines.english: Jogging is only part of it. The most important thing is your mom's cooking: it's all low in oil and salt. At first I thought it tasted awful, but I'm used to it now. And I've stopped drinking cola; I only drink water.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 爸爸覺得自己身體變好，最重要的是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 爸爸觉得自己身体变好，最重要的是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Bàba juéde zìjǐ shēntǐ biàn hǎo, zuì zhòngyào de shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the father think matters most in his better health?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu qù mànpǎo
choices.english: Jogging every evening.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào bǐ yǐqián chī de shǎo le
choices.english: Taking less medicine than before.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chī de cài yóu gēn yán dōu shǎo le
choices.english: Eating food with less oil and salt.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bù hē kělè, gǎi hē kāishuǐ
choices.english: Drinking water instead of cola.

questions.why: His daughter guesses jogging, but he says 慢跑只是一部分。最重要的是 his wife's cooking, now low in oil and salt, which he first found 難吃死了. Less medicine is the result, not the cause, and giving up cola comes after 也: one more change, not the main one.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這家吃到飽的餐廳真不錯，我們再去拿一盤吧！
lines.simplified: 这家吃到饱的餐厅真不错，我们再去拿一盘吧！
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā chīdàobǎo de cāntīng zhēn búcuò, wǒmen zài qù ná yì pán ba!
lines.english: This all-you-can-eat place is really good. Let's get another plate!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我已經吃了三盤，真的吃不下了。
lines.simplified: 我已经吃了三盘，真的吃不下了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng chī le sān pán, zhēn de chī bú xià le.
lines.english: I've already had three plates. I really can't eat any more.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是一個人要六百塊，不多吃一點太可惜了。
lines.simplified: 可是一个人要六百块，不多吃一点太可惜了。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì yí ge rén yào liùbǎi kuài, bù duō chī yìdiǎn tài kěxí le.
lines.english: But it's six hundred a person. It's a waste not to eat a bit more.

lines.speaker: F

lines.simplified: 怕白花钱就吃那么多，对身体没有好处。你去拿吧，我喝杯热茶就好。
lines.pinyin: Pà bái huā qián jiù chī nàme duō, duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù. Nǐ qù ná ba, wǒ hē bēi rè chá jiù hǎo.
lines.english: Eating that much to get your money's worth does your body no good. You go; a cup of hot tea is enough for me.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼不再去拿菜了？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么不再去拿菜了？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme bú zài qù ná cài le?
prompt.english: Why won't the woman get more food?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā dùzi yǐjīng hěn bǎo le
choices.english: She is already full.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde liùbǎi kuài tài guì le
choices.english: She thinks six hundred is too expensive.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiān hē yì bēi rè chá
choices.english: She wants a cup of hot tea first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde cài bú tài hǎochī
choices.english: She doesn't think the food is good.

lines.traditional: 我們不是要去游泳嗎？你怎麼穿著運動服來了？
lines.simplified: 我们不是要去游泳吗？你怎么穿着运动服来了？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen bú shì yào qù yóuyǒng ma? Nǐ zěnme chuān zhe yùndòngfú lái le?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 游泳池今天在打掃，不開。我們只好改去河邊慢跑了。
lines.simplified: 游泳池今天在打扫，不开。我们只好改去河边慢跑了。
lines.pinyin: Yóuyǒngchí jīntiān zài dǎsǎo, bù kāi. Wǒmen zhǐhǎo gǎi qù hébiān mànpǎo le.
lines.english: The pool is being cleaned today, so it's closed. We'll have to go jogging by the river instead.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是我穿著牛仔褲，怎麼跑啊？
lines.simplified: 可是我穿着牛仔裤，怎么跑啊？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ chuān zhe niúzǎikù, zěnme pǎo a?
lines.english: But I'm wearing jeans. How can I run?

lines.simplified: 没关系，你家就在附近，我先送你回去换衣服吧。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxì, nǐ jiā jiù zài fùjìn, wǒ xiān sòng nǐ huíqù huàn yīfú ba.
lines.english: No problem. Your place is close by; I'll take you back to change first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們現在要先去哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 他们现在要先去哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen xiànzài yào xiān qù nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where are they going first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The school pool.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The river nearby.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: A sportswear shop.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The woman's home.

questions.why: The pool is closed, so 只好 they switch to jogging by the river; but she is in jeans, so first (先) she goes home to change. The pool was the first plan, the river comes after, and nobody mentions buying sportswear.

focus.en: have no choice but to; go back and change first

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 媽媽，社區活動中心有一個老人健身班，你要不要去？
lines.simplified: 妈妈，社区活动中心有一个老人健身班，你要不要去？
lines.pinyin: Māma, shèqū huódòng zhōngxīn yǒu yí ge lǎorén jiànshēn bān, nǐ yào bú yào qù?
lines.english: Mom, the community activity center has a fitness class for older people. Do you want to go?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我這個年紀還去健身？那是年輕人做的事吧。
lines.simplified: 我这个年纪还去健身？那是年轻人做的事吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhège niánjì hái qù jiànshēn? Nà shì niánqīngrén zuò de shì ba.
lines.english: Work out, at my age? That's for young people, isn't it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 健身跟年紀沒什麼關係，男人、女人、老人都應該多運動。隔壁的張太太說，她去了兩個月，精神好多了。
lines.simplified: 健身跟年纪没什么关系，男人、女人、老人都应该多运动。隔壁的张太太说，她去了两个月，精神好多了。
lines.pinyin: Jiànshēn gēn niánjì méi shénme guānxì, nánrén, nǚrén, lǎorén dōu yīnggāi duō yùndòng. Gébì de Zhāng tàitai shuō, tā qù le liǎng ge yuè, jīngshén hǎo duō le.
lines.english: Working out has nothing to do with age: men, women and older people should all exercise more. Mrs. Zhang next door says she's been going for two months and has much more energy.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是我的腿不好，跟不上的話怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 可是我的腿不好，跟不上的话怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ de tuǐ bù hǎo, gēn bú shàng dehuà zěnme bàn?
lines.english: But my legs aren't good. What if I can't keep up?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 跟不上的話，坐在椅子上做就可以了。教練會照每個人的體力教。
lines.simplified: 跟不上的话，坐在椅子上做就可以了。教练会照每个人的体力教。
lines.pinyin: Gēn bú shàng dehuà, zuò zài yǐzi shàng zuò jiù kěyǐ le. Jiàoliàn huì zhào měi ge rén de tǐlì jiāo.
lines.english: If you can't keep up, you can just do it sitting on a chair. The coach teaches according to each person's strength.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，那我先去上一堂看看。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那我先去上一堂看看。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà wǒ xiān qù shàng yì táng kànkan.
lines.english: All right, I'll go to one class and see.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 媽媽一聽到健身班，最先是怎麼想的？
prompt.simplified: 妈妈一听到健身班，最先是怎么想的？
prompt.pinyin: Māma yì tīng dào jiànshēn bān, zuì xiān shì zěnme xiǎng de?
prompt.english: When the mother hears about the fitness class, what does she think first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà zìjǐ gēn bú shàng biérén
choices.english: She is afraid she can't keep up with others.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She thinks she is too old.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She wants to ask Mrs. Zhang first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng xiān qù shàng yì táng kànkan
choices.english: She wants to try one class first.

questions.why: 我這個年紀還去健身？那是年輕人做的事吧 is her first answer: she feels too old for it. Not keeping up is the worry she raises later, trying one class is where she ends up, and she never says she wants to ask Mrs. Zhang.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 兒子說，媽媽跟不上的話可以怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 儿子说，妈妈跟不上的话可以怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Érzi shuō, māma gēn bú shàng dehuà kěyǐ zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the son say his mother can do if she can't keep up?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng Zhāng tàitai péi tā qù
choices.english: Ask Mrs. Zhang to go with her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huàn yí ge niánqīngrén de bān
choices.english: Switch to a class for young people.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān xiūxí yí ge yuè zài qù
choices.english: Rest for a month before going.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zuò zhe gēn dàjiā yìqǐ zuò
choices.english: Do the exercises with everyone while seated.

questions.why: 跟不上的話，坐在椅子上做就可以了: if she can't keep up, she can do the exercises sitting down. Mrs. Zhang is only the neighbour who goes, the young people's class is what she thought the class was, and nobody suggests waiting a month.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下學期的體育課，你要選什麼？我想選游泳。
lines.simplified: 下学期的体育课，你要选什么？我想选游泳。
lines.pinyin: Xià xuéqí de tǐyù kè, nǐ yào xuǎn shénme? Wǒ xiǎng xuǎn yóuyǒng.
lines.english: Which PE class will you choose next semester? I want to take swimming.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我從小就怕水，還是選慢跑吧。慢跑課一個星期兩堂，都在操場上課。
lines.simplified: 我从小就怕水，还是选慢跑吧。慢跑课一个星期两堂，都在操场上课。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù pà shuǐ, háishì xuǎn mànpǎo ba. Mànpǎo kè yí ge xīngqí liǎng táng, dōu zài cāochǎng shàngkè.
lines.english: I've been afraid of water since I was little, so I'll take jogging. It's two classes a week, on the sports field.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我最討厭跑操場了，多無聊啊！游泳課的老師很會教，不會游泳的話，他會從頭教。我姐姐去年也怕水，現在每個星期都去游泳。
lines.simplified: 我最讨厌跑操场了，多无聊啊！游泳课的老师很会教，不会游泳的话，他会从头教。我姐姐去年也怕水，现在每个星期都去游泳。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì tǎoyàn pǎo cāochǎng le, duō wúliáo a! Yóuyǒng kè de lǎoshī hěn huì jiāo, bú huì yóuyǒng dehuà, tā huì cóng tóu jiāo. Wǒ jiějie qùnián yě pà shuǐ, xiànzài měi ge xīngqí dōu qù yóuyǒng.
lines.english: I hate running laps; it's so boring! The swimming teacher is great: if you can't swim, he teaches you from the start. My sister was afraid of water last year too, and now she swims every week.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？那我也去試試看。學不會的話，再換慢跑。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？那我也去试试看。学不会的话，再换慢跑。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nà wǒ yě qù shìshi kàn. Xué bú huì dehuà, zài huàn mànpǎo.
lines.english: Really? Then I'll give it a try. If I can't learn, I'll switch to jogging.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼本來想選慢跑課？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么本来想选慢跑课？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme běnlái xiǎng xuǎn mànpǎo kè?
prompt.english: Why did the man first want to choose the jogging class?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The jogging class is more fun.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎo shíhòu jiù bù gǎn xià shuǐ
choices.english: He hasn't dared go in the water since he was a child.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mànpǎo kè de lǎoshī hěn huì jiāo
choices.english: The jogging teacher is very good.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yí ge xīngqí zhǐ yǒu liǎng táng
choices.english: It meets only twice a week.

questions.why: 我從小就怕水，還是選慢跑吧: he has been afraid of water since childhood, so he first picks jogging. Two classes a week is only a fact about the class, the teacher who is good is the swimming one, and she, not he, talks about which class is boring.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man finally plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān shàng mànpǎo kè, zài huàn yóuyǒng
choices.english: Take jogging first, then switch to swimming.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ shàng yóuyǒng kè, bú huàn le
choices.english: Take only swimming and never switch.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先試游泳課，學不會再換
choices.simplified: 先试游泳课，学不会再换
choices.pinyin: Xiān shì yóuyǒng kè, xué bú huì zài huàn
choices.english: Try swimming first and switch if it doesn't work.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn tā jiějie yìqǐ qù yóuyǒng
choices.english: Go swimming with her sister.

questions.why: 那我也去試試看。學不會的話，再換慢跑: he will try swimming, and only if he can't learn will he switch back. The order is swimming first, not jogging first; he keeps the option to switch; her sister is just an example.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 陳太太您好，我是陳先生的醫生，我姓林。他的腿恢復得很好，下星期一就可以回家了。
lines.simplified: 陈太太您好，我是陈先生的医生，我姓林。他的腿恢复得很好，下星期一就可以回家了。
lines.pinyin: Chén tàitai nín hǎo, wǒ shì Chén xiānshēng de yīshēng, wǒ xìng Lín. Tā de tuǐ huīfù de hěn hǎo, xià xīngqíyī jiù kěyǐ huíjiā le.
lines.english: Hello, Mrs. Chen, this is Mr. Chen's doctor; my name is Lin. His leg is recovering well; he can go home next Monday.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不過，對腿剛開始恢復的病人來說，一下子走太多路不太好。
lines.simplified: 不过，对腿刚开始恢复的病人来说，一下子走太多路不太好。
lines.pinyin: Búguò, duì tuǐ gāng kāishǐ huīfù de bìngrén lái shuō, yíxiàzi zǒu tài duō lù bú tài hǎo.
lines.english: But for a patient whose leg has only just started to recover, walking too much all at once isn't good.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我建議他每天在家裡慢慢活動，走十分鐘就休息一下。
lines.simplified: 我建议他每天在家里慢慢活动，走十分钟就休息一下。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiànyì tā měi tiān zài jiālǐ mànmàn huódòng, zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù xiūxí yíxià.
lines.english: I suggest he move about slowly at home every day and rest after ten minutes of walking.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還有，回家以後，請他每個星期回醫院一次。他最近不能打球，心情很難過，回家跟家人在一起，對他也會很有幫助。
lines.simplified: 还有，回家以后，请他每个星期回医院一次。他最近不能打球，心情很难过，回家跟家人在一起，对他也会很有帮助。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, huíjiā yǐhòu, qǐng tā měi ge xīngqí huí yīyuàn yí cì. Tā zuìjìn bù néng dǎqiú, xīnqíng hěn nánguò, huíjiā gēn jiārén zài yìqǐ, duì tā yě huì hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
lines.english: Also, after he goes home, please have him come back to the hospital once a week. He has been very down lately, not being able to play ball; being home with his family will do him a lot of good too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 林醫生覺得陳先生回家以後應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 林医生觉得陈先生回家以后应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Lín yīshēng juéde Chén xiānshēng huíjiā yǐhòu yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does Dr. Lin think Mr. Chen should do after going home?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Duō zǒulù, huīfù de bǐjiào kuài
choices.english: Walk a lot so he recovers faster.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān zǒu yíhuìr jiù xiūxí
choices.english: Walk a little each day, then rest.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān qù yīyuàn yí cì
choices.english: Go to the hospital once a day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Play ball as soon as he is home.

questions.why: 對腿剛開始恢復的病人來說 walking a lot at once is bad, so she suggests short walks with rests (走十分鐘就休息一下). Walking more is exactly what she warns against, the hospital visit is once a week, not a day, and ball games are what he misses.

focus.en: for …; as far as … is concerned

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 林醫生留這段話，最想告訴陳太太什麼？
prompt.simplified: 林医生留这段话，最想告诉陈太太什么？
prompt.pinyin: Lín yīshēng liú zhè duàn huà, zuì xiǎng gàosù Chén tàitai shénme?
prompt.english: What does Dr. Lin most want to tell Mrs. Chen in this message?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jīntiān děi lái yīyuàn yí cì
choices.english: That she must come to the hospital today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā wèishénme hái bù néng huíjiā
choices.english: Why he can't go home yet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā shénme shíhòu néng zài dǎqiú
choices.english: When he can play ball again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他回家以後要注意什麼
choices.simplified: 他回家以后要注意什么
choices.pinyin: Tā huíjiā yǐhòu yào zhùyì shénme
choices.english: What he must watch out for at home.

questions.why: She gives the day he goes home and then, point by point, what to do after: short walks with rests, a weekly check, time with family for his low mood. He can go home on Monday, so nothing keeps him; she asks nobody to come today, and she never says when he can play ball: that is only why he is down.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位同學，期末考快到了，很多同學經常開夜車念書。
lines.simplified: 各位同学，期末考快到了，很多同学经常开夜车念书。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi tóngxué, qímòkǎo kuài dào le, hěn duō tóngxué jīngcháng kāiyèchē niànshū.
lines.english: Students, finals are coming, and many of you often stay up late studying.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是對學生來說，睡得夠比念到半夜更重要。睡不夠的話，白天沒有精神，上課老是打瞌睡。
lines.simplified: 可是对学生来说，睡得够比念到半夜更重要。睡不够的话，白天没有精神，上课老是打瞌睡。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì duì xuéshēng lái shuō, shuì de gòu bǐ niàn dào bànyè gèng zhòngyào. Shuì bú gòu dehuà, báitiān méiyǒu jīngshén, shàngkè lǎoshì dǎ kēshuì.
lines.english: But for students, getting enough sleep matters more than studying until midnight. Without enough sleep you have no energy in the daytime and keep nodding off in class.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 為了改善這個情況，從下星期一開始，每天中午十二點到一點，大家都可以到圖書館三樓的教室睡午覺。
lines.simplified: 为了改善这个情况，从下星期一开始，每天中午十二点到一点，大家都可以到图书馆三楼的教室睡午觉。
lines.pinyin: Wèile gǎishàn zhège qíngkuàng, cóng xià xīngqíyī kāishǐ, měi tiān zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn dào yì diǎn, dàjiā dōu kěyǐ dào túshūguǎn sān lóu de jiàoshì shuì wǔjiào.
lines.english: To improve this, from next Monday, every day from twelve to one, the classroom on the library's third floor is open for everyone to take a nap.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 進去以後請安靜。不用睡很久，睡二十分鐘，對下午上課就很有幫助。
lines.simplified: 进去以后请安静。不用睡很久，睡二十分钟，对下午上课就很有帮助。
lines.pinyin: Jìnqù yǐhòu qǐng ānjìng. Búyòng shuì hěn jiǔ, shuì èrshí fēnzhōng, duì xiàwǔ shàngkè jiù hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
lines.english: Please be quiet once you are inside. You don't need to sleep long: twenty minutes already helps a lot with afternoon classes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 說話的人覺得，對學生來說什麼比較重要？
prompt.simplified: 说话的人觉得，对学生来说什么比较重要？
prompt.pinyin: Shuōhuà de rén juéde, duì xuéshēng lái shuō shénme bǐjiào zhòngyào?
prompt.english: What does the speaker think matters more for students?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Getting enough sleep.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ yídìng yào shuì yì xiǎoshí
choices.english: Always sleeping an hour at noon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Studying more at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Never nodding off in class.

questions.why: 對學生來說，睡得夠比念到半夜更重要: for students, enough sleep comes first. Studying late is what he argues against, the nap needs only twenty minutes, not an hour, and nodding off is the result of too little sleep, not the point.

focus.en: for …; as far as … is concerned

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 學校為什麼讓學生中午去睡覺？
prompt.simplified: 学校为什么让学生中午去睡觉？
prompt.pinyin: Xuéxiào wèishénme ràng xuéshēng zhōngwǔ qù shuìjiào?
prompt.english: Why does the school let students sleep at noon?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓學生晚上能多念一點書
choices.simplified: 让学生晚上能多念一点书
choices.pinyin: Ràng xuéshēng wǎnshàng néng duō niàn yìdiǎn shū
choices.english: So students can study more at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓學生睡一個小時再上課
choices.simplified: 让学生睡一个小时再上课
choices.pinyin: Ràng xuéshēng shuì yí ge xiǎoshí zài shàngkè
choices.english: So students sleep an hour before class.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓學生下午上課有精神
choices.simplified: 让学生下午上课有精神
choices.pinyin: Ràng xuéshēng xiàwǔ shàngkè yǒu jīngshén
choices.english: So students have energy in afternoon classes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓學生中午安靜地念書
choices.simplified: 让学生中午安静地念书
choices.pinyin: Ràng xuéshēng zhōngwǔ ānjìng de niànshū
choices.english: So students study quietly at noon.

questions.why: The nap is there 為了改善這個情況 (no energy, nodding off in class), and 睡二十分鐘，對下午上課就很有幫助. Studying late at night is what he argues against, twelve to one is when the room is open, not how long to sleep, and 請安靜 is a rule for the nap room, not a study plan.

title.english: Healthy meals at the student cafeteria

text.traditional:
為了讓同學三餐吃得更健康，十二月起每天中午、晚上都有健康餐！
每份有：飯、一種肉、兩種青菜、一碗湯

passage.traditional: 我妹妹從小就愛吃漢堡、薯條，渴了就喝可樂。她的{1}越來越重，連牛仔褲都穿不下了。上個月她去看病，醫生說她吃得太油、太鹹，要她{2}飲食習慣，多吃青菜和水果，也要多運動。一開始她很不習慣，可是兩個星期以後，她不但習慣了，而且上課{3}好多了，不再老是想睡覺。現在她照醫生的{4}，每天去操場走半個小時。她說，要是早一點開始，她{5}就不會這麼胖了。
passage.simplified: 我妹妹从小就爱吃汉堡、薯条，渴了就喝可乐。她的{1}越来越重，连牛仔裤都穿不下了。上个月她去看病，医生说她吃得太油、太咸，要她{2}饮食习惯，多吃青菜和水果，也要多运动。一开始她很不习惯，可是两个星期以后，她不但习惯了，而且上课{3}好多了，不再老是想睡觉。现在她照医生的{4}，每天去操场走半个小时。她说，要是早一点开始，她{5}就不会这么胖了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei cóngxiǎo jiù ài chī hànbǎo, shǔtiáo, kě le jiù hē kělè. Tā de tǐzhòng yuè lái yuè zhòng, lián niúzǎikù dōu chuān bú xià le. Shàng ge yuè tā qù kànbìng, yīshēng shuō tā chī de tài yóu, tài xián, yào tā gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn, duō chī qīngcài hàn shuǐguǒ, yě yào duō yùndòng. Yì kāishǐ tā hěn bù xíguàn, kěshì liǎng ge xīngqí yǐhòu, tā búdàn xíguàn le, érqiě shàngkè jīngshén hǎo duō le, bú zài lǎoshì xiǎng shuìjiào. Xiànzài tā zhào yīshēng de jiànyì, měi tiān qù cāochǎng zǒu bàn ge xiǎoshí. Tā shuō, yàoshì zǎo yìdiǎn kāishǐ, tā huòxǔ jiù bú huì zhème pàng le.
passage.english: Since she was little my younger sister has loved hamburgers and fries, and when she's thirsty she drinks cola. Her weight kept going up, until she couldn't even get into her jeans. Last month she saw a doctor, who said she ate food that was too oily and too salty and told her to change her eating habits, eat more green vegetables and fruit, and exercise more as well. At first she found it hard to get used to, but after two weeks she had not only got used to it, she also had much more energy in class and no longer kept wanting to sleep. Now, following the doctor's advice, she walks on the sports field for half an hour every day. She says that if she had started earlier, maybe she wouldn't have got so heavy.

choices.english: illness
homework
work
body weight

questions.why: An illness, homework or work can all get 越來越重, but the next clause decides: she can no longer get into last year's jeans, so it is her weight, 體重.

choices.english: to understand
to change
to continue
to go back to

questions.why: She eats too oily and too salty, and the doctor wants more vegetables and exercise, so her eating habits must change: 改變飲食習慣. 繼續 would keep the habits the doctor criticises, 恢復 would go back to old ones, and only understanding them would not change what she eats.

choices.english: mood
grades
energy
physical strength

questions.why: What gets better in class is explained by the next clause, 不再老是想睡覺: she is more awake, so her 精神 is better. A better mood or better grades could also come in class, but neither is about no longer wanting to sleep, and 體力 is strength for running, not staying awake in class.

choices.english: advice
habit
experience
training

questions.why: Earlier the doctor told her to exercise more, so the daily walk is her following his advice: 照醫生的建議. The doctor's own habit, experience or training are not what he gave her.

choices.english: on earth
maybe
always
often

questions.why: With 要是早一點開始 she imagines what might have been, so she guesses: 或許就不會這麼胖了. 到底 belongs in a question, and 老是 and 經常 describe something that keeps happening, not one possible result.

passage.traditional: 我的室友{1}開夜車，早上起不來，常常{2}吃早餐就去上課了，上課也常打瞌睡。有一次體育課跑操場，她跑到一半就跑不動了。後來她決定{3}這個情況，每天十二點以前就睡，早上先吃完早餐再出門。現在她不但上課{4}不打瞌睡了，而且跑步也跑得比以前快。以前她{5}感冒，這個學期一次都沒生病。
passage.simplified: 我的室友{1}开夜车，早上起不来，常常{2}吃早餐就去上课了，上课也常打瞌睡。有一次体育课跑操场，她跑到一半就跑不动了。后来她决定{3}这个情况，每天十二点以前就睡，早上先吃完早餐再出门。现在她不但上课{4}不打瞌睡了，而且跑步也跑得比以前快。以前她{5}感冒，这个学期一次都没生病。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu lǎoshì kāiyèchē, zǎoshàng qǐ bù lái, chángcháng láibùjí chī zǎocān jiù qù shàngkè le, shàngkè yě cháng dǎ kēshuì. Yǒu yí cì tǐyù kè pǎo cāochǎng, tā pǎo dào yíbàn jiù pǎo bú dòng le. Hòulái tā juédìng gǎishàn zhège qíngkuàng, měi tiān shí'èr diǎn yǐqián jiù shuì, zǎoshàng xiān chī wán zǎocān zài chūmén. Xiànzài tā búdàn shàngkè zàiyě bù dǎ kēshuì le, érqiě pǎobù yě pǎo de bǐ yǐqián kuài. Yǐqián tā jīngcháng gǎnmào, zhège xuéqí yí cì dōu méi shēngbìng.
passage.english: My roommate was always staying up late. She couldn't get up in the morning and often went to class without time for breakfast, and she often nodded off in class too. Once, running laps in PE, she couldn't run any more halfway through. After that she decided to improve the situation: she goes to bed before twelve every night and eats breakfast before going out in the morning. Now she not only never nods off in class any more, she also runs faster than before. She used to catch colds often, and this semester she hasn't been ill once.

choices.english: seldom
just
always
already

questions.why: 常常 and the habits she changes later show a habit the writer dislikes: 老是開夜車. 剛 would be one late night, not a habit; 很少 cannot be followed by 早上起不來 and 上課也常打瞌睡; and 已經 would only say she has started, not that it keeps happening.

choices.english: not have time to
have time to
don't have to
have no choice but to

questions.why: She cannot get up, so there is no time for breakfast before class: 來不及吃早餐就去上課了. 來得及 says the opposite, and 不必 and 只好 make skipping breakfast a choice instead of a result of getting up late.

choices.english: to recover
to improve
to continue
to suggest

questions.why: She goes to bed earlier and eats breakfast: she is making the situation better, 改善這個情況. 繼續 would mean keeping the old habits, which is the opposite of what she does next; 恢復 and 建議 do not take 這個情況.

choices.english: (not) ever again
all along
still
originally

questions.why: Before, she often nodded off in class (上課也常打瞌睡); after changing her habits it has stopped for good: 再也不打瞌睡了. 一直 and 本來 would say she never dozed, which the start of the passage contradicts, and 還是 would mean nothing changed.

choices.english: maybe
just
often
almost

questions.why: 以前 against 這個學期一次都沒生病 contrasts how often she was ill: 以前她經常感冒. 或許 makes a guess the writer, her roommate, has no need for, 剛 would be one cold, and 差一點 would mean she nearly caught a cold but did not, which is no contrast with never being ill.

text.traditional: 上個學期的一堂體育課，我們在操場跑三千公尺。跑到一半，一位男同學忽然倒在地上，叫他也不回答。體育老師馬上叫了救護車，把他送到醫院。後來我們才知道，他前一天開夜車，沒怎麼睡，早上又來不及吃早餐。醫生說，很多人以為運動越累越有用，其實沒睡夠、沒吃東西的時候，跑得越久越危險。還好救護車來得快，他休息了幾天就好了。這件事以後，學校請醫生來給大家上了一堂課，教我們看到有人倒下的時候應該怎麼做。我覺得那是一堂能救命的課，因為下次倒下的人，可能就在我們旁邊。
text.simplified: 上个学期的一堂体育课，我们在操场跑三千公尺。跑到一半，一位男同学忽然倒在地上，叫他也不回答。体育老师马上叫了救护车，把他送到医院。后来我们才知道，他前一天开夜车，没怎么睡，早上又来不及吃早餐。医生说，很多人以为运动越累越有用，其实没睡够、没吃东西的时候，跑得越久越危险。还好救护车来得快，他休息了几天就好了。这件事以后，学校请医生来给大家上了一堂课，教我们看到有人倒下的时候应该怎么做。我觉得那是一堂能救命的课，因为下次倒下的人，可能就在我们旁边。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge xuéqí de yì táng tǐyù kè, wǒmen zài cāochǎng pǎo sānqiān gōngchǐ. Pǎo dào yíbàn, yí wèi nán tóngxué hūrán dǎo zài dìshàng, jiào tā yě bù huídá. Tǐyù lǎoshī mǎshàng jiào le jiùhùchē, bǎ tā sòng dào yīyuàn. Hòulái wǒmen cái zhīdào, tā qián yì tiān kāiyèchē, méi zěnme shuì, zǎoshàng yòu láibùjí chī zǎocān. Yīshēng shuō, hěn duō rén yǐwéi yùndòng yuè lèi yuè yǒuyòng, qíshí méi shuì gòu, méi chī dōngxi de shíhòu, pǎo de yuè jiǔ yuè wéixiǎn. Háihǎo jiùhùchē lái de kuài, tā xiūxí le jǐ tiān jiù hǎo le. Zhè jiàn shì yǐhòu, xuéxiào qǐng yīshēng lái gěi dàjiā shàng le yì táng kè, jiāo wǒmen kàn dào yǒu rén dǎo xià de shíhòu yīnggāi zěnme zuò. Wǒ juéde nà shì yì táng néng jiùmìng de kè, yīnwèi xià cì dǎo xià de rén, kěnéng jiù zài wǒmen pángbiān.
text.english: In a PE class last semester we were running 3,000 metres on the sports field. Halfway through, a male classmate suddenly fell to the ground and didn't answer when we called him. The PE teacher called an ambulance at once and it took him to hospital. Later we learned that he had stayed up the night before, hardly slept, and had no time for breakfast that morning. The doctor said many people think the more tiring exercise is, the more good it does, but when you haven't slept enough or eaten, the longer you run, the more dangerous it is. Luckily the ambulance came quickly, and after a few days' rest he was fine. After this, the school asked a doctor to give everyone a class on what to do when someone collapses. I think it was a class that can save lives, because the next person to collapse may be right next to us.

choices.pinyin: Nà táng kè yǐhòu tóngxué bù kāiyèchē le
choices.english: Classmates stopped staying up late after the class.

choices.traditional: 上課的醫生救過很多人
choices.simplified: 上课的医生救过很多人
choices.pinyin: Shàngkè de yīshēng jiù guo hěn duō rén
choices.english: The doctor who taught has saved many people.

choices.traditional: 以後可能用得到課上學的方法
choices.simplified: 以后可能用得到课上学的方法
choices.pinyin: Yǐhòu kěnéng yòng de dào kè shàng xué de fāngfǎ
