questions.why: The writer gives the reason with 因為: the next person to collapse could be right beside them, so what the class taught may be needed. The ambulance saved the classmate before the class existed, nothing is said about the doctor's past, and the passage never says anyone stopped staying up.

text.traditional: 我的同事小高今年三十歲。去年他的體重有九十公斤，他想在三個月裡減掉十公斤。他一天三餐只吃一餐，餓了就吃幾塊餅乾。一個月以後，他真的瘦了四公斤，可是經常頭痛，上班也沒有精神。後來他去健身房找了一位教練。教練說，不吃飯雖然能瘦，可是好處很少，壞處很多，而且很容易又胖回來。他要小高改一改飲食習慣：三餐都得吃，早餐更要吃得像國王一樣好，只是少吃炸的東西，多吃青菜，再加上一個星期三次訓練。剛開始小高覺得累死了，可是越做越輕鬆，現在跑半個小時也不覺得累。半年過去了，他瘦了八公斤，人看起來也年輕多了。
text.simplified: 我的同事小高今年三十岁。去年他的体重有九十公斤，他想在三个月里减掉十公斤。他一天三餐只吃一餐，饿了就吃几块饼干。一个月以后，他真的瘦了四公斤，可是经常头痛，上班也没有精神。后来他去健身房找了一位教练。教练说，不吃饭虽然能瘦，可是好处很少，坏处很多，而且很容易又胖回来。他要小高改一改饮食习惯：三餐都得吃，早餐更要吃得像国王一样好，只是少吃炸的东西，多吃青菜，再加上一个星期三次训练。刚开始小高觉得累死了，可是越做越轻松，现在跑半个小时也不觉得累。半年过去了，他瘦了八公斤，人看起来也年轻多了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngshì Xiǎo Gāo jīnnián sānshí suì. Qùnián tā de tǐzhòng yǒu jiǔshí gōngjīn, tā xiǎng zài sān ge yuè lǐ jiǎn diào shí gōngjīn. Tā yì tiān sāncān zhǐ chī yì cān, è le jiù chī jǐ kuài bǐnggān. Yí ge yuè yǐhòu, tā zhēn de shòu le sì gōngjīn, kěshì jīngcháng tóutòng, shàngbān yě méiyǒu jīngshén. Hòulái tā qù jiànshēnfáng zhǎo le yí wèi jiàoliàn. Jiàoliàn shuō, bù chīfàn suīrán néng shòu, kěshì hǎochù hěn shǎo, huàichù hěn duō, érqiě hěn róngyì yòu pàng huílái. Tā yào Xiǎo Gāo gǎi yì gǎi yǐnshí xíguàn: Sāncān dōu děi chī, zǎocān gèng yào chī de xiàng guówáng yíyàng hǎo, zhǐshì shǎo chī zhá de dōngxi, duō chī qīngcài, zài jiā shàng yí ge xīngqí sān cì xùnliàn. Gāng kāishǐ Xiǎo Gāo juéde lèi sǐ le, kěshì yuè zuò yuè qīngsōng, xiànzài pǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí yě bù juéde lèi. Bàn nián guòqù le, tā shòu le bā gōngjīn, rén kàn qǐlái yě niánqīng duō le.
text.english: My coworker Xiao Gao is thirty. Last year he weighed ninety kilos and wanted to lose ten in three months. He ate only one of his three meals a day and had a few cookies when he was hungry. After a month he really had lost four kilos, but he often had headaches and no energy at work. Then he went to a gym and found a coach. The coach said not eating may make you thinner, but it has few benefits and many drawbacks, and the weight easily comes back. He told Xiao Gao to change his eating habits: eat all three meals, breakfast above all like a king, only less fried food and more green vegetables, and to add training three times a week. At first Xiao Gao found it exhausting, but the more he did, the easier it got, and now he can run for half an hour without feeling tired. Half a year on, he has lost eight kilos and looks much younger too.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人最想說的是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人最想说的是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén zuì xiǎng shuō de shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the writer most want to say?

choices.traditional: 少吃一點比多運動更容易瘦
choices.simplified: 少吃一点比多运动更容易瘦
choices.pinyin: Shǎo chī yìdiǎn bǐ duō yùndòng gèng róngyì shòu
choices.english: Eating less makes you thinner faster than exercising more.

choices.pinyin: Zhǐyào duō yùndòng jiù néng shòu
choices.english: Exercising more is all it takes to get thin.

choices.pinyin: Jiǎnzhòng de shíhòu bié chī bǐnggān
choices.english: Don't eat cookies while losing weight.

choices.traditional: 吃得對再加上訓練最好
choices.simplified: 吃得对再加上训练最好
choices.pinyin: Chī de duì zài jiā shàng xùnliàn zuì hǎo
choices.english: Eating right plus training works best.

questions.why: The story moves from his own plan (one meal, headaches, no energy) to the coach's (three proper meals plus training), which is easier as it goes, takes off eight kilos and makes him look younger. Eating less is the plan that failed, and the coach never puts food above exercise; the coach never says exercise alone does it (he also changes the meals), and cookies are one detail of the first plan, not the point.

prompt.traditional: 教練覺得一天只吃一餐來減重怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 教练觉得一天只吃一餐来减重怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Jiàoliàn juéde yì tiān zhǐ chī yì cān lái jiǎnzhòng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the coach think of losing weight by eating one meal a day?

choices.traditional: 只要加上訓練就沒問題
choices.simplified: 只要加上训练就没问题
choices.pinyin: Zhǐyào jiā shàng xùnliàn jiù méi wèntí
choices.english: It is fine as long as you add training.

choices.traditional: 對身體不好，也很容易再變胖
choices.simplified: 对身体不好，也很容易再变胖
choices.pinyin: Duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, yě hěn róngyì zài biàn pàng
choices.english: It is bad for him, and the weight easily comes back.

choices.traditional: 瘦得太慢，還得再少吃一點
choices.simplified: 瘦得太慢，还得再少吃一点
choices.pinyin: Shòu de tài màn, hái děi zài shǎo chī yìdiǎn
choices.english: It is too slow; he must eat even less.

choices.traditional: 早餐吃得好，只吃一餐也可以
choices.simplified: 早餐吃得好，只吃一餐也可以
choices.pinyin: Zǎocān chī de hǎo, zhǐ chī yì cān yě kěyǐ
choices.english: One meal is fine if breakfast is good.

questions.why: 不吃飯雖然能瘦，可是好處很少，壞處很多，而且很容易又胖回來: the coach thinks skipping meals does him harm and the weight comes back. Training is something he adds to three meals, not a fix for one meal; he never says it is too slow; and a good breakfast is one of the three meals he wants, not a reason to drop the others.

text.traditional: 上個月我跟三個同學趁著春假去國家公園爬山。我們早上六點就從民宿出發，太陽出來以後越來越熱，大家都把外套脫下來，拿在手上。爬到一半，一個同學的腿忽然痛得走不動，我們只好在路邊休息了一個小時。後來大家怕回去的時候天黑了會迷路，決定不爬了，慢慢走下山。回到民宿，老闆已經替我們準備好熱湯，還說明天可以帶我們去附近的森林走走。雖然這次沒爬到最上面，可是大家都覺得很值得，打算明年春假再來一次。
text.simplified: 上个月我跟三个同学趁着春假去国家公园爬山。我们早上六点就从民宿出发，太阳出来以后越来越热，大家都把外套脱下来，拿在手上。爬到一半，一个同学的腿忽然痛得走不动，我们只好在路边休息了一个小时。后来大家怕回去的时候天黑了会迷路，决定不爬了，慢慢走下山。回到民宿，老板已经替我们准备好热汤，还说明天可以带我们去附近的森林走走。虽然这次没爬到最上面，可是大家都觉得很值得，打算明年春假再来一次。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ gēn sān ge tóngxué chèn zhe chūnjià qù guójiā gōngyuán páshān. Wǒmen zǎoshàng liù diǎn jiù cóng mínsù chūfā, tàiyáng chūlái yǐhòu yuè lái yuè rè, dàjiā dōu bǎ wàitào tuō xiàlái, ná zài shǒu shàng. Pá dào yíbàn, yí ge tóngxué de tuǐ hūrán tòng de zǒu bú dòng, wǒmen zhǐhǎo zài lùbiān xiūxí le yí ge xiǎoshí. Hòulái dàjiā pà huíqù de shíhòu tiān hēi le huì mílù, juédìng bù pá le, mànmàn zǒu xià shān. Huí dào mínsù, lǎobǎn yǐjīng tì wǒmen zhǔnbèi hǎo rè tāng, hái shuō míngtiān kěyǐ dài wǒmen qù fùjìn de sēnlín zǒuzou. Suīrán zhè cì méi pá dào zuì shàngmiàn, kěshì dàjiā dōu juéde hěn zhíde, dǎsuàn míngnián chūnjià zài lái yí cì.
text.english: Last month three classmates and I used the spring break to go hiking in a national park. We set off from our B&B at six in the morning; once the sun was up it got hotter and hotter, and we all took off our jackets and carried them. Halfway up, one classmate's leg suddenly hurt so much he couldn't walk, so we had to rest by the path for an hour. Then, afraid we would get lost if it was dark on the way back, we decided to stop climbing and walked slowly down. Back at the B&B, the owner already had hot soup ready for us and said he could take us for a walk in the nearby forest the next day. Although we didn't reach the top this time, we all felt it was worth it, and we plan to come again next spring break.

prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼選那個時候去爬山？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么选那个时候去爬山？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme xuǎn nàge shíhòu qù páshān?
prompt.english: Why did they choose that time to go hiking?

choices.english: School was on holiday then.
The weather wasn't hot then.

choices.pinyin: Mínsù lǎobǎn yào dài tāmen qù
choices.english: The B&B owner was going to take them.

choices.pinyin: Tóngxué de tuǐ yǐjīng hǎo le
choices.english: Their classmate's leg had got better.

questions.why: 趁著春假: they made use of the spring break, when there were no classes. It got hotter and hotter that day, the owner's offer was for the forest the next day, and the classmate's leg only started hurting on the way up.

prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼沒有爬到最上面？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么没有爬到最上面？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme méiyǒu pá dào zuì shàngmiàn?
prompt.english: Why didn't they reach the top?

choices.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè, dàjiā dōu lèi le
choices.english: It was too hot and everyone was tired.

choices.pinyin: Tāmen zài shān shàng mílù le
choices.english: They got lost on the mountain.

choices.pinyin: Yǒu rén tuǐ tòng, yòu pà tiān hēi
choices.english: Someone's leg hurt, and they feared the dark.

choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bú ràng tāmen pá shàngqù
choices.english: The owner didn't let them climb up.

questions.why: Two things together: a classmate's leg hurt too much to walk, and after the long rest they feared getting lost in the dark (怕……天黑了會迷路). They never actually got lost, the heat only made them take off their jackets, and the owner appears only after they are back.

prompt.traditional: 這篇文章最想說的是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这篇文章最想说的是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè piān wénzhāng zuì xiǎng shuō de shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does this passage most want to say?

choices.pinyin: Méi pá dào zuì shàngmiàn tài kěxí
choices.english: Not reaching the top was a real shame.

choices.pinyin: Tiān hēi yǐqián yídìng yào xià shān
choices.english: Always come down before dark.

choices.pinyin: Méi pá wán, háishì hěn zhíde
choices.english: They didn't finish, but it was still worth it.

choices.pinyin: Tuǐ tòng dehuà zuì hǎo bié páshān
choices.english: If your legs hurt, better not hike.

questions.why: The story ends on 雖然這次沒爬到最上面，可是大家都覺得很值得, and they want to come back next year. 雖然 sets the disappointment aside, so 太可惜了 is the wrong half; nothing bad is said about the B&B, and the forest walk has not happened yet.

text.traditional: 期末考快到了，我的室友為了準備考試，每天在圖書館念到很晚才回來，連週末都不休息。上個星期她要交三份報告，忙得連飯都沒時間吃。星期四早上的口試，她因為太緊張，說錯了好幾個字，也沒辦法把自己的意思表達清楚。回家以後她很難過，一直說不是因為緊張，是自己不夠用功。我告訴她，努力很重要，可是休息也一樣重要。那天晚上我帶她去夜市吃了一碗牛肉麵，又逛了一個小時。第二天她睡到九點才起床，精神好多了，下午的筆試也考得很順利。
text.simplified: 期末考快到了，我的室友为了准备考试，每天在图书馆念到很晚才回来，连周末都不休息。上个星期她要交三份报告，忙得连饭都没时间吃。星期四早上的口试，她因为太紧张，说错了好几个字，也没办法把自己的意思表达清楚。回家以后她很难过，一直说不是因为紧张，是自己不够用功。我告诉她，努力很重要，可是休息也一样重要。那天晚上我带她去夜市吃了一碗牛肉面，又逛了一个小时。第二天她睡到九点才起床，精神好多了，下午的笔试也考得很顺利。
text.pinyin: Qímòkǎo kuài dào le, wǒ de shìyǒu wèile zhǔnbèi kǎoshì, měi tiān zài túshūguǎn niàn dào hěn wǎn cái huílái, lián zhōumò dōu bù xiūxí. Shàng ge xīngqí tā yào jiāo sān fèn bàogào, máng de lián fàn dōu méi shíjiān chī. Xīngqísì zǎoshàng de kǒushì, tā yīnwèi tài jǐnzhāng, shuō cuò le hǎo jǐ ge zì, yě méi bànfǎ bǎ zìjǐ de yìsi biǎodá qīngchǔ. Huíjiā yǐhòu tā hěn nánguò, yìzhí shuō bú shì yīnwèi jǐnzhāng, shì zìjǐ bú gòu yònggōng. Wǒ gàosù tā, nǔlì hěn zhòngyào, kěshì xiūxí yě yíyàng zhòngyào. Nà tiān wǎnshàng wǒ dài tā qù yèshì chī le yì wǎn niúròu miàn, yòu guàng le yí ge xiǎoshí. Dì èr tiān tā shuì dào jiǔ diǎn cái qǐchuáng, jīngshén hǎo duō le, xiàwǔ de bǐshì yě kǎo de hěn shùnlì.
text.english: Finals are coming. To prepare, my roommate studies at the library until late every day and doesn't rest even at weekends. Last week she had three reports to hand in and was so busy she had no time even to eat. In Thursday morning's oral exam she was so nervous that she said several words wrong and couldn't express herself clearly. Back home she was very upset and kept saying it wasn't nerves, it was that she hadn't studied hard enough. I told her that hard work matters, but rest matters just as much. That evening I took her to the night market for a bowl of beef noodles and we strolled for an hour. The next day she slept until nine, had much more energy, and the written exam that afternoon went smoothly.

prompt.traditional: 室友準備考試的時候怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 室友准备考试的时候怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Shìyǒu zhǔnbèi kǎoshì de shíhòu zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is the roommate like while preparing for exams?

choices.pinyin: Měi tiān wǎnshàng qù guàng yèshì
choices.english: She goes to the night market every evening.
She studies at weekends too.

choices.pinyin: Měi tiān hěn zǎo jiù shuì le
choices.english: She goes to bed early every day.
She prepared only for the oral exam.

questions.why: 連週末都不休息: not even weekends are free, so she studies then too. The night market was one evening the writer took her, she comes back late from the library, and she had reports and a written exam as well.

prompt.traditional: 室友自己覺得，口試考不好是因為什麼？
prompt.simplified: 室友自己觉得，口试考不好是因为什么？
prompt.pinyin: Shìyǒu zìjǐ juéde, kǒushì kǎo bù hǎo shì yīnwèi shénme?
prompt.english: What does the roommate herself think made her oral exam go badly?

choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī de wèntí tài nán le
choices.english: The teacher's questions were too hard.

choices.pinyin: Tā niànshū niàn de bú gòu duō
choices.english: She hadn't studied enough.
She was too nervous at the time.

choices.pinyin: Tā qián yì tiān méi shuì hǎo jiào
choices.english: She hadn't slept well the night before.

questions.why: Back home she 一直說不是因為緊張，是自己不夠用功: she blames herself for not studying enough. Nerves are the reason the passage gives, and she herself says it was not that; the questions are never called hard, and nothing is said about her sleep before the oral exam.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人覺得怎麼樣才對？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人觉得怎么样才对？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén juéde zěnmeyàng cái duì?
prompt.english: What does the writer think is right?

choices.english: Rest matters more than hard work.

choices.pinyin: Kǎo bù hǎo jiù yào gèng yònggōng
choices.english: After a bad exam you must work harder.

choices.pinyin: Zhōumò yě yào liú xiàlái niànshū
choices.english: You should stay and study at weekends too.

choices.pinyin: Niànshū lèi le yě yào xiūxí
choices.english: Even while studying you need rest.

questions.why: 努力很重要，可是休息也一樣重要: rest matters as much as hard work, and the good written exam after a night's rest shows it. 一樣重要 is not 更重要, so rest does not come first; working harder after a bad exam and studying at weekends are the roommate's ways, which the writer answers.

picture.alt: A sunny club fair on a university campus: tents in blue, orange, green and red, students walking between them, trees and brick buildings behind. Two young men with backpacks stand in front. On the left, under a blue tent, an acoustic guitar stands on a black stand next to a table with a red cloth; nobody is holding it. A young man with black hair, a green jacket over a red striped T-shirt and black trousers stands near it with his hands in his pockets, leaning forward and looking right, at the next table. On the right, at a table with a blue cloth, a young man with wavy brown shoulder-length hair, a yellow sweater vest over a purple shirt, dark green trousers and a white backpack holds a calligraphy brush up in his right hand and looks down at a sheet of white paper held by a wooden weight, his left hand resting on the table; a pot of brushes and an ink stone stand on the table. Far behind him on the right, people in black clothes do kung fu on a red carpet.

picture.alt: A bright children's room with big windows, green plants, shelves of books and toys and a picture of a yellow flower on the wall. A young man with black hair, a green jacket over a red striped T-shirt sits at a table between two small boys, smiling, and holds out a blue crayon to the boy on the right, who reaches for it. The boy on the left has curly brown hair and an orange T-shirt and draws with a red crayon on a picture with a yellow sun and green trees. The boy on the right has short black hair and a dark blue T-shirt, holds a green crayon in his other hand and has drawn a house, trees and a sun. A box of crayons and a cup of crayons stand on the table. Nobody is reading. In the back, a woman with reddish-brown hair and a green apron works at a table.

text.traditional:
時間：11月4日到12月23日，每個星期六早上9點到12點
地點：學校旁邊的醫院
工作：陪病人掛號、檢查，幫病人處理住院、出院等事情，或是到病房關心、照顧病人。
注意：第一次參加的社員，只能陪病人掛號跟檢查；服務過三次的社員，才能去病房。想參加的社員，請在10月27日以前寫電子郵件給社團。
text.simplified:
时间：11月4日到12月23日，每个星期六早上9点到12点
地点：学校旁边的医院
工作：陪病人挂号、检查，帮病人处理住院、出院等事情，或是到病房关心、照顾病人。
注意：第一次参加的社员，只能陪病人挂号跟检查；服务过三次的社员，才能去病房。想参加的社员，请在10月27日以前写电子邮件给社团。
text.pinyin:
Shíjiān: 11 yuè 4 rì dào 12 yuè 23 rì, měi ge xīngqíliù zǎoshàng 9 diǎn dào 12 diǎn
Dìdiǎn: Xuéxiào pángbiān de yīyuàn
Gōngzuò: Péi bìngrén guàhào, jiǎnchá, bāng bìngrén chǔlǐ zhùyuàn, chūyuàn děng shìqíng, huòshì dào bìngfáng guānxīn, zhàogù bìngrén.
Zhùyì: Dì yī cì cānjiā de shèyuán, zhǐ néng péi bìngrén guàhào gēn jiǎnchá; fúwù guo sān cì de shèyuán, cái néng qù bìngfáng. Xiǎng cānjiā de shèyuán, qǐng zài 10 yuè 27 rì yǐqián xiě diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi shètuán.
text.english:
Time: November 4 to December 23, every Saturday, 9 a.m. to 12 noon
Place: the hospital next to the school
Work: going with patients to register and for check-ups, helping them with admission, discharge and so on, or visiting and caring for patients on the wards.
Note: members coming for the first time may only go with patients to register and for check-ups; members who have served three times may go to the wards. Members who want to take part, please email the club before October 27.

passage.traditional: 我從小就想學鋼琴，所以開學第一天，我{1}去參加了鋼琴社。社團的教室不大，門旁邊{2}著一架鋼琴，大家一進門就看得見。社員都得用{3}一架練習，一天只能用半個小時。老師說我的{4}還不夠好，要多練習以前學過、現在快忘了的歌。所以我每天先把那些歌{5}一遍，再學新的。雖然時間不長，一個學期後，我的進步不小。
passage.simplified: 我从小就想学钢琴，所以开学第一天，我{1}去参加了钢琴社。社团的教室不大，门旁边{2}着一架钢琴，大家一进门就看得见。社员都得用{3}一架练习，一天只能用半个小时。老师说我的{4}还不够好，要多练习以前学过、现在快忘了的歌。所以我每天先把那些歌{5}一遍，再学新的。虽然时间不长，一个学期后，我的进步不小。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng xué gāngqín, suǒyǐ kāixué dì yī tiān, wǒ lìkè qù cānjiā le gāngqín shè. Shètuán de jiàoshì bú dà, mén pángbiān bǎi zhe yí jià gāngqín, dàjiā yí jìn mén jiù kàn de jiàn. Shèyuán dōu děi yòng tóng yí jià liànxí, yì tiān zhǐ néng yòng bàn ge xiǎoshí. Lǎoshī shuō wǒ de jìqiǎo hái bú gòu hǎo, yào duō liànxí yǐqián xué guo, xiànzài kuài wàng le de gē. Suǒyǐ wǒ měi tiān xiān bǎ nàxiē gē fùxí yí biàn, zài xué xīn de. Suīrán shíjiān bù cháng, yí ge xuéqí hòu, wǒ de jìnbù bù xiǎo.
passage.english: I’ve wanted to learn piano since I was little, so I joined the piano club on the first day of term. The club room is small. A piano is set out by the door, where everyone can see it as soon as they come in. The members share it, so we can only play for half an hour each day. The teacher said my technique needed work and told me to play more of the songs I used to know but am starting to forget. So each day I go over those songs first, then practise new ones. Even with so little time, I made quite a bit of progress after a term.

choices.english: each other
originally
right away
often

questions.why: Wanting it since childhood, on the very first day of term she went at once: 立刻. 互相 needs two people doing it to each other, 本來 needs a later change of plan, and 經常 does not fit one first day.

choices.english: to set out
to put away
to stand
to hang

questions.why: Everyone sees the piano as they come in and members play it daily, so it stands set out by the door: 擺著. 收著 means put away out of sight; 站著 is for people standing, not for things; a piano is not hung.

choices.english: every
each
which
same

questions.why: There is only one piano in the room, so everyone shares it: 同一架鋼琴, and that is why each person gets only half an hour. 每一架 and 各 would mean many pianos.

choices.english: meaning
skill
gains
future

questions.why: What is "not good enough yet" and fixed by daily practice is her playing skill: 技巧. Gains (收穫), meaning (意義) and the future (未來) are not what a teacher corrects before practice.

choices.english: to choose
to check
to review
to perform

questions.why: The teacher tells the writer to go back over songs they are starting to forget. 表演 could fit the blank itself, but the aim is to remember the songs.

passage.traditional: 我妹妹從小就很害羞，上大學以後，她參加了功夫社，希望能學會{1}自己。教室的門後面{2}著幾件功夫衣服，大家練習以前才拿下來穿。教我妹妹的女同學住二樓，妹妹住三樓，兩個人住在同一{3}宿舍，妹妹走樓梯就能去找她。有一次練習的時候，社員做了好幾遍都做不好，女同學一次就做好了，妹妹覺得她很{4}。練習了一個學期，妹妹變得{5}多了，連晚上一個人回宿舍都不怕了。
passage.simplified: 我妹妹从小就很害羞，上大学以后，她参加了功夫社，希望能学会{1}自己。教室的门后面{2}着几件功夫衣服，大家练习以前才拿下来穿。教我妹妹的女同学住二楼，妹妹住三楼，两个人住在同一{3}宿舍，妹妹走楼梯就能去找她。有一次练习的时候，社员做了好几遍都做不好，女同学一次就做好了，妹妹觉得她很{4}。练习了一个学期，妹妹变得{5}多了，连晚上一个人回宿舍都不怕了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei cóngxiǎo jiù hěn hàixiū, shàng dàxué yǐhòu, tā cānjiā le gōngfu shè, xīwàng néng xué huì bǎohù zìjǐ. Jiàoshì de mén hòumiàn guà zhe jǐ jiàn gōngfu yīfu, dàjiā liànxí yǐqián cái ná xiàlái chuān. Jiāo wǒ mèimei de nǚ tóngxué zhù èr lóu, mèimei zhù sān lóu, liǎng ge rén zhù zài tóng yí dòng sùshè, mèimei zǒu lóutī jiù néng qù zhǎo tā. Yǒu yí cì liànxí de shíhòu, shèyuán zuò le hǎo jǐ biàn dōu zuò bù hǎo, nǚ tóngxué yí cì jiù zuò hǎo le, mèimei juéde tā hěn lìhài. Liànxí le yí ge xuéqí, mèimei biàn de yǒnggǎn duō le, lián wǎnshàng yí ge rén huí sùshè dōu bú pà le.
passage.english: My younger sister has been shy since childhood. When she started university, she joined the kung fu club to learn to protect herself. In the practice room, some kung fu clothes hang on the back of the door; everyone takes them down to wear before practice. The female student who teaches my sister lives on the second floor and my sister lives on the third. They live in the same dorm building and can find one another by taking the stairs. Once at practice, the members tried a move several times and still couldn’t get it, but she got it right the first time. My sister was impressed. After a term of practice she got much braver. She isn’t even afraid of going back to her dorm alone at night.

choices.english: to check
to handle
to choose
to protect

questions.why: A shy girl takes up kung fu, and at the end she is not afraid to walk alone at night: she wanted to learn to protect herself, 保護自己. Checking, handling or choosing yourself is not what kung fu teaches.

choices.english: to stick up
to hang up
to put
to draw

questions.why: Clothes on the back of a door that are taken down to wear are hanging there: 掛著. Clothes are not stuck up (貼) or drawn (畫), and nothing can be put (放) on the back of a door.

choices.english: building
room
floor
row

questions.why: They live on different floors and use the same stairs. They share the building, not a room or floor.

focus.en: same dorm, with the right measure word

choices.english: polite
attentive
impressive
gentle

questions.why: The members try a move several times and fail, while the student who teaches her gets it right at once: that shows skill, 厲害. Polite, gentle or attentive are about manner or effort, which the one-try success does not show.

focus.en: recognising skill from a person’s actions

choices.english: brave
shy
bored
polite

questions.why: Not afraid to walk home alone at night shows she has become braver: 勇敢多了. She WAS shy before, so 害羞多了 turns the story round, and 無聊 and 客氣 say nothing about fear.

text.traditional: 我念高中的時候，父母極重視我的成績，常說只要成績好，就會有美好的未來。所以上大學以前，我除了念書，什麼活動都沒參加過。大一的時候，室友帶我去參加吉他社。一開始我學得很慢，也不好意思問別人，後來發現社員都會互相幫忙，學得快的會教學得慢的。期末的時候，我們在校園裡表演，前面坐滿了同學。從這次表演中，我發現自己成長了不少：我變得比以前勇敢，不只會念書，也能把別的事做好。我覺得這是上大學以後最大的收穫。
text.simplified: 我念高中的时候，父母极重视我的成绩，常说只要成绩好，就会有美好的未来。所以上大学以前，我除了念书，什么活动都没参加过。大一的时候，室友带我去参加吉他社。一开始我学得很慢，也不好意思问别人，后来发现社员都会互相帮忙，学得快的会教学得慢的。期末的时候，我们在校园里表演，前面坐满了同学。从这次表演中，我发现自己成长了不少：我变得比以前勇敢，不只会念书，也能把别的事做好。我觉得这是上大学以后最大的收获。
text.pinyin: Wǒ niàn gāozhōng de shíhòu, fùmǔ jí zhòngshì wǒ de chéngjī, cháng shuō zhǐyào chéngjī hǎo, jiù huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái. Suǒyǐ shàng dàxué yǐqián, wǒ chúle niànshū, shénme huódòng dōu méi cānjiā guo. Dà yī de shíhòu, shìyǒu dài wǒ qù cānjiā jítā shè. Yì kāishǐ wǒ xué de hěn màn, yě bù hǎoyìsi wèn biérén, hòulái fāxiàn shèyuán dōu huì hùxiāng bāngmáng, xué de kuài de huì jiāo xué de màn de. Qímò de shíhòu, wǒmen zài xiàoyuán lǐ biǎoyǎn, qiánmiàn zuò mǎn le tóngxué. Cóng zhè cì biǎoyǎn zhōng, wǒ fāxiàn zìjǐ chéngzhǎng le bù shǎo: wǒ biàn de bǐ yǐqián yǒnggǎn, bù zhǐ huì niànshū, yě néng bǎ bié de shì zuò hǎo. Wǒ juéde zhè shì shàng dàxué yǐhòu zuì dà de shōuhuò.
text.english: When I was in high school, my parents put enormous weight on my grades and often said that as long as my grades were good, I would have a wonderful future. So before university I took part in no activities at all, only studying. In my first year, my roommate took me to join the guitar club. At first I learnt slowly and was too shy to ask anyone, but then I found that the members all help one another: those who learn fast teach those who learn slowly. At the end of term we performed on campus, with classmates filling the seats in front. From this performance I found that I had grown a lot: I am braver than before, and I can do more than study: I can do other things well too. I think this is the biggest thing I have gained since starting university.

text.traditional: 小文是我在愛心服務社認識的朋友。他從小在育幼院長大，那時候常有大學生來陪孩子念書、畫畫。他說，跟大哥哥、大姐姐一起念書、畫畫的時間很美好，也讓他知道有人關心他。現在他自己上了大學，每個月都會回育幼院兩次，教孩子做功課，也教他們互相幫忙。我知道小文也極重視成績，所以問他，花這麼多時間服務，不會影響成績嗎？他說：「成績當然重要，可是我從服務中發現，這些孩子很像小時候的我。能陪他們一起成長，對我來說，是最大的收穫，也比什麼都有意義。」
text.simplified: 小文是我在爱心服务社认识的朋友。他从小在育幼院长大，那时候常有大学生来陪孩子念书、画画。他说，跟大哥哥、大姐姐一起念书、画画的时间很美好，也让他知道有人关心他。现在他自己上了大学，每个月都会回育幼院两次，教孩子做功课，也教他们互相帮忙。我知道小文也极重视成绩，所以问他，花这么多时间服务，不会影响成绩吗？他说：「成绩当然重要，可是我从服务中发现，这些孩子很像小时候的我。能陪他们一起成长，对我来说，是最大的收获，也比什么都有意义。」
text.pinyin: Xiǎowén shì wǒ zài àixīn fúwù shè rènshì de péngyǒu. Tā cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, nà shíhòu cháng yǒu dàxuéshēng lái péi háizi niànshū, huàhuà. Tā shuō, gēn dà gēge, dà jiějie yìqǐ niànshū, huàhuà de shíjiān hěn měihǎo, yě ràng tā zhīdào yǒu rén guānxīn tā. Xiànzài tā zìjǐ shàng le dàxué, měi ge yuè dōu huì huí yùyòuyuàn liǎng cì, jiāo háizi zuò gōngkè, yě jiāo tāmen hùxiāng bāngmáng. Wǒ zhīdào Xiǎowén yě jí zhòngshì chéngjī, suǒyǐ wèn tā, huā zhème duō shíjiān fúwù, bú huì yǐngxiǎng chéngjī ma? Tā shuō: "Chéngjī dāngrán zhòngyào, kěshì wǒ cóng fúwù zhōng fāxiàn, zhèxiē háizi hěn xiàng xiǎoshíhou de wǒ. Néng péi tāmen yìqǐ chéngzhǎng, duì wǒ lái shuō, shì zuì dà de shōuhuò, yě bǐ shénme dōu yǒu yìyì."
text.english: Xiaowen is a friend I met in the volunteer service club. He grew up in a children's home, and back then university students often came to help the children study and draw. He says the days he spent reading and drawing with those older students were wonderful and showed him that someone cared about him. Now he is at university himself, and twice a month he goes back to the children's home to help the children with homework and to teach them to help one another. I know Xiaowen also cares a great deal about grades, so I asked him whether spending so much time on service would not hurt his grades. He said: "Grades matter, of course, but volunteering has shown me how much these children are like I was at their age. Being able to grow up alongside them is the biggest thing I gain, and it means more to me than anything."

text.traditional: 上個月我從宿舍搬出來，在學校附近租了一間公寓。房租每個月七千塊，包括水費，可是電費得自己付。房東就住在樓下，人很好，還替我裝了一台新的洗衣機，說有什麼問題，隨時可以找他。這個社區很安全，門口二十四小時都有人，不認識的人得先說要找誰，才能進去。搬家那天下大雨，還好室友開車來幫我，要不然我一個人得搬好幾次。現在我對住的地方很滿意，只要有空，就請朋友來家裡吃飯。
text.simplified: 上个月我从宿舍搬出来，在学校附近租了一间公寓。房租每个月七千块，包括水费，可是电费得自己付。房东就住在楼下，人很好，还替我装了一台新的洗衣机，说有什么问题，随时可以找他。这个社区很安全，门口二十四小时都有人，不认识的人得先说要找谁，才能进去。搬家那天下大雨，还好室友开车来帮我，要不然我一个人得搬好几次。现在我对住的地方很满意，只要有空，就请朋友来家里吃饭。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ cóng sùshè bān chūlái, zài xuéxiào fùjìn zū le yì jiān gōngyù. Fángzū měi ge yuè qīqiān kuài, bāokuò shuǐfèi, kěshì diànfèi děi zìjǐ fù. Fángdōng jiù zhù zài lóuxià, rén hěn hǎo, hái tì wǒ zhuāng le yì tái xīn de xǐyījī, shuō yǒu shénme wèntí, suíshí kěyǐ zhǎo tā. Zhège shèqū hěn ānquán, ménkǒu èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu yǒu rén, bú rènshì de rén děi xiān shuō yào zhǎo shéi, cái néng jìnqù. Bānjiā nà tiān xià dà yǔ, háihǎo shìyǒu kāichē lái bāng wǒ, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén děi bān hǎo jǐ cì. Xiànzài wǒ duì zhù de dìfāng hěn mǎnyì, zhǐyào yǒu kòng, jiù qǐng péngyǒu lái jiā lǐ chīfàn.
text.english: Last month I moved out of the dorm and rented a flat near school. The rent is seven thousand a month, water included, but I pay the electricity myself. The landlord lives just downstairs and is very kind; he even had a new washing machine put in for me, and said I could come to him any time with a problem. The neighbourhood is very safe: there is someone at the entrance twenty-four hours a day, and unfamiliar visitors must first say who they are visiting before they can go in. It poured on moving day; luckily my roommate drove over to help, otherwise I would have had to make several trips on my own. Now I am very happy living here, and whenever I am free I invite friends over for a meal.

text.traditional: 我爸爸去年因為身體不好，住院了兩個星期。出院以後，醫生建議他改善飲食，少油少鹽，也別再喝可樂了。醫生說，不改的話，很快又得回醫院。爸爸從小就愛吃炸的東西，一開始覺得青菜一點味道都沒有，難吃死了。後來，我們每天吃完晚飯就陪他去公園散步，他越走越遠，體重也減了五公斤。現在爸爸不但精神好多了，而且常說：「對我這個年紀的人來說，身體健康比什麼都重要。」
text.simplified: 我爸爸去年因为身体不好，住院了两个星期。出院以后，医生建议他改善饮食，少油少盐，也别再喝可乐了。医生说，不改的话，很快又得回医院。爸爸从小就爱吃炸的东西，一开始觉得青菜一点味道都没有，难吃死了。后来，我们每天吃完晚饭就陪他去公园散步，他越走越远，体重也减了五公斤。现在爸爸不但精神好多了，而且常说：「对我这个年纪的人来说，身体健康比什么都重要。」
text.pinyin: Wǒ bàba qùnián yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo, zhùyuàn le liǎng ge xīngqí. Chūyuàn yǐhòu, yīshēng jiànyì tā gǎishàn yǐnshí, shǎo yóu shǎo yán, yě bié zài hē kělè le. Yīshēng shuō, bù gǎi de huà, hěn kuài yòu děi huí yīyuàn. Bàba cóngxiǎo jiù ài chī zhá de dōngxi, yì kāishǐ juéde qīngcài yìdiǎn wèidào dōu méiyǒu, nánchī sǐ le. Hòulái, wǒmen měi tiān chī wán wǎnfàn jiù péi tā qù gōngyuán sànbù, tā yuè zǒu yuè yuǎn, tǐzhòng yě jiǎn le wǔ gōngjīn. Xiànzài bàba búdàn jīngshén hǎo duō le, érqiě cháng shuō: "Duì wǒ zhège niánjì de rén lái shuō, shēntǐ jiànkāng bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào."
text.english: Last year my father was in hospital for two weeks because of poor health. After he came out, the doctor advised him to improve his diet: less oil, less salt, and no more cola. The doctor said that if he did not change, he would soon be back in hospital. Dad has loved fried food since he was little, and at first he found vegetables had no taste at all and were awful. Later we took him for a walk in the park every day after dinner; he walked further and further, and lost five kilos too. Now Dad not only has much more energy, he often says: "For someone my age, good health matters more than anything."

picture.alt: A sunny day outside a school building, under green trees. On a wooden bench sits a young woman with short wavy dark hair, round glasses and freckles, in a white shirt, a dark purple sweater vest and green trousers, a light backpack on one shoulder. She holds a closed yellow notebook against her chest and, smiling, turns to talk to her friend, one hand held out open. Her friend stands next to the bench: long wavy dark hair, gold hoop earrings, a short blue jacket over an orange top, a long white skirt and a black bag on her shoulder; she holds up her left wrist with a brown wristwatch and looks at the woman on the bench. In the background, two students with backpacks walk through the glass doors into the building.

choices.english: He works at an insurance company.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō tā chuān zhèyàng hǎokàn.
choices.english: The woman said he looks good like this.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā píngcháng dōu xǐhuān zhèyàng chuān.
choices.english: He usually likes to dress like this.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiàwǔ yào qù tán gōngzuò.
choices.english: He is going to talk about a job this afternoon.

questions.why: He is going to an insurance company to talk about a summer job, which is why he is dressed up (and why, 難怪, he looks nervous). He does not work there yet, she praises the shirt only after he is wearing it, and he usually wears sportswear.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 老闆，三號桌的客人要點菜了，我去吧？
lines.simplified: 老板，三号桌的客人要点菜了，我去吧？
lines.pinyin: Lǎobǎn, sān hào zhuō de kèrén yào diǎncài le, wǒ qù ba?
lines.english: Boss, the customers at table three want to order. Shall I go?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你先去洗碗，點菜讓新來的服務生來。
lines.simplified: 你先去洗碗，点菜让新来的服务生来。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù xǐ wǎn, diǎncài ràng xīn lái de fúwùshēng lái.
lines.english: You go and wash the dishes first; let the new waitress take the order.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 她今天第一天上班，對菜單還不熟呢。
lines.simplified: 她今天第一天上班，对菜单还不熟呢。
lines.pinyin: Tā jīntiān dì yī tiān shàngbān, duì càidān hái bù shú ne.
lines.english: It's her first day; she doesn't know the menu well yet.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那好吧，你去點菜，碗我自己來洗。
lines.simplified: 那好吧，你去点菜，碗我自己来洗。
lines.pinyin: Nà hǎo ba, nǐ qù diǎncài, wǎn wǒ zìjǐ lái xǐ.
lines.english: All right then, you take the order and I'll wash the dishes myself.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老闆最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 老板最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎobǎn zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the boss finally decide to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Wash the dishes herself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Take the customers' order herself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Have the new waitress take the order.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng nán de xiān qù xǐ wǎn.
choices.english: Have the man wash the dishes first.

questions.why: Her first plan was the man washing up and the new waitress taking the order, but the waitress does not know the menu well yet, so she changes it: 碗我自己來洗, she will do the dishes and he takes the order.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 爸爸，你的頭髮太長了，我來幫你剪吧！
lines.simplified: 爸爸，你的头发太长了，我来帮你剪吧！
lines.pinyin: Bàba, nǐ de tóufǎ tài cháng le, wǒ lái bāng nǐ jiǎn ba!
lines.english: Dad, your hair is too long. Let me cut it for you!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳會剪嗎？上次妳幫弟弟剪，他三天都不想出門。
lines.simplified: 你会剪吗？上次你帮弟弟剪，他三天都不想出门。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ huì jiǎn ma? Shàng cì nǐ bāng dìdi jiǎn, tā sān tiān dōu bù xiǎng chūmén.
lines.english: Can you cut hair? Last time you cut your brother's, he didn't want to go out for three days.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那次是我第一次剪嘛！這次一定剪得比較好。
lines.simplified: 那次是我第一次剪嘛！这次一定剪得比较好。
lines.pinyin: Nà cì shì wǒ dì yī cì jiǎn ma! Zhè cì yídìng jiǎn de bǐjiào hǎo.
lines.english: That was my first time! This time it'll definitely be better.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 說真的，下星期我要開一個很正式的會，還是去外面剪個頭髮吧。
lines.simplified: 说真的，下星期我要开一个很正式的会，还是去外面剪个头发吧。
lines.pinyin: Shuōzhēnde, xià xīngqí wǒ yào kāi yí ge hěn zhèngshì de huì, háishì qù wàimiàn jiǎn ge tóufǎ ba.
lines.english: Honestly, next week I have a very formal meeting. I'd better go and get a haircut.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 爸爸打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 爸爸打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Bàba dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does Dad plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng nǚ'ér bāng tā jiǎn tóufǎ.
choices.english: Let his daughter cut his hair.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng érzi bāng tā jiǎn tóufǎ.
choices.english: Let his son cut his hair.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng biérén bāng tā jiǎn tóufǎ.
choices.english: Have someone else cut his hair.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kāi wán huì yǐhòu zài jiǎn.
choices.english: Cut it after the meeting.

questions.why: His daughter offers (我來幫你剪), but with a formal meeting next week he would rather go out and have it cut: someone else will do it. The son is the one she cut last time, and he wants it done before the meeting, not after.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳最近怎麼老是頭痛？要不要去看病？
lines.simplified: 你最近怎么老是头痛？要不要去看病？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zěnme lǎoshì tóutòng? Yào bú yào qù kànbìng?
lines.english: Why do you keep getting headaches lately? Do you want to see a doctor?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 看過了。醫生說我太少運動，多運動對頭痛有幫助。
lines.simplified: 看过了。医生说我太少运动，多运动对头痛有帮助。
lines.pinyin: Kàn guo le. Yīshēng shuō wǒ tài shǎo yùndòng, duō yùndòng duì tóutòng yǒu bāngzhù.
lines.english: I've been. The doctor says I exercise too little, and more exercise helps with headaches.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那跟我去健身房吧！
lines.simplified: 那跟我去健身房吧！
lines.pinyin: Nà gēn wǒ qù jiànshēnfáng ba!
lines.english: Then come to the gym with me!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 健身房一個月要兩千塊，我每天早上去操場慢跑就好。
lines.simplified: 健身房一个月要两千块，我每天早上去操场慢跑就好。
lines.pinyin: Jiànshēnfáng yí ge yuè yào liǎngqiān kuài, wǒ měi tiān zǎoshàng qù cāochǎng mànpǎo jiù hǎo.
lines.english: The gym costs two thousand a month. I'll just jog on the sports field every morning.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼不跟男的去健身房？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么不跟男的去健身房？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme bù gēn nán de qù jiànshēnfáng?
prompt.english: Why won't the woman go to the gym with the man?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The doctor won't let her go.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She has no time in the morning.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde tài huā qián le.
choices.english: She thinks it costs too much.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She still has to see a doctor.

questions.why: She answers the invitation with the price, two thousand a month, and says jogging on the field will do: the gym costs too much for her. The doctor wants her to exercise more, she plans to jog in the mornings, and she has already seen the doctor (看過了).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這首歌真好聽！你聽得出來是誰唱的嗎？
lines.simplified: 这首歌真好听！你听得出来是谁唱的吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē zhēn hǎotīng! Nǐ tīng de chūlái shì shéi chàng de ma?
lines.english: This song is lovely! Can you tell who is singing?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽不出來。不過上個星期社團在校園擺攤子的時候，好像有人唱過。
lines.simplified: 听不出来。不过上个星期社团在校园摆摊子的时候，好像有人唱过。
lines.pinyin: Tīng bù chūlái. Búguò shàng ge xīngqí shètuán zài xiàoyuán bǎi tānzi de shíhòu, hǎoxiàng yǒu rén chàng guo.
lines.english: I can't tell. But last week, when the clubs set up stalls on campus, I think someone sang it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，就是我們吉他社的社員唱的，歌也是他自己寫的。
lines.simplified: 对啊，就是我们吉他社的社员唱的，歌也是他自己写的。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, jiù shì wǒmen jítā shè de shèyuán chàng de, gē yě shì tā zìjǐ xiě de.
lines.english: Right, it was a member of our guitar club, and he wrote the song himself too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從對話中，可以知道這首歌的什麼事？
prompt.simplified: 从对话中，可以知道这首歌的什么事？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng duìhuà zhōng, kěyǐ zhīdào zhè shǒu gē de shénme shì?
prompt.english: Which statement about the song is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shì yí wèi shèyuán xiě de.
choices.english: A club member wrote it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shì nán de zìjǐ xiě de.
choices.english: The man wrote it himself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shì nǚ de zài nàlǐ chàng de
choices.english: The woman sang it there.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shì shèyuán zài nàlǐ mǎi de
choices.english: A club member bought it there.

questions.why: The woman says a member of her guitar club sang the song and wrote it himself.

focus.en: to be unable to tell by listening

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳快畢業了，決定念研究所了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你快毕业了，决定念研究所了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kuài bìyè le, juédìng niàn yánjiùsuǒ le ma?
lines.english: You're graduating soon. Have you decided to go to graduate school?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還沒。研究所的學費太貴了，我想先工作兩年，存一點錢再說。
lines.simplified: 还没。研究所的学费太贵了，我想先工作两年，存一点钱再说。
lines.pinyin: Hái méi. Yánjiùsuǒ de xuéfèi tài guì le, wǒ xiǎng xiān gōngzuò liǎng nián, cún yìdiǎn qián zàishuō.
lines.english: Not yet. Graduate school fees are too high. I want to work for two years first and save some money, then see.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳想找什麼工作？
lines.simplified: 你想找什么工作？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zhǎo shénme gōngzuò?
lines.english: What kind of job do you want?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 除了保險公司，什麼工作我都想試試。我媽媽在保險公司做了二十年，常常很晚了還在打電話給客人。
lines.simplified: 除了保险公司，什么工作我都想试试。我妈妈在保险公司做了二十年，常常很晚了还在打电话给客人。
lines.pinyin: Chúle bǎoxiǎn gōngsī, shénme gōngzuò wǒ dōu xiǎng shìshì. Wǒ māma zài bǎoxiǎn gōngsī zuò le èrshí nián, chángcháng hěn wǎn le hái zài dǎ diànhuà gěi kèrén.
lines.english: I'd try any job except at an insurance company. My mom has worked at one for twenty years, and she's often still phoning clients at night.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我哥哥的廣告公司在找設計助理，妳要不要去看看？
lines.simplified: 我哥哥的广告公司在找设计助理，你要不要去看看？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēge de guǎnggào gōngsī zài zhǎo shèjì zhùlǐ, nǐ yào bú yào qù kànkàn?
lines.english: My brother's advertising company is looking for a design assistant. Do you want to take a look?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我又不會設計，那種工作我做不了。有沒有需要用外語的？
lines.simplified: 我又不会设计，那种工作我做不了。有没有需要用外语的？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yòu bú huì shèjì, nà zhǒng gōngzuò wǒ zuò bù liǎo. Yǒu méiyǒu xūyào yòng wàiyǔ de?
lines.english: But I can't design; I couldn't do that kind of job. Is there anything that needs a foreign language?

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼不想去保險公司工作？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么不想去保险公司工作？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme bù xiǎng qù bǎoxiǎn gōngsī gōngzuò?
prompt.english: Why doesn't the woman want to work at an insurance company?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiān qù niàn yánjiùsuǒ.
choices.english: She wants to go to graduate school first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā māma bú ràng tā qù.
choices.english: Her mother won't let her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: It doesn't need a foreign language.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā pà xiàbān le hái děi gōngzuò.
choices.english: She fears having to work after hours.

questions.why: She rules out insurance (除了保險公司) then explains that her mother, at an insurance company, often still phones clients at night: she does not want work that follows her home. Graduate school comes after two years of work, her mother does not forbid anything, and the foreign language is what she asks about the other job.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼不想做廣告公司的工作？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么不想做广告公司的工作？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme bù xiǎng zuò guǎnggào gōngsī de gōngzuò?
prompt.english: Why does the woman decide against the job at the advertising company?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng zhǐ dāng zhùlǐ.
choices.english: She doesn't want to be only an assistant.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She doesn't have the skills for it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nàlǐ de gōngzuò shíjiān tài cháng.
choices.english: The working hours there are too long.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nàlǐ yào yòng hěn duō wàiyǔ.
choices.english: It uses a lot of foreign languages.

questions.why: 我又不會設計，那種工作我做不了: she cannot design, so she could not do a design assistant's job. She never objects to being an assistant, the long hours were her mother's insurance job, and the foreign language is what she would like, not what the ad job needs.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個週末大家要去海邊玩兩天，妳去不去？
lines.simplified: 这个周末大家要去海边玩两天，你去不去？
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò dàjiā yào qù hǎibiān wán liǎng tiān, nǐ qù bú qù?
lines.english: This weekend everyone's going to the beach for two days. Are you coming?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我去不了。我上個月開始在貿易公司上班，最近太忙了，除了星期天，每天都得去公司。
lines.simplified: 我去不了。我上个月开始在贸易公司上班，最近太忙了，除了星期天，每天都得去公司。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qù bù liǎo. Wǒ shàng ge yuè kāishǐ zài màoyì gōngsī shàngbān, zuìjìn tài máng le, chúle xīngqítiān, měi tiān dōu děi qù gōngsī.
lines.english: I can't. I started working at a trading company last month, and it's so busy lately that I have to go in every day except Sunday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳星期天來吧！我們星期六晚上住在海邊，星期天下午才回來。
lines.simplified: 那你星期天来吧！我们星期六晚上住在海边，星期天下午才回来。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ xīngqítiān lái ba! Wǒmen xīngqíliù wǎnshàng zhù zài hǎibiān, xīngqítiān xiàwǔ cái huílái.
lines.english: Then come on Sunday! We're staying at the beach on Saturday night and won't come back until Sunday afternoon.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊！說真的，我也很想休息一下。那我星期天早上坐火車去找你們。
lines.simplified: 好啊！说真的，我也很想休息一下。那我星期天早上坐火车去找你们。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Shuōzhēnde, wǒ yě hěn xiǎng xiūxí yíxià. Nà wǒ xīngqítiān zǎoshàng zuò huǒchē qù zhǎo nǐmen.
lines.english: OK! Honestly, I'd love a rest too. I'll take the train on Sunday morning to meet you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的星期六要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的星期六要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de xīngqíliù yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will the woman do on Saturday?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go to the beach with everyone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go to work at the company.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Rest at home for a day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Take the train to meet her friends.

questions.why: 除了星期天，每天都得去公司: every day but Sunday she must go to work, so Saturday is a work day. The train to her friends is Sunday morning, and the rest she wants is the beach day, not a day at home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the woman finally decide to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go for both days with everyone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go on Saturday evening.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhè cì bú qù hǎibiān le.
choices.english: Skip the beach this time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go to the beach only on Sunday.

questions.why: At first she says 我去不了, but when he suggests Sunday she agrees and will take the train on Sunday morning: she joins for the second day only. Saturday night is when the others stay at the beach, and she cannot do both days because Saturday is a work day.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 林先生，您好！我是大明貿易公司張經理的助理。
lines.simplified: 林先生，您好！我是大明贸易公司张经理的助理。
lines.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng, nín hǎo! Wǒ shì Dàmíng Màoyì Gōngsī Zhāng jīnglǐ de zhùlǐ.
lines.english: Hello, Mr. Lin! I am the assistant to Manager Zhang at Daming Trading Company.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們收到了您的自我推薦信，經理覺得您的想法很好，想請您來公司談一談。
lines.simplified: 我们收到了您的自我推荐信，经理觉得您的想法很好，想请您来公司谈一谈。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen shōudào le nín de zìwǒ tuījiàn xìn, jīnglǐ juéde nín de xiǎngfǎ hěn hǎo, xiǎng qǐng nín lái gōngsī tán yì tán.

passage.traditional: 姐姐念完研究所以後，沒有留在都市，決定去鄉下的一所小學{1}。朋友都說鄉下{2}都市那麼方便，買東西、看電影都得開很久的車。可是姐姐很{3}，她說鄉下空氣好，下了課還可以在學校後面種種菜，再{4}，喝完一杯再回家。她也發現，那裡的孩子雖然不多，但是每個孩子都很想學。這讓她有了新的{5}。只要認真教，孩子將來一定會有更多機會。
passage.simplified: 姐姐念完研究所以后，没有留在都市，决定去乡下的一所小学{1}。朋友都说乡下{2}都市那么方便，买东西、看电影都得开很久的车。可是姐姐很{3}，她说乡下空气好，下了课还可以在学校后面种种菜，再{4}，喝完一杯再回家。她也发现，那里的孩子虽然不多，但是每个孩子都很想学。这让她有了新的{5}。只要认真教，孩子将来一定会有更多机会。
passage.pinyin: Jiějie niàn wán yánjiùsuǒ yǐhòu, méiyǒu liú zài dūshì, juédìng qù xiāngxià de yì suǒ xiǎoxué jiāoshū. Péngyǒu dōu shuō xiāngxià bú xiàng dūshì nàme fāngbiàn, mǎi dōngxi, kàn diànyǐng dōu děi kāi hěn jiǔ de chē. Kěshì jiějie hěn lèguān, tā shuō xiāngxià kōngqì hǎo, xià le kè hái kěyǐ zài xuéxiào hòumiàn zhòngzhòng cài, zài hē ge chá, hē wán yì bēi zài huí jiā. Tā yě fāxiàn, nàlǐ de háizi suīrán bù duō, dànshì měi ge háizi dōu hěn xiǎng xué. Zhè ràng tā yǒu le xīn de xiǎngfǎ. zhǐyào rènzhēn jiāo, háizi jiānglái yídìng huì yǒu gèng duō jīhuì.
passage.english: After finishing graduate school, my older sister didn't stay in the city; she decided to teach at a primary school in the countryside. Her friends all say the countryside isn't as convenient as the city: shopping or seeing a film means a long drive. But my sister is optimistic. She says the country air is good, and after class she can grow a few vegetables behind the school, then have a cup of tea before going home. She has also found that although there aren't many children there, every one of them really wants to learn. That gave her a new idea. If she teaches carefully, the children will have more chances in the future.

choices.english: to work part-time
to help out
to teach
to clean

questions.why: The final sentences show she is responsible for teaching the children and hopes to improve their chances. The other choices could describe someone at a school without identifying the work she chose.

choices.english: not as … as
not only
but
needn't

questions.why: 鄉下不像都市那麼方便: 不像 + NP + 那麼 + Vs compares the countryside with the city. 不但 needs a second clause with 而且 or 還, 不過 joins two clauses, and 不必 is followed by a verb.

您以前說過，退休以後想在家裡種很多植物。我相信您以後的生活一定會過得很開心。下個月放假的時候，我想回去看您，可以嗎？

text.pinyin:
Lǐ lǎoshī:
Nín hǎo! Wǒ shì nín shí nián qián zài gāozhōng jiāo guo de xuéshēng Xiǎofāng. Shàng ge xīngqí wǒ huí xiāngxià kàn māma, cái tīngshuō nín jīnnián liù yuè jiù yào tuìxiū le, suǒyǐ xiǎng xiě zhè fēng xìn xièxie nín.
Gāozhōng de shíhòu, wǒ de Yīngwén hěn chà, tīnglì gēn huìhuà dōu bù hǎo. Shì nín měi tiān xiàkè yǐhòu huā shíjiān jiāo wǒ, wǒ cái yuè lái yuè xǐhuān Yīngwén. Xiànzài wǒ zài Táiběi de yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī shàngbān, chángcháng yào yòng Yīngwén gēn wàiguó kèrén kāihuì. Rúguǒ méiyǒu nín, wǒ bú huì xuǎnzé zhège yào yòng wàiyǔ de zhíyè.
Nín yǐqián shuō guo, tuìxiū yǐhòu xiǎng zài jiā lǐ zhòng hěn duō zhíwù. Wǒ xiāngxìn nín yǐhòu de shēnghuó yídìng huì guò de hěn kāixīn. Xià ge yuè fàngjià de shíhòu, wǒ xiǎng huíqù kàn nín, kěyǐ ma?
Xuéshēng Xiǎofāng jìngshàng 3 yuè 2 rì
text.english:
Dear Teacher Li,
Hello! I am Xiaofang, the student you taught at high school ten years ago. Last week I went back to the countryside to see my mother, and only then heard that you will retire this June, so I wanted to write this letter to thank you.
At high school my English was poor; neither my listening nor my conversation was good. It was because you spent time teaching me after class every day that I came to like English more and more. Now I work at an insurance company in Taipei and often have meetings in English with foreign clients. Without you I would not have chosen a job that uses a foreign language.
You once said that after you retire you want to grow lots of plants at home. I believe your life from now on will be a very happy one. When I have time off next month, I would like to come back and visit you. May I?
Respectfully yours, your student Xiaofang, March 2

text.traditional: 陳先生以前在都市當保險公司的經理，管理四十多個員工。他每天開會、加班，有時夜裡還在工作。五年前，他的身體越來越差，醫生告訴他，如果還是這麼忙，身體一定會出問題。他想了很久，決定早一點退休，搬到鄉下，開了一家賣植物的小店。剛開始，他不懂怎麼照顧植物，種了很多都死了。後來他常常向附近種花的老人學習，現在不但會種，還會教客人怎麼剪花、照顧花園。他現在不像以前那麼有錢，可是他很樂觀。他說：「錢少一點沒關係，能每天做自己喜歡的事，就是最好的生活。」
text.simplified: 陈先生以前在都市当保险公司的经理，管理四十多个员工。他每天开会、加班，有时夜里还在工作。五年前，他的身体越来越差，医生告诉他，如果还是这么忙，身体一定会出问题。他想了很久，决定早一点退休，搬到乡下，开了一家卖植物的小店。刚开始，他不懂怎么照顾植物，种了很多都死了。后来他常常向附近种花的老人学习，现在不但会种，还会教客人怎么剪花、照顾花园。他现在不像以前那么有钱，可是他很乐观。他说：「钱少一点没关系，能每天做自己喜欢的事，就是最好的生活。」
text.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng yǐqián zài dūshì dāng bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ, guǎnlǐ sìshí duō ge yuángōng. Tā měi tiān kāihuì, jiābān, yǒushí yèlǐ hái zài gōngzuò. Wǔ nián qián, tā de shēntǐ yuè lái yuè chà, yīshēng gàosu tā, rúguǒ háishì zhème máng, shēntǐ yídìng huì chū wèntí. Tā xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, juédìng zǎo yìdiǎn tuìxiū, bān dào xiāngxià, kāi le yì jiā mài zhíwù de xiǎo diàn. Gāng kāishǐ, tā bù dǒng zěnme zhàogù zhíwù, zhòng le hěn duō dōu sǐ le. Hòulái tā chángcháng xiàng fùjìn zhòng huā de lǎorén xuéxí, xiànzài búdàn huì zhòng, hái huì jiāo kèrén zěnme jiǎn huā, zhàogù huāyuán. Tā xiànzài bú xiàng yǐqián nàme yǒu qián, kěshì tā hěn lèguān. Tā shuō: "Qián shǎo yìdiǎn méi guānxi, néng měi tiān zuò zìjǐ xǐhuān de shì, jiù shì zuì hǎo de shēnghuó."
text.english: Mr. Chen used to be a manager at an insurance company in the city, in charge of more than forty employees. Every day he had meetings and worked overtime, sometimes still dealing with work at night. Five years ago his health kept getting worse, and his doctor told him that if he stayed this busy his body would certainly break down. After thinking about it for a long time, he decided to retire early, moved to the countryside and opened a small shop selling plants. At first he did not know how to look after plants, and many that he planted died. Later he often learned from the old people nearby who grow flowers; now he not only grows them well but also teaches customers how to cut flowers and look after a garden. He is not as well-off as before, but he is optimistic. He says: "A bit less money doesn't matter. Being able to do what you like every day is the best life there is."

text.traditional: 上個月，我姐姐肚子痛得很厲害，我們馬上帶她去醫院。我先去掛號，醫生檢查以後，說姐姐得住院一個星期。爸爸媽媽白天都要上班，所以我每天下了課就去病房照顧她，幫她倒水、陪她聊天。同一個病房還有一位老太太，她的家人都住在國外，很少來看她，所以我也常常跟她說說話。姐姐出院那天，那位老太太送給我一張卡片，上面寫著：「謝謝你的關心。」從這件事中，我學到了：一點點的關心，對別人來說可能是很寶貴的。
text.simplified: 上个月，我姐姐肚子痛得很厉害，我们马上带她去医院。我先去挂号，医生检查以后，说姐姐得住院一个星期。爸爸妈妈白天都要上班，所以我每天下了课就去病房照顾她，帮她倒水、陪她聊天。同一个病房还有一位老太太，她的家人都住在国外，很少来看她，所以我也常常跟她说说话。姐姐出院那天，那位老太太送给我一张卡片，上面写着：「谢谢你的关心。」从这件事中，我学到了：一点点的关心，对别人来说可能是很宝贵的。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ jiějie dùzi tòng de hěn lìhài, wǒmen mǎshàng dài tā qù yīyuàn. Wǒ xiān qù guàhào, yīshēng jiǎnchá yǐhòu, shuō jiějie děi zhùyuàn yí ge xīngqí. Bàba māma báitiān dōu yào shàngbān, suǒyǐ wǒ měi tiān xià le kè jiù qù bìngfáng zhàogù tā, bāng tā dào shuǐ, péi tā liáotiān. Tóng yí ge bìngfáng hái yǒu yí wèi lǎo tàitai, tā de jiārén dōu zhù zài guówài, hěn shǎo lái kàn tā, suǒyǐ wǒ yě chángcháng gēn tā shuōshuō huà. Jiějie chūyuàn nà tiān, nà wèi lǎo tàitai sòng gěi wǒ yì zhāng kǎpiàn, shàngmiàn xiě zhe: "Xièxie nǐ de guānxīn." Cóng zhè jiàn shì zhōng, wǒ xué dào le: yìdiǎndiǎn de guānxīn, duì biérén lái shuō kěnéng shì hěn bǎoguì de.
text.english: Last month my older sister had a terrible stomachache, and we took her to the hospital at once. First I registered her; after the doctor examined her, he said my sister had to stay in hospital for a week. My parents both work during the day, so every day after class I went to the ward to look after her, pouring her water and chatting with her. In the same ward there was an old lady whose family all live abroad and seldom visit her, so I often talked with her too. The day my sister left hospital, the old lady gave me a card that said: "Thank you for caring." From this I learned that a little care can be very precious to someone else.

text.traditional: 期末考前一個星期，我的室友每天都開夜車，念書念到半夜三點才睡。我建議他早一點睡覺，他說：「書還沒看完，我能睡嗎？」考試那天，他精神很差，筆試的時候一直頭痛。每一題他都會，可是寫得很慢，最後有兩題來不及寫。口試在下午，考試以前，他先回宿舍睡午覺，睡了一個小時，所以口試的時候精神好多了，成績也不錯。考完以後，他說以後要早一點開始準備，不再開夜車了，因為睡不夠對考試的影響真的太大了。
text.simplified: 期末考前一个星期，我的室友每天都开夜车，念书念到半夜三点才睡。我建议他早一点睡觉，他说：「书还没看完，我能睡吗？」考试那天，他精神很差，笔试的时候一直头痛。每一题他都会，可是写得很慢，最后有两题来不及写。口试在下午，考试以前，他先回宿舍睡午觉，睡了一个小时，所以口试的时候精神好多了，成绩也不错。考完以后，他说以后要早一点开始准备，不再开夜车了，因为睡不够对考试的影响真的太大了。
text.pinyin: Qímòkǎo qián yí ge xīngqí, wǒ de shìyǒu měi tiān dōu kāi yèchē, niànshū niàn dào bànyè sān diǎn cái shuì. Wǒ jiànyì tā zǎo yìdiǎn shuìjiào, tā shuō: "Shū hái méi kàn wán, wǒ néng shuì ma?" Kǎoshì nà tiān, tā jīngshén hěn chà, bǐshì de shíhòu yìzhí tóutòng. Měi yì tí tā dōu huì, kěshì xiě de hěn màn, zuìhòu yǒu liǎng tí láibùjí xiě. Kǒushì zài xiàwǔ, kǎoshì yǐqián, tā xiān huí sùshè shuì wǔjiào, shuì le yí ge xiǎoshí, suǒyǐ kǒushì de shíhòu jīngshén hǎo duō le, chéngjī yě búcuò. Kǎo wán yǐhòu, tā shuō yǐhòu yào zǎo yìdiǎn kāishǐ zhǔnbèi, bú zài kāi yèchē le, yīnwèi shuì bú gòu duì kǎoshì de yǐngxiǎng zhēnde tài dà le.
text.english: In the week before finals my roommate stayed up every night, studying until three in the morning before he slept. I suggested he go to bed earlier, and he said: "I haven't finished the books yet; how can I sleep?" On the day of the exam he had no energy and had a headache all through the written exam. He knew all the questions but wrote slowly, and in the end there were two he had no time to write. The oral exam was in the afternoon; before it he went back to the dorm for a nap and slept an hour, so he had much more energy in the oral exam and did well. After the exams he said he would start preparing earlier from now on and stop staying up late, because not getting enough sleep really affects exams too much.

lines.simplified: 你不是说要趁打折买新手机吗？买了没？

lines.simplified: 买了。昨天是打折的最后一天，我加班到九点，差点儿就来不及了。

lines.english: I did. Yesterday was the last day of the sale. I worked overtime until nine and almost didn't make it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那家店不是九點就關門了嗎？
lines.simplified: 那家店不是九点就关门了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn bú shì jiǔ diǎn jiù guānmén le ma?

lines.simplified: 打折那几天开到十点。我九点半才到，还好买到了。
lines.pinyin: Dǎzhé nà jǐ tiān kāi dào shí diǎn. Wǒ jiǔ diǎn bàn cái dào, háihǎo mǎi dào le.
lines.english: During the sale it's open until ten. I only got there at half past nine, but luckily I got one.

prompt.english: Why does the man say he almost didn't make it?

choices.english: He worked until late.

choices.english: The shop closes at nine.

questions.why: He worked overtime until nine (加班到九點), so he reached the shop only at 9:30, just before it closed at ten. Closing at nine is what the woman thought, but during the sale the shop stayed open until ten.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 從上個月起，我姊姊就在一家貿易公司當經理的助理，每天都加班到很晚。
lines.simplified: 从上个月起，我姊姊就在一家贸易公司当经理的助理，每天都加班到很晚。
lines.pinyin: Cóng shàng ge yuè qǐ, wǒ jiějie jiù zài yì jiā màoyì gōngsī dāng jīnglǐ de zhùlǐ, měi tiān dōu jiābān dào hěn wǎn.
lines.english: Since last month my older sister has been a manager's assistant at a trading company, and she works late every day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 難怪她最近看起來那麼累。她打算繼續做嗎？
lines.simplified: 难怪她最近看起来那么累。她打算继续做吗？
lines.pinyin: Nánguài tā zuìjìn kàn qǐlái nàme lèi. Tā dǎsuàn jìxù zuò ma?
lines.english: No wonder she looks so tired lately. Does she plan to keep doing it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她說雖然很累，可是經理很專業，她能學到很多，所以不想換。
lines.simplified: 她说虽然很累，可是经理很专业，她能学到很多，所以不想换。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō suīrán hěn lèi, kěshì jīnglǐ hěn zhuānyè, tā néng xué dào hěn duō, suǒyǐ bù xiǎng huàn.
lines.english: She says it's tiring, but the manager is very professional and she can learn a lot, so she doesn't want to change.

prompt.simplified: 姊姊觉得这份工作怎么样？

choices.speaker: N

choices.simplified: 工作很累，也学不到东西
choices.pinyin: Gōngzuò hěn lèi, yě xué bu dào dōngxi.
choices.english: The work is tiring, and she can’t learn anything.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn lèi, kěshì xué de dào dōngxi.
choices.english: Tiring, but she learns from it.

questions.why: She works late, but she learns a lot from her manager. That is why she wants to stay.

lines.traditional: 妳參加了什麼社團？
lines.simplified: 你参加了什么社团？

lines.simplified: 我本来想参加吉他社，可是他们每天晚上都要练习，我没那么多时间。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng cānjiā jítā shè, kěshì tāmen měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu yào liànxí, wǒ méi nàme duō shíjiān.
lines.english: I wanted to join the guitar club, but they practise every evening and I don't have that much time.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳後來參加了哪一個？
lines.simplified: 那你后来参加了哪一个？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ hòulái cānjiā le nǎ yí ge?
lines.english: So which one did you join in the end?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 服務社。我們一個月去一次安養院，陪老人聊天。
lines.simplified: 服务社。我们一个月去一次安养院，陪老人聊天。
lines.pinyin: Fúwù shè. Wǒmen yí ge yuè qù yí cì ānyǎngyuàn, péi lǎorén liáotiān.
lines.english: The service club. Once a month we go to a nursing home and chat with the old people.

prompt.simplified: 女的为什么没参加吉他社？

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The service club is more interesting.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: The guitar club has too few people.

questions.why: She wanted the guitar club (本來想參加), but it practises every evening and she lacks the time. So she was interested; the service club is where she ended up, not a reason she gave.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 經理，客人要把資料傳真過來，可是公司的傳真機又壞了。
lines.simplified: 经理，客人要把资料传真过来，可是公司的传真机又坏了。
lines.pinyin: Jīnglǐ, kèrén yào bǎ zīliào chuánzhēn guòlái, kěshì gōngsī de chuánzhēnjī yòu huài le.
lines.english: Manager, a client wants to fax us some documents, but the office fax machine is broken again.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那台用了十幾年了。修理要多少錢？
lines.simplified: 那台用了十几年了。修理要多少钱？
lines.pinyin: Nà tái yòng le shí jǐ nián le. Xiūlǐ yào duōshǎo qián?
lines.english: That one is over ten years old. How much would a repair cost?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 店裡說大約三千塊，而且不保證修好以後能用多久。
lines.simplified: 店里说大约三千块，而且不保证修好以后能用多久。
lines.pinyin: Diàn lǐ shuō dàyuē sānqiān kuài, érqiě bù bǎozhèng xiū hǎo yǐhòu néng yòng duō jiǔ.
lines.english: The shop says about three thousand, and they can't promise how long it will last after the repair.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 現在大多數客人都用網路，那就別修了。你跟客人說，不管是什麼資料，都請他們用網路傳給你。
lines.simplified: 现在大多数客人都用网路，那就别修了。你跟客人说，不管是什么资料，都请他们用网路传给你。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài dàduōshù kèrén dōu yòng wǎnglù, nà jiù bié xiū le. Nǐ gēn kèrén shuō, bùguǎn shì shénme zīliào, dōu qǐng tāmen yòng wǎnglù chuán gěi nǐ.
lines.english: Most clients use the internet now, so don't repair it. Tell clients that whatever the documents are, they should send them to you online.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好。可是有一位老先生只會用傳真，他怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 好。可是有一位老先生只会用传真，他怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo. Kěshì yǒu yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng zhǐ huì yòng chuánzhēn, tā zěnme bàn?
lines.english: OK. But there's an elderly gentleman who only knows how to fax. What about him?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那就請他把資料寄過來吧。
lines.simplified: 那就请他把资料寄过来吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù qǐng tā bǎ zīliào jì guòlái ba.
lines.english: Then ask him to mail them to us.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 經理希望大多數客人怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 经理希望大多数客人怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Jīnglǐ xīwàng dàduōshù kèrén zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the manager want most customers to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Call first, then fax the documents.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Wait for the fax machine to be fixed before sending them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Send the documents online.

choices.speaker: N

focus.en: all types of documents and most customers

choices.pinyin: Tā de zīliào tài duō, bù néng yòng wǎnglù chuán.
choices.english: He has too many documents to send online.

choices.simplified: 他的传真机坏了，还没有修好

choices.english: He can’t use the internet, and the company can’t receive a fax.

questions.why: The customer only knows how to fax, and it is the company’s machine that is broken. Mailing the documents works for both sides.

intro.speaker: N

intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那支新手機下個月就開始賣了，我好想買。
lines.simplified: 那支新手机下个月就开始卖了，我好想买。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhī xīn shǒujī xià ge yuè jiù kāishǐ mài le, wǒ hǎo xiǎng mǎi.
lines.english: That new phone goes on sale next month. I really want to buy it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳的手機才用了一年，跟新的比起來，差別大嗎？
lines.simplified: 你的手机才用了一年，跟新的比起来，差别大吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de shǒujī cái yòng le yì nián, gēn xīn de bǐ qǐlái, chābié dà ma?
lines.english: You've only had your phone for a year. Compared with the new one, is the difference big?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 差別不大，只是新的電池用得比較久，手機也輕一點。
lines.simplified: 差别不大，只是新的电池用得比较久，手机也轻一点。
lines.pinyin: Chābié bú dà, zhǐ shì xīn de diànchí yòng de bǐjiào jiǔ, shǒujī yě qīng yìdiǎn.
lines.english: Not big. It's just that the new one's battery lasts longer, and it's a bit lighter.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳上個月不是說自己窮死了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你上个月不是说自己穷死了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge yuè bú shì shuō zìjǐ qióng sǐ le ma?
lines.english: Didn't you say last month that you were totally broke?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，所以我答應自己，不管它多好用，都要等打折再買。
lines.simplified: 对啊，所以我答应自己，不管它多好用，都要等打折再买。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, suǒyǐ wǒ dāyìng zìjǐ, bùguǎn tā duō hǎoyòng, dōu yào děng dǎzhé zài mǎi.
lines.english: Right, so I promised myself that no matter how handy it is, I'll wait for a discount before buying it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 新手機很少剛開始賣就打折，妳恐怕得等很久。
lines.simplified: 新手机很少刚开始卖就打折，你恐怕得等很久。
lines.pinyin: Xīn shǒujī hěn shǎo gāng kāishǐ mài jiù dǎzhé, nǐ kǒngpà děi děng hěn jiǔ.
lines.english: New phones are seldom discounted as soon as they go on sale. I'm afraid you'll have to wait a long time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的打算什麼時候買新手機？
prompt.simplified: 女的打算什么时候买新手机？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de dǎsuàn shénme shíhòu mǎi xīn shǒujī?
prompt.english: When does the woman plan to buy the new phone?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè yì kāishǐ mài jiù mǎi.
choices.english: As soon as it goes on sale next month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng jiàgé piányí yìdiǎn zài mǎi.
choices.english: When the price comes down a bit.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 等現在的手機壞了再買
choices.simplified: 等现在的手机坏了再买
choices.pinyin: Děng xiànzài de shǒujī huài le zài mǎi.
choices.english: When her current phone breaks.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Cún gòu le língyòngqián jiù mǎi.
choices.english: Once she has saved enough allowance.

questions.why: 不管它多好用，都要等打折再買: however handy it is, she will wait for a discount, that is, until the price is lower. Buying it the moment it goes on sale was her wish at the start, before he reminded her she was broke.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼打算先用現在的手機？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么打算先用现在的手机？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme dǎsuàn xiān yòng xiànzài de shǒujī?
prompt.english: Why does the woman plan to keep using her current phone for now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 兩支差不多，她又想省錢
choices.simplified: 两支差不多，她又想省钱
choices.pinyin: Liǎng zhī chàbuduō, tā yòu xiǎng shěng qián.
choices.english: The two are similar, and she wants to save money.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 新的比較重，她常帶出門
choices.simplified: 新的比较重，她常带出门
choices.pinyin: Xīn de bǐjiào zhòng, tā cháng dài chūmén.
choices.english: The new one is heavier, and she often takes her phone out.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 舊的電池好，她不用常換
choices.simplified: 旧的电池好，她不用常换
choices.pinyin: Jiù de diànchí hǎo, tā bú yòng cháng huàn.
choices.english: The old phone’s battery is good, so she seldom needs to replace it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 新的不好用，她還想再看看
choices.simplified: 新的不好用，她还想再看看
choices.pinyin: Xīn de bù hǎoyòng, tā hái xiǎng zài kànkan.
choices.english: The new one is hard to use, so she wants to keep looking.

questions.why: The new phone is lighter and its battery lasts longer, but she sees little difference overall. She is short on money and plans to wait for a sale.
