intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 李小姐您好，這裡是光華電腦修理中心。昨天您來拿筆電，可是我們還沒修好，讓您白跑了一次，真不好意思。
lines.simplified: 李小姐您好，这里是光华电脑修理中心。昨天您来拿笔电，可是我们还没修好，让您白跑了一次，真不好意思。
lines.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě nín hǎo, zhèlǐ shì Guānghuá diànnǎo xiūlǐ zhōngxīn. Zuótiān nín lái ná bǐdiàn, kěshì wǒmen hái méi xiū hǎo, ràng nín bái pǎo le yí cì, zhēn bù hǎoyìsi.
lines.english: Hello Ms Li, this is the Guanghua Computer Repair Center. You came for your laptop yesterday, but we hadn't finished repairing it, so you made the trip for nothing. We're very sorry.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 電池很正常，是筆電裡面有個零件壞了，得從日本訂，下星期三才會送到。
lines.simplified: 电池很正常，是笔电里面有个零件坏了，得从日本订，下星期三才会送到。
lines.pinyin: Diànchí hěn zhèngcháng, shì bǐdiàn lǐmiàn yǒu ge língjiàn huài le, děi cóng Rìběn dìng, xià xīngqísān cái huì sòng dào.
lines.english: The battery is working normally. A part inside the laptop broke. We have to order it from Japan, and it won’t arrive until next Wednesday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這台筆電買了超過一年，現在修理要付錢，大約四千五百塊。如果您同意，請回個電話，下星期五下午就能來拿了。
lines.simplified: 这台笔电买了超过一年，现在修理要付钱，大约四千五百块。如果您同意，请回个电话，下星期五下午就能来拿了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè tái bǐdiàn mǎi le chāoguò yì nián, xiànzài xiūlǐ yào fù qián, dàyuē sì qiān wǔ bǎi kuài. Rúguǒ nín tóngyì, qǐng huí ge diànhuà, xià xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ jiù néng lái ná le.
lines.english: You bought this laptop more than a year ago, so there’s a charge for the repair, about 4,500 dollars. If you agree, please call us back. Then you can pick it up next Friday afternoon.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這家店為什麼還要等幾天才能修？
prompt.simplified: 这家店为什么还要等几天才能修？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn wèishénme hái yào děng jǐ tiān cái néng xiū?
prompt.english: Why does the shop need to wait several more days before it can do the repair?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào děng kèrén bǎ bǐdiàn dài lái.
choices.english: They need to wait for the customer to bring in the laptop.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 要等日本送來要換的零件
choices.simplified: 要等日本送来要换的零件
choices.pinyin: Yào děng Rìběn sòng lái yào huàn de língjiàn.
choices.english: They need to wait for the replacement part to arrive from Japan.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 要等新電池從日本送到
choices.simplified: 要等新电池从日本送到
choices.pinyin: Yào děng xīn diànchí cóng Rìběn sòng dào.
choices.english: They need to wait for a new battery from Japan.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 要等壞掉的零件送到日本
choices.simplified: 要等坏掉的零件送到日本
choices.pinyin: Yào děng huài diào de língjiàn sòng dào Rìběn.
choices.english: They need to wait for the broken part to arrive in Japan.

questions.why: Her earlier trip was for nothing because the laptop wasn’t ready. The shop is waiting for a replacement part from Japan, and her battery is fine.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 哪一個做法能讓李小姐星期五拿到筆電，又不用再白跑一次？
prompt.simplified: 哪一个做法能让李小姐星期五拿到笔电，又不用再白跑一次？
prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge zuòfǎ néng ràng Lǐ xiǎojiě xīngqíwǔ ná dào bǐdiàn, yòu bú yòng zài bái pǎo yí cì?
prompt.english: What can Ms. Li do to get her laptop on Friday without making another wasted trip?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先打電話同意付錢修理
choices.simplified: 先打电话同意付钱修理
choices.pinyin: Xiān dǎ diànhuà tóngyì fù qián xiūlǐ.
choices.english: Call first to agree to pay for the repair.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期三先到店裡拿筆電
choices.simplified: 星期三先到店里拿笔电
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān xiān dào diàn lǐ ná bǐdiàn.
choices.english: Go to the shop on Wednesday to pick up the laptop.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期五到店再決定修不修
choices.simplified: 星期五到店再决定修不修
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ dào diàn zài juédìng xiū bu xiū.
choices.english: Decide whether to get it repaired at the shop on Friday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先打電話請店裡換電池
choices.simplified: 先打电话请店里换电池
choices.pinyin: Xiān dǎ diànhuà qǐng diàn lǐ huàn diànchí.
choices.english: Call first and ask the shop to replace the battery.

questions.why: The shop has the laptop but needs her approval for the paid repair. Wednesday is when the part arrives, so waiting until Friday to approve the repair risks another wasted trip.

focus.en: a wasted trip and exceeding the warranty period

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 現在是新聞時間。最近不少人抱怨，大明公司去年出的手機用了半年，電池就很快沒電。
lines.simplified: 现在是新闻时间。最近不少人抱怨，大明公司去年出的手机用了半年，电池就很快没电。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài shì xīnwén shíjiān. Zuìjìn bù shǎo rén bàoyuàn, Dàmíng gōngsī qùnián chū de shǒujī yòng le bàn nián, diànchí jiù hěn kuài méi diàn.
lines.english: And now, today’s news. Many people have complained recently that the batteries in Daming phones released last year start running out quickly after six months.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大明公司本來認為，手機用久了，電池比較快沒電是正常的。後來抱怨的人越來越多，公司昨天決定，手機買了沒超過一年，就可以免費換一顆電池。
lines.simplified: 大明公司本来认为，手机用久了，电池比较快没电是正常的。后来抱怨的人越来越多，公司昨天决定，手机买了没超过一年，就可以免费换一颗电池。
lines.pinyin: Dàmíng gōngsī běnlái rènwéi, shǒujī yòng jiǔ le, diànchí bǐjiào kuài méi diàn shì zhèngcháng de. Hòulái bàoyuàn de rén yuè lái yuè duō, gōngsī zuótiān juédìng, shǒujī mǎi le méi chāoguò yì nián, jiù kěyǐ miǎnfèi huàn yì kē diànchí.
lines.english: Daming initially said that it was normal for a battery to run out faster as the phone aged. But complaints kept increasing. Yesterday the company decided to replace batteries for free if the phone was purchased no more than a year ago.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 公司也說明，因為電池不多，大家去換以前，最好先上網看看哪家店還有，才不會白跑。
lines.simplified: 公司也说明，因为电池不多，大家去换以前，最好先上网看看哪家店还有，才不会白跑。
lines.pinyin: Gōngsī yě shuōmíng, yīnwèi diànchí bù duō, dàjiā qù huàn yǐqián, zuìhǎo xiān shàngwǎng kànkan nǎ jiā diàn hái yǒu, cái bú huì bái pǎo.
lines.english: The company also explained that batteries are in short supply, so before going to have one put in, people had better check online which shops still have them, so as not to go for nothing.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 大明公司最後怎麼解決電池的問題？
prompt.simplified: 大明公司最后怎么解决电池的问题？
prompt.pinyin: Dàmíng gōngsī zuìhòu zěnme jiějué diànchí de wèntí?
prompt.english: How did Daming finally decide to address the battery problem?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 用了超過半年才能免費換
choices.simplified: 用了超过半年才能免费换
choices.pinyin: Yòng le chāoguò bàn nián cái néng miǎnfèi huàn.
choices.english: Only phones used for more than six months get a free replacement.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 買了不到半年才能免費換
choices.simplified: 买了不到半年才能免费换
choices.pinyin: Mǎi le bú dào bàn nián cái néng miǎnfèi huàn.
choices.english: Only phones bought less than six months ago get a free replacement.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 去年出的手機都能免費換
choices.simplified: 去年出的手机都能免费换
choices.pinyin: Qùnián chū de shǒujī dōu néng miǎnfèi huàn.
choices.english: Offer a free replacement for every phone model released last year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 這一年裡買的都能免費換
choices.simplified: 这一年里买的都能免费换
choices.pinyin: Zhè yì nián lǐ mǎi de dōu néng miǎnfèi huàn.
choices.english: Phones bought within the past year all get a free replacement.

questions.why: The company counts from the purchase date: a phone bought no more than a year ago gets a free battery. Six months is when users noticed the problem, not a condition, and a phone released last year but bought more than a year ago does not qualify.

focus.en: the one-year limit for battery replacement

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 有人八個月前買了大明手機，家附近那家店沒有電池了。他最好怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 有人八个月前买了大明手机，家附近那家店没有电池了。他最好怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Yǒurén bā ge yuè qián mǎi le Dàmíng shǒujī, jiā fùjìn nà jiā diàn méiyǒu diànchí le. Tā zuìhǎo zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: Someone bought a Daming phone eight months ago, but the store near home is out of batteries. What should he do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 等買滿一年再上網找電池
choices.simplified: 等买满一年再上网找电池
choices.pinyin: Děng mǎi mǎn yì nián zài shàngwǎng zhǎo diànchí.
choices.english: Wait until he’s owned it a full year, then look online for a battery.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先到別家店付錢換電池
choices.simplified: 先到别家店付钱换电池
choices.pinyin: Xiān dào bié jiā diàn fù qián huàn diànchí.
choices.english: Go to another store and pay to replace the battery.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 上網找有電池的店免費換
choices.simplified: 上网找有电池的店免费换
choices.pinyin: Shàngwǎng zhǎo yǒu diànchí de diàn miǎnfèi huàn.
choices.english: Find a store with batteries online and get one replaced for free.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān děng gōngsī dǎ diànhuà lái.
choices.english: Wait for the company to call first.

questions.why: He bought the phone within the past year, so the replacement is free. Since the store near him is out, he should look online for another store with batteries before going.

focus.en: avoiding a wasted trip and checking the time limit

text.traditional:
時間：星期一到星期六10:00到21:00，星期日休息
換電池：手機1,200元，平板1,800元，筆電2,500元，大約一個小時就能換好
其他問題：先免費檢查，修理以前會打電話向您說明價格
免費修理：有保證書、買了不超過一年的產品
換電池或修理後，不到三個月，原來的問題又發生，可以免費處理一次
學生打折：修理或換電池要付錢時，帶學生證打九折
text.simplified:
时间：星期一到星期六10:00到21:00，星期日休息
换电池：手机1,200元，平板1,800元，笔电2,500元，大约一个小时就能换好
其他问题：先免费检查，修理以前会打电话向您说明价格
免费修理：有保证书、买了不超过一年的产品
换电池或修理后，不到三个月，原来的问题又发生，可以免费处理一次
学生打折：修理或换电池要付钱时，带学生证打九折
text.pinyin:
Shíjiān: xīngqíyī dào xīngqíliù 10:00 dào 21:00, xīngqírì xiūxí.
Huàn diànchí: shǒujī 1,200 yuán, píngbǎn 1,800 yuán, bǐdiàn 2,500 yuán, dàyuē yí ge xiǎoshí jiù néng huàn hǎo.
Qítā wèntí: xiān miǎnfèi jiǎnchá, xiūlǐ yǐqián huì dǎ diànhuà xiàng nín shuōmíng jiàgé.
Miǎnfèi xiūlǐ: yǒu bǎozhèngshū, mǎi le bù chāoguò yì nián de chǎnpǐn.
Huàn diànchí huò xiūlǐ hòu, bú dào sān ge yuè, yuánlái de wèntí yòu fāshēng, kěyǐ miǎnfèi chǔlǐ yí cì.
Xuéshēng dǎzhé: xiūlǐ huò huàn diànchí yào fù qián shí, dài xuéshēngzhèng dǎ jiǔ zhé.
text.english:
Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. Closed Sunday.
Battery replacement: phones NT$1,200, tablets NT$1,800, laptops NT$2,500. It takes about an hour.
Other problems: free initial check. We’ll call you with a price before doing any repairs.
Free repairs: products bought no more than a year ago and accompanied by the warranty document.
If the same problem returns less than three months after a battery replacement or repair, we’ll fix it once for free.
Paid repairs or battery replacements: 10% off with student ID.

prompt.traditional: 一位大學生的平板買了兩年。他帶學生證來換電池。跟沒帶學生證的人比起來，他少付多少錢？
prompt.simplified: 一位大学生的平板买了两年。他带学生证来换电池。跟没带学生证的人比起来，他少付多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi dàxuéshēng de píngbǎn mǎi le liǎng nián. Tā dài xuéshēngzhèng lái huàn diànchí. Gēn méi dài xuéshēngzhèng de rén bǐ qǐlái, tā shǎo fù duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: A university student brings his student ID to replace the battery in his two-year-old tablet. How much less does he pay than someone without a student ID?

questions.why: The tablet is past the one-year limit, so its battery replacement costs 1,800 yuan before the discount. The student saves 180 yuan with the 10% discount.

focus.en: comparing prices and applying a discount

prompt.traditional: 一位上班族星期六晚上八點帶筆電來。他上個月在這家店換了電池，現在原來的問題又發生了。那時候店有開嗎？這次要付錢嗎？
prompt.simplified: 一位上班族星期六晚上八点带笔电来。他上个月在这家店换了电池，现在原来的问题又发生了。那时候店有开吗？这次要付钱吗？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi shàngbān zú xīngqíliù wǎnshàng bā diǎn dài bǐdiàn lái. Tā shàng ge yuè zài zhè jiā diàn huàn le diànchí, xiànzài yuánlái de wèntí yòu fāshēng le. Nà shíhòu diàn yǒu kāi ma? Zhè cì yào fù qián ma?
prompt.english: An office worker brings in his laptop at 8 p.m. on Saturday. This shop replaced his battery last month, and the original problem has returned. Is the shop open then? Will he have to pay?

choices.pinyin: Diàn yǒu kāi, zhè cì bú yòng fù qián.
choices.english: The shop is open, and this time there’s no charge.

choices.pinyin: Diàn yǒu kāi, huàn diànchí yào fù qián.
choices.english: The shop is open, but replacing the battery will cost money.

choices.pinyin: Diàn méi kāi, gǎitiān lái miǎnfèi xiū.
choices.english: The shop is closed; he can come another day for a free repair.

choices.pinyin: Diàn méi kāi, gǎitiān huàn yào fù qián.
choices.english: The shop is closed, and a replacement another day would cost money.

questions.why: The shop is open on Saturday until 21:00, so it is open at eight. The same problem came back less than three months after the replacement, so the shop handles it once for free.

focus.en: the service window and when to come in

text.traditional:
我要賣一台用了一年半的平板。功能都很正常，電池能用八個小時。跟新的比起來，除了電池能用的時間短了一點，差別不大。保證書不見了。
價格：6,000元（新的要15,000元），還送一個真皮的袋子裝平板。
我下個月要帶筆電去日本交換，這台平板只賣到這個星期五。只賣給我們學校的學生，而且不管是誰，都得先來看過再決定。
想看的人，請到女生宿舍門口找我。
text.simplified:
我要卖一台用了一年半的平板。功能都很正常，电池能用八个小时。跟新的比起来，除了电池能用的时间短了一点，差别不大。保证书不见了。
价格：6,000元（新的要15,000元），还送一个真皮的袋子装平板。
我下个月要带笔电去日本交换，这台平板只卖到这个星期五。只卖给我们学校的学生，而且不管是谁，都得先来看过再决定。
想看的人，请到女生宿舍门口找我。
text.pinyin:
Wǒ yào mài yì tái yòng le yì nián bàn de píngbǎn. Gōngnéng dōu hěn zhèngcháng, diànchí néng yòng bā ge xiǎoshí. Gēn xīn de bǐ qǐlái, chúle diànchí néng yòng de shíjiān duǎn le yìdiǎn, chābié bú dà. Bǎozhèngshū bújiàn le.
Jiàgé: 6,000 yuán (xīn de yào 15,000 yuán), hái sòng yí ge zhēnpí de dàizi zhuāng píngbǎn.
Wǒ xià ge yuè yào dài bǐdiàn qù Rìběn jiāohuàn, zhè tái píngbǎn zhǐ mài dào zhè ge xīngqíwǔ. Zhǐ mài gěi wǒmen xuéxiào de xuéshēng, érqiě bùguǎn shì shéi, dōu děi xiān lái kàn guo zài juédìng.
Xiǎng kàn de rén, qǐng dào nǚshēng sùshè ménkǒu zhǎo wǒ.
text.english:
I’m selling a tablet I’ve used for a year and a half. All its features work normally, and the battery lasts eight hours. It’s much like a new one except the battery doesn’t last quite as long. I’ve lost the warranty document.
Price: NT$6,000 (a new one costs NT$15,000). I’ll also throw in a genuine leather tablet case.
I’m taking my laptop to Japan on exchange next month. This tablet is for sale only through Friday. I’ll sell only to students at my school, and everyone needs to come see it before deciding.
If you want to see it, find me at the entrance of the women’s dorm.

prompt.traditional: 有個學生想帶平板出門，從早上八點一直用到晚上八點。買以前，他最需要想清楚什麼？
prompt.simplified: 有个学生想带平板出门，从早上八点一直用到晚上八点。买以前，他最需要想清楚什么？
prompt.pinyin: Yǒu ge xuéshēng xiǎng dài píngbǎn chūmén, cóng zǎoshàng bā diǎn yìzhí yòng dào wǎnshàng bā diǎn. Mǎi yǐqián, tā zuì xūyào xiǎng qīngchǔ shénme?
prompt.english: A student wants to take the tablet out and use it continuously from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. What does he most need to consider before buying it?

choices.traditional: 平板的功能是不是正常
choices.simplified: 平板的功能是不是正常
choices.pinyin: Píngbǎn de gōngnéng shì bu shì zhèngcháng.
choices.english: Whether the tablet’s features work normally.

choices.traditional: 有沒有袋子可以裝平板
choices.simplified: 有没有袋子可以装平板
choices.pinyin: Yǒu méiyǒu dàizi kěyǐ zhuāng píngbǎn.
choices.english: Whether there’s a case to carry the tablet in.

choices.pinyin: Diànchí néng bu néng yòng dào wǎnshàng.
choices.english: Whether the battery will last until evening.

choices.traditional: 平板到底賣不賣給學生
choices.simplified: 平板到底卖不卖给学生
choices.pinyin: Píngbǎn dàodǐ mài bu mài gěi xuéshēng.
choices.english: Whether the seller sells to students at all.

questions.why: The student needs 12 hours of use, but the tablet only runs for eight hours on its battery. The post says its features work normally and that a case comes with it.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一位有機會買到這位女生的平板？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一位有机会买到这位女生的平板？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí wèi yǒu jīhuì mǎi dào zhè wèi nǚshēng de píngbǎn?
prompt.english: Who has a chance to buy this young woman’s tablet?

choices.traditional: 附近的上班族星期四到宿舍看
choices.simplified: 附近的上班族星期四到宿舍看
choices.pinyin: Fùjìn de shàngbān zú xīngqísì dào sùshè kàn.
choices.english: An office worker from nearby who comes to the dorm to see it on Thursday.

choices.traditional: 她的同學星期六到宿舍看
choices.simplified: 她的同学星期六到宿舍看
choices.pinyin: Tā de tóngxué xīngqíliù dào sùshè kàn.

passage.traditional: 上個月我買了一支新手機，功能很多，可是電池{1}。早上帶出門，下午就沒電了。我上網{2}了一下，想知道這是不是只有我才有的問題。後來才知道，連新聞都在說這個問題。我拿去店裡問，店員說新手機都是這樣，很{3}。{4}我怎麼說明，他都不願意換。最後我把新聞拿給他看，他才{5}幫我換一支新的，說新手機明天才到，請我到時候來拿。
passage.simplified: 上个月我买了一支新手机，功能很多，可是电池{1}。早上带出门，下午就没电了。我上网{2}了一下，想知道这是不是只有我才有的问题。后来才知道，连新闻都在说这个问题。我拿去店里问，店员说新手机都是这样，很{3}。{4}我怎么说明，他都不愿意换。最后我把新闻拿给他看，他才{5}帮我换一支新的，说新手机明天才到，请我到时候来拿。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ mǎi le yì zhī xīn shǒujī, gōngnéng hěn duō, kěshì diànchí chà le yìdiǎnr. Zǎoshàng dài chūmén, xiàwǔ jiù méi diàn le. Wǒ shàngwǎng dǎtīng le yíxià, xiǎng zhīdào zhè shì bu shì zhǐ yǒu wǒ cái yǒu de wèntí. Hòulái cái zhīdào, lián xīnwén dōu zài shuō zhè ge wèntí. Wǒ ná qù diàn lǐ wèn, diànyuán shuō xīn shǒujī dōu shì zhèyàng, hěn zhèngcháng. Bùguǎn wǒ zěnme shuōmíng, tā dōu bú yuànyì huàn. Zuìhòu wǒ bǎ xīnwén ná gěi tā kàn, tā cái dāyìng bāng wǒ huàn yì zhī xīn de, shuō xīn shǒujī míngtiān cái dào, qǐng wǒ dàoshíhòu lái ná.
passage.english: I bought a new phone last month. It has lots of features, but the battery is a little disappointing. I take it out in the morning, and by afternoon it’s dead. I asked around online to see if I was the only one with this problem and found out even the news was talking about it. I took it to the shop, where the clerk said all new phones did that and it was normal. No matter how I explained, he wouldn’t replace it. Only after I showed him the news did he agree to replace it. He said the new phone would arrive tomorrow and asked me to come pick it up then.

choices.english: a bit too heavy
a bit better
a bit poor
a bit too expensive

questions.why: 可是 brings a weakness, and the next sentence shows what it is: the phone is flat by the afternoon, so the battery is a bit poor (差了一點兒). A heavy or expensive battery would not run flat, and 好 is no weakness.

choices.english: Ask around.
Explain.
Complain.
Chat.

questions.why: He goes online specifically to find out whether anyone else has the same battery problem. 打聽 means asking around to find information.

choices.english: handy
cheap
strange
normal

questions.why: 新手機都是這樣 means every new phone's battery runs flat like this, so the clerk calls it normal: 很正常. 好用 and 便宜 would praise the phone, which does not answer a complaint, and if every new phone does it, it is not strange (奇怪).

choices.english: although
no matter
as long as
because

questions.why: A question word (怎麼) followed by 都 means "however … still": 不管我怎麼說明，他都不願意換. 雖然 and 因為 need a plain statement, not 怎麼, and 只要 goes with 就.

choices.english: Didn’t want to.
Wanted.
Agreed.
Started to.

questions.why: The clerk had refused at first. After seeing the news, he tells the customer that the customer can come back for a replacement tomorrow. That is an agreement, rather than just something the clerk is considering.

passage.traditional: 爸爸做生意常用傳真機。上個月機器壞了，我陪他去光華商場。店員說修好要三千多，{1}買台新的，才四千塊，爸爸就買了。我說現在{2}公司都用手機上網傳資料，只有幾家還在用傳真。爸爸說手機上的字{3}。我把字放大，他就看清楚了。我又教他傳資料，他覺得手機很{4}，現在自己傳得比以前快。新傳真機一次也沒用過，真是{5}花錢了。
passage.simplified: 爸爸做生意常用传真机。上个月机器坏了，我陪他去光华商场。店员说修好要三千多，{1}买台新的，才四千块，爸爸就买了。我说现在{2}公司都用手机上网传资料，只有几家还在用传真。爸爸说手机上的字{3}。我把字放大，他就看清楚了。我又教他传资料，他觉得手机很{4}，现在自己传得比以前快。新传真机一次也没用过，真是{5}花钱了。
passage.pinyin: Bàba zuò shēngyì cháng yòng chuánzhēnjī. Shàng ge yuè jīqì huài le, wǒ péi tā qù Guānghuá Shāngchǎng. Diànyuán shuō xiū hǎo yào sān qiān duō, bùrú mǎi tái xīn de, cái sì qiān kuài, bàba jiù mǎi le. Wǒ shuō xiànzài dàduōshù gōngsī dōu yòng shǒujī shàngwǎng chuán zīliào, zhǐ yǒu jǐ jiā hái zài yòng chuánzhēn. Bàba shuō shǒujī shàng de zì xiǎo le yìdiǎn. Wǒ bǎ zì fàng dà, tā jiù kàn qīngchǔ le. Wǒ yòu jiāo tā chuán zīliào, tā juéde shǒujī hěn hǎoyòng, xiànzài zìjǐ chuán de bǐ yǐqián kuài. Xīn chuánzhēnjī yí cì yě méi yòng guo, zhēn shì bái huā qián le.
passage.english: Dad often used a fax machine for his business. The machine broke last month, so I went with him to Guanghua Digital Plaza. The clerk said it would cost over 3,000 to fix. Better to buy a new one, he said. It was only 4,000, so Dad bought it. I said most businesses now send documents online by phone. Only a few still use fax. Dad said the text on his phone was a little too small. I made it bigger and he could see it clearly. Then I showed him how to send documents. He found the phone handy and now sends them on his own faster than before. The new fax machine hasn’t been used once. What a waste of money.

choices.english: Already did long ago.
moreover
no wonder
it would be better to

questions.why: The clerk compares two workable choices and recommends the new machine because it costs only a little more than the repair.

choices.english: most
all
half
a small part

questions.why: The next clause says only a few old companies still use fax, so most companies send documents online: 大多數. 所有 leaves no room for those few, and if only half or a small part used the internet, far more than a few would still be faxing.

choices.english: a bit too big
a bit too small
a bit too many
a bit too few

questions.why: The father can read the text after it is made bigger. That change explains what he originally found unsatisfactory.

choices.english: Hard to use.

questions.why: After learning to use the phone, he can send documents on his own and do it faster. That shows how useful it is to him.

text.traditional: 現在的科技產品功能越來越多，大多數的人買手機、筆電的時候，都想買功能最多的那一種。我以前也這麼想，前年花了四萬塊，買了一台最新的筆電。可是用了兩年我才發現，那些功能我只用過三、四種，其他的連怎麼用都不知道。今年妹妹上大學，也想買最貴的筆電，我就把我的經驗告訴她。她認為我說得很有道理，先想清楚自己要用電腦做什麼，再去店裡請店員說明不同產品的差別。最後她買的筆電比我的便宜一半，她需要的功能都有，而且輕多了，放在背包裡帶去上課也不麻煩。我覺得，買科技產品不是功能越多越好，能解決自己的問題才最重要。
text.simplified: 现在的科技产品功能越来越多，大多数的人买手机、笔电的时候，都想买功能最多的那一种。我以前也这么想，前年花了四万块，买了一台最新的笔电。可是用了两年我才发现，那些功能我只用过三、四种，其他的连怎么用都不知道。今年妹妹上大学，也想买最贵的笔电，我就把我的经验告诉她。她认为我说得很有道理，先想清楚自己要用电脑做什么，再去店里请店员说明不同产品的差别。最后她买的笔电比我的便宜一半，她需要的功能都有，而且轻多了，放在背包里带去上课也不麻烦。我觉得，买科技产品不是功能越多越好，能解决自己的问题才最重要。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì chǎnpǐn gōngnéng yuè lái yuè duō, dàduōshù de rén mǎi shǒujī, bǐdiàn de shíhòu, dōu xiǎng mǎi gōngnéng zuì duō de nà yì zhǒng. Wǒ yǐqián yě zhème xiǎng, qiánnián huā le sìwàn kuài, mǎi le yì tái zuì xīn de bǐdiàn. Kěshì yòng le liǎng nián wǒ cái fāxiàn, nàxiē gōngnéng wǒ zhǐ yòng guo sān, sì zhǒng, qítā de lián zěnme yòng dōu bù zhīdào. Jīnnián mèimei shàng dàxué, yě xiǎng mǎi zuì guì de bǐdiàn, wǒ jiù bǎ wǒ de jīngyàn gàosu tā. Tā rènwéi wǒ shuō de hěn yǒudàolǐ, xiān xiǎng qīngchǔ zìjǐ yào yòng diànnǎo zuò shénme, zài qù diàn lǐ qǐng diànyuán shuōmíng bùtóng chǎnpǐn de chābié. Zuìhòu tā mǎi de bǐdiàn bǐ wǒ de piányí yíbàn, tā xūyào de gōngnéng dōu yǒu, érqiě qīng duō le, fàng zài bēibāo lǐ dài qù shàngkè yě bù máfán. Wǒ juéde, mǎi kējì chǎnpǐn bú shì gōngnéng yuè duō yuè hǎo, néng jiějué zìjǐ de wèntí cái zuì zhòngyào.
text.english: Today's technology products have more and more functions, and when most people buy a phone or a laptop, they want the kind with the most functions. I used to think so too: the year before last I spent forty thousand on the newest laptop. But only after two years of use did I find that I had used just three or four of those functions, and I did not even know how to use the rest. This year my younger sister started university and also wanted the most expensive laptop, so I told her about my experience. She thought I had a point: she first worked out what she would use a computer for, then went to a shop and asked the clerk to explain the differences between the models. In the end the laptop she bought cost half as much as mine, had every function she needed and was much lighter, so carrying it to class in her backpack is no trouble. I think that with technology products, more functions are not better; what matters most is that they solve your own problems.

text.traditional: 我媽媽是一個很愛惜東西的人。家裡的電視用了十五年，壞了三次，她都找人來修理，不願意買新的。我小時候覺得很奇怪，我們家又不窮，為什麼要這麼省？我上大學以後，她給我的零用錢不多，還逼我把每一筆錢花在哪裡都記下來。有一次我想買最新的手機，她說：「你的手機還很好用，跟新的比起來，差別不大，不如把錢存起來。」那時候我很不高興，覺得她不懂我的想法。去年我去日本交換一年，因為一直在存錢，我不必向家裡要錢就能夠出國，還有錢到處旅行。這時候我才懂，媽媽要我省錢，是希望我在需要的時候有錢用。
text.simplified: 我妈妈是一个很爱惜东西的人。家里的电视用了十五年，坏了三次，她都找人来修理，不愿意买新的。我小时候觉得很奇怪，我们家又不穷，为什么要这么省？我上大学以后，她给我的零用钱不多，还逼我把每一笔钱花在哪里都记下来。有一次我想买最新的手机，她说：「你的手机还很好用，跟新的比起来，差别不大，不如把钱存起来。」那时候我很不高兴，觉得她不懂我的想法。去年我去日本交换一年，因为一直在存钱，我不必向家里要钱就能够出国，还有钱到处旅行。这时候我才懂，妈妈要我省钱，是希望我在需要的时候有钱用。
text.pinyin: Wǒ māma shì yí ge hěn àixí dōngxi de rén. Jiā lǐ de diànshì yòng le shíwǔ nián, huài le sān cì, tā dōu zhǎo rén lái xiūlǐ, bú yuànyì mǎi xīn de. Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu juéde hěn qíguài, wǒmen jiā yòu bù qióng, wèishénme yào zhème shěng? Wǒ shàng dàxué yǐhòu, tā gěi wǒ de língyòngqián bù duō, hái bī wǒ bǎ měi yì bǐ qián huā zài nǎlǐ dōu jì xiàlái. Yǒu yí cì wǒ xiǎng mǎi zuì xīn de shǒujī, tā shuō: “Nǐ de shǒujī hái hěn hǎoyòng, gēn xīn de bǐ qǐlái, chābié bú dà, bùrú bǎ qián cún qǐlái.” Nà shíhòu wǒ hěn bù gāoxìng, juéde tā bù dǒng wǒ de xiǎngfǎ. Qùnián wǒ qù Rìběn jiāohuàn yì nián, yīnwèi yìzhí zài cún qián, wǒ búbì xiàng jiā lǐ yào qián jiù nénggòu chūguó, hái yǒu qián dàochù lǚxíng. Zhè shíhòu wǒ cái dǒng, māma yào wǒ shěng qián, shì xīwàng wǒ zài xūyào de shíhòu yǒu qián yòng.
text.english: My mother is someone who takes great care of things. Our TV has been used for fifteen years and broken down three times, and each time she had someone come and repair it rather than buy a new one. As a child I found it strange: our family isn't poor, so why be so thrifty? After I started university, she gave me only a small allowance and even made me write down where every sum of money went. Once I wanted to buy the newest phone, and she said, "Your phone still works well. Compared with the new one there's not much difference. Better to save the money." I was very unhappy then and felt she did not understand how I thought. Last year I went to Japan on exchange for a year. Because I had kept saving, I could go abroad without asking my family for money, and I even had money to travel all over. Only then did I understand: my mother wanted me to save so that I would have money when I needed it.

choices.pinyin: Yǐqián juéde tā hěn shěng, xiànzài háishi bù dǒng.
choices.english: He used to think she was thrifty; he still does not understand her.

questions.why: As a child he found her thrift strange and later felt she did not understand him; only after the year in Japan did he understand (才懂) why she did it. He never did as she said gladly (she 逼 him to write everything down), the text says nothing about him being afraid to buy things, and D misses that he came to understand her.

text.traditional: 我從大二起就在光華商場的一家電腦店打工，每個星期六、星期日各工作八個小時。剛開始的時候，我對電腦一點兒也不懂，顧客問我問題，我常常回答不了，只好去請經理幫忙。為了不讓顧客等太久，我每天晚上都在宿舍看電腦雜誌，把每種產品的特色都記下來。三個月以後，我已經能自己向顧客介紹產品了。上個月，經理說我做事很認真，問我畢業後要不要留在店裡工作。我還沒決定，因為我也想念研究所。不過，這份工作不但讓我學到很多電腦知識，也讓我更敢跟人說話了。
text.simplified: 我从大二起就在光华商场的一家电脑店打工，每个星期六、星期日各工作八个小时。刚开始的时候，我对电脑一点儿也不懂，顾客问我问题，我常常回答不了，只好去请经理帮忙。为了不让顾客等太久，我每天晚上都在宿舍看电脑杂志，把每种产品的特色都记下来。三个月以后，我已经能自己向顾客介绍产品了。上个月，经理说我做事很认真，问我毕业后要不要留在店里工作。我还没决定，因为我也想念研究所。不过，这份工作不但让我学到很多电脑知识，也让我更敢跟人说话了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cóng dà èr qǐ jiù zài Guānghuá Shāngchǎng de yì jiā diànnǎo diàn dǎgōng, měi ge xīngqíliù, xīngqírì gè gōngzuò bā ge xiǎoshí. Gāng kāishǐ de shíhòu, wǒ duì diànnǎo yìdiǎnr yě bù dǒng, gùkè wèn wǒ wèntí, wǒ chángcháng huídá bu liǎo, zhǐhǎo qù qǐng jīnglǐ bāngmáng. Wèile bú ràng gùkè děng tài jiǔ, wǒ měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu zài sùshè kàn diànnǎo zázhì, bǎ měi zhǒng chǎnpǐn de tèsè dōu jì xiàlái. Sān ge yuè yǐhòu, wǒ yǐjīng néng zìjǐ xiàng gùkè jièshào chǎnpǐn le. Shàng ge yuè, jīnglǐ shuō wǒ zuòshì hěn rènzhēn, wèn wǒ bìyè hòu yào bú yào liú zài diàn lǐ gōngzuò. Wǒ hái méi juédìng, yīnwèi wǒ yě xiǎng niàn yánjiūsuǒ. Búguò, zhè fèn gōngzuò búdàn ràng wǒ xué dào hěn duō diànnǎo zhīshì, yě ràng wǒ gèng gǎn gēn rén shuōhuà le.
text.english: I’ve worked at a computer shop in Guanghua Digital Plaza since my second year of university, eight hours each Saturday and Sunday. At first I knew nothing about computers. I often couldn’t answer customers’ questions and had to ask my manager for help. So customers wouldn’t have to wait so long, I read computer magazines in my dorm every night and wrote down what was distinctive about each product. After three months, I could explain the products to customers on my own. Last month, my manager said I worked hard and asked if I wanted to stay at the shop full-time after graduation. I haven’t decided because I’m also thinking of graduate school. The job has taught me a lot about computers and made me more comfortable talking to people.

prompt.traditional: 剛開始打工的時候，他回答不了顧客的問題，怎麼辦？
prompt.simplified: 刚开始打工的时候，他回答不了顾客的问题，怎么办？
prompt.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ dǎgōng de shíhòu, tā huídá bù liǎo gùkè de wèntí, zěnme bàn?
prompt.english: When he first started working, what did the writer do when he could not answer a customer's question?

choices.english: Looked it up online.
Read computer magazines in the evening.
Asked the customer to come back another day.
Got the manager to answer.

questions.why: 只好去請經理幫忙: when a customer asked something he could not answer, he had no choice but to get the manager. The magazines were his evening study so that customers would not wait in future, not what he did at the counter.

prompt.traditional: 有顧客問他兩台筆電有什麼差別。三個月後，他最可能怎麼回答？
prompt.simplified: 有顾客问他两台笔电有什么差别。三个月后，他最可能怎么回答？
prompt.pinyin: Yǒu gùkè wèn tā liǎng tái bǐdiàn yǒu shénme chābié. Sān ge yuè hòu, tā zuì kěnéng zěnme huídá?
prompt.english: A customer asks him about the differences between two laptops. How would he most likely answer after three months on the job?

choices.traditional: 請經理幫顧客介紹產品
choices.simplified: 请经理帮顾客介绍产品
choices.pinyin: Qǐng jīnglǐ bāng gùkè jièshào chǎnpǐn.
choices.english: Ask the manager to explain the products to the customer.

choices.traditional: 用自己記下的特色來說明
choices.simplified: 用自己记下的特色来说明
choices.pinyin: Yòng zìjǐ jì xià de tèsè lái shuōmíng.
choices.english: Explain them using the features he wrote down.

choices.pinyin: Xiān qǐng gùkè zìjǐ kàn zázhì.
choices.english: First ask the customer to read the magazines.

choices.traditional: 只用兩台筆電的價格來比
choices.simplified: 只用两台笔电的价格来比
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ yòng liǎng tái bǐdiàn de jiàgé lái bǐ.
choices.english: Compare the two laptops on price alone.

questions.why: He writes down what makes each product different. After three months, he can use that knowledge to answer customers himself instead of asking his manager.

prompt.traditional: 經理為什麼想讓他畢業後繼續做這份工作？
prompt.simplified: 经理为什么想让他毕业后继续做这份工作？
prompt.pinyin: Jīnglǐ wèishénme xiǎng ràng tā bìyè hòu jìxù zuò zhè fèn gōngzuò?
prompt.english: Why does the manager want him to keep working there after graduation?

choices.traditional: 他花時間學，能自己回答問題
choices.simplified: 他花时间学，能自己回答问题
choices.pinyin: Tā huā shíjiān xué, néng zìjǐ huídá wèntí.
choices.english: He puts effort into learning and can now help customers on his own.

choices.traditional: 他一來就很懂店裡的產品
choices.simplified: 他一来就很懂店里的产品
choices.pinyin: Tā yì lái jiù hěn dǒng diàn lǐ de chǎnpǐn.
choices.english: He already knew the shop’s products well when he started.

choices.traditional: 他現在每天都能到店裡工作
choices.simplified: 他现在每天都能到店里工作
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài měi tiān dōu néng dào diàn lǐ gōngzuò.
choices.english: He can now come in to work every day.

choices.traditional: 他答應一畢業就來店裡工作
choices.simplified: 他答应一毕业就来店里工作
choices.pinyin: Tā dāyìng yí bìyè jiù lái diàn lǐ gōngzuò.
choices.english: He has agreed to work at the shop as soon as he graduates.

questions.why: The manager says he is diligent. He went from needing help with customers’ questions to being able to explain the products himself. He is still considering the offer.

focus.en: customers and becoming a staff member

text.traditional: 我的室友小美以前每天晚上都躺在床上看手機，常常看到半夜兩、三點，第二天上課老是打瞌睡。後來她的脖子越來越痛，還常常頭痛，只好去看病。醫生說，她每天低著頭看手機，脖子才會痛。再這樣下去，恐怕會更痛。醫生建議她晚上十一點以後別再用手機，白天多出去活動活動。小美聽了醫生的話，還參加了學校的網球社，每個星期練習三次。兩個月以後，她的脖子不痛了，精神也好多了。她後來發現，手機對生活有很多好處，可是用得太多，對身體的影響也很大。
text.simplified: 我的室友小美以前每天晚上都躺在床上看手机，常常看到半夜两、三点，第二天上课老是打瞌睡。后来她的脖子越来越痛，还常常头痛，只好去看病。医生说，她每天低着头看手机，脖子才会痛。再这样下去，恐怕会更痛。医生建议她晚上十一点以后别再用手机，白天多出去活动活动。小美听了医生的话，还参加了学校的网球社，每个星期练习三次。两个月以后，她的脖子不痛了，精神也好多了。她后来发现，手机对生活有很多好处，可是用得太多，对身体的影响也很大。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu Xiǎoměi yǐqián měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu tǎng zài chuáng shàng kàn shǒujī, chángcháng kàn dào bànyè liǎng, sān diǎn, dì èr tiān shàngkè lǎoshì dǎ kēshuì. Hòulái tā de bózi yuè lái yuè tòng, hái chángcháng tóutòng, zhǐhǎo qù kànbìng. Yīshēng shuō, tā měi tiān dī zhe tóu kàn shǒujī, bózi cái huì tòng. Zài zhèyàng xiàqù, kǒngpà huì gèng tòng. Yīshēng jiànyì tā wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn yǐhòu bié zài yòng shǒujī, báitiān duō chūqù huódòng huódòng. Xiǎoměi tīng le yīshēng de huà, hái cānjiā le xuéxiào de wǎngqiú shè, měi ge xīngqí liànxí sān cì. Liǎng ge yuè yǐhòu, tā de bózi bú tòng le, jīngshén yě hǎo duō le. Tā hòulái fāxiàn, shǒujī duì shēnghuó yǒu hěn duō hǎochù, kěshì yòng de tài duō, duì shēntǐ de yǐngxiǎng yě hěn dà.
text.english: My roommate Xiaomei used to look at her phone in bed every night, often until two or three in the morning. The next day she kept nodding off in class. Then her neck began to hurt more and more, and she often had headaches, so she went to see a doctor. He said her neck hurt because she looked down at her phone every day. It might hurt even more if she kept doing that. He advised her to stop using her phone after eleven at night and get out and move more during the day. Xiaomei took his advice and joined the school tennis club, practicing three times a week. Two months later, her neck no longer hurt, and she had more energy. She came to see that phones are useful in daily life, but using them too much can have a big effect on your health.

prompt.traditional: 看病以前，小美白天的精神怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 看病以前，小美白天的精神怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Kànbìng yǐqián, Xiǎoměi báitiān de jīngshén zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: Before seeing the doctor, how alert was Xiaomei during the day?

choices.traditional: 早上很好，下午才覺得累
choices.simplified: 早上很好，下午才觉得累
choices.pinyin: Zǎoshàng hěn hǎo, xiàwǔ cái juéde lèi.
choices.english: She felt fine in the morning and tired only in the afternoon.

choices.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhòu chángcháng xiǎng shuì.
choices.english: She often felt sleepy in class.

choices.pinyin: Dǎ wán wǎngqiú jiù xiǎng shuìjiào.
choices.english: She felt sleepy after playing tennis.

choices.traditional: 上課沒問題，下課才想睡
choices.simplified: 上课没问题，下课才想睡
choices.pinyin: Shàngkè méi wèntí, xiàkè cái xiǎng shuì.
choices.english: She was fine in class and only got sleepy after it ended.

questions.why: She used to stay up looking at her phone and would nod off in class the next day. Tennis came later, after she saw the doctor.

prompt.traditional: 小美參加網球社，是照醫生的哪個建議做？
prompt.simplified: 小美参加网球社，是照医生的哪个建议做？
prompt.pinyin: Xiǎoměi cānjiā wǎngqiú shè, shì zhào yīshēng de nǎ ge jiànyì zuò?
prompt.english: Which part of her doctor’s advice is Xiaomei following by joining the tennis club?

choices.pinyin: Shíyī diǎn yǐhòu bié yòng shǒujī.
choices.english: Stop using her phone after eleven.

choices.traditional: 看手機的時候不要低頭
choices.simplified: 看手机的时候不要低头
choices.pinyin: Kàn shǒujī de shíhòu bú yào dī tóu.
choices.english: Avoid looking down when using her phone.

choices.traditional: 脖子痛的時候在家休息
choices.simplified: 脖子痛的时候在家休息
choices.pinyin: Bózi tòng de shíhòu zài jiā xiūxí.
choices.english: Rest at home when her neck hurts.
Exercise more during the day.

questions.why: The doctor gives two pieces of advice: no phone after eleven at night, and more activity during the day. Joining the tennis club puts the second into practice.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪種做法最像小美後來會做的事？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪种做法最像小美后来会做的事？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ zhǒng zuòfǎ zuì xiàng Xiǎoměi hòulái huì zuò de shì?
prompt.english: Which approach best fits what Xiaomei thinks by the end?

choices.traditional: 出門多打球，週末在家再多看
choices.simplified: 出门多打球，周末在家再多看
choices.pinyin: Chūmén duō dǎqiú, zhōumò zài jiā zài duō kàn.
choices.english: Play more tennis outside and catch up on the phone at home at weekends.

choices.traditional: 只要多運動，晚上多看一點沒關係
choices.simplified: 只要多运动，晚上多看一点没关系
choices.pinyin: Zhǐyào duō yùndòng, wǎnshàng duō kàn yìdiǎn méiguānxi.
choices.english: As long as she exercises more, looking a bit more at night does not matter.

choices.traditional: 有需要才用，晚上早點收起來
choices.simplified: 有需要才用，晚上早点收起来
choices.pinyin: Yǒu xūyào cái yòng, wǎnshàng zǎodiǎn shōu qǐlái.
choices.english: Use the phone when needed and put it away early at night.

choices.traditional: 白天少用，晚上有空再看
choices.simplified: 白天少用，晚上有空再看
choices.pinyin: Báitiān shǎo yòng, wǎnshàng yǒu kòng zài kàn.
choices.english: Use it less during the day and catch up at night.

questions.why: She still sees practical benefits in using her phone, but changing her late-night habit helped her feel better. Exercise does not make late-night use harmless, and saving it up for weekends or for the evening is still using it too much.

picture.alt: A bright school canteen with big windows, green trees outside and other students eating at tables in the back. Three young people sit side by side at a wooden table, each with a bowl of food on a blue tray. In the middle, a young man with wavy brown hair, a dark red shirt and a mustard-yellow sweater vest rests his cheek on one hand and looks down at a phone in the other hand; his eyebrows are raised and his mouth turns down, so he looks sad and worried. The dark blue bowl of noodles in front of him is untouched. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair, round glasses, a white collared shirt, a dark purple sweater vest and olive trousers puts one hand on his shoulder and holds the other hand out, smiling and talking to him. On the right, a girl with long wavy black hair, gold hoop earrings, a blue jacket over an orange top and white trousers smiles at him and holds out an open hand. Chopsticks lie on the left tray.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 中間的男生怎麼了？
prompt.simplified: 中间的男生怎么了？
prompt.pinyin: Zhōngjiān de nánshēng zěnme le?
prompt.english: What is going on with the young man in the middle?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他手機上的東西很好笑，大家都在笑。
choices.simplified: 他手机上的东西很好笑，大家都在笑。
choices.pinyin: Tā shǒujī shàng de dōngxi hěn hǎoxiào, dàjiā dōu zài xiào.
choices.english: Something on his phone is funny, and everyone is laughing.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他吃不完麵，朋友要幫他吃。
choices.simplified: 他吃不完面，朋友要帮他吃。
choices.pinyin: Tā chī bù wán miàn, péngyǒu yào bāng tā chī.
choices.english: He can't finish his noodles, and his friends want to eat them for him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他心情不好，朋友很關心他，陪他說話。
choices.simplified: 他心情不好，朋友很关心他，陪他说话。
choices.pinyin: Tā xīnqíng bù hǎo, péngyǒu hěn guānxīn tā, péi tā shuōhuà.
choices.english: He's feeling down; his friends are worried about him and keep him company, talking to him.

questions.why: His mouth turns down and his noodles are untouched: he is upset, and the two girls lean toward him, smiling and talking to him: they care about him (關心). The girls are smiling at him, not laughing at his phone, and he has not eaten any of his noodles.

picture.alt: Daytime outside an old house with a grey tiled roof and stone walls, under a blue sky with a few clouds. In the red wooden doorway stand an old man with grey hair in a bun, a white beard and a dark brown robe, one hand on the door frame, and an old woman with grey hair in a bun and a red robe, her hands pressed together in front of her chest; both are laughing and looking toward the monster. A red lantern hangs from the roof. Red firecrackers with gold bands lie on the stone steps and the ground and are going off with bright yellow sparks; bits of red paper fly through the air. On the right, a big furry teal-and-cream monster with one golden horn, a red-orange mane, wide frightened eyes and an open mouth full of fangs leaps away from the house with its paws in the air. Snow lies on the roofs in the background.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 發生了什麼事？
prompt.simplified: 发生了什么事？
prompt.pinyin: Fāshēng le shénme shì?
prompt.english: What has happened?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老太太跟先生讓怪獸給嚇到了。
choices.simplified: 老太太跟先生让怪兽给吓到了。
choices.pinyin: Lǎotàitai gēn xiānshēng ràng guàishòu gěi xià dào le.
choices.english: The old woman and her husband have been frightened by the monster.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Guàishòu ràng biānpào gěi xià zǒu le.
choices.english: The monster has been scared away by the firecrackers.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 怪獸想把門口的鞭炮拿走。
choices.simplified: 怪兽想把门口的鞭炮拿走。
choices.pinyin: Guàishòu xiǎng bǎ ménkǒu de biānpào ná zǒu.
choices.english: The monster wants to take away the firecrackers by the door.

questions.why: Firecrackers go off on the steps and the monster leaps away with frightened eyes: it has been scared off (讓鞭炮給嚇走了). The frightened one is the monster, not the old couple, who stand in their doorway laughing; and the monster is leaping away from the firecrackers, not reaching for them.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 奶奶說除夕下午要拜祖先，是幾點開始？我一下子想不起來。
lines.simplified: 奶奶说除夕下午要拜祖先，是几点开始？我一下子想不起来。

lines.english: She told us yesterday... Now I remember: four. But she wants us there an hour early.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 為什麼要那麼早？
lines.simplified: 为什么要那么早？
lines.pinyin: Wèishénme yào nàme zǎo?
lines.english: Why so early?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 拜拜要用的雞跟鴨，她一個人煮不完，要我們去幫忙。
lines.simplified: 拜拜要用的鸡跟鸭，她一个人煮不完，要我们去帮忙。
lines.pinyin: Bàibài yào yòng de jī gēn yā, tā yí ge rén zhǔ bù wán, yào wǒmen qù bāngmáng.
lines.english: She can't cook all the chicken and duck for the offering by herself, so she wants us to help.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最晚幾點要到奶奶家？
prompt.simplified: 他们最晚几点要到奶奶家？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuì wǎn jǐ diǎn yào dào nǎinai jiā?

questions.why: She remembers (想起來了) that the worship starts at four, but Grandma wants them an hour earlier to help cook, so they must be there by three. Four is when the worship begins, not when they must arrive.

lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiǎng qǐlái le, wǒ xiànzài jiù xiūgǎi.
lines.english: Right, I remember now. I’ll make the change now.

choices.pinyin: Bǎ hǎibào shàng de shíjiān gǎi zǎo yìdiǎn.
choices.english: Put an earlier time on the poster.

choices.english: Redo the lettering on the poster.

questions.why: When she reminds him of the final decision, he remembers (想起來了) that the event now starts an hour earlier. Replacing the photo was an earlier idea.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 今年的年夜飯，我們在家裡吃，還是去餐廳吃？
lines.simplified: 今年的年夜饭，我们在家里吃，还是去餐厅吃？
lines.pinyin: Jīnnián de niányèfàn, wǒmen zài jiā lǐ chī, háishì qù cāntīng chī?
lines.english: This year's New Year's Eve dinner: shall we eat at home or go to a restaurant?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 在哪裡吃我都無所謂。可是媽媽每年都要煮水餃、炒米粉，還要煎年糕，從早上忙到晚上。
lines.simplified: 在哪里吃我都无所谓。可是妈妈每年都要煮水饺、炒米粉，还要煎年糕，从早上忙到晚上。
lines.pinyin: Zài nǎlǐ chī wǒ dōu wúsuǒwèi. Kěshì māma měi nián dōu yào zhǔ shuǐjiǎo, chǎo mǐfěn, hái yào jiān niángāo, cóng zǎoshàng máng dào wǎnshàng.
lines.english: Where we eat doesn't matter to me. But every year Mom boils dumplings, stir-fries rice noodles and has to pan-fry rice cake, and she's busy from morning to night.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你說得對，今年就讓她好好休息吧。我來訂位。
lines.simplified: 你说得对，今年就让她好好休息吧。我来订位。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì, jīnnián jiù ràng tā hǎohǎo xiūxí ba. Wǒ lái dìngwèi.

prompt.simplified: 男的觉得什么比较重要？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde shénme bǐjiào zhòngyào?
prompt.english: What does the man think matters more?

choices.english: New Year's Eve dinner should be at home.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: They should have dumplings and fried rice noodles.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Everyone should get dishes they like.

choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 在哪裡吃我都無所謂: where they eat doesn't matter to him. What he points to is his mother cooking all day. The dishes are what she makes every year, and he never says what anyone likes to eat: his concern is her work, not the menu.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們宿舍門口也貼一張春聯吧！妳喜歡「大吉大利」，還是「年年有餘」？

lines.english: Let's put a spring couplet on our dorm door too! Do you like 'great luck' or 'plenty every year'?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 上面寫什麼我都無所謂，可是這兩張都太大了，我們的門貼不下。
lines.simplified: 上面写什么我都无所谓，可是这两张都太大了，我们的门贴不下。
lines.pinyin: Shàngmiàn xiě shénme wǒ dōu wúsuǒwèi, kěshì zhè liǎng zhāng dōu tài dà le, wǒmen de mén tiē bú xià.
lines.english: I don't mind what it says, but both of these are too big. They won't fit on our door.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那這張小的「平平安安」呢？
lines.simplified: 那这张小的「平平安安」呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà zhè zhāng xiǎo de “píngpíng ān'ān” ne?
lines.english: Then what about this small one, 'safe and sound'?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，就買這張。
lines.simplified: 好啊，就买这张。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, jiù mǎi zhè zhāng.
lines.english: OK, let's buy that one.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的選春聯的時候，最重視什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的选春联的时候，最重视什么？

prompt.english: What matters most to the woman in choosing a couplet?

questions.why: 上面寫什麼我都無所謂: the wording don't matter to her. What decides it is size: the first two are too big for the door (貼不下), so she takes the small one. Where it goes was settled at the start: their dorm door. How many to buy never comes up: she just picks the one that fits.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 除夕店裡要放音樂，可是筆電壞了，我差一點就買一台新的。
lines.simplified: 除夕店里要放音乐，可是笔电坏了，我差一点就买一台新的。
lines.pinyin: Chúxī diàn lǐ yào fàng yīnyuè, kěshì bǐdiàn huài le, wǒ chà yìdiǎn jiù mǎi yì tái xīn de.
lines.english: We need music in the shop on New Year's Eve. But my laptop broke, and I almost bought a new one.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 過年恐怕來不及修理。你手機不是也有這個功能嗎？
lines.simplified: 过年恐怕来不及修理。你手机不是也有这个功能吗？
lines.pinyin: Guònián kǒngpà lái bu jí xiūlǐ. Nǐ shǒujī bú shì yě yǒu zhège gōngnéng ma?
lines.english: You probably won't get it repaired in time. Doesn't your phone have that feature too?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊。花錢買新的，不如先用手機。
lines.simplified: 对啊。花钱买新的，不如先用手机。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Huā qián mǎi xīn de, bùrú xiān yòng shǒujī.
lines.english: Right. Instead of spending money on a new one, I'd do better to use my phone for now.

choices.english: Wait until after New Year to play the music.

questions.why: 不如 introduces the better option: use the phone he already has. He only considered buying a laptop, and repairs may take too long.

lines.simplified: 好啊，不过我对画画不感兴趣。

lines.simplified: 你用毛笔写的字很漂亮嘛。你来写「大吉大利」，我来画橘子。

lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà júzi jiāo gěi nǐ.

choices.pinyin: Bǎ zuò hǎo de kǎpiàn sòng qù yīyuàn.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你今年寒假沒回家過年，家人沒說什麼嗎？
lines.simplified: 你今年寒假没回家过年，家人没说什么吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīnnián hánjià méi huíjiā guònián, jiārén méi shuō shénme ma?
lines.english: You didn't go home for New Year this winter break. Didn't your family mind?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他們都說沒關係。我只擔心我爺爺，他從來不用手機，我以為今年沒辦法跟他拜年了。
lines.simplified: 他们都说没关系。我只担心我爷爷，他从来不用手机，我以为今年没办法跟他拜年了。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen dōu shuō méiguānxi. Wǒ zhǐ dānxīn wǒ yéye, tā cónglái bú yòng shǒujī, wǒ yǐwéi jīnnián méi bànfǎ gēn tā bàinián le.
lines.english: They all said it was fine. I only worried about my grandpa: he never uses a phone, and I thought I couldn't wish him a happy New Year this time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那後來呢？
lines.simplified: 那后来呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà hòulái ne?
lines.english: So what happened?

lines.simplified: 我妹妹花了一个下午教他用手机。过年那天，他在手机上看到我，还叫我在外面要平平安安的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei huā le yí ge xiàwǔ jiāo tā yòng shǒujī. Guònián nà tiān, tā zài shǒujī shàng kàndào wǒ, hái jiào wǒ zài wàimiàn yào píngpíng ān'ān de.
lines.english: My sister spent an afternoon teaching him to use a phone. At New Year he saw me on the phone and told me to stay safe while away from home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你妹妹真厲害！
lines.simplified: 你妹妹真厉害！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ mèimei zhēn lìhài!
lines.english: Your sister is amazing!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是啊，要不是她，我今年就看不到爺爺了。
lines.simplified: 是啊，要不是她，我今年就看不到爷爷了。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, yàobúshì tā, wǒ jīnnián jiù kàn bú dào yéye le.
lines.english: Yes. If it weren't for her, I wouldn't have seen Grandpa at all this year.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: He'd have to eat New Year's Eve dinner alone.

questions.why: 從來不用手機: Grandpa had never used a phone, so he thought he could not greet him. His family, the woman’s guess, had said it was fine, and it is his sister who taught Grandpa.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說「要不是她」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的说「要不是她」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō “yàobúshì tā”, shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean by 'if it weren't for her'?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiāo yéye de rén bú shì mèimei.
choices.english: It wasn't his sister who taught Grandpa.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He didn't get to see Grandpa this year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mèimei yě xiǎng gēn yéye bàinián.
choices.english: His sister also wanted to wish Grandpa a happy New Year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 因為妹妹，他才見到爺爺
choices.simplified: 因为妹妹，他才见到爷爷
choices.pinyin: Yīnwèi mèimei, tā cái jiàndào yéye.
choices.english: Thanks to his sister, he got to see Grandpa.

questions.why: 要不是她，我今年就看不到爺爺了: 要不是 names what really happened (his sister taught Grandpa), and the result after it did not happen: he did see Grandpa, on the phone. Reading 要不是 as 不是 gives the first choice; taking the result as fact gives the second.

lines.simplified: 你舅妈真好！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiùmā zhēn hǎo!
lines.english: Your aunt is so kind!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 是啊，我們到的時候，她正在煮米粉湯。
lines.simplified: 是啊，我们到的时候，她正在煮米粉汤。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, wǒmen dào de shíhòu, tā zhèngzài zhǔ mǐfěn tāng.
lines.english: Yes, and she was making rice-noodle soup when we arrived.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 為什麼每年都是她們去台東？
prompt.simplified: 为什么每年都是她们去台东？
prompt.pinyin: Wèishénme měi nián dōu shì tāmen qù Táidōng?
prompt.english: Why do they go to Taitung every year?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiùmā hěn huì zhǔ mǐfěn tāng.
choices.english: Her aunt makes good rice-noodle soup.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 舅舅不想開八小時的車
choices.simplified: 舅舅不想开八小时的车
choices.pinyin: Jiùjiu bù xiǎng kāi bā xiǎoshí de chē.
choices.english: Her uncle doesn't want to drive for eight hours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiùjiu děi zài jiā zhàogù lǎorén.
choices.english: Her uncle needs to stay home to look after an elderly relative.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huǒchē piào hěn róngyì mǎi dào.
choices.english: Train tickets are easy to get.

questions.why: He has an elderly relative to look after, so he never travels far over New Year (從來不出遠門) and they go to see him. The eight-hour drive is what her own family would have faced, and the hard-to-get tickets belong to this trip only.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從對話可以知道什麼？
prompt.simplified: 从对话可以知道什么？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng duìhuà kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
prompt.english: What can we learn from the conversation?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 因為舅媽，她們才買到票
choices.simplified: 因为舅妈，她们才买到票
choices.pinyin: Yīnwèi jiùmā, tāmen cái mǎi dào piào.
choices.english: Thanks to the aunt, they got tickets.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們開了八個小時的車
choices.simplified: 她们开了八个小时的车
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kāi le bā ge xiǎoshí de chē.
choices.english: They drove for eight hours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiùjiu bāng tāmen mǎi dào le piào.
choices.english: The uncle got the tickets for them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǐfěn tāng shì tāmen zhǔ de.
choices.english: They made the rice-noodle soup.

questions.why: 要不是舅媽每天在網路上幫我們找，我們就得開八個小時的車了: the aunt searched every day and they went by train, so the eight-hour drive did not happen. It was the aunt, not the uncle, who looked, and the aunt was already making the soup when they arrived.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 喂，是媽媽。我打了兩次電話都找不到你，只好留言。
lines.simplified: 喂，是妈妈。我打了两次电话都找不到你，只好留言。
lines.pinyin: Wéi, shì māma. Wǒ dǎ le liǎng cì diànhuà dōu zhǎo bú dào nǐ, zhǐhǎo liúyán.
lines.english: Hello, it's Mom. I tried calling twice and couldn't reach you, so I'm leaving a message.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 除夕那天，當火車到台南的時候，你就打電話給爸爸，他會開車到車站帶你回家。你舅舅跟舅媽坐下一班車，你在車站等他們，大家再一起走。
lines.simplified: 除夕那天，当火车到台南的时候，你就打电话给爸爸，他会开车到车站带你回家。你舅舅跟舅妈坐下一班车，你在车站等他们，大家再一起走。
lines.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān, dāng huǒchē dào Táinán de shíhòu, nǐ jiù dǎ diànhuà gěi bàba, tā huì kāichē dào chēzhàn dài nǐ huíjiā. Nǐ jiùjiu gēn jiùmā zuò xià yì bān chē, nǐ zài chēzhàn děng tāmen, dàjiā zài yìqǐ zǒu.
lines.english: On New Year's Eve, when the train gets to Tainan, call Dad and he'll drive to the station to take you home. Your uncle and aunt are on the next train: wait for them at the station, and then you can all leave together.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 爸爸昨天把橘子跟外套寄到學校了。
lines.simplified: 爸爸昨天把橘子跟外套寄到学校了。
lines.pinyin: Bàba zuótiān bǎ júzi gēn wàitào jì dào xuéxiào le.
lines.english: Dad mailed the tangerines and the jacket to your school yesterday.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還有，奶奶做了很多蘿蔔糕跟年糕，說吃了年糕會年年高升。蘿蔔糕跟年糕不好寄，過完年回學校時，你再帶一些走，分給你的室友吃。
lines.simplified: 还有，奶奶做了很多萝卜糕跟年糕，说吃了年糕会年年高升。萝卜糕跟年糕不好寄，过完年回学校时，你再带一些走，分给你的室友吃。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, nǎinai zuò le hěn duō luóbogāo gēn niángāo, shuō chī le niángāo huì niánnián gāoshēng. Luóbogāo gēn niángāo bù hǎo jì, guò wán nián huí xuéxiào shí, nǐ zài dài yìxiē zǒu, fēn gěi nǐ de shìyǒu chī.
lines.english: And Grandma has made lots of radish cake and New Year cake; she says eating New Year cake helps you rise higher every year. The cakes are hard to mail, so when you go back to school after New Year, take some with you and share them with your roommates.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 聽留言的人到了台南，要先做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 听留言的人到了台南，要先做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tīng liúyán de rén dào le Táinán, yào xiān zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What should the person hearing the message do first on reaching Tainan?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Call his mother.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Take a bus home by himself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎ diànhuà gàosu bàba dào le.
choices.english: Call his father to say he has arrived.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǎo zài chēzhàn děng tā de jiùjiu.
choices.english: Find the uncle who is waiting for him at the station.

questions.why: 當火車到台南的時候，你就打電話給爸爸: as soon as the train arrives he should call his father, who will then drive to the station. It is he who waits for his uncle and aunt, who come on the next train, not the other way round; his mother only left the message.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 要帶到學校的東西，媽媽怎麼安排？
prompt.simplified: 要带到学校的东西，妈妈怎么安排？
prompt.pinyin: Yào dài dào xuéxiào de dōngxi, māma zěnme ānpái?
prompt.english: How has his mother arranged the things that are to go to school?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 年糕自己帶，橘子已經寄了
choices.simplified: 年糕自己带，橘子已经寄了
choices.pinyin: Niángāo zìjǐ dài, júzi yǐjīng jì le.
choices.english: He takes the cakes himself; the tangerines are already mailed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 年糕跟橘子都請爸爸寄
choices.simplified: 年糕跟橘子都请爸爸寄
choices.pinyin: Niángāo gēn júzi dōu qǐng bàba jì.
choices.english: Dad is to mail both the cakes and the tangerines.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 橘子自己帶，年糕請爸爸寄
choices.simplified: 橘子自己带，年糕请爸爸寄
choices.pinyin: Júzi zìjǐ dài, niángāo qǐng bàba jì.
choices.english: He takes the tangerines himself; Dad mails the cakes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 年糕自己帶，外套過完年再寄
choices.simplified: 年糕自己带，外套过完年再寄
choices.pinyin: Niángāo zìjǐ dài, wàitào guò wán nián zài jì.
choices.english: He takes the cakes himself; the jacket is mailed after New Year.

questions.why: Dad mailed the tangerines and the jacket yesterday, but the cakes are hard to mail, so he is to take some with him (帶一些走) when he goes back to school. The other choices swap what is mailed and what he carries, or put the jacket after New Year.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 歡迎大家來廟裡拜拜。今天是除夕，人特別多，請大家從左邊的門進來，不要擠。
lines.simplified: 欢迎大家来庙里拜拜。今天是除夕，人特别多，请大家从左边的门进来，不要挤。
lines.pinyin: Huānyíng dàjiā lái miào lǐ bàibài. Jīntiān shì chúxī, rén tèbié duō, qǐng dàjiā cóng zuǒbiān de mén jìnlái, búyào jǐ.
lines.english: Welcome to the temple. It's New Year's Eve and very crowded today, so please come in through the door on the left and don't push.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當您拜完以後，就請從右邊的門離開，讓後面的人可以進來。
lines.simplified: 当您拜完以后，就请从右边的门离开，让后面的人可以进来。
lines.pinyin: Dāng nín bài wán yǐhòu, jiù qǐng cóng yòubiān de mén líkāi, ràng hòumiàn de rén kěyǐ jìnlái.
lines.english: When you have finished praying, please leave by the door on the right, so the people behind you can come in.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 廟裡準備了一些發糕，希望大家新的一年都能發財。一個人拿一塊就好，請不要拿走太多，讓每個人都拿得到。
lines.simplified: 庙里准备了一些发糕，希望大家新的一年都能发财。一个人拿一块就好，请不要拿走太多，让每个人都拿得到。
lines.pinyin: Miào lǐ zhǔnbèi le yìxiē fāgāo, xīwàng dàjiā xīn de yì nián dōu néng fācái. Yí ge rén ná yí kuài jiù hǎo, qǐng búyào ná zǒu tài duō, ràng měi ge rén dōu ná de dào.
lines.english: The temple has prepared some sponge cakes, wishing you all wealth in the new year. One piece each is enough: please don't take too many, so that everyone gets one.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有，晚上十一點以後，廟前面會放鞭炮，有小孩的朋友請小心，別讓孩子嚇到了。
lines.simplified: 还有，晚上十一点以后，庙前面会放鞭炮，有小孩的朋友请小心，别让孩子吓到了。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn yǐhòu, miào qiánmiàn huì fàng biānpào, yǒu xiǎohái de péngyǒu qǐng xiǎoxīn, bié ràng háizi xià dào le.
lines.english: Also, after eleven tonight there will be firecrackers in front of the temple. If you have children with you, please take care they don't get a fright.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 拜完以后，大家应该怎么做？

choices.english: Set off firecrackers in front of the temple.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Leave through the other door.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Leave through the entrance.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Wait at the door for the people behind.

questions.why: 當您拜完以後，就請從右邊的門離開: once they have prayed, people should leave by the right-hand door so others can come in. The firecrackers are the temple’s, after eleven, and the people behind are let in, not waited for.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 一位爸爸带两个孩子来拜拜，照庙里说的，他们可以怎么做？

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: The family takes one sponge cake.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Duō ná jǐ kuài gěi jiārén chī.
choices.english: Take a few extra for the rest of the family.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: The three of them take three sponge cakes.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Let the children set off firecrackers in front of the temple.

questions.why: 一個人拿一塊就好，請不要拿走太多: one piece per person, so a father with two children may take three, but no extra. The firecrackers are the temple’s, and families with children are asked to keep them safe from the noise.

text.traditional:
社區通知
一、垃圾：除夕到春節第三天，垃圾車不來，垃圾請先留在家裡。去年春節有人把垃圾放在大門外面，讓狗給弄得滿地都是。
二、鞭炮：除夕晚上六點到十一點可以放。地點在停車場旁邊的草地，請不要在大門前放。
三、春聯：請貼在自己家的門上，不要貼在大門上。
四、寄來的東西：除夕下午兩點前，管理人員會幫大家收。兩點後寄到的，請到一樓的桌上拿。
社區管理中心
text.simplified:
社区通知
一、垃圾：除夕到春节第三天，垃圾车不来，垃圾请先留在家里。去年春节有人把垃圾放在大门外面，让狗给弄得满地都是。
二、鞭炮：除夕晚上六点到十一点可以放。地点在停车场旁边的草地，请不要在大门前放。
三、春联：请贴在自己家的门上，不要贴在大门上。
四、寄来的东西：除夕下午两点前，管理人员会帮大家收。两点后寄到的，请到一楼的桌上拿。
社区管理中心
text.pinyin:
Shèqū tōngzhī
Yī, lèsè: chúxī dào chūnjié dì sān tiān, lèsè chē bù lái, lèsè qǐng xiān liú zài jiā lǐ. Qùnián chūnjié yǒu rén bǎ lèsè fàng zài dàmén wàimiàn, ràng gǒu gěi nòng de mǎn dì dōu shì.
Èr, biānpào: chúxī wǎnshàng liù diǎn dào shíyī diǎn kěyǐ fàng. Dìdiǎn zài tíngchēchǎng pángbiān de cǎodì, qǐng búyào zài dàmén qián fàng.
Sān, chūnlián: qǐng tiē zài zìjǐ jiā de mén shàng, búyào tiē zài dàmén shàng.
Sì, jì lái de dōngxi: chúxī xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn qián, guǎnlǐ rényuán huì bāng dàjiā shōu. Liǎng diǎn hòu jì dào de, qǐng dào yī lóu de zhuō shàng ná.
Shèqū guǎnlǐ zhōngxīn
text.english:
Community notice for the Spring Festival
1. Garbage: from New Year's Eve to the third day of the Spring Festival the garbage truck does not come; please keep your garbage at home. Last Spring Festival someone left garbage outside the main gate and dogs scattered it everywhere.
2. Firecrackers: from 6 p.m. to 11 p.m. on New Year’s Eve. Use the lawn beside the parking lot and keep the main gate clear.
3. Spring couplets: please put them on your own door, not on the main gate.
4. Parcels: staff will take in parcels until 2 p.m. on New Year's Eve. Parcels delivered after two will be on the table on the ground floor.
Community management office

text.traditional:
小文：
我先回家過年了，二月一號晚上回來。冰箱裡有我媽媽做的水餃，妳想吃就自己煮，不用客氣。
說好要借妳腳踏車，可是鑰匙讓我弟弟給帶走了。他後天會送回來，樓下的管理人員負責收。到時候妳下樓拿就好。
宿舍餐廳貼了通知，除夕晚上不開。我舅媽說，妳可以去我舅舅家吃年夜飯，他們家很好找，地址在妳桌上。
小真 一月二十六日
text.simplified:
小文：
我先回家过年了，二月一号晚上回来。冰箱里有我妈妈做的水饺，你想吃就自己煮，不用客气。
说好要借你脚踏车，可是钥匙让我弟弟给带走了。他后天会送回来，楼下的管理人员负责收。到时候你下楼拿就好。
宿舍餐厅贴了通知，除夕晚上不开。我舅妈说，你可以去我舅舅家吃年夜饭，他们家很好找，地址在你桌上。
小真 一月二十六日
text.pinyin:
Xiǎowén:
Wǒ xiān huíjiā guònián le, èr yuè yī hào wǎnshàng huílái. Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu wǒ māma zuò de shuǐjiǎo, nǐ xiǎng chī jiù zìjǐ zhǔ, búyòng kèqì.
Shuō hǎo yào jiè nǐ jiǎotàchē, kěshì yàoshi ràng wǒ dìdi gěi dài zǒu le. Tā hòutiān huì sòng huílái, lóuxià de guǎnlǐ rényuán fùzé shōu. Dào shíhòu nǐ xià lóu ná jiù hǎo.
Sùshè cāntīng tiē le tōngzhī, chúxī wǎnshàng bù kāi. Wǒ jiùmā shuō, nǐ kěyǐ qù wǒ jiùjiu jiā chī niányèfàn, tāmen jiā hěn hǎo zhǎo, dìzhǐ zài nǐ zhuō shàng.
Xiǎozhēn, yī yuè èrshíliù rì
text.english:
Xiaowen,
I've gone home for New Year and will be back on the evening of February 1. There are dumplings my mom made in the fridge: if you want some, just boil them yourself, help yourself.
I meant to lend you my bike, but my younger brother took the key away with him. He'll bring it back the day after tomorrow and leave it with the staff downstairs; just go and get it there.
The dorm canteen has put up a notice: it is closed on New Year's Eve evening. My aunt says you can have New Year's Eve dinner at my uncle's: their place is easy to find, and the address is on your desk.
Xiaozhen, January 26

passage.traditional: 寒假我在老店打工。春節前，客人常買年糕、發糕、蘿蔔糕等等。除夕那天，我們得在中午前{1}最後幾盒蘿蔔糕，訂的客人下午才來拿。老闆對我們有兩個{2}：蘿蔔要用當天買的，米一定要用台灣的。我做過別的工作，可是{3}沒這麼累過。我本來就喜歡這份工作，看到客人笑著拿走年糕，我就{4}喜歡這份工作了。工作完成後，老闆把剩下的蘿蔔糕{5}給大家，每人一盒，一塊錢也沒收。
passage.simplified: 寒假我在老店打工。春节前，客人常买年糕、发糕、萝卜糕等等。除夕那天，我们得在中午前{1}最后几盒萝卜糕，订的客人下午才来拿。老板对我们有两个{2}：萝卜要用当天买的，米一定要用台湾的。我做过别的工作，可是{3}没这么累过。我本来就喜欢这份工作，看到客人笑着拿走年糕，我就{4}喜欢这份工作了。工作完成后，老板把剩下的萝卜糕{5}给大家，每人一盒，一块钱也没收。
passage.pinyin: Hánjià wǒ zài lǎodiàn dǎgōng. Chūnjié qián, kèrén cháng mǎi niángāo, fāgāo, luóbogāo děngděng. Chúxī nà tiān, wǒmen děi zài zhōngwǔ qián zuò wán zuìhòu jǐ hé luóbogāo, dìng de kèrén xiàwǔ cái lái ná. Lǎobǎn duì wǒmen yǒu liǎng ge yāoqiú: luóbo yào yòng dāngtiān mǎi de, mǐ yídìng yào yòng Táiwān de. Wǒ zuò guo bié de gōngzuò, kěshì cónglái méi zhème lèi guo. Wǒ běnlái jiù xǐhuān zhè fèn gōngzuò, kàndào kèrén xiàozhe ná zǒu niángāo, wǒ jiù gèngjiā xǐhuān zhè fèn gōngzuò le. Gōngzuò wánchéng hòu, lǎobǎn bǎ shèngxià de luóbogāo fēn gěi dàjiā, měi rén yì hé, yí kuài qián yě méi shōu.
passage.english: I worked part-time at a long-established shop over winter break. Before the Spring Festival, customers often bought New Year rice cakes, sponge cakes, radish cakes and so on. On New Year's Eve, we had to finish making the last few boxes of radish cake before noon: the customers who had ordered them would come for them in the afternoon. The boss had two requirements for us: the radishes had to be bought that day, and we had to use Taiwanese rice. I'd had other jobs, but I'd never been that tired. I already liked the work, and seeing customers smile as they took their rice cakes away made me like it even more. When the work was done, the boss shared out the leftover radish cakes, one box per person, without taking a cent.

choices.english: to sell out of
to manage to buy
to finish making
to take away

questions.why: The customers who ordered these boxes come for them in the afternoon, so what must happen before noon is making them (做完). They cannot be sold out (賣完) or taken away (帶走) before the customers arrive, and the shop makes its radish cake, it does not buy it (買到).

choices.english: requirement
method
question
habit

questions.why: 老闆對我們有兩個…: both are rules the boss sets for the workers, so they are requirements (要求). A habit (習慣) would be the boss’s own way of doing things, not something he has 對我們; neither rule is a cooking method or a question.

choices.english: just now
it turns out
later
ever (with 沒)

questions.why: The writer compares this job with all earlier jobs: 從來沒這麼累過 means this is the most tired they have ever been. 後來 would move the story forward in time.

choices.english: quite
even more
suddenly
to start

questions.why: 更加 marks an increase in how much the person likes the job. The customers’ smiles add to a satisfaction they already felt.

choices.english: to lend
to sell
to share out
to give back

questions.why: The boss gave everyone a share (分), one box each. He took no money, so 賣 cannot describe what happened.

passage.traditional: 今年春節我到室友的舅舅家過年。第一次見面，她的舅舅、舅媽就對我很{1}，像對自己的孩子一樣。除夕晚上，大家先吃年夜飯，{2}一起到門口放鞭炮。鞭炮一響，我嚇了一跳。{3}舅媽拉住我，我早就跑回房間了。第二天，室友帶我去鄰居家{4}。我們一進門就說「新年快樂」。回學校前，我寫了卡片，{5}舅舅一家讓我在花蓮過了一個溫暖的春節。
passage.simplified: 今年春节我到室友的舅舅家过年。第一次见面，她的舅舅、舅妈就对我很{1}，像对自己的孩子一样。除夕晚上，大家先吃年夜饭，{2}一起到门口放鞭炮。鞭炮一响，我吓了一跳。{3}舅妈拉住我，我早就跑回房间了。第二天，室友带我去邻居家{4}。我们一进门就说「新年快乐」。回学校前，我写了卡片，{5}舅舅一家让我在花莲过了一个温暖的春节。
passage.pinyin: Jīnnián chūnjié wǒ dào shìyǒu de jiùjiu jiā guònián. Dì yī cì jiànmiàn, tā de jiùjiu, jiùmā jiù duì wǒ hěn qīnqiè, xiàng duì zìjǐ de háizi yíyàng. Chúxī wǎnshàng, dàjiā xiān chī niányèfàn, jiēzhe yìqǐ dào ménkǒu fàng biānpào. Biānpào yì xiǎng, wǒ xià le yí tiào. Yàobúshì jiùmā lā zhù wǒ, wǒ zǎo jiù pǎo huí fángjiān le. Dì èr tiān, shìyǒu dài wǒ qù línjū jiā bàinián. Wǒmen yí jìn mén jiù shuō “xīnnián kuàilè”. Huí xuéxiào qián, wǒ xiě le kǎpiàn, gǎnxiè jiùjiu yì jiā ràng wǒ zài Huālián guò le yí ge wēnnuǎn de chūnjié.
passage.english: I spent this Spring Festival at my roommate's uncle's home. Her uncle and aunt were warm to me right from our first meeting, treating me like their own child. On New Year's Eve, everyone had dinner first and then went out to the door together to set off firecrackers. I jumped when they went off. If her aunt hadn't held on to me, I would have run back to my room right then. The next day my roommate took me to pay New Year visits to the neighbours. We said “Happy New Year” as soon as we stepped inside. Before going back to school, I wrote a card thanking her uncle's family for making my Spring Festival in Hualien so warm.

choices.english: angry
kind, friendly
polite
dissatisfied

questions.why: They treat the writer like their own child, and the aunt stays close when the firecrackers scare the writer. 親切 describes that warmth. 客氣 could describe how people greet a guest they have just met.

choices.english: already
suddenly
all along
then, next

questions.why: 先……接著: the group first eats, then goes out; 接著 is the second step after 先. 忽然 cannot follow a 先 step, and the surprise comes later, when the firecrackers go off.

choices.english: if it weren't for
as long as
although
because

questions.why: Her aunt really held on to her, and that kept her from running away. 要不是 introduces the fact that prevented the outcome.

choices.english: to spend New Year
to pay a New Year call
to clean
to pray

questions.why: They go from house to house wishing people a happy New Year: 拜年. They spend the holiday with the uncle’s family, so 過年 is a less specific description and does not fit these short visits.

focus.en: to pay a New Year call

choices.english: to hope
to ask
to complain
to thank

questions.why: The card is written at the end of the stay, about something that has already happened (過了) and that was warm. 感謝 thanks the family for it. 希望 and 請 would look ahead to something not yet done, and 抱怨 clashes with 溫暖.

text.traditional:
奶奶常說，從前過日子很辛苦，平日很少吃肉。只有慶祝新年的時候，才吃得到雞、鴨、魚、肉。除夕一定要有魚，才會年年有餘。除夕前幾天，我們家就開始自己做年糕、發糕、蘿蔔糕等等。我們家只有三口人，爺爺用一節竹子就做得出三雙筷子，奶奶在廚房裡忙，火從早燒到晚。到了除夕晚上，一家人聚在一起吃年夜飯，大家一聽見外面的鞭炮響，就知道新的一年要來了。
現在準備年菜方便多了，市場有各式各樣的年菜，餐廳也能訂年夜飯。奶奶還記得從前家裡總是很亮，相當熱鬧，不過她也說，年菜是自己做的還是買的，都無所謂，只要一家人平平安安地在一起，這樣過年就最好了。
text.simplified:
奶奶常说，从前过日子很辛苦，平日很少吃肉。只有庆祝新年的时候，才吃得到鸡、鸭、鱼、肉。除夕一定要有鱼，才会年年有余。除夕前几天，我们家就开始自己做年糕、发糕、萝卜糕等等。我们家只有三口人，爷爷用一节竹子就做得出三双筷子，奶奶在厨房里忙，火从早烧到晚。到了除夕晚上，一家人聚在一起吃年夜饭，大家一听见外面的鞭炮响，就知道新的一年要来了。
现在准备年菜方便多了，市场有各式各样的年菜，餐厅也能订年夜饭。奶奶还记得从前家里总是很亮，相当热闹，不过她也说，年菜是自己做的还是买的，都无所谓，只要一家人平平安安地在一起，这样过年就最好了。
text.pinyin:
Nǎinai cháng shuō, cóngqián guòrìzi hěn xīnkǔ, píngrì hěn shǎo chī ròu. Zhǐyǒu qìngzhù xīnnián de shíhòu, cái chī de dào jī, yā, yú, ròu. Chúxī yídìng yào yǒu yú, cái huì niánnián yǒuyú. Chúxī qián jǐ tiān, wǒmen jiā jiù kāishǐ zìjǐ zuò niángāo, fāgāo, luóbogāo děngděng. Wǒmen jiā zhǐ yǒu sān kǒu rén, yéye yòng yì jié zhúzi jiù zuò de chū sān shuāng kuàizi, nǎinai zài chúfáng lǐ máng, huǒ cóng zǎo shāo dào wǎn. Dào le chúxī wǎnshàng, yì jiā rén jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn, dàjiā yì tīngjiàn wàimiàn de biānpào xiǎng, jiù zhīdào xīn de yì nián yào lái le.
Xiànzài zhǔnbèi niáncài fāngbiàn duō le, shìchǎng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de niáncài, cāntīng yě néng dìng niányèfàn. Nǎinai hái jìde cóngqián jiā lǐ zǒngshì hěn liàng, xiāngdāng rènào, bùguò tā yě shuō, niáncài shì zìjǐ zuò de háishì mǎi de, dōu wúsuǒwèi, zhǐyào yì jiā rén píngpíng ān'ān de zài yìqǐ, zhèyàng guònián jiù zuì hǎo le.
text.english:
Grandma often says life was hard in the old days and they rarely ate meat on ordinary days. Only when celebrating New Year could they have chicken, duck, fish or meat. On New Year's Eve there had to be fish, so that there would be plenty (餘, which sounds like 魚) year after year. In the days before New Year's Eve our family made rice cakes, sponge cakes, radish cakes and so on. There were only three people in the family. Grandpa could make three pairs of chopsticks from one section of bamboo, and Grandma kept the kitchen fire going from morning to night. On New Year's Eve the family gathered for dinner, and as soon as they heard the firecrackers outside, they knew the new year was coming.
Getting the New Year food ready is much easier now. The market has all kinds of festive dishes, and you can reserve dinner at a restaurant. Grandma still remembers how bright and lively their home used to be. She says a good New Year is when the family is together and safe, whether they cook or buy the food.

text.traditional:
我跟媽媽還有爺爺、奶奶住在一起，樓下住著一位老太太。她先生前年就不在了，孩子都在國外工作，過年也回不來。今年除夕下午，媽媽說她一個人過年太可憐了，要我去請她上來吃年夜飯。老太太一開始說不要，怕麻煩我們，我說我們煮了很多，她才答應。
晚上六點，老太太出現在我家門口，手上拿著她自己做的年糕、發糕等等，說是要感謝我們。媽媽也送了她一包橘子，說橘子有「大吉大利」的意思。吃飯的時候，她說了很多從前過年的事，大家都聽得很開心。
吃完飯，我送她下樓。她說，這是她這幾年第一次覺得過年這麼溫暖，心裡相當感動。離開她家時，我想到桌上還剩下很多菜。讓她開心的，應該是有人陪她吃飯吧。
text.simplified:
我跟妈妈还有爷爷、奶奶住在一起，楼下住着一位老太太。她先生前年就不在了，孩子都在国外工作，过年也回不来。今年除夕下午，妈妈说她一个人过年太可怜了，要我去请她上来吃年夜饭。老太太一开始说不要，怕麻烦我们，我说我们煮了很多，她才答应。
晚上六点，老太太出现在我家门口，手上拿着她自己做的年糕、发糕等等，说是要感谢我们。妈妈也送了她一包橘子，说橘子有「大吉大利」的意思。吃饭的时候，她说了很多从前过年的事，大家都听得很开心。
吃完饭，我送她下楼。她说，这是她这几年第一次觉得过年这么温暖，心里相当感动。离开她家时，我想到桌上还剩下很多菜。让她开心的，应该是有人陪她吃饭吧。
text.pinyin:
Wǒ gēn māma háiyǒu yéye, nǎinai zhù zài yìqǐ, lóuxià zhùzhe yí wèi lǎotàitai. Tā xiānshēng qiánnián jiù bú zài le, háizi dōu zài guówài gōngzuò, guònián yě huí bù lái. Jīnnián chúxī xiàwǔ, māma shuō tā yí ge rén guònián tài kělián le, yào wǒ qù qǐng tā shànglái chī niányèfàn. Lǎotàitai yìkāishǐ shuō búyào, pà máfan wǒmen, wǒ shuō wǒmen zhǔ le hěn duō, tā cái dāyìng.
Wǎnshàng liù diǎn, lǎotàitai chūxiàn zài wǒ jiā ménkǒu, shǒu shàng názhe tā zìjǐ zuò de niángāo, fāgāo děngděng, shuō shì yào gǎnxiè wǒmen. Māma yě sòng le tā yì bāo júzi, shuō júzi yǒu “dàjídàlì” de yìsi. Chī fàn de shíhòu, tā shuō le hěn duō cóngqián guònián de shì, dàjiā dōu tīng de hěn kāixīn.
Chī wán fàn, wǒ sòng tā xià lóu. Tā shuō, zhè shì tā zhè jǐ nián dì yī cì juéde guònián zhème wēnnuǎn, xīnli xiāngdāng gǎndòng. Líkāi tā jiā shí, wǒ xiǎngdào zhuō shàng hái shèngxià hěn duō cài. Ràng tā kāixīn de, yīnggāi shì yǒu rén péi tā chī fàn ba.
text.english:
I live with my mother and grandparents. An older woman lives downstairs from us. Her husband passed away the year before last, and her children all work abroad and can't come back even for New Year. This New Year's Eve afternoon my mother said it was too sad for her to spend New Year alone and asked me to invite her up for dinner. At first the old lady said no, not wanting to trouble us; only when I said we had cooked plenty did she agree.
At six o'clock she appeared at our door with New Year cakes, sponge cakes and other things she had made herself, to thank us. My mother gave her a bag of tangerines, saying tangerines mean 'great luck'. At dinner she told us many stories about New Year in the old days, and we all loved listening.
After dinner I walked her downstairs. She said it was the first time in years that New Year had felt so warm, and that she was quite moved. As I left her apartment, I remembered how much food was still on the table. It must have been having people to eat with that made her happy.

text.traditional: 今年寒假，我在一家貿易公司當經理的助理。公司的員工不多，工作相當多。剛開始，我什麼都不會，連傳真機都不會用，只好請同事說明機器的功能，有不懂的地方也常向他們問問題。經理看我那麼緊張，就說：「誰第一天上班就什麼都會呢？慢慢來。」從那天起，我每天都早半個小時到公司，把同事教我的做法都練習一次。春節前那個星期，公司特別忙，大家天天加班。經理說我是學生，不用加班，可是我還是留在公司幫忙。過年以前，經理送了我一盒年糕，說他對我很滿意，明年寒假歡迎再來。後來我聽別的同事說，經理以前也是從助理開始做的，難怪他那麼了解剛來的人。
text.simplified: 今年寒假，我在一家贸易公司当经理的助理。公司的员工不多，工作相当多。刚开始，我什么都不会，连传真机都不会用，只好请同事说明机器的功能，有不懂的地方也常向他们问问题。经理看我那么紧张，就说：「谁第一天上班就什么都会呢？慢慢来。」从那天起，我每天都早半个小时到公司，把同事教我的做法都练习一次。春节前那个星期，公司特别忙，大家天天加班。经理说我是学生，不用加班，可是我还是留在公司帮忙。过年以前，经理送了我一盒年糕，说他对我很满意，明年寒假欢迎再来。后来我听别的同事说，经理以前也是从助理开始做的，难怪他那么了解刚来的人。
text.pinyin: Jīnnián hánjià, wǒ zài yì jiā màoyì gōngsī dāng jīnglǐ de zhùlǐ. Gōngsī de yuángōng bù duō, gōngzuò xiāngdāng duō. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ shénme dōu bú huì, lián chuánzhēnjī dōu bú huì yòng, zhǐhǎo qǐng tóngshì shuōmíng jīqì de gōngnéng, yǒu bù dǒng de dìfāng yě cháng xiàng tāmen wèn wèntí. Jīnglǐ kàn wǒ nàme jǐnzhāng, jiù shuō: “Shéi dì yī tiān shàngbān jiù shénme dōu huì ne? Mànmàn lái.” Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān dōu zǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí dào gōngsī, bǎ tóngshì jiāo wǒ de zuòfǎ dōu liànxí yí cì. Chūnjié qián nà ge xīngqí, gōngsī tèbié máng, dàjiā tiāntiān jiābān. Jīnglǐ shuō wǒ shì xuéshēng, búyòng jiābān, kěshì wǒ háishì liú zài gōngsī bāngmáng. Guònián yǐqián, jīnglǐ sòng le wǒ yì hé niángāo, shuō tā duì wǒ hěn mǎnyì, míngnián hánjià huānyíng zài lái. Hòulái wǒ tīng bié de tóngshì shuō, jīnglǐ yǐqián yě shì cóng zhùlǐ kāishǐ zuò de, nánguài tā nàme liǎojiě gāng lái de rén.
text.english: This winter break I worked as a manager's assistant at a trading company. There are few employees and a lot of work. At first I couldn't do anything, not even use the fax machine, so I asked my colleagues to explain how the machine worked, and whenever there was something I didn't understand I asked them too. Seeing how nervous I was, the manager said, 'Who can do everything on their first day? Take your time.' From that day on I got to the office half an hour early every day and practised everything my colleagues had shown me once more. The week before the Spring Festival the company was extremely busy and everyone worked overtime every day. The manager said I was a student and didn't need to, but I stayed on to help anyway. Before New Year he gave me a box of New Year cake, said he was pleased with me, and told me I was welcome back next winter. Later another colleague told me the manager had started as an assistant himself: no wonder he understands newcomers so well.

text.traditional:
春節前，社區安排我們把年菜送給附近的老人。有的公寓沒有電梯，我連走上三樓都累得不得了。想到除夕那天還要搬好幾盒年糕跟蘿蔔糕，我開始擔心自己的體力。
我去健身房找教練。他說，一開始不要搬重的東西，先每天練習走樓梯。剛開始手上不用拿東西，等體力好一點，再拿著一兩盒東西練習。他也叫我晚上別開夜車，白天才有精神。
練習越多，走起來越輕鬆。到了除夕，我不但把年菜送到了，還有體力替樓上的老人搬米。隔壁的鄰居看見了，說明年也想一起幫忙。
text.simplified:
春节前，社区安排我们把年菜送给附近的老人。有的公寓没有电梯，我连走上三楼都累得不得了。想到除夕那天还要搬好几盒年糕跟萝卜糕，我开始担心自己的体力。
我去健身房找教练。他说，一开始不要搬重的东西，先每天练习走楼梯。刚开始手上不用拿东西，等体力好一点，再拿着一两盒东西练习。他也叫我晚上别开夜车，白天才有精神。
练习越多，走起来越轻松。到了除夕，我不但把年菜送到了，还有体力替楼上的老人搬米。隔壁的邻居看见了，说明年也想一起帮忙。
text.pinyin:
Chūnjié qián, shèqū ānpái wǒmen bǎ niáncài sòng gěi fùjìn de lǎorén. Yǒu de gōngyù méiyǒu diàntī, wǒ lián zǒu shàng sān lóu dōu lèi de bùdéliǎo. Xiǎngdào chúxī nà tiān hái yào bān hǎo jǐ hé niángāo gēn luóbogāo, wǒ kāishǐ dānxīn zìjǐ de tǐlì.
Wǒ qù jiànshēnfáng zhǎo jiàoliàn. Tā shuō, yìkāishǐ búyào bān zhòng de dōngxi, xiān měi tiān liànxí zǒu lóutī. Gāng kāishǐ shǒu shàng búyòng ná dōngxi, děng tǐlì hǎo yìdiǎn, zài názhe yì liǎng hé dōngxi liànxí. Tā yě jiào wǒ wǎnshàng bié kāi yèchē, báitiān cái yǒu jīngshén.
Liànxí yuè duō, zǒu qǐlái yuè qīngsōng. Dào le chúxī, wǒ búdàn bǎ niáncài sòng dào le, hái yǒu tǐlì tì lóu shàng de lǎorén bān mǐ. Gébì de línjū kànjiàn le, shuō míngnián yě xiǎng yìqǐ bāngmáng.
text.english:
Before the Spring Festival, the community arranged for us to deliver New Year's food to older people nearby. Some apartment buildings had no elevator, and even walking up to the third floor wore me out. When I thought about carrying several boxes of rice cake and radish cake on New Year's Eve, I worried about my stamina.
I went to the gym to see a coach. He said I should practise walking up stairs every day instead of starting with something heavy. I should start empty-handed and practise carrying a box or two once my stamina improved. He also reminded me to go to bed on time so I wouldn't be tired during the day.
The more I practised, the easier it got. On New Year's Eve I delivered the food and still had the energy to carry rice for someone upstairs. The next-door neighbour saw me and said they'd like to help next year.
