choices.pinyin: Tā yìbiān shuōhuà, yìbiān zhǐ zhe tàiyáng.
choices.english: He is talking and pointing at the sun.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他一邊說話，一邊指著船。
choices.simplified: 他一边说话，一边指着船。
choices.pinyin: Tā yìbiān shuōhuà, yìbiān zhǐ zhe chuán.
choices.english: He is talking and pointing at the boat.

questions.why: The bridge and the boat are behind the child. His hand points up toward the sun.

picture.alt: Inside an old hall with red pillars, open to a courtyard with grey tiled roofs; the leaves of a big green tree fill the top of the picture. At the left end of a long dark wooden table sits an old man with a long grey beard and grey hair in a topknot tied with a blue ribbon, in a mustard-yellow robe; he smiles and talks with both hands open towards the others, looking at them, not at the table. An unrolled bamboo scroll lies on the table; nobody is reading it, holding a brush or writing. Facing him at the table sit three listeners, each with a hand at the chin: a man with a black beard in a teal robe, a smiling child in a brown robe, and a young woman with long black hair in a pink robe.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 坐在老先生對面的三個人在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 坐在老先生对面的三个人在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zuò zài lǎo xiānshēng duìmiàn de sān ge rén zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What are the three people sitting across from the old man doing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zài wèn lǎo xiānshēng wèntí.
choices.english: They are asking the older man questions.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zài kàn zhuōzi shàng de shū.
choices.english: They are looking at the book on the table.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們在認真地聽老先生說話。
choices.simplified: 他们在认真地听老先生说话。
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zài rènzhēn de tīng lǎo xiānshēng shuōhuà.
choices.english: They are listening carefully to the older man.

questions.why: The older man is speaking with his hands open. The three people look at him with their hands at their chins. The scroll is in front of them.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼這麼高興？
lines.simplified: 你怎么这么高兴？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhème gāoxìng?
lines.english: Why are you so happy?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我剛才在捷運上遇到我小學的老師。我們十五年沒見了，我以為她早就不記得我了。
lines.simplified: 我刚才在捷运上遇到我小学的老师。我们十五年没见了，我以为她早就不记得我了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái zài jiéyùn shàng yùdào wǒ xiǎoxué de lǎoshī. Wǒmen shíwǔ nián méi jiàn le, wǒ yǐwéi tā zǎo jiù bú jìdé wǒ le.
lines.english: I just ran into my primary-school teacher on the MRT. We hadn't seen each other for fifteen years, and I thought she'd long forgotten me.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 後來呢？
lines.simplified: 后来呢？
lines.pinyin: Hòulái ne?
lines.english: What happened next?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 誰知道她一看到我，就叫出了我的名字，還說我以前上課最愛跟同學吵架。
lines.simplified: 谁知道她一看到我，就叫出了我的名字，还说我以前上课最爱跟同学吵架。
lines.pinyin: Shéi zhīdào tā yí kàndào wǒ, jiù jiào chū le wǒ de míngzi, hái shuō wǒ yǐqián shàngkè zuì ài gēn tóngxué chǎojià.
lines.english: Who would have thought: the moment she saw me she called out my name, and she even said I used to love arguing with classmates in class.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼這麼高興？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么这么高兴？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme zhème gāoxìng?
prompt.english: Why is the man so happy?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī hái zhīdào tā shì shéi.
choices.english: His teacher still knew who he was.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ le lǎoshī de míngzi.
choices.english: He remembered his teacher's name.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老師說他以前很有禮貌
choices.simplified: 老师说他以前很有礼貌
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō tā yǐqián hěn yǒu lǐmào.
choices.english: His teacher said he used to be very polite.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他每天都在捷運上遇到老師
choices.simplified: 他每天都在捷运上遇到老师
choices.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài jiéyùn shàng yùdào lǎoshī.
choices.english: He meets his teacher on the MRT every day.

questions.why: He expected her to have forgotten him after fifteen years, but 誰知道 brings in the surprise: she called out his name at once. She is the one who remembered a name, and what she remembered was his arguing in class, not good manners.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你們換了一位教歷史的老師，他怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 听说你们换了一位教历史的老师，他怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐmen huàn le yí wèi jiāo lìshǐ de lǎoshī, tā zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: I hear you've got a new history teacher. What's he like?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我本來以為他年紀大，想法一定很保守，誰知道他上課都讓我們自己找問題討論。
lines.simplified: 我本来以为他年纪大，想法一定很保守，谁知道他上课都让我们自己找问题讨论。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi tā niánjì dà, xiǎngfǎ yídìng hěn bǎoshǒu, shéi zhīdào tā shàngkè dōu ràng wǒmen zìjǐ zhǎo wèntí tǎolùn.
lines.english: I thought that since he's older his ideas would be really conservative. Who knew he'd have us find our own questions to discuss in every class.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 討論什麼問題？
lines.simplified: 讨论什么问题？
lines.pinyin: Tǎolùn shénme wèntí?
lines.english: What kind of questions?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 像是古代南方人跟北方人，為什麼吃的東西不一樣。雖然比以前累，可是有意思多了。
lines.simplified: 像是古代南方人跟北方人，为什么吃的东西不一样。虽然比以前累，可是有意思多了。
lines.pinyin: Xiàng shì gǔdài nánfāng rén gēn běifāng rén, wèishénme chī de dōngxi bù yíyàng. Suīrán bǐ yǐqián lèi, kěshì yǒu yìsi duō le.
lines.english: Like why people in the south and the north ate different things in ancient times. It is more tiring than before, but much more interesting.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得新老師怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得新老师怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde xīn lǎoshī zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of the new teacher?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ jiāo dàjiā yǐqián chī shénme.
choices.english: He only teaches what people used to eat.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiāo de bǐ tā xiǎng de yǒu yìsi.
choices.english: He makes class more interesting than expected.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He teaches in a conservative way.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shàng tā de kè bǐ yǐqián qīngsōng.
choices.english: His class is easier than the old one.

questions.why: He expected a conservative teacher, but the students find their own questions to discuss. The man finds class harder work than before, yet more interesting.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們班那個小朋友今天又哭了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你们班那个小朋友今天又哭了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen bān nàge xiǎopéngyǒu jīntiān yòu kū le ma?
lines.english: Did that child in your class cry again today?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，他常常說哭就哭。今天別的小朋友只是推了他一下，他就哭了半天。
lines.simplified: 对啊，他常常说哭就哭。今天别的小朋友只是推了他一下，他就哭了半天。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, tā chángcháng shuō kū jiù kū. Jīntiān bié de xiǎopéngyǒu zhǐshì tuī le tā yíxià, tā jiù kū le bàntiān.
lines.english: Yes, he often bursts into tears just like that. Today another child only gave him a little push, and he cried for ages.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他們沒有打架吧？
lines.simplified: 他们没有打架吧？
lines.pinyin: Tāmen méiyǒu dǎjià ba?
lines.english: They didn't fight, did they?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒有。我讓推他的小朋友跟他說對不起，後來他們又一起玩了。
lines.simplified: 没有。我让推他的小朋友跟他说对不起，后来他们又一起玩了。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Wǒ ràng tuī tā de xiǎopéngyǒu gēn tā shuō duìbùqǐ, hòulái tāmen yòu yìqǐ wán le.
lines.english: No. I had the child who pushed him say sorry, and afterwards they played together again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 兩個小朋友怎麼又一起玩了？
prompt.simplified: 两个小朋友怎么又一起玩了？
prompt.pinyin: Liǎng ge xiǎopéngyǒu zěnme yòu yìqǐ wán le?
prompt.english: How did the two children end up playing together again?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 哭的小朋友先說對不起
choices.simplified: 哭的小朋友先说对不起
choices.pinyin: Kū de xiǎopéngyǒu xiān shuō duìbùqǐ.
choices.english: The child who cried apologized first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de qǐng tāmen xiān fēnkāi wán.
choices.english: The man asked them to play apart for a while.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的請推人的孩子說對不起
choices.simplified: 男的请推人的孩子说对不起
choices.pinyin: Nán de qǐng tuī rén de háizi shuō duìbùqǐ.
choices.english: The man asked the child who pushed to apologize.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 推人的孩子去找別人幫忙
choices.simplified: 推人的孩子去找别人帮忙
choices.pinyin: Tuī rén de háizi qù zhǎo biérén bāngmáng.
choices.english: The child who pushed went to get help.

questions.why: The child who cried was the one who got pushed. The man asked the other child to apologize, and they played together again afterwards.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 今天好熱，聽說下午會到三十五度。
lines.simplified: 今天好热，听说下午会到三十五度。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān hǎo rè, tīngshuō xiàwǔ huì dào sānshíwǔ dù.
lines.english: It's so hot today. I hear it'll reach thirty-five degrees this afternoon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我們去山上吧！山上溫度比較低，河邊那座老橋下面感覺更涼快。
lines.simplified: 那我们去山上吧！山上温度比较低，河边那座老桥下面感觉更凉快。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen qù shān shàng ba! Shān shàng wēndù bǐjiào dī, hébiān nà zuò lǎo qiáo xiàmiàn gǎnjué gèng liángkuài.
lines.english: Then let's go up the mountain! It's cooler up there, and under the old bridge by the river it feels even cooler.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 現在嗎？我本來想等晚上不那麼熱再出門。
lines.simplified: 现在吗？我本来想等晚上不那么热再出门。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài ma? Wǒ běnlái xiǎng děng wǎnshàng bú nàme rè zài chūmén.
lines.english: Now? I was going to wait until the evening, when it is not so hot, to go out.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 山上現在就很舒服啊，說走就走吧！
lines.simplified: 山上现在就很舒服啊，说走就走吧！
lines.pinyin: Shān shàng xiànzài jiù hěn shūfú a, shuō zǒu jiù zǒu ba!
lines.english: It's lovely up there right now. Let's just go!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，不過我得先回家換衣服，我們一點在捷運站見。
lines.simplified: 好吧，不过我得先回家换衣服，我们一点在捷运站见。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, búguò wǒ děi xiān huí jiā huàn yīfú, wǒmen yī diǎn zài jiéyùn zhàn jiàn.
lines.english: All right, but I have to go home and change first. Let's meet at the MRT station at one.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們什麼時候出門？
prompt.simplified: 他们什么时候出门？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen shénme shíhòu chūmén?
prompt.english: When will they set off?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Right now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: In the evening, when it is not hot.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: After the man goes home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de huàn hǎo yīfú yǐhòu.
choices.english: After the woman has changed her clothes.

questions.why: 說走就走 is the man urging them to leave this minute, but the woman agrees only after she has gone home to change: they meet at one. Waiting for the evening was her first idea, which she drops, and it is she, not the man, who goes home.

focus.en: to go the moment you say so

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳今天看起來好累，昨天沒睡好嗎？
lines.simplified: 你今天看起来好累，昨天没睡好吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái hǎo lèi, zuótiān méi shuì hǎo ma?
lines.english: You look exhausted today. Didn't you sleep well last night?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我昨天加班到十一點，回家以後還幫弟弟複習數學。
lines.simplified: 我昨天加班到十一点，回家以后还帮弟弟复习数学。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān jiābān dào shíyī diǎn, huí jiā yǐhòu hái bāng dìdi fùxí shùxué.
lines.english: I worked overtime until eleven yesterday, and after I got home I helped my brother review maths.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 難怪妳剛才上課的時候一直打瞌睡。
lines.simplified: 难怪你刚才上课的时候一直打瞌睡。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ gāngcái shàngkè de shíhòu yìzhí dǎ kēshuì.
lines.english: No wonder you kept nodding off in class just now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，連老師叫我回答問題，我都沒聽見。
lines.simplified: 对啊，连老师叫我回答问题，我都没听见。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, lián lǎoshī jiào wǒ huídá wèntí, wǒ dōu méi tīngjiàn.
lines.english: Yes. I didn't even hear the teacher call on me to answer a question.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說「難怪」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的说「难怪」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō “nánguài”, shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean by 難怪?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The woman shouldn't work overtime.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他明白女的為什麼想睡
choices.simplified: 他明白女的为什么想睡
choices.pinyin: Tā míngbái nǚ de wèishénme xiǎng shuì.
choices.english: He understands why she is sleepy.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She doesn't take class seriously.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Her brother is bad at maths.

questions.why: 難怪 means "no wonder": once he hears she worked late and then helped her brother study, he understands why she kept dozing off. He does not blame her for the overtime or for not caring about class.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳不是說要做一個蛋糕，明天教師節送給老師嗎？
lines.simplified: 你不是说要做一个蛋糕，明天教师节送给老师吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō yào zuò yí ge dàngāo, míngtiān Jiàoshījié sòng gěi lǎoshī ma?
lines.english: Didn't you say you'd bake a cake to give your teacher tomorrow, for Teachers' Day?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 做好了啊。我去洗個手，回來才發現蛋糕已經被狗吃掉一半了。
lines.simplified: 做好了啊。我去洗个手，回来才发现蛋糕已经被狗吃掉一半了。
lines.pinyin: Zuò hǎo le a. Wǒ qù xǐ ge shǒu, huílái cái fāxiàn dàngāo yǐjīng bèi gǒu chī diào yíbàn le.
lines.english: I finished it. I went to wash my hands, and when I came back I found the dog had eaten half the cake.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn?
lines.english: What will you do?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我只好去樓下的麵包店買一盒餅乾了。
lines.simplified: 我只好去楼下的面包店买一盒饼干了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐhǎo qù lóuxià de miànbāo diàn mǎi yì hé bǐnggān le.
lines.english: I'll just have to buy a box of cookies at the bakery downstairs.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼改送餅乾？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么改送饼干？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme gǎi sòng bǐnggān?
prompt.english: Why is the woman giving cookies instead?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zuò hǎo de dàngāo zhǐ shèng yíbàn.
choices.english: Only half the cake she made is left.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā láibùjí bǎ dàngāo zuò hǎo.
choices.english: She won't finish the cake in time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老師說想吃麵包店的餅乾
choices.simplified: 老师说想吃面包店的饼干
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō xiǎng chī miànbāo diàn de bǐnggān.
choices.english: The teacher said they wanted cookies from the bakery.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā běnlái zuò de jiù shì bǐnggān.
choices.english: She made cookies to begin with.

questions.why: She finished making the cake for her teacher, but her dog ate half of it. Buying cookies solves the gift problem.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天的歷史考試妳準備好了嗎？我上星期生病，三堂課都沒去。
lines.simplified: 明天的历史考试你准备好了吗？我上星期生病，三堂课都没去。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān de lìshǐ kǎoshì nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Wǒ shàng xīngqí shēngbìng, sān táng kè dōu méi qù.
lines.english: Are you ready for tomorrow's history exam? I was ill last week and missed three classes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這次可難了！老師說古代的政治思想一定會考。
lines.simplified: 这次可难了！老师说古代的政治思想一定会考。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì kě nán le! Lǎoshī shuō gǔdài de zhèngzhì sīxiǎng yídìng huì kǎo.
lines.english: This one is really hard! The teacher says ancient political thought is sure to come up.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？妳上課的時候有沒有把老師的話記下來？
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？你上课的时候有没有把老师的话记下来？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn? Nǐ shàngkè de shíhòu yǒu méiyǒu bǎ lǎoshī de huà jì xiàlái?
lines.english: What do I do? Did you write down what the teacher said in class?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有，都在這裡，借你看吧。
lines.simplified: 有，都在这里，借你看吧。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, dōu zài zhèlǐ, jiè nǐ kàn ba.
lines.english: Yes, it's all here. You can borrow it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 太好了！我今天晚上看完，明天早上還妳。
lines.simplified: 太好了！我今天晚上看完，明天早上还你。

text.traditional:
九月二十八日是教師節，也是紀念孔子的節日。圖書館請三位教師介紹孔子和他的思想。每場免費，歡迎對歷史、哲學或教育有興趣的人參加。
九月九日：孔子和他的學生子路，三樓
九月十六日（二樓）：孔子的政治理想——君王為什麼不接受？
九月二十三日：孔子的思想對東方教育的影響，二樓
每場下午兩點開始，一個半小時。每次只有六十個位子，必須在活動開始前進去。三場都聽完的人，最後一場聽完可以拿到一本《孔子的故事》。
圖書館
text.simplified:
九月二十八日是教师节，也是纪念孔子的节日。图书馆请三位教师介绍孔子和他的思想。每场免费，欢迎对历史、哲学或教育有兴趣的人参加。
九月九日：孔子和他的学生子路，三楼
九月十六日（二楼）：孔子的政治理想——君王为什么不接受？

text.english:
Teachers’ Day, September 28, commemorates Confucius. The library has invited three teachers to introduce him and his ideas. All talks are free. Anyone interested in history, philosophy, or education is welcome.
September 9: Confucius and his student Zilu, third floor
September 16 (second floor): Confucius’s political ideals. Why didn’t rulers accept them?
September 23: How Confucius’s ideas influenced education in the East, second floor

passage.traditional: 上個月，我到鄉下一所小學教畫畫。我帶小朋友到河邊畫橋，看了大家一眼，發現只有一個男孩一直看著{1}。我問他在看什麼。他用手{2}著剛到河邊的船說：「我爸爸下班都坐這條船回家。」船停了，有個人{3}，笑著向我們走來。我這才{4}，男孩一直在等爸爸。男孩{5}地跳了起來，大聲叫爸爸。那天，他畫的不是橋，是剛回家的爸爸。

passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ dào xiāngxià yì suǒ xiǎoxué jiāo huàhuà. Wǒ dài xiǎopéngyǒu dào hébiān huà qiáo, kàn le dàjiā yì yǎn, fāxiàn zhǐ yǒu yí ge nánhái yìzhí kàn zhe duìmiàn. Wǒ wèn tā zài kàn shénme. Tā yòng shǒu zhǐ zhe gāng dào hébiān de chuán shuō: “Wǒ bàba xiàbān dōu zuò zhè tiáo chuán huí jiā.” Chuán tíng le, yǒu ge rén xià chuán, xiào zhe xiàng wǒmen zǒu lái. Wǒ zhè cái míngbái, nánhái yìzhí zài děng bàba. Nánhái jīdòng de tiào le qǐlái, dà shēng jiào bàba. Nà tiān, tā huà de bú shì qiáo, shì gāng huí jiā de bàba.
passage.english: Last month I taught art at a primary school in the countryside. I took the children to the river to draw the bridge. When I glanced at the group, I noticed that only one boy kept looking across the river. I asked what he was looking at. He pointed at the boat that had just reached the bank. “Dad takes this boat home from work,” he said. The boat stopped, and someone got off and walked toward us with a smile. I finally understood that the boy had been waiting for his dad. The boy jumped up excitedly and called out to him. That day he drew his father coming home instead of the bridge.

passage.traditional: 小時候吃飯，我老是{1}。有一次，爺爺還沒坐下，我就吃了好幾口魚。爺爺沒說我沒有禮貌，只問我：「要是大家都這樣，最後來的人可能就{2}了吧？」他又說：「做人做事，必須先{3}別人。」我當時沒放在心上。上大學後，我本來想住家裡，可是搭最早的車也會遲到，所以我{4}搬出去跟同學住。有好吃的，我會先留一些給他們。原來爺爺的話{5}了我這麼多年。

passage.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhòu chīfàn, wǒ lǎoshì zìjǐ xiān chī. Yǒu yí cì, yéye hái méi zuò xià, wǒ jiù chī le hǎo jǐ kǒu yú. Yéye méi shuō wǒ méiyǒu lǐmào, zhǐ wèn wǒ: “Yàoshi dàjiā dōu zhèyàng, zuìhòu lái de rén kěnéng jiù méi yú chī le ba?” Tā yòu shuō: “Zuòrén zuòshì, bìxū xiān xiǎngdào biérén.” Wǒ dāngshí méi fàng zài xīn shàng. Shàng dàxué hòu, wǒ běnlái xiǎng zhù jiālǐ, kěshì dā zuì zǎo de chē yě huì chídào, suǒyǐ wǒ bùdébù bān chūqù gēn tóngxué zhù. Yǒu hǎochī de, wǒ huì xiān liú yìxiē gěi tāmen. Yuánlái yéye de huà yǐngxiǎng le wǒ zhème duō nián.
passage.english: When I was little, I always started eating without waiting for anyone else. Once, I took several bites of fish before Grandpa had even sat down. He didn’t tell me I was being rude. He just asked, “If everyone did that, the last person to arrive might not get any fish, right?” He added, “Whatever you do, you must think of others first.” I didn’t take it to heart at the time. When I started university, I wanted to live at home, but even the earliest ride would get me there late. I had to move out and live with classmates. Whenever I had anything good to eat, I would save some for them first. Grandpa’s words had been influencing me all those years.

text.traditional:
住在我家對面的張爺爺今年七十歲，上個月開始到社區大學學英文。他告訴我，他小時候家裡很窮，十二歲就不得不離開學校，到工廠去工作。這一輩子，他最大的希望就是再回到教室念書。
退休以後，他曾經想去上課，可是一直覺得自己年紀太大，又笨，學不會新東西，所以一直不敢去。後來，他的小兒子對他說：「只有開始學，才知道自己學不學得會。」他想了很久，最後決定試試看。
班上同學的背景和程度不同，老師常用生活中的例子教會話。大家互相幫忙，慢慢學會用英文表達自己的想法。張爺爺每次都很認真地回答問題，表現比很多年輕人還好。他說，這個機會他等待了五十多年，所以到現在每次都準時到教室。
text.simplified:
住在我家对面的张爷爷今年七十岁，上个月开始到社区大学学英文。他告诉我，他小时候家里很穷，十二岁就不得不离开学校，到工厂去工作。这一辈子，他最大的希望就是再回到教室念书。
退休以后，他曾经想去上课，可是一直觉得自己年纪太大，又笨，学不会新东西，所以一直不敢去。后来，他的小儿子对他说：「只有开始学，才知道自己学不学得会。」他想了很久，最后决定试试看。
班上同学的背景和程度不同，老师常用生活中的例子教会话。大家互相帮忙，慢慢学会用英文表达自己的想法。张爷爷每次都很认真地回答问题，表现比很多年轻人还好。他说，这个机会他等待了五十多年，所以到现在每次都准时到教室。
text.pinyin:
Zhù zài wǒ jiā duìmiàn de Zhāng yéye jīnnián qīshí suì, shàng ge yuè kāishǐ dào shèqū dàxué xué Yīngwén. Tā gàosù wǒ, tā xiǎoshíhòu jiālǐ hěn qióng, shí'èr suì jiù bùdébù líkāi xuéxiào, dào gōngchǎng qù gōngzuò. Zhè yíbèizi, tā zuì dà de xīwàng jiù shì zài huí dào jiàoshì niànshū.
Tuìxiū yǐhòu, tā céngjīng xiǎng qù shàngkè, kěshì yìzhí juéde zìjǐ niánjì tài dà, yòu bèn, xué bú huì xīn dōngxi, suǒyǐ yìzhí bù gǎn qù. Hòulái, tā de xiǎo érzi duì tā shuō: “Zhǐyǒu kāishǐ xué, cái zhīdào zìjǐ xué bù xué de huì.” Tā xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, zuìhòu juédìng shìshì kàn.
Bān shàng tóngxué de bèijǐng hé chéngdù bùtóng, lǎoshī cháng yòng shēnghuó zhōng de lìzi jiāo huìhuà. Dàjiā hùxiāng bāngmáng, mànmàn xuéhuì yòng Yīngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ. Zhāng yéye měi cì dōu hěn rènzhēn de huídá wèntí, biǎoxiàn bǐ hěn duō niánqīng rén hái hǎo. Tā shuō, zhège jīhuì tā děngdài le wǔshí duō nián, suǒyǐ dào xiànzài měi cì dōu zhǔnshí dào jiàoshì.
text.english:
Grandpa Zhang, who lives across from me, is seventy this year, and last month he started learning English at the community college. He told me his family was very poor when he was a boy, and at twelve he had no choice but to leave school and go to work in a factory. All his life, his greatest hope was to go back to a classroom and study.
After he retired he once thought of taking classes, but he kept thinking he was too old and too stupid to learn anything new, so he never dared to go. Then his youngest son said to him, “Only when you start learning will you know whether you can learn it.” He thought about it for a long time and eventually decided to give it a try.
The students have different backgrounds and levels. The teacher uses examples from daily life to teach conversation. The students help each other and slowly learn to express their ideas in English. Grandpa Zhang always answers questions carefully and does better than many young people. He says he waited more than fifty years for this chance, so he gets to class on time every time.

text.traditional:
我是從德國來的交換學生。剛到台灣的時候，我發現這裡上課跟我在西方的經驗很不一樣。在德國，老師一問問題，大家就馬上說自己的想法，說錯了也沒關係；在這裡，同學大多安靜地把老師的話寫下來，很少有人開口回答。
我曾經以為大家的想法比較保守，後來才明白，很多人有自己的想法，只是怕說錯了，別人會笑。現在我們的老師常常先讓大家三、四個人一起討論，再請同學向大家說明自己的想法。大家很快就接受了這個方法，表現也比我想的好得多。
我覺得東方和西方的教育都有好的地方，任何一種教法都不會永遠有用。教師可以看學生的背景和程度，改變上課的方式。
text.simplified:
我是从德国来的交换学生。刚到台湾的时候，我发现这里上课跟我在西方的经验很不一样。在德国，老师一问问题，大家就马上说自己的想法，说错了也没关系；在这里，同学大多安静地把老师的话写下来，很少有人开口回答。
我曾经以为大家的想法比较保守，后来才明白，很多人有自己的想法，只是怕说错了，别人会笑。现在我们的老师常常先让大家三、四个人一起讨论，再请同学向大家说明自己的想法。大家很快就接受了这个方法，表现也比我想的好得多。
我觉得东方和西方的教育都有好的地方，任何一种教法都不会永远有用。教师可以看学生的背景和程度，改变上课的方式。
text.pinyin:
Wǒ shì cóng Déguó lái de jiāohuàn xuéshēng. Gāng dào Táiwān de shíhòu, wǒ fāxiàn zhèlǐ shàngkè gēn wǒ zài xīfāng de jīngyàn hěn bù yíyàng. Zài Déguó, lǎoshī yí wèn wèntí, dàjiā jiù mǎshàng shuō zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, shuō cuò le yě méiguānxi; zài zhèlǐ, tóngxué dàduō ānjìng de bǎ lǎoshī de huà xiě xiàlái, hěn shǎo yǒu rén kāikǒu huídá.
Wǒ céngjīng yǐwéi dàjiā de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào bǎoshǒu, hòulái cái míngbái, hěn duō rén yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, zhǐshì pà shuō cuò le, biérén huì xiào. Xiànzài wǒmen de lǎoshī chángcháng xiān ràng dàjiā sān, sì ge rén yìqǐ tǎolùn, zài qǐng tóngxué xiàng dàjiā shuōmíng zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ. Dàjiā hěn kuài jiù jiēshòu le zhège fāngfǎ, biǎoxiàn yě bǐ wǒ xiǎng de hǎo de duō.
Wǒ juéde dōngfāng hé xīfāng de jiàoyù dōu yǒu hǎo de dìfāng, rènhé yì zhǒng jiāofǎ dōu bú huì yǒngyuǎn yǒuyòng. Jiàoshī kěyǐ kàn xuéshēng de bèijǐng hé chéngdù, gǎibiàn shàngkè de fāngshì.
text.english:
I am an exchange student from Germany. When I first arrived in Taiwan, I found classes here very different from my experience in the West. In Germany, as soon as the teacher asks a question, everyone says what they think straight away, and it doesn't matter if they get it wrong; here, most classmates quietly write down what the teacher says, and few people speak up to answer.
I once thought people's ideas here were rather conservative, but later I understood that many people have ideas of their own. They just worry others will laugh if they get something wrong. Now our teacher often has us discuss in groups of three or four first, and then asks them to explain their ideas to the class. Everyone quickly took to this method, and they do far better than I expected.
I think education in both the East and the West has its good points; no teaching method works in every situation forever. Teachers can change how they teach based on their students’ backgrounds and levels.

text.traditional:
除夕前一天，公司通知我們晚上還要加班。我本來打算留在台北。下班後，媽媽打電話給我。她說：「你以前不是想學煎蘿蔔糕嗎？明天回來，我教你。」我改坐除夕早上的高鐵回南部。
媽媽在廚房裡準備年夜飯。媽媽說，她跟爸爸結婚以後，就跟奶奶學會了做蘿蔔糕，以前都是奶奶一個人做。這幾年奶奶的手常常痛，現在是媽媽負責這一部分。她叫我先用小火煎一塊。等我學會了，才讓我煎給家人吃。
吃年夜飯的時候，奶奶吃了一口，笑著說：「我從來沒吃過你做的蘿蔔糕，今天可吃到了！」要不是媽媽打來，我大概還在台北呢。
text.simplified:
除夕前一天，公司通知我们晚上还要加班。我本来打算留在台北。下班后，妈妈打电话给我。她说：「你以前不是想学煎萝卜糕吗？明天回来，我教你。」我改坐除夕早上的高铁回南部。
妈妈在厨房里准备年夜饭。妈妈说，她跟爸爸结婚以后，就跟奶奶学会了做萝卜糕，以前都是奶奶一个人做。这几年奶奶的手常常痛，现在是妈妈负责这一部分。她叫我先用小火煎一块。等我学会了，才让我煎给家人吃。
吃年夜饭的时候，奶奶吃了一口，笑着说：「我从来没吃过你做的萝卜糕，今天可吃到了！」要不是妈妈打来，我大概还在台北呢。
text.pinyin:
Chúxì qián yì tiān, gōngsī tōngzhī wǒmen wǎnshàng hái yào jiābān. Wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn liú zài Táiběi. Xiàbān hòu, māma dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ. Tā shuō: “Nǐ yǐqián bú shì xiǎng xué jiān luóbogāo ma? Míngtiān huílái, wǒ jiāo nǐ.” Wǒ gǎi zuò chúxì zǎoshàng de gāotiě huí nánbù.
Māma zài chúfáng lǐ zhǔnbèi niányèfàn. Māma shuō, tā gēn bàba jiéhūn yǐhòu, jiù gēn nǎinai xuéhuì le zuò luóbogāo, yǐqián dōu shì nǎinai yí ge rén zuò. Zhè jǐ nián nǎinai de shǒu chángcháng tòng, xiànzài shì māma fùzé zhè yí bùfen. Tā jiào wǒ xiān yòng xiǎo huǒ jiān yí kuài. Děng wǒ xuéhuì le, cái ràng wǒ jiān gěi jiārén chī.
Chī niányèfàn de shíhòu, nǎinai chī le yì kǒu, xiào zhe shuō: “Wǒ cónglái méi chī guo nǐ zuò de luóbogāo, jīntiān kě chī dào le!” Yàobúshì māma dǎ lái, wǒ dàgài hái zài Táiběi ne.
text.english:
The day before Lunar New Year’s Eve, the company told us we had to work overtime that evening. I had planned to stay in Taipei. After work my mother called. “Haven’t you been wanting to learn to pan-fry radish cake? Come home tomorrow and I’ll teach you.” I changed my plans and took the high-speed train south the next morning.
My mother was getting New Year’s Eve dinner ready in the kitchen. She said Grandma taught her to make radish cake after she married my father. Grandma used to do it herself. Her hands have often hurt these past few years, so my mother now takes care of that part. She had me fry one piece over low heat first. Once I got the hang of it, she let me cook for the family.
At dinner Grandma took a bite and smiled. “I’d never had radish cake made by you before. Today I finally got to try it!” If my mother hadn’t called, I’d probably still be in Taipei.

text.traditional:
大一的時候，我對好幾個社團都感興趣，一下子就參加了四個。下課後，有時得去學吉他，有時得去打籃球。我連功課都來不及寫，考試成績也越來越差。
一位大三的同學看出我有煩惱，問我平常怎麼安排時間。我說，四個社團的活動我都想去。他告訴我，自己以前也遇到過這種情況，後來發現光是上課就很忙。他說：「每個社團都去，不如只留下你最喜歡的一個。」我想了幾天，決定只留在吉他社。
現在我有時間複習功課，也可以跟社員互相學習。上個月，我還跟他們一起上台表演。原來少參加幾個社團，收穫比以前更多。
text.simplified:
大一的时候，我对好几个社团都感兴趣，一下子就参加了四个。下课后，有时得去学吉他，有时得去打篮球。我连功课都来不及写，考试成绩也越来越差。
一位大三的同学看出我有烦恼，问我平常怎么安排时间。我说，四个社团的活动我都想去。他告诉我，自己以前也遇到过这种情况，后来发现光是上课就很忙。他说：「每个社团都去，不如只留下你最喜欢的一个。」我想了几天，决定只留在吉他社。
现在我有时间复习功课，也可以跟社员互相学习。上个月，我还跟他们一起上台表演。原来少参加几个社团，收获比以前更多。
text.pinyin:
Dà yī de shíhòu, wǒ duì hǎo jǐ ge shètuán dōu gǎn xìngqù, yíxiàzi jiù cānjiā le sì ge. Xiàkè hòu, yǒushí děi qù xué jítā, yǒushí děi qù dǎ lánqiú. Wǒ lián gōngkè dōu láibùjí xiě, kǎoshì chéngjī yě yuè lái yuè chà.
Yí wèi dà sān de tóngxué kàn chū wǒ yǒu fánnǎo, wèn wǒ píngcháng zěnme ānpái shíjiān. Wǒ shuō, sì ge shètuán de huódòng wǒ dōu xiǎng qù. Tā gàosù wǒ, zìjǐ yǐqián yě yùdào guo zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng, hòulái fāxiàn guāng shì shàngkè jiù hěn máng. Tā shuō: “Měi ge shètuán dōu qù, bùrú zhǐ liú xià nǐ zuì xǐhuān de yí ge.” Wǒ xiǎng le jǐ tiān, juédìng zhǐ liú zài jítā shè.
Xiànzài wǒ yǒu shíjiān fùxí gōngkè, yě kěyǐ gēn shèyuán hùxiāng xuéxí. Shàng ge yuè, wǒ hái gēn tāmen yìqǐ shàng tái biǎoyǎn. Yuánlái shǎo cānjiā jǐ ge shètuán, shōuhuò bǐ yǐqián gèng duō.
text.english:
In my first year of university I was interested in several clubs and joined four straight away. After class I sometimes had to go play guitar and sometimes had to play basketball. I didn’t even have time for my homework, and my grades got worse and worse.
A third-year student noticed I was worried and asked how I usually planned my time. I said I wanted to attend all four clubs’ activities. He had been in the same situation and had found that classes alone kept him quite busy. “Instead of going to every club, you’d be better off staying in just your favorite one,” he said. I thought about it for a few days and decided to stay in the guitar club alone.
Now I have time to review my schoolwork and learn with the other members. Last month I even performed onstage with them. It turns out that I got more out of joining fewer clubs.

lines.traditional: 差一點就沒看到！我把時間記錯了，以為八點才開始。還好朋友打電話來問我在哪裡，我叫了計程車過去，到的時候表演剛要開始。
lines.simplified: 差一点就没看到！我把时间记错了，以为八点才开始。还好朋友打电话来问我在哪里，我叫了计程车过去，到的时候表演刚要开始。
lines.pinyin: Chà yìdiǎn jiù méi kàndào! Wǒ bǎ shíjiān jì cuò le, yǐwéi bā diǎn cái kāishǐ. Hái hǎo péngyǒu dǎ diànhuà lái wèn wǒ zài nǎlǐ, wǒ jiào le jìchéngchē guòqù, dào de shíhòu biǎoyǎn gāng yào kāishǐ.
lines.english: I almost missed it! I got the time wrong and thought it started at eight. Luckily a friend called to ask where I was. I took a taxi, and when I got there the show was just about to start.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那還好。
lines.simplified: 那还好。
lines.pinyin: Nà hái hǎo.
lines.english: That's lucky, then.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He missed the show.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He saw the show after all.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bā diǎn cái dào lǐtáng.
choices.english: He reached the hall only at eight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Péngyǒu péi tā qù kàn biǎoyǎn.
choices.english: A friend went with him.

questions.why: 差一點就沒看到 means he very nearly missed it, so in the end he did see it: he arrived just as it began. Eight o'clock was only the wrong time he had in mind, and the friend only phoned.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我以為那位非洲同學才來台灣半年，中文應該不太好。誰知道他說得比我們班的同學都好。
lines.simplified: 我以为那位非洲同学才来台湾半年，中文应该不太好。谁知道他说得比我们班的同学都好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi nà wèi Fēizhōu tóngxué cái lái Táiwān bàn nián, Zhōngwén yīnggāi bú tài hǎo. Shéi zhīdào tā shuō de bǐ wǒmen bān de tóngxué dōu hǎo.
lines.english: I thought that African student had only been in Taiwan for half a year, so his Chinese couldn't be very good. Who knew he speaks better than everyone in our class.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他在他們國家學了三年了，來台灣以前就常跟台灣朋友在網路上聊天。
lines.simplified: 他在他们国家学了三年了，来台湾以前就常跟台湾朋友在网路上聊天。
lines.pinyin: Tā zài tāmen guójiā xué le sān nián le, lái Táiwān yǐqián jiù cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu zài wǎnglù shàng liáotiān.
lines.english: He studied for three years in his country, and before coming to Taiwan he often chatted online with Taiwanese friends.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zǎo jiù zhīdào tā Zhōngwén hǎo.
choices.english: She knew all along his Chinese was good.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zhǐ xué le bàn nián Zhōngwén.
choices.english: He has studied Chinese for only half a year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她沒想到他中文那麼好
choices.simplified: 她没想到他中文那么好
choices.pinyin: Tā méi xiǎngdào tā Zhōngwén nàme hǎo.
choices.english: She didn't expect his Chinese to be so good.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bān shàng de tóngxué bǐjiào hǎo.
choices.english: Her classmates are better.

questions.why: 誰知道 introduces something she did not expect: she thought his Chinese would be weak, and it is better than her whole class's. Half a year is his time in Taiwan; he studied for three years at home.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 剛才跟我們說「你好」的那個人，我覺得在哪裡見過，可是想不起來他是誰。
lines.simplified: 刚才跟我们说「你好」的那个人，我觉得在哪里见过，可是想不起来他是谁。
lines.pinyin: Gāngcái gēn wǒmen shuō “nǐ hǎo” de nàge rén, wǒ juéde zài nǎlǐ jiàn guo, kěshì xiǎng bù qǐlái tā shì shéi.
lines.english: That person who just said hello to us: I feel I've seen him somewhere, but I can't remember who he is.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他是上個月在禮堂吹笛子的那個美國人啊！
lines.simplified: 他是上个月在礼堂吹笛子的那个美国人啊！
lines.pinyin: Tā shì shàng ge yuè zài lǐtáng chuī dízi de nàge Měiguó rén a!
lines.english: He's the American who played the flute in the auditorium last month!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對對對，我想起來了，他吹得好極了。
lines.simplified: 对对对，我想起来了，他吹得好极了。
lines.pinyin: Duì duì duì, wǒ xiǎng qǐlái le, tā chuī de hǎo jí le.
lines.english: Right, now I remember. He played wonderfully.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的一開始是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的一开始是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de yì kāishǐ shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean at first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā cónglái méi jiàn guo nàge rén.
choices.english: He had never seen that person.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那個人記錯了他的名字
choices.simplified: 那个人记错了他的名字
choices.pinyin: Nàge rén jì cuò le tā de míngzì.
choices.english: That person got his name wrong.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng gēn nàge rén shuōhuà.
choices.english: He didn't want to talk to that person.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā wàng le nàge rén shì shéi.
choices.english: He had forgotten who that person was.

questions.why: 想不起來 means he cannot bring it back to mind: he knows he has seen the man but has forgotten who he is, until she reminds him. He says he has seen him before, so "never seen" is wrong.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們說了半天，還是沒決定攤子要做什麼。表演唱歌怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 我们说了半天，还是没决定摊子要做什么。表演唱歌怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen shuō le bàntiān, háishì méi juédìng tānzi yào zuò shénme. Biǎoyǎn chànggē zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: We've talked for ages and still haven't decided what our stall will do. How about singing?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 表演唱歌的社團已經太多了。我想來想去，覺得介紹台灣的傳統玩具比較特別，還可以請大家一起玩。
lines.simplified: 表演唱歌的社团已经太多了。我想来想去，觉得介绍台湾的传统玩具比较特别，还可以请大家一起玩。
lines.pinyin: Biǎoyǎn chànggē de shètuán yǐjīng tài duō le. Wǒ xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, juéde jièshào Táiwān de chuántǒng wánjù bǐjiào tèbié, hái kěyǐ qǐng dàjiā yìqǐ wán.
lines.english: Too many clubs are already singing. I've thought it over and over, and introducing Taiwan's traditional toys would be more special. We could also invite everyone to play.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個想法不錯！可是要去哪裡找那些玩具呢？
lines.simplified: 这个想法不错！可是要去哪里找那些玩具呢？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xiǎngfǎ búcuò! Kěshì yào qù nǎlǐ zhǎo nàxiē wánjù ne?
lines.english: That's a nice idea! But where do we find those toys?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我爺爺家還留著很多，我這個週末回去拿。
lines.simplified: 我爷爷家还留着很多，我这个周末回去拿。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yéye jiā hái liú zhe hěn duō, wǒ zhège zhōumò huíqù ná.
lines.english: My grandpa still keeps lots of them at home. I'll go back and get them this weekend.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我來做海報，邀請大家來玩。
lines.simplified: 那我来做海报，邀请大家来玩。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ lái zuò hǎibào, yāoqǐng dàjiā lái wán.
lines.english: Then I'll make a poster inviting everyone to come and play.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後覺得攤子應該做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后觉得摊子应该做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu juéde tānzi yīnggāi zuò shénme?
prompt.english: In the end, what does the man think the stall should do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā chàng Táiwān de gē.
choices.english: Have everyone sing Taiwanese songs.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Let people play with old toys.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Sell toys grandpa made.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Introduce Taiwan with posters.

questions.why: After 想來想去 (thinking it over and over) he settles on Taiwan's traditional toys that visitors can play with. Singing was her first idea; the toys are only kept at grandpa's, not made or sold; the poster is just to invite people.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的打算做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的打算做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go to grandpa's to get things.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Sing on stage.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Buy some new toys.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng gèng duō rén zhīdào tānzi.
choices.english: Let more people know about the stall.

questions.why: Her poster is to 邀請大家來玩: it tells people about the stall so more come to play. Going to grandpa's for the toys is his job, singing was the idea they dropped, and the toys come from grandpa, not a shop.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們班那個從中美洲來的同學，好像跟誰都聊得來。
lines.simplified: 你们班那个从中美洲来的同学，好像跟谁都聊得来。
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen bān nàge cóng Zhōngměizhōu lái de tóngxué, hǎoxiàng gēn shéi dōu liáo de lái.
lines.english: That classmate of yours from Central America seems to get along with everyone.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，他活潑大方，常說笑話給大家聽，看到誰都會先笑一笑。
lines.simplified: 对啊，他活泼大方，常说笑话给大家听，看到谁都会先笑一笑。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, tā huópō dàfāng, cháng shuō xiàohuà gěi dàjiā tīng, kàndào shéi dōu huì xiān xiào yí xiào.
lines.english: Yes, he's lively and open, often tells everyone jokes, and gives a smile to anyone he sees.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我也很想認識他，可是想來想去，還是不敢過去說話，怕自己中文說得不好。
lines.simplified: 我也很想认识他，可是想来想去，还是不敢过去说话，怕自己中文说得不好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě hěn xiǎng rènshì tā, kěshì xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì bù gǎn guòqù shuōhuà, pà zìjǐ Zhōngwén shuō de bù hǎo.
lines.english: I'd love to get to know him too, but I keep going back and forth and still don't dare go over, afraid my Chinese isn't good enough.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 別擔心，妳說錯了他也不會笑妳。下星期三我們班有活動，妳一起來，我介紹你們認識。
lines.simplified: 别担心，你说错了他也不会笑你。下星期三我们班有活动，你一起来，我介绍你们认识。
lines.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, nǐ shuō cuò le tā yě bú huì xiào nǐ. Xià xīngqísān wǒmen bān yǒu huódòng, nǐ yìqǐ lái, wǒ jièshào nǐmen rènshì.
lines.english: Don't worry, even if you get something wrong he won't laugh at you. Our class has an event next Wednesday. Come along and I'll introduce you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼還沒跟那位同學說話？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么还没跟那位同学说话？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme hái méi gēn nà wèi tóngxué shuōhuà?
prompt.english: Why hasn't the woman talked to that classmate yet?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nà wèi tóngxué bú tài ài shuōhuà.
choices.english: That classmate doesn't like to talk much.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She doesn't like jokes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得自己中文不夠好
choices.simplified: 她觉得自己中文不够好
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde zìjǐ Zhōngwén bú gòu hǎo.
choices.english: She thinks her Chinese isn't good enough.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的不想介紹他們認識
choices.simplified: 男的不想介绍他们认识
choices.pinyin: Nán de bù xiǎng jièshào tāmen rènshì.
choices.english: The man doesn't want to introduce them.

questions.why: 想來想去，還是不敢: she has thought about it again and again and still holds back, afraid her Chinese is not good enough. The classmate talks with everyone, and the man offers to introduce them.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下星期三女的可能會做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 下星期三女的可能会做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Xià xīngqísān nǚ de kěnéng huì zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will the woman probably do next Wednesday?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ qù zhǎo nà wèi tóngxué.
choices.english: Go and find the classmate on her own.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Tell everyone jokes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Introduce a friend to the man.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Cānjiā nán de bān shàng de huódòng.
choices.english: Go to the man's class event.

questions.why: He invites her to his class's event next Wednesday so that he can introduce her to the classmate: she will not go to him alone. Jokes are what the classmate tells, and the man, not she, does the introducing.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 明生你好，我是華語文中心的李老師。這次的文化日，我們邀請了附近中學的學生來參加，人會比以前多，所以會場的安排改了。
lines.simplified: 明生你好，我是华语文中心的李老师。这次的文化日，我们邀请了附近中学的学生来参加，人会比以前多，所以会场的安排改了。
lines.pinyin: Míngshēng nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn de Lǐ lǎoshī. Zhè cì de Wénhuàrì, wǒmen yāoqǐng le fùjìn zhōngxué de xuéshēng lái cānjiā, rén huì bǐ yǐqián duō, suǒyǐ huìchǎng de ānpái gǎi le.
lines.english: Hello Mingsheng, this is Ms. Li from the Chinese Language Center. For this Culture Day we have invited students from the nearby middle schools, so there will be more people than before, and the arrangement of the venue has changed.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 攤子本來都在大禮堂裡面，現在改到禮堂外面，裡面只留給表演用。
lines.simplified: 摊子本来都在大礼堂里面，现在改到礼堂外面，里面只留给表演用。
lines.pinyin: Tānzi běnlái dōu zài dà lǐtáng lǐmiàn, xiànzài gǎi dào lǐtáng wàimiàn, lǐmiàn zhǐ liú gěi biǎoyǎn yòng.
lines.english: The stalls were all going to be inside the main auditorium; now they move outside it, and the inside is kept only for the shows.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們的攤子要放影片，外面可能太亮，請你星期五下午以前來會場看看，找一個比較好的地點。謝謝！
lines.simplified: 你们的摊子要放影片，外面可能太亮，请你星期五下午以前来会场看看，找一个比较好的地点。谢谢！
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen de tānzi yào fàng yǐngpiàn, wàimiàn kěnéng tài liàng, qǐng nǐ xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ yǐqián lái huìchǎng kànkàn, zhǎo yí ge bǐjiào hǎo de dìdiǎn. Xièxie!
lines.english: Your stall is showing a video, and outside may be too bright, so please come to the venue before Friday afternoon and find a better spot. Thank you!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 會場的安排為什麼改了？
prompt.simplified: 会场的安排为什么改了？
prompt.pinyin: Huìchǎng de ānpái wèishénme gǎi le?
prompt.english: Why was the venue arrangement changed?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: It is brighter outside the hall.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Middle-school students will perform in the hall.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lái cānjiā de rén huì gèng duō.
choices.english: More people will come.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The video must be shown outside.

questions.why: The middle-school students are invited as visitors, so more people will come, and that is why the venue was rearranged. The brightness outside is a problem for the video, not the reason for the move.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 李老師希望明生做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 李老师希望明生做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Lǐ lǎoshī xīwàng Míngshēng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does Ms. Li want Mingsheng to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān qù huìchǎng zhǎo hǎo dìfāng.
choices.english: Go to the venue first and find a good place.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǎ yǐngpiàn gǎi dào lǐtáng lǐ fàng.
choices.english: Move the video into the hall.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Invite middle-school students.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Come to watch the show on Friday afternoon.

questions.why: Because the video may be hard to see outside, she asks him to come before Friday afternoon and pick a suitable spot. The hall is kept for shows, and the school has already invited the middle-school students.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位同學，歡迎來到世界文化日！今天有五大洲、三十幾個國家的攤子。
lines.simplified: 各位同学，欢迎来到世界文化日！今天有五大洲、三十几个国家的摊子。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi tóngxué, huānyíng lái dào Shìjiè Wénhuàrì! Jīntiān yǒu wǔdàzhōu, sānshí jǐ ge guójiā de tānzi.
lines.english: Students, welcome to World Culture Day! Today there are stalls from more than thirty countries on five continents.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 亞洲的攤子在會場的東北邊，歐洲的在西北邊，非洲跟大洋洲的在東南邊，美洲的在西南邊。歐洲的攤子還準備了鬆餅跟葡萄。
lines.simplified: 亚洲的摊子在会场的东北边，欧洲的在西北边，非洲跟大洋洲的在东南边，美洲的在西南边。欧洲的摊子还准备了松饼跟葡萄。

passage.traditional: 去年春節，我是在台灣朋友家過的。朋友的家人都很{1}，一見面就送我紅包，還一直請我吃東西。吃飯的時候，我發現台灣過年的{2}很多，像魚不能吃完、不能說不好聽的話{3}，都很有意思。吃完飯，奶奶拿出一大盤{4}，說是自己家種的，又小又圓，甜得很，讓我很感動。奶奶做的年菜也好吃極了，我在餐廳吃過的菜都{5}她做的。
passage.simplified: 去年春节，我是在台湾朋友家过的。朋友的家人都很{1}，一见面就送我红包，还一直请我吃东西。吃饭的时候，我发现台湾过年的{2}很多，像鱼不能吃完、不能说不好听的话{3}，都很有意思。吃完饭，奶奶拿出一大盘{4}，说是自己家种的，又小又圆，甜得很，让我很感动。奶奶做的年菜也好吃极了，我在餐厅吃过的菜都{5}她做的。
passage.pinyin: Qùnián Chūnjié, wǒ shì zài Táiwān péngyǒu jiā guò de. Péngyǒu de jiārén dōu hěn dàfāng, yí jiànmiàn jiù sòng wǒ hóngbāo, hái yìzhí qǐng wǒ chī dōngxi. Chīfàn de shíhòu, wǒ fāxiàn Táiwān guònián de fēngsú hěn duō, xiàng yú bù néng chī wán, bù néng shuō bù hǎotīng de huà shénme de, dōu hěn yǒu yìsi. Chī wán fàn, nǎinai ná chū yí dà pán pútáo, shuō shì zìjǐ jiā zhòng de, yòu xiǎo yòu yuán, tián dehěn, ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng. Nǎinai zuò de niáncài yě hǎochī jí le, wǒ zài cāntīng chī guo de cài dōu bǐ bú shàng tā zuò de.
passage.english: Last Spring Festival I spent at a Taiwanese friend's home. My friend's family were all very generous: as soon as we met they gave me a red envelope, and they kept offering me food. At the meal I found that Taiwan has many New Year customs, such as not finishing the fish and not saying unlucky words, and they were all interesting. After the meal Grandma brought out a big plate of grapes, grown by the family themselves, small, round and very sweet, which touched me. Grandma's New Year dishes were wonderful too: none of the dishes I have had in restaurants can compare with hers.

choices.english: shy
quiet
generous
careful

questions.why: The family give a red envelope at once and keep offering food: they are generous, 大方. A family that keeps urging food on a guest is not 安靜 (quiet); 害羞 is the opposite of how they act; 仔細 is about doing something carefully.

choices.english: custom
programme
region
ethnic group

questions.why: Not finishing the fish and not saying unlucky words are rules people keep at New Year: customs, 風俗. 節目 are shows you watch, and 地區 and 民族 are places and peoples, not things you do.

choices.english: when
and so on
if
after

questions.why: The list opens with 像 and gives two examples, so it closes with 什麼的: 像……什麼的. 的時候, 的話 and 以後 would make the examples a time or a condition, and nothing would follow them.

choices.english: watermelon
mango
bananas
grapes

questions.why: All four are sweet fruit a family in Taiwan could grow and serve on a plate; the next clause decides: 又小又圓, small and round, so grapes, 葡萄. A watermelon is round but not small, and a mango and a banana are not round.

choices.english: can match
to surpass
to be like
can't compare with

questions.why: Grandma's dishes were 好吃極了, so restaurant dishes cannot match them: 都比不上她做的. 比得上 would make them just as good and 超過 better, which takes the praise away, and 像 says only that they look or taste alike.

passage.traditional: 上個月我去歐洲看法國朋友，住在他家。他的家人不太會說英文，我也不會說他們的語言，剛開始我很緊張，不知道要怎麼跟他們{1}。後來我發現，雖然語言不同，可是一個{2}就能讓人覺得很溫暖。朋友的媽媽教我做了很多法國的點心，{3}蛋糕、麵包什麼的。我做得不太好，她也從來不{4}我，只是笑著再教我一次。我覺得法國菜好吃得很，在我吃過的東西當中，只有台灣的小吃{5}法國菜。
passage.simplified: 上个月我去欧洲看法国朋友，住在他家。他的家人不太会说英文，我也不会说他们的语言，刚开始我很紧张，不知道要怎么跟他们{1}。后来我发现，虽然语言不同，可是一个{2}就能让人觉得很温暖。朋友的妈妈教我做了很多法国的点心，{3}蛋糕、面包什么的。我做得不太好，她也从来不{4}我，只是笑着再教我一次。我觉得法国菜好吃得很，在我吃过的东西当中，只有台湾的小吃{5}法国菜。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ qù Ōuzhōu kàn Fǎguó péngyǒu, zhù zài tā jiā. Tā de jiārén bú tài huì shuō Yīngwén, wǒ yě bú huì shuō tāmen de yǔyán, gāng kāishǐ wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, bù zhīdào yào zěnme gēn tāmen liáotiān. Hòulái wǒ fāxiàn, suīrán yǔyán bùtóng, kěshì yí ge wéixiào jiù néng ràng rén juéde hěn wēnnuǎn. Péngyǒu de māma jiāo wǒ zuò le hěn duō Fǎguó de diǎnxīn, xiàng dàngāo, miànbāo shénme de. Wǒ zuò de bú tài hǎo, tā yě cónglái bù pīpíng wǒ, zhǐshì xiào zhe zài jiāo wǒ yí cì. Wǒ juéde Fǎguó cài hǎochī dehěn, zài wǒ chī guo de dōngxi dāngzhōng, zhǐyǒu Táiwān de xiǎochī bǐ de shàng Fǎguó cài.
passage.english: Last month I went to Europe to visit a French friend and stayed at his home. His family don't speak much English and I don't speak theirs, so at first I was nervous and didn't know how to chat with them. Later I found that although our languages differ, a smile is enough to make people feel warm. My friend's mother taught me to make lots of French pastries, such as cakes, bread and so on. I didn't make them very well, but she never criticized me; she just smiled and showed me again. I think French cooking is really delicious: of everything I have eaten, only Taiwanese street food can match French cooking.

choices.english: to meet
to chat
to complain
to discuss

questions.why: The sentence before gives the problem: neither side speaks the other's language, so he does not know how to talk with them at all, 聊天. He is already living in their home, so meeting (見面) is no problem, and nothing has gone wrong to complain about (抱怨) or come up to discuss (討論).

choices.english: suggestion
joke
story
smile

questions.why: 雖然語言不同 sets up something that needs no words, and the mother later 笑著 teaches him again: a smile, 微笑. A joke, a story and a suggestion can all be warm, but each needs the shared language they lack.

choices.english: even
than
such as
and

questions.why: Two examples followed by 什麼的 need 像 in front: 像蛋糕、麵包什麼的. 連 needs 都 or 也, 比 needs something to compare, and 跟 joins two nouns, not a list ending in 什麼的.

choices.english: to criticize
to invite
to observe
to help

questions.why: He cooked badly, yet she never 批評 (criticized) him and only showed him again. She was helping him all along, so 從來不幫我 is the opposite of the story; 邀請 and 觀察 do not fit his mistakes.

choices.english: can't compare with
can match
to be unlike
to be like

questions.why: He has just praised French cooking with 好吃得很, and 只有 picks out the one thing among all he has eaten that can match it: 只有台灣的小吃比得上法國菜. With 比不上, Taiwanese food would be the only thing worse, which the praise does not lead to; 像 and 不像 only say whether the two foods are alike, not how good they are.

title.pinyin: Bù yíyàng, bú shì bù hǎo

text.traditional: 我在華語文中心打工已經一年了。剛開始，我常常覺得外國學生的習慣很怪：有的同學說話的聲音很大，有的同學跟老師說話的時候不看老師的眼睛。我心裡常想：他們真沒有禮貌。後來中心舉辦了一次交流活動，請各國學生介紹自己民族的風俗，連校長也親自來聽。其中有一位非洲同學說，在他們那個地區，跟老師說話時看老師的眼睛是不禮貌的。我仔細聽了以後才知道，這些習慣在他們國家都很平常，就像我們過年要拜拜一樣。這個活動改變了我的想法。從那天起，看到不一樣的習慣，我不再馬上批評，我會先觀察、先問。我明白了，只有先了解別人的文化，才能真的跟他們交朋友，互相學習。
text.simplified: 我在华语文中心打工已经一年了。刚开始，我常常觉得外国学生的习惯很怪：有的同学说话的声音很大，有的同学跟老师说话的时候不看老师的眼睛。我心里常想：他们真没有礼貌。后来中心举办了一次交流活动，请各国学生介绍自己民族的风俗，连校长也亲自来听。其中有一位非洲同学说，在他们那个地区，跟老师说话时看老师的眼睛是不礼貌的。我仔细听了以后才知道，这些习惯在他们国家都很平常，就像我们过年要拜拜一样。这个活动改变了我的想法。从那天起，看到不一样的习惯，我不再马上批评，我会先观察、先问。我明白了，只有先了解别人的文化，才能真的跟他们交朋友，互相学习。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Huáyǔwén Zhōngxīn dǎgōng yǐjīng yì nián le. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ chángcháng juéde wàiguó xuéshēng de xíguàn hěn guài: yǒu de tóngxué shuōhuà de shēngyīn hěn dà, yǒu de tóngxué gēn lǎoshī shuōhuà de shíhòu bú kàn lǎoshī de yǎnjīng. Wǒ xīn lǐ cháng xiǎng: tāmen zhēn méiyǒu lǐmào. Hòulái zhōngxīn jǔbàn le yí cì jiāoliú huódòng, qǐng gè guó xuéshēng jièshào zìjǐ mínzú de fēngsú, lián xiàozhǎng yě qīnzì lái tīng. Qízhōng yǒu yí wèi Fēizhōu tóngxué shuō, zài tāmen nàge dìqū, gēn lǎoshī shuōhuà shí kàn lǎoshī de yǎnjīng shì bù lǐmào de. Wǒ zǐxì tīng le yǐhòu cái zhīdào, zhèxiē xíguàn zài tāmen guójiā dōu hěn píngcháng, jiù xiàng wǒmen guònián yào bàibai yíyàng. Zhège huódòng gǎibiàn le wǒ de xiǎngfǎ. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, kàndào bù yíyàng de xíguàn, wǒ bú zài mǎshàng pīpíng, wǒ huì xiān guānchá, xiān wèn. Wǒ míngbái le, zhǐyǒu xiān liǎojiě biérén de wénhuà, cái néng zhēn de gēn tāmen jiāo péngyǒu, hùxiāng xuéxí.
text.english: I have worked part-time at the Chinese Language Center for a year. At first I often found the foreign students' habits strange: some spoke very loudly, some didn't look the teacher in the eye when talking to them. I often thought to myself: how rude they are. Then the Center held an exchange event and asked students from each country to introduce their own people's customs, and even the principal came in person to listen. One of them, an African student, said that in his region looking a teacher in the eye while talking is rude. Only after listening carefully did I understand that these habits are ordinary in their countries, just as we pray at New Year. The event changed my thinking. From that day on, when I see a different habit I no longer criticize at once; I first watch and ask. I have understood that only by first understanding other people's culture can you really make friends with them and learn from each other.

text.traditional:
李老師：
您好！我來台灣已經兩個月了，現在住在一個台灣家庭裡。這家人對我很親切，週末常帶我去許多地方，像是夜市、老街和海邊，讓我認識了許多當地的特色。剛開始我最煩惱的是吃飯，因為很多菜我都沒看過。可是這家的媽媽說：「不嚐嚐看，怎麼知道好不好吃？」現在我什麼都敢吃了。在台灣小吃當中，我最愛的是臭豆腐，覺得它香得很。上個星期學校舉辦世界文化日，活動的內容很豐富，我邀請這家人來參觀，還請他們嚐我們國家的甜點。他們吃了都說好吃極了，連校長也來嚐了一口。這家的爸爸還說，連台灣的蛋糕都比不上。我非常感謝他們。下個月我就要回國了，真不想離開這個溫暖的家庭。
您的學生 安安
text.simplified:
李老师：
您好！我来台湾已经两个月了，现在住在一个台湾家庭里。这家人对我很亲切，周末常带我去许多地方，像是夜市、老街和海边，让我认识了许多当地的特色。刚开始我最烦恼的是吃饭，因为很多菜我都没看过。可是这家的妈妈说：「不尝尝看，怎么知道好不好吃？」现在我什么都敢吃了。在台湾小吃当中，我最爱的是臭豆腐，觉得它香得很。上个星期学校举办世界文化日，活动的内容很丰富，我邀请这家人来参观，还请他们尝我们国家的甜点。他们吃了都说好吃极了，连校长也来尝了一口。这家的爸爸还说，连台湾的蛋糕都比不上。我非常感谢他们。下个月我就要回国了，真不想离开这个温暖的家庭。
您的学生 安安
text.pinyin:
Lǐ lǎoshī:
Nín hǎo! Wǒ lái Táiwān yǐjīng liǎng ge yuè le, xiànzài zhù zài yí ge Táiwān jiātíng lǐ. Zhè jiā rén duì wǒ hěn qīnqiè, zhōumò cháng dài wǒ qù xǔduō dìfāng, xiàng shì yèshì, lǎo jiē hé hǎibiān, ràng wǒ rènshì le xǔduō dāngdì de tèsè. Gāng kāishǐ wǒ zuì fánnǎo de shì chīfàn, yīnwèi hěn duō cài wǒ dōu méi kàn guo. Kěshì zhè jiā de māma shuō: “Bù chángchang kàn, zěnme zhīdào hǎo bù hǎochī?” Xiànzài wǒ shénme dōu gǎn chī le. Zài Táiwān xiǎochī dāngzhōng, wǒ zuì ài de shì chòu dòufǔ, juéde tā xiāng dehěn. Shàng ge xīngqí xuéxiào jǔbàn Shìjiè Wénhuàrì, huódòng de nèiróng hěn fēngfù, wǒ yāoqǐng zhè jiā rén lái cānguān, hái qǐng tāmen cháng wǒmen guójiā de tiándiǎn. Tāmen chī le dōu shuō hǎochī jí le, lián xiàozhǎng yě lái cháng le yì kǒu. Zhè jiā de bàba hái shuō, lián Táiwān de dàngāo dōu bǐ bú shàng. Wǒ fēicháng gǎnxiè tāmen. Xià ge yuè wǒ jiù yào huí guó le, zhēn bù xiǎng líkāi zhège wēnnuǎn de jiātíng.
Nín de xuéshēng Ān'ān
text.english:
Dear Ms. Li,
How are you? I have been in Taiwan for two months and now live with a Taiwanese family. They are very warm to me and often take me to many places at the weekend, such as night markets, old streets and the seaside, and I have come to know many local features. At first meals worried me most, because I had never seen many of the dishes. But the mother of the family said, "If you don't taste it, how will you know whether it's good?" Now I dare to eat anything. Among Taiwanese snacks my favourite is stinky tofu; it smells great to me. Last week the school held World Culture Day, with a very rich programme. I invited the family to come, and had them taste a dessert from my country. They all said it was delicious, and even the principal came over for a taste. The father of the family said that not even Taiwanese cakes compare with it. I am very grateful to them. Next month I go home, and I really don't want to leave this warm family.
Your student, An'an

text.traditional: 我的室友是法國人，下個月就要回國了。我想送她一個有特別意義的禮物，就先問了班上同學的意見。有人推薦台灣茶，有人說可以送平板，可是平板太貴了，茶她又不常喝。我想了很久，覺得買的東西都不如自己做的值得紀念。所以，我用我們這一年的照片做了一部影片，從第一次見面到一起去夜市、一起過春節。影片的內容都是這一年當中我們一起做過的事。不管多忙，我每天晚上都做一點。送她影片那天，她一邊看一邊笑，眼睛都紅了，看得出來她非常感動。她說，除了家人，從來沒有人送過她這樣的禮物。
text.simplified: 我的室友是法国人，下个月就要回国了。我想送她一个有特别意义的礼物，就先问了班上同学的意见。有人推荐台湾茶，有人说可以送平板，可是平板太贵了，茶她又不常喝。我想了很久，觉得买的东西都不如自己做的值得纪念。所以，我用我们这一年的照片做了一部影片，从第一次见面到一起去夜市、一起过春节。影片的内容都是这一年当中我们一起做过的事。不管多忙，我每天晚上都做一点。送她影片那天，她一边看一边笑，眼睛都红了，看得出来她非常感动。她说，除了家人，从来没有人送过她这样的礼物。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu shì Fǎguó rén, xià ge yuè jiù yào huí guó le. Wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge yǒu tèbié yìyì de lǐwù, jiù xiān wèn le bān shàng tóngxué de yìjiàn. Yǒu rén tuījiàn Táiwān chá, yǒu rén shuō kěyǐ sòng píngbǎn, kěshì píngbǎn tài guì le, chá tā yòu bù cháng hē. Wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, juéde mǎi de dōngxi dōu bùrú zìjǐ zuò de zhídé jìniàn. Suǒyǐ, wǒ yòng wǒmen zhè yì nián de zhàopiàn zuò le yí bù yǐngpiàn, cóng dì yī cì jiànmiàn dào yìqǐ qù yèshì, yìqǐ guò Chūnjié. Yǐngpiàn de nèiróng dōu shì zhè yì nián dāngzhōng wǒmen yìqǐ zuò guo de shì. Bùguǎn duō máng, wǒ měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu zuò yìdiǎn. Sòng tā yǐngpiàn nà tiān, tā yìbiān kàn yìbiān xiào, yǎnjīng dōu hóng le, kàn de chūlái tā fēicháng gǎndòng. Tā shuō, chúle jiārén, cónglái méiyǒu rén sòng guo tā zhèyàng de lǐwù.
text.english: My roommate is French and goes home next month. I wanted to give her a present with special meaning, so first I asked my classmates what they thought. Some recommended Taiwanese tea, some said a tablet, but a tablet was too expensive and she doesn't often drink tea. After thinking for a long time, I felt that nothing bought is as worth keeping as something you make yourself. So I made our photos from this year into a video, from the first time we met to going to night markets and spending Spring Festival together. Everything in it was something we had done together that year. However busy I was, I worked on it a little every evening. The day I gave her the video, she laughed as she watched and her eyes went red; you could see she was deeply moved. She said that apart from her family, nobody had ever given her a present like this.

text.traditional: 上個週末，我跟幾位不同國家的同學坐火車去花蓮。出發那天早上，台北的天氣好極了，大家都很興奮。誰知道一到花蓮，就忽然下起大雨來，我們只好走進火車站附近的一家小吃店，等雨停。店裡的老闆是一位老太太，她看我們是外國人，就親自教我們做當地的特色小吃，還很熱心地說明每一種小吃的做法。要不是那場雨，我們也不會認識這麼熱心的人。下午，雨一停，我們就馬上去海邊走走。回台北以前，老太太還送了我們一盒名產，要我們帶回去慢慢吃。這次旅行雖然有一半的時間在下雨，可是我覺得非常值得，比哪一次都好玩。
text.simplified: 上个周末，我跟几位不同国家的同学坐火车去花莲。出发那天早上，台北的天气好极了，大家都很兴奋。谁知道一到花莲，就忽然下起大雨来，我们只好走进火车站附近的一家小吃店，等雨停。店里的老板是一位老太太，她看我们是外国人，就亲自教我们做当地的特色小吃，还很热心地说明每一种小吃的做法。要不是那场雨，我们也不会认识这么热心的人。下午，雨一停，我们就马上去海边走走。回台北以前，老太太还送了我们一盒名产，要我们带回去慢慢吃。这次旅行虽然有一半的时间在下雨，可是我觉得非常值得，比哪一次都好玩。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ gēn jǐ wèi bùtóng guójiā de tóngxué zuò huǒchē qù Huālián. Chūfā nà tiān zǎoshàng, Táiběi de tiānqì hǎo jí le, dàjiā dōu hěn xīngfèn. Shéi zhīdào yí dào Huālián, jiù hūrán xià qǐ dà yǔ lái, wǒmen zhǐhǎo zǒu jìn huǒchēzhàn fùjìn de yì jiā xiǎochī diàn, děng yǔ tíng. Diàn lǐ de lǎobǎn shì yí wèi lǎo tàitai, tā kàn wǒmen shì wàiguó rén, jiù qīnzì jiāo wǒmen zuò dāngdì de tèsè xiǎochī, hái hěn rèxīn de shuōmíng měi yì zhǒng xiǎochī de zuòfǎ. Yàobúshì nà cháng yǔ, wǒmen yě bú huì rènshì zhème rèxīn de rén. Xiàwǔ, yǔ yì tíng, wǒmen jiù mǎshàng qù hǎibiān zǒuzou. Huí Táiběi yǐqián, lǎo tàitai hái sòng le wǒmen yì hé míngchǎn, yào wǒmen dài huíqù mànmàn chī. Zhè cì lǚxíng suīrán yǒu yíbàn de shíjiān zài xià yǔ, kěshì wǒ juéde fēicháng zhídé, bǐ nǎ yí cì dōu hǎowán.
text.english: Last weekend I took the train to Hualien with a few classmates from different countries. On the morning we left, the weather in Taipei was wonderful and everyone was excited. Who knew that as soon as we reached Hualien it would suddenly start pouring, so we had to go into a snack shop near the station to wait for the rain to stop. The owner was an old lady who, seeing we were foreigners, taught us herself how to make the local speciality snacks, and kindly explained how each one is made. If it hadn't been for that rain, we would never have met such a kind person. In the afternoon, as soon as the rain stopped, we went straight to the seaside for a walk. Before we went back to Taipei, she even gave us a box of local specialties to take back and enjoy. Although it rained for half of the trip, I think it was well worth it, more fun than any other time.

Took the train back to Taipei
Bought specialties to take back
Went for a walk by the sea

questions.why: 雨一停，我們就馬上去海邊走走: 一……就…… puts the walk right when the rain stopped, so the seaside came first. Going back to Taipei came later, the snack lesson was while it rained, and the specialties were a gift from the lady, not bought.
